zh.tag: 阿里内部验证的混合架构 AI 代码审查 CLI 工具
zh.what: Open Code Review 是阿里巴巴内部孵化并开源的 AI 代码审查命令行工具，采用确定性流水线加 LLM Agent 的混合架构。它能在代码行级别给出精确评论，并内置 NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL 注入等多语言规则集。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 编写，提供 CLI 主程序、内置规则集与 Agent 集成配置，并附带官网、多语言 README 与 npm 包发布脚本。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，通过 npm 包 @alibaba-group/open-code-review 分发，兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 接口，并支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent。
zh.hot: 背靠阿里内部两年、数万开发者与数百万缺陷的实战验证，加上 22734 星、今日新增 264 星并登上 Go 日榜第 11 名，关注度持续攀升。
uses: 希望把 AI 代码审查接入 CI/CD 的工程团队
使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent 的开发者
需要 NPE、线程安全、SQL 注入等规则检查的 Go/多语言项目
想借鉴混合架构与规则集设计的 AI 工具开发者

en.tag: Alibaba's battle-tested hybrid-architecture AI code review CLI
en.what: Open Code Review is an open-sourced AI code review CLI incubated inside Alibaba, combining deterministic pipelines with an LLM Agent. It produces precise line-level comments and ships with a built-in multi-language ruleset covering NPE, thread-safety, XSS and SQL injection.
en.content: Written in Go, the repo contains the CLI, built-in rule sets and agent integration configs, plus a website, multilingual READMEs and npm publishing setup.
en.stack: Primary language is Go, distributed via the npm package @alibaba-group/open-code-review, compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and integrates with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
en.hot: Backed by two years of internal Alibaba use by tens of thousands of developers and millions of defects found, it has reached 22,734 stars with 264 added today, ranking 11th on the Go daily trending list.
uses: Engineering teams wanting AI code review in CI/CD
Developers using Claude Code, Codex or Cursor agents
Go and multi-language projects needing NPE, thread-safety and SQL injection checks
AI tool builders studying hybrid architecture and ruleset design

zh.tag: 将编码代理转变为多阶段安全审计员的技能
zh.what: 这是一个编码代理技能，通过侦察、覆盖导向狩猎、候选验证、结构化输出、独立记录验证和目标中立报告六个阶段，将代理转变为安全审计员。它编排隔离的代理进行漏洞发现，并生成机器可读的发现记录。
zh.content: 仓库包含 SKILL.md 主技能文件，以及针对不同阶段的提示文件如 RECONNAISSANCE.md、HUNTING.md、ATTACK-CLASSES.md，还有针对特定领域的 MEMORY-SAFETY-AND-BINARY.md、AI-AND-LLM.md、WEB-PROTOCOL-AND-AUTH.md、CLIENT-SIDE.md 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 Node.js 运行验证脚本（如 validate-coverage-ledger.cjs 和 validate-findings.cjs），并遵循 JSON 模式进行结构化输出。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 1434 颗星，总星数达 5126，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 JavaScript 第 9 名。它源自 Cloudflare 的漏洞发现工具链，提供了可复用的安全审计技能，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 安全工程师和渗透测试人员 —— 利用代理自动化多阶段安全审计，提高漏洞发现效率。
AI 代理开发者 —— 集成此技能到编码代理中，增强其安全审计能力。
DevSecOps 团队 —— 在 CI/CD 流程中自动执行安全审计，生成结构化报告。
安全研究人员 —— 基于此技能构建自定义漏洞挖掘工具链。

en.tag: A coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a multi-phase security auditor
en.what: This is a coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a security auditor by orchestrating isolated agents through six phases: reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting. It produces machine-readable findings with independently verified claims.
en.content: The repo contains SKILL.md as the main skill file, along with phase-specific prompt files like RECONNAISSANCE.md, HUNTING.md, ATTACK-CLASSES.md, and domain-specific files such as MEMORY-SAFETY-AND-BINARY.md, AI-AND-LLM.md, WEB-PROTOCOL-AND-AUTH.md, and CLIENT-SIDE.md.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, it relies on Node.js for validation scripts (e.g., validate-coverage-ledger.cjs and validate-findings.cjs) and uses JSON schemas for structured output.
en.hot: It gained 1,434 stars today, reaching 5,126 total, and ranked 9th on GitHub Trending (JavaScript). It originated from Cloudflare's vulnerability discovery harness, offering a reusable security audit skill that has attracted significant attention.
uses: Security engineers and penetration testers — automate multi-phase security audits with agents to improve vulnerability discovery efficiency.
AI agent developers — integrate this skill into coding agents to enhance their security auditing capabilities.
DevSecOps teams — automate security audits in CI/CD pipelines and generate structured reports.
Security researchers — build custom vulnerability hunting harnesses based on this skill.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编程代理提供生产级工程技能包
zh.what: 这是一套面向 AI 编程代理的工程技能库，把资深工程师的工作流、质量门禁和最佳实践编码成可复用的技能。它覆盖从需求定义到上线的完整开发生命周期，让代理在每个阶段都遵循一致的标准。
zh.content: 仓库以技能包形式组织，包含 25 个技能和 9 个斜杠命令（如 /spec、/plan、/build、/test、/review、/ship），每个命令会自动激活对应技能。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，通过开放的 skills CLI（npx skills add）安装，可接入 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Copilot、Cline 等 70 多个代理。
zh.hot: 凭借 Addy Osmani 的影响力与 AI 编程代理热潮，项目已获 94,344 颗星，今日新增 354 星，位列 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 3 名。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理的开发者，希望代理遵循统一工程规范
团队想为 AI 辅助开发引入质量门禁与标准化工作流
个人开发者需要从需求到上线的结构化开发流程模板
对 AI 代理技能包设计感兴趣、想学习或二次开发的人

en.tag: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents
en.what: A collection of engineering skills that encode the workflows, quality gates, and best practices senior engineers use, packaged so AI coding agents follow them consistently. It spans the full development lifecycle from defining requirements to shipping to production.
en.content: The repo is organized as skill packages, offering 25 skills and 9 slash commands (e.g. /spec, /plan, /build, /test, /review, /ship), each automatically activating the relevant skills.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, installed via the open skills CLI (npx skills add) and compatible with 70+ agents including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, and Cline.
en.hot: Backed by Addy Osmani's reputation and the AI coding agent boom, it has reached 94,344 stars with 354 added today, ranking #3 on GitHub Trending (JavaScript) daily.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor who want consistent engineering standards
Teams looking to add quality gates and standardized workflows to AI-assisted development
Individual developers wanting a structured spec-to-ship development process
Anyone curious about designing AI agent skill packages or wanting to extend them

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理借用你已登录的真实浏览器，不打断你的工作
zh.what: BrowserSkill 通过 CLI 加浏览器扩展，把 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等任意能调用 shell 的 AI 代理连接到你已经登录的浏览器。代理需要操作某个已打开的标签页时必须显式借用，任务完成后归还，不影响你其余浏览。
zh.content: 仓库包含 bsk CLI/守护进程与浏览器扩展两部分运行时，以及安装文档、全页截图指南、沙箱代理配置等 docs 目录。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，支持 macOS、Linux、Windows，浏览器端支持 Chrome 与 Edge 等 Chromium 内核扩展。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1302 star、总数 4149，冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 4，切中了代理复用真实登录态与人工接管的刚需。
uses: 用 Cursor、Claude Code 等代理自动操作已登录网站的个人开发者
需要代理处理验证码、登录等人工步骤并随时接管的团队
希望避免维护独立测试账号与登录态的自动化工程师
在沙箱环境中运行代理、需要持久守护进程的进阶用户

en.tag: Let AI agents borrow your real, logged-in browser without interrupting your work
en.what: BrowserSkill connects shell-capable AI agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex to your already logged-in browser via a CLI plus extension. Agents must explicitly borrow an open tab, return it when done, and leave the rest of your browser untouched.
en.content: The repo ships two local runtimes — the bsk CLI/daemon and a browser extension — plus docs for installation, full-page screenshots, and sandboxed agent setup.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript; runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows, with Chrome and Edge (Chromium-based) extension support.
en.hot: With 1,302 stars added today and 4,149 total, it hit #4 on GitHub Trending, tapping the real need for agents to reuse live login state with human-in-the-loop handoff.
uses: Individual developers automating logged-in sites with Cursor, Claude Code, or similar agents
Teams needing agents to pause for captcha or login and hand control back to a human
Engineers who want to avoid maintaining separate test accounts and login states
Advanced users running agents in sandboxes who need a persistent daemon

zh.tag: 本地优先的并行科研智能体工作台
zh.what: OpenResearch 把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等编码智能体改造成科研助手，可自动做文献综述、提出假设、跑实验并产出研究产物。它支持多个智能体并行探索不同研究方向，并用 git 原生实验树记录每次运行的不可变快照。
zh.content: 仓库提供桌面应用与 CLI（orx），包含本地仪表盘、实验树管理、技能安装（orx install-skills）以及远程/集群运行支持，另附本地模型接入文档。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写，提供 macOS/Linux 安装脚本，可对接 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 及 LM Studio、Ollama 等本地模型端点。
zh.hot: 上线不久即获约 990 星、单日新增 210 星并登上 Rust 日榜第 3，契合了「让编码智能体自动做科研」这一热门方向。
uses: 想用 AI 智能体自动化文献调研与实验迭代的研究者
需要并行探索多个技术方向并保证实验可复现的工程团队
希望在本地或自有 GPU 集群上运行智能体、掌控数据的开发者
想把 Claude Code、Codex 等编码智能体接入科研工作流的 AI 工具爱好者

en.tag: Local-first workspace for parallel research agents
en.what: OpenResearch turns coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode into research agents that can review literature, form hypotheses, run experiments, and produce research artifacts. It lets multiple agents explore directions in parallel while a git-native experiment tree preserves each run's immutable snapshot.
en.content: The repo ships a desktop app plus an orx CLI, including a local dashboard, experiment-tree management, skill installation (orx install-skills), and remote/cluster execution support, along with docs for connecting local models.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it offers macOS/Linux install scripts and integrates with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, plus local model endpoints like LM Studio and Ollama.
en.hot: It quickly reached ~990 stars with 210 added in a day and ranked #3 on the Rust daily trending list, riding the hot wave of using coding agents for automated research.
uses: Researchers who want AI agents to automate literature review and experiment iteration
Engineering teams needing parallel exploration with reproducible experiments
Developers who want to run agents locally or on their own GPU clusters while owning their data
AI tooling enthusiasts looking to plug Claude Code, Codex, and similar agents into research workflows

zh.tag: 终端里的智能体编程助手，用自然语言写代码
zh.what: Claude Code 是 Anthropic 推出的智能体编程工具，常驻终端，能理解你的代码库。它通过自然语言指令执行日常任务、解释复杂代码并处理 git 工作流，帮助开发者更快编码。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含安装脚本、插件目录（提供自定义命令与智能体扩展）以及演示动图，官方文档托管在外部站点。
zh.stack: 核心以 TypeScript 编写，要求 Node.js 18+，支持 curl、Homebrew、WinGet、PowerShell 等多种安装方式（npm 已弃用）。
zh.hot: 作为 Anthropic 官方出品的智能体编程工具，它已积累 145,507 颗星，今日再增 165 星并登上日榜第 11 名，持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 希望用自然语言加速日常编码与重构的开发者
需要在终端内处理 git 工作流和代码解释的工程师
想通过插件扩展自定义命令与智能体的进阶用户

en.tag: An agentic coding tool living in your terminal, coding via natural language
en.what: Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal and understands your codebase. It executes routine tasks, explains complex code, and handles git workflows through natural language commands, helping developers code faster.
en.content: The repo mainly contains install scripts, a plugins directory (offering custom commands and agent extensions), and a demo GIF, with official docs hosted externally.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, it requires Node.js 18+ and supports multiple install methods like curl, Homebrew, WinGet, and PowerShell (npm is deprecated).
en.hot: As Anthropic's official agentic coding tool, it has amassed 145,507 stars, gaining 165 more today and ranking 11th on the daily trending list, drawing steady developer attention.
uses: Developers who want to speed up daily coding and refactoring with natural language
Engineers handling git workflows and code explanations inside the terminal
Advanced users extending custom commands and agents via plugins

zh.tag: 美国国安局开源的顶级软件逆向工程框架
zh.what: Ghidra 是由美国国家安全局研究局创建并维护的软件逆向工程（SRE）框架，提供反汇编、汇编、反编译、图形化与脚本等一整套高端分析工具。它支持多种处理器指令集与可执行格式，可在 Windows、macOS、Linux 上以交互或自动化模式运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Ghidra 源码，按功能模块划分（如 Features/Base 等），并附带构建脚本、扩展组件与文档。用户可用 Java 或 Python 开发自定义扩展和脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Java 开发，构建依赖 JDK 25、Gradle 9.1.0+，并需要 Python3（3.9–3.14）以及 GCC/Clang 和 make（Linux/macOS）。
zh.hot: 作为 NSA 开源的重量级逆向工具，Ghidra 长期是安全研究者的首选，已积累 76710 颗星，今日新增 725 星并登上 GitHub 日榜第 8 名。
uses: 安全研究员与逆向工程师，用于分析恶意软件和挖掘漏洞
CTF 参赛者与漏洞赏金猎人，快速反编译和调试二进制文件
企业安全团队，在自动化模式下批量分析可疑样本
开发者与研究人员，基于 Java/Python 扩展自定义分析插件

en.tag: NSA's open-source, high-end software reverse engineering framework
en.what: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework created and maintained by the NSA Research Directorate, offering a full suite of high-end analysis tools including disassembly, assembly, decompilation, graphing, and scripting. It supports a wide range of processor instruction sets and executable formats, and runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux in both interactive and automated modes.
en.content: The repository holds the complete Ghidra source, organized into feature modules (such as Features/Base), along with build scripts, extension components, and documentation. Users can develop custom extensions and scripts in Java or Python.
en.stack: Primarily written in Java, it builds with JDK 25 and Gradle 9.1.0+, and requires Python3 (3.9–3.14) plus GCC/Clang and make on Linux/macOS.
en.hot: As a heavyweight reverse engineering tool open-sourced by the NSA, Ghidra has long been a top choice for security researchers, accumulating 76,710 stars with 725 added today, ranking 8th on GitHub's daily trending list.
uses: Security researchers and reverse engineers analyzing malware and uncovering vulnerabilities
CTF players and bug bounty hunters quickly decompiling and debugging binaries
Enterprise security teams batch-analyzing suspicious samples in automated mode
Developers and researchers extending custom analysis plugins in Java/Python

zh.tag: 面向知识工作者的 Claude 插件集，按职能定制 AI 工作流
zh.what: 这是 Anthropic 开源的一套 Claude 插件，旨在将 Claude 转变为特定角色、团队和公司的专家。每个插件捆绑了技能、连接器、斜杠命令和子代理，覆盖销售、产品、营销、法律等 11 种职能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 11 个职能插件目录（如 productivity、sales、customer-support 等），每个目录内有技能定义、连接器配置、斜杠命令和子代理。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，依赖 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code 平台，并集成 Slack、Notion、Jira 等第三方连接器。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 110 星，总星数达 24287，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 7 名，反映出知识工作者对 AI 提效工具的强烈需求。
uses: 知识工作者：通过插件快速获得角色专属的 AI 助手，提升日常工作效率。
团队负责人：定制插件以统一团队工作流程和术语，确保输出一致性。
企业开发者：基于开源插件进行二次开发，集成内部工具和数据源。
Claude 用户：利用现成插件扩展 Claude 功能，无需从零构建。

en.tag: Claude plugins for knowledge workers, customizing AI workflows by job function
en.what: Anthropic open-sources a set of Claude plugins designed to turn Claude into a specialist for your role, team, and company. Each plugin bundles skills, connectors, slash commands, and sub-agents for specific job functions like sales, product, marketing, legal, and more.
en.content: The repo contains 11 job-function plugin directories (e.g., productivity, sales, customer-support), each with skill definitions, connector configurations, slash commands, and sub-agents.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, it relies on Claude Cowork and Claude Code platforms, and integrates third-party connectors like Slack, Notion, and Jira.
en.hot: With 110 stars added today and a total of 24,287 stars, it ranks 7th on GitHub Trending daily, reflecting strong demand for AI productivity tools among knowledge workers.
uses: Knowledge workers: get role-specific AI assistance to boost daily productivity.
Team leads: customize plugins to unify workflows and terminology for consistent output.
Enterprise developers: extend open-source plugins to integrate internal tools and data.
Claude users: leverage ready-made plugins to expand Claude's capabilities without building from scratch.

zh.tag: 把文档变成可查询RAG、自主推理Agent和自维护Wiki的LLM知识平台
zh.what: WeKnora是腾讯开源的LLM知识平台，将原始文档转化为可查询的RAG、自主推理的Agent和自维护的Wiki。它支持多源数据导入、树状文件夹视图、块编辑与版本回滚，并提供交互式知识图谱。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、架构文档、API参考、开发者指南，以及多语言README（中英日韩）。核心功能包括RAG快速问答、ReAct Agent、Wiki模式、知识图谱、多源导入（飞书、Notion、语雀、RSS等）和网站嵌入组件。
zh.stack: 主语言为Go，基于LLM能力构建，涉及RAG、ReAct Agent、MCP工具集成、向量检索等技术。支持多种文档格式和外部服务（如飞书、Notion、RSS）。
zh.hot: 上线后迅速获得2万+星标，今日新增105星，位列GitHub Go语言日榜第5。其将文档自动转化为可交互知识图谱和自维护Wiki的能力，解决了企业知识管理的痛点，备受开发者关注。
uses: 企业知识库建设：将内部文档自动整理为可查询的RAG和自维护Wiki，提升员工检索效率。
智能客服与问答系统：利用RAG快速问答能力，构建基于私有知识的对话机器人。
复杂任务自动化：通过ReAct Agent编排检索、工具调用和网络搜索，完成多步骤分析。
个人知识管理：导入个人文档，生成知识图谱和Wiki，辅助学习和研究。

en.tag: Open-source LLM knowledge platform turning documents into queryable RAG, autonomous agent, and self-maintaining Wiki
en.what: WeKnora is an open-source LLM knowledge platform from Tencent that transforms raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki. It supports multi-source ingestion, tree-structured folder views, chunk editing with revision history, and an interactive knowledge graph.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, architecture docs, API reference, developer guide, and multi-language READMEs (EN, CN, JA, KO). Key features include RAG-based Q&A, ReAct Agent, Wiki mode, knowledge graph, multi-source ingestion (Feishu, Notion, Yuque, RSS, etc.), and website embed widgets.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on LLM capabilities, incorporating RAG, ReAct Agent, MCP tool integration, and vector retrieval. Supports various document formats and external services like Feishu, Notion, and RSS.
en.hot: Quickly gained over 20k stars with 105 new stars today, ranking #5 on GitHub Go daily trending. Its ability to auto-convert documents into interactive knowledge graphs and self-maintaining wikis addresses enterprise knowledge management pain points, drawing significant developer attention.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base: Automatically organize internal documents into queryable RAG and self-maintaining Wiki to boost employee retrieval efficiency.
Intelligent customer service and Q&A systems: Leverage RAG-based quick Q&A to build chatbots grounded in private knowledge.
Complex task automation: Use ReAct Agent to orchestrate retrieval, tool calls, and web search for multi-step analysis.
Personal knowledge management: Import personal documents to generate knowledge graphs and wikis for learning and research.

zh.tag: 原生 macOS 启动器：热键、剪贴板历史，内存不到 100MB
zh.what: Tinycast 是一款完全原生的 macOS 启动器，用一个全局热键呼出命令面板，快速启动应用、搜索文件、查看剪贴板历史。它还内置计算器、快捷链接、Snippets 和 Apple 快捷指令，并能运行真实的 Raycast 扩展。
zh.content: 仓库为 Swift 编写的 macOS 应用源码，包含 SwiftUI/AppKit 界面、启动器与热键逻辑、剪贴板历史、Spotlight 文件搜索、计算器、Quicklinks、Snippets 等模块，并附有截图与文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Swift 6.0 与 SwiftUI/AppKit 构建，零第三方依赖，无 Electron、无遥测，要求 macOS 26 及以上，采用 AGPL-3.0 许可。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1179 星、总星 5595，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 4。它切中了用户对轻量、原生、无 Electron 的 macOS 启动器的需求，还兼容 Raycast 扩展。
uses: macOS 用户想用轻量原生启动器替代 Raycast/Alfred
注重隐私、不希望有遥测或 Electron 开销的开发者
需要剪贴板历史、快捷链接和 Snippets 的效率工具爱好者
想用 Swift 学习原生 macOS 应用开发的开发者

en.tag: A tiny native macOS launcher with hotkeys and clipboard history under 100 MB RAM
en.what: Tinycast is a fully native macOS launcher that summons a command palette with one global hotkey to launch apps, search files, and browse clipboard history. It also packs a calculator, quicklinks, snippets, Apple Shortcuts, and can run real Raycast extensions.
en.content: The repo contains the Swift source of a macOS app, including SwiftUI/AppKit UI, launcher and hotkey logic, clipboard history, Spotlight file search, calculator, Quicklinks, and Snippets modules, plus screenshots and docs.
en.stack: Built with Swift 6.0 and SwiftUI/AppKit, zero third-party dependencies, no Electron and no telemetry, requires macOS 26+, licensed under AGPL-3.0.
en.hot: It gained 1,179 stars today (5,595 total) and hit #4 on GitHub Trending daily. It taps demand for a lightweight, native, Electron-free macOS launcher that also runs Raycast extensions.
uses: macOS users seeking a lightweight native launcher to replace Raycast/Alfred
Developers who care about privacy and avoiding telemetry or Electron overhead
Power users wanting clipboard history, quicklinks, and snippets
Developers learning native macOS app development with Swift

zh.tag: 基于eBPF的云原生网络、安全与可观测性平台
zh.what: Cilium 是一个基于 eBPF 数据平面的网络、可观测性和安全解决方案。它提供简单的扁平三层网络，支持多集群原生路由或覆盖模式，并具备 L7 协议感知能力，可基于身份模型实施 L3-L7 网络策略。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cilium 核心组件（如 agent、operator、CNI 插件）、eBPF 数据平面代码、文档、测试和部署清单。主要目录有 daemon、pkg、bpf、Documentation、operator 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Linux 内核 eBPF 技术，需要较新内核版本（通常 4.19+）。项目使用 Kubernetes 作为主要编排平台，并集成 Prometheus、Envoy 等生态组件。
zh.hot: Cilium 是 CNCF 毕业项目，拥有 25k+ stars，今日新增 20 stars，位列 Go 趋势榜第 20 名。作为 Kubernetes 网络、安全和可观测性的领先方案，它持续受到云原生社区的高度关注。
uses: Kubernetes 集群管理员：需要高性能、可扩展的网络方案来替代 kube-proxy。
云原生安全工程师：希望实施基于身份的网络策略和 L7 层安全控制。
平台运维团队：需要深度网络可观测性和故障排查能力。
服务网格架构师：寻求集成 ingress/egress 网关和带宽管理的一体化方案。

en.tag: eBPF-based networking, security, and observability for cloud native
en.what: Cilium is a networking, observability, and security solution with an eBPF-based dataplane. It provides a simple flat Layer 3 network that can span multiple clusters in native routing or overlay mode, and is L7-protocol aware, enforcing network policies on L3-L7 using an identity-based security model.
en.content: The repository contains Cilium core components (such as agent, operator, CNI plugin), eBPF dataplane code, documentation, tests, and deployment manifests. Main directories include daemon, pkg, bpf, Documentation, operator, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on Linux kernel eBPF technology and requiring a relatively new kernel (typically 4.19+). The project uses Kubernetes as the main orchestration platform and integrates with ecosystem components like Prometheus and Envoy.
en.hot: Cilium is a CNCF graduated project with 25k+ stars, gaining 20 stars today and ranking 20th on the Go trending list. As a leading solution for Kubernetes networking, security, and observability, it continues to attract significant attention from the cloud native community.
uses: Kubernetes cluster administrators: need a high-performance, scalable networking solution to replace kube-proxy.
Cloud native security engineers: want to implement identity-based network policies and L7 security controls.
Platform operations teams: require deep network observability and troubleshooting capabilities.
Service mesh architects: seek an integrated solution with ingress/egress gateways and bandwidth management.

zh.tag: 本地优先的开源 AI 语音工作室：克隆、合成、听写
zh.what: Voicebox 是一个本地运行的 AI 语音工作室，可替代 ElevenLabs 与 WisprFlow。它支持用几秒音频克隆音色、在 7 个 TTS 引擎和 23 种语言中生成语音，并通过全局快捷键向任意输入框听写。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用本体、landing 官网与 docs 文档站，并附带应用截图与图标资源，同时提供 API 与 MCP 集成说明。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，采用本地优先架构，内置本地 LLM 用于文本润色与角色人格，并打包多个 TTS 引擎。
zh.hot: 以 54,383 星、单日新增 417 星冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 5，靠的是把语音输入与输出两条链路合并进一个免费本地应用。
uses: 内容创作者：用几秒样本克隆音色，为视频和播客批量生成多语言配音
开发者与 AI 工程师：通过 API 或 MCP 为智能体接入自有音色
注重隐私的用户：模型、语音数据与录音全部留在本机，不上传云端
效率办公人群：用全局快捷键在任意应用中语音听写代替打字

en.tag: The local-first open-source AI voice studio: clone, generate, dictate
en.what: Voicebox is a local-first AI voice studio positioned as a free, open-source alternative to ElevenLabs and WisprFlow. It clones voices from a few seconds of audio, generates speech across 7 TTS engines and 23 languages, and dictates into any text field via a global hotkey.
en.content: The repo ships the desktop app itself plus a landing site and a docs site, along with app screenshots and icon assets, and documents an API and MCP integration.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript with a local-first architecture, it bundles a local LLM for refinement and per-profile personas alongside multiple TTS engines.
en.hot: With 54,383 stars and 417 gained today, it hit #5 on GitHub Trending by merging both halves of the voice I/O loop into one free local app.
uses: Content creators: clone a voice from a few seconds and batch-generate multilingual voiceovers for video and podcasts
Developers and AI engineers: wire custom voices into agents via the API or MCP
Privacy-conscious users: models, voice data and captures all stay on the local machine
Productivity users: dictate into any app with a global hotkey instead of typing

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理打造的性能优化与安全增强系统
zh.what: ECC 是一个代理工具链（harness）优化系统，为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、直觉、记忆、安全与研究优先的开发能力。它通过统一的配置与插件机制，增强代理在复杂任务中的表现与可控性。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 JavaScript 库、CLI 工具、GitHub App（ecc-tools）、文档（多语言 README）以及示例配置，支持通过 npm 包（ecc-universal）集成。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js，依赖 npm 生态，提供 CLI 与 GitHub App 集成，支持多代理框架（Claude Code、Codex 等）。
zh.hot: 凭借 24.4 万 Star 和今日新增 235 星，ECC 成为 AI 代理工具链领域的明星项目，其跨代理兼容性和性能优化特性吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: AI 编码代理用户：希望增强 Claude Code、Codex 等代理的记忆、安全与技能，提升开发效率。
团队与组织：需要统一管理多个 AI 代理的配置、权限与安全策略，确保合规与可控。
开发者工具链爱好者：对代理性能优化、插件机制和 GitHub App 集成感兴趣，可扩展自定义功能。

en.tag: Performance optimization and security enhancement system for AI coding agents like Claude Code
en.what: ECC is an agent harness optimization system that provides skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development capabilities for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. It enhances agent performance and control through unified configuration and plugin mechanisms.
en.content: The repository includes core JavaScript libraries, CLI tools, a GitHub App (ecc-tools), multi-language documentation, and example configurations, integrable via the npm package (ecc-universal).
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, leveraging the npm ecosystem, offering CLI and GitHub App integration, compatible with multiple agent frameworks (Claude Code, Codex, etc.).
en.hot: With 244k stars and 235 new stars today, ECC has become a star project in the AI agent toolchain space, attracting developers with its cross-agent compatibility and performance optimization features.
uses: AI coding agent users: Enhance memory, security, and skills for agents like Claude Code and Codex to boost development productivity.
Teams and organizations: Need unified management of configurations, permissions, and security policies across multiple AI agents for compliance and control.
Developer toolchain enthusiasts: Interested in agent performance optimization, plugin mechanisms, and GitHub App integration for custom extensions.

zh.tag: 可复用的计算机视觉工具库，模型无关的检测与标注工具箱
zh.what: Supervision 是 Roboflow 开源的计算机视觉工具库，提供从数据加载、模型推理结果解析到实时区域计数、标注可视化的一整套可复用组件。它不绑定具体模型，可接入任意分类、检测或分割模型，让开发者专注于应用逻辑。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 包形式发布，包含 Detections 数据结构、丰富的 Annotators 标注器、数据集工具以及 Colab 笔记本和教程，并配套文档站点。
zh.stack: 基于 Python（>=3.10），通过 pip 安装，依赖 NumPy、OpenCV 等，并提供与 Ultralytics、Transformers 等主流推理库的连接器。
zh.hot: Star 数已突破 5 万，今日新增 217，位列 GitHub Trending Python 日榜第 13 名，说明它已成为 CV 应用开发的事实标准工具之一。
uses: 计算机视觉工程师快速搭建检测、分割与追踪应用原型
需要在视频流中做区域计数、越线检测等实时分析的开发者
希望统一处理不同模型输出并可视化标注结果的研究者
想学习 CV 工程实践的学生与爱好者，可借助教程和笔记本上手

en.tag: Reusable computer vision toolkit with model-agnostic detection and annotation utilities
en.what: Supervision is Roboflow's open-source computer vision toolkit offering reusable building blocks from data loading and model output parsing to real-time zone counting and annotation visualization. It is model-agnostic, plugging into any classification, detection, or segmentation model so developers can focus on their applications.
en.content: The repo ships as a Python package containing the Detections data structure, a rich set of Annotators, dataset utilities, Colab notebooks and tutorials, plus a documentation site.
en.stack: Built on Python (>=3.10), installable via pip, depending on NumPy, OpenCV and more, with connectors for popular inference libraries like Ultralytics and Transformers.
en.hot: With over 50k stars and 217 added today, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending (Python), it has become a de facto standard toolkit for CV application development.
uses: CV engineers prototyping detection, segmentation and tracking applications
Developers needing real-time analytics like zone counting and line crossing on video streams
Researchers wanting unified handling of model outputs and annotation visualization
Students and hobbyists learning CV engineering via tutorials and notebooks

zh.tag: 纯 C 零依赖引擎，把 744B~2.8T MoE 大模型跑在消费级硬件上
zh.what: Colibrì 是一个纯 C 编写、零引擎依赖的 MoE 推理引擎，把显存、内存和磁盘当作统一的多级推理层级，让 744B 到 2.8T 参数的前沿 MoE 模型能在消费级与异构硬件上运行。它同时是开放研究平台，追求推理侧软硬件边界的性能优化，并承诺绝不悄悄改变模型精度或路由语义。
zh.content: 仓库包含每个模型家族一个 C 文件的实现（GLM-5.x、Kimi K3、DeepSeek V4.x、Qwen3.x、OLMoE 等九大家族），统一的 coli chat / coli serve / coli web 前端，以及带实时指标、专家分层和“大脑”可视化的 Web 仪表盘。
zh.stack: 纯 C 实现，零引擎依赖，专家权重从磁盘流式加载；支持 int4 量化，可在 CPU 与多卡 GPU（如 6× RTX 5090）混合环境中运行。
zh.hot: 它以“小引擎跑超大模型”的极简路线直击显存焦虑，29840 颗星、今日 +868 登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜第一，说明本地跑前沿大模型的需求极其旺盛。
uses: 想在本地或自有硬件上跑 744B+ MoE 大模型的个人与实验室研究者
关注推理引擎、内存分层、存储 I/O 与 CPU/GPU 重叠等系统优化的工程师
需要在消费级 GPU 或异构集群上低成本部署大模型的团队
对量化、专家流式加载与投机解码等前沿推理技术感兴趣的学习者

en.tag: Pure C, zero-dep engine running 744B–2.8T MoE models on consumer hardware
en.what: Colibrì is a pure-C, zero-dependency MoE inference engine that treats VRAM, RAM and storage as one multitier hierarchy, letting frontier 744B–2.8T-parameter MoE models run on consumer and heterogeneous hardware. It doubles as an open research platform for inference-side performance across the software/hardware boundary, with a hard guarantee that it never silently changes model precision or router semantics.
en.content: It ships one C file per model family (GLM-5.x, Kimi K3, DeepSeek V4.x, Qwen3.x, OLMoE and more — nine families), a unified coli chat / coli serve / coli web front end, and a web dashboard with live metrics, expert tiers and a 'brain' visualization.
en.stack: Written in pure C with zero engine dependencies, streaming experts from disk; supports int4 quantization and runs across CPU plus multi-GPU setups such as 6× RTX 5090.
en.hot: Its 'tiny engine, immense model' approach directly addresses VRAM anxiety; with 29,840 stars and +868 today it tops GitHub Trending, showing huge demand for running frontier models locally.
uses: Individuals and labs wanting to run 744B+ MoE models on hardware they already own
Engineers working on inference engines, memory tiering, storage I/O and CPU/GPU overlap
Teams needing low-cost deployment of large models on consumer GPUs or heterogeneous clusters
Learners curious about quantization, expert streaming and speculative decoding

zh.tag: 腾讯云开源的自托管多用户多智能体 AI 助手
zh.what: Octop 是腾讯云开源的自托管 AI 助手，主打多用户与多智能体并行协作，可为团队、家庭和个人搭建独立又协同的智能环境。它完全运行在本地，隐私不外泄，单进程启动即可用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 3.12+ 的完整实现，提供 Web 控制台、CLI 与 IM 集成，并有专家库、Connectors（OAuth + MCP）和 ACP 等扩展模块，附中英文 README 与路线图。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.12+，采用 Ruff 代码风格，通过 PyPI 分发，支持 HTTP/SSE/WebSocket 接口，并集成 MCP、OAuth 与 ACP 协议。
zh.hot: 上线即冲上 GitHub Trending Python 日榜第 6，累计约 2950 star、单日新增 396，腾讯云背书加上自托管多智能体定位正好切中隐私与协作需求。
uses: 注重数据隐私、希望本地自托管 AI 助手的团队与个人
需要多用户共享、多智能体协作的家庭或小型组织
想通过飞书、钉钉、QQ、Discord、企业微信等 IM 接入 AI 的用户
希望用专家库、Connectors 与 ACP 扩展 IDE 工作流的开发者

en.tag: Tencent Cloud's self-hosted multi-user, multi-agent AI assistant
en.what: Octop is an open-source, self-hosted AI assistant from Tencent Cloud built around multi-user and multi-agent parallelism, creating an intelligent environment that is both independent and collaborative for teams, families, and individuals. It runs entirely on your own machine, so privacy is never compromised, and a single process brings up the whole stack.
en.content: The repo ships a full Python 3.12+ implementation with a web console, CLI and IM integrations, plus extension modules such as an expert library, Connectors (OAuth + MCP) and ACP, along with bilingual READMEs and a roadmap.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.12+, styled with Ruff and distributed via PyPI, it exposes HTTP/SSE/WebSocket interfaces and integrates MCP, OAuth and ACP protocols.
en.hot: It hit No.6 on GitHub Trending's Python daily list with roughly 2,950 stars and 396 gained in a single day, as Tencent Cloud's backing plus a self-hosted multi-agent angle taps straight into privacy and collaboration needs.
uses: Teams and individuals who value privacy and want a self-hosted AI assistant
Families or small organizations needing multi-user sharing and multi-agent collaboration
Users who want AI access via Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, Discord or WeCom
Developers extending IDE workflows with the expert library, Connectors and ACP

zh.tag: 开源企业级业务管理平台，集 ERP、CRM、HRM、ATS 与项目管理于一体
zh.what: Ever Gauzy 是一个面向协作、按需和共享经济的开源业务管理平台，提供企业资源规划（ERP）、客户关系管理（CRM）、人力资源管理（HRM）、招聘跟踪（ATS）以及工作与项目管理（PM）等核心功能。它旨在帮助企业在一个统一的系统中管理财务、销售、库存、员工和项目等关键业务流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台源代码，主要使用 TypeScript 编写，提供无头 API、仪表盘、时间跟踪、员工管理、招聘、销售管道、会计发票等模块。还包括详细的文档和部署指南，支持 Gitpod 在线开发。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 TypeScript 为主，基于 Node.js 和 NestJS 构建后端，前端可能使用 Angular 或 React，数据库支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL 等，并采用 AGPL v3 许可证。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 191 颗星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 2 名，总星数达 5084，表明其作为开源 ERP/CRM 替代方案正受到广泛关注。
uses: 中小企业寻求开源 ERP/CRM 解决方案以降低软件成本
开发团队需要可定制、可扩展的业务管理平台进行二次开发
人力资源和招聘团队希望集成 ATS 和员工管理功能
项目管理和咨询公司需要时间跟踪与项目协作工具

en.tag: Open business management platform combining ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS and project management
en.what: Ever Gauzy is an open business management platform for collaborative, on-demand and sharing economies, offering Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Human Resource Management (HRM), Applicant Tracking System (ATS), and Work and Project Management (PM). It aims to help businesses manage key processes like finance, sales, inventory, employees, and projects in one unified system.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform source code, primarily written in TypeScript, offering headless APIs, dashboards, time tracking, employee management, ATS, sales pipelines, accounting/invoicing modules, and more. It also includes detailed documentation and deployment guides, with Gitpod support for online development.
en.stack: The tech stack is primarily TypeScript, with a Node.js and NestJS backend, possibly Angular or React frontend, and support for databases like PostgreSQL and MySQL, under the AGPL v3 license.
en.hot: The project gained 191 stars today, ranking 2nd on GitHub Trending daily list, with a total of 5,084 stars, indicating growing attention as an open-source ERP/CRM alternative.
uses: Small and medium businesses seeking open-source ERP/CRM solutions to reduce software costs
Development teams needing a customizable and extensible business management platform for secondary development
HR and recruitment teams looking to integrate ATS and employee management features
Project management and consulting firms requiring time tracking and project collaboration tools

zh.tag: 开源自主编码代理，覆盖 IDE、终端与桌面
zh.what: Cline 是一个开源的自主编码代理，能读写文件、执行命令、浏览网页并调用工具，全程可人工审批。它以 VS Code/JetBrains 插件、CLI、桌面应用和 SDK 多种形态提供同一套代理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库按产品线组织：sdk/ 提供 Node.js 编程式代理 API，apps/cli/ 是终端 UI 与无头模式，另有 VS Code 扩展、JetBrains 插件和 macOS/Windows 桌面应用。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，基于 Node.js 生态；CLI 通过 npm 全局安装，SDK 以 @cline/sdk 包发布，支持 MCP 服务器与自定义工具。
zh.hot: 68,377 颗星、日增 112 并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 20，说明多形态统一代理引擎的定位持续吸引开发者。
uses: 想在 VS Code 或 JetBrains 里获得可审批自主编码助手的开发者
需要在 CI/CD 或脚本中使用无头编码代理的工程团队
希望基于同一引擎构建自定义 AI 代理与集成的开发者
偏好桌面应用管理模型、插件与 MCP 服务器的进阶用户

en.tag: Open-source autonomous coding agent for IDE, terminal, and desktop
en.what: Cline is an open-source autonomous coding agent that can create files, run commands, browse the web, and use tools with human-in-the-loop approval. It ships the same agent engine as VS Code/JetBrains extensions, a CLI, a desktop app, and an SDK.
en.content: The repo is organized by product line: sdk/ offers a Node.js programmatic agent API, apps/cli/ holds the terminal UI and headless mode, plus VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin, and macOS/Windows desktop app.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript on the Node.js ecosystem; the CLI installs globally via npm and the SDK ships as @cline/sdk, with support for MCP servers and custom tools.
en.hot: With 68,377 stars, +112 today, and a #20 spot on GitHub Trending daily, its multi-surface unified agent engine keeps drawing developers.
uses: Developers wanting an approval-gated autonomous coding assistant in VS Code or JetBrains
Engineering teams needing a headless coding agent for CI/CD or scripting
Developers building custom AI agents and integrations on the same engine
Power users preferring a desktop app to manage models, plugins, and MCP servers

zh.tag: 自托管的云端开发环境与 AI 编码代理平台
zh.what: Coder 是一个可自托管的平台，用 Terraform 定义云端开发环境（工作区），通过安全的 WireGuard 隧道连接，闲置时自动关闭以节省成本。它还内置 AI 编码代理，代理循环运行在你自己的控制平面中，工作区内无需存放任何 API 密钥。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的服务端与 CLI、Terraform 模板与 provider、Web 管理界面、文档和安装脚本，可部署到 EC2、Kubernetes、Docker 等多种基础设施。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 开发，依赖 Terraform 定义基础设施，采用 WireGuard 隧道保障连接安全，并支持接入 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、Bedrock 或自托管模型。
zh.hot: 凭借 14612 颗星和今日新增 83 星登上 Go 日榜第 16 名，反映出开发者对自托管、安全且带 AI 代理的云端开发环境需求旺盛。
uses: 需要为团队统一管理云端开发环境并控制成本的平台工程团队
希望让 AI 编码代理在自己基础设施上运行、避免密钥外泄的企业
使用 Terraform 管理基础设施、追求可审计与合规的开发组织
想快速为新人开通开发环境、缩短入职时间的工程团队

en.tag: Self-hosted cloud development environments and AI coding agents
en.what: Coder is a self-hosted platform for cloud development environments and AI coding agents. Workspaces are defined with Terraform, connected through a secure WireGuard tunnel, and automatically shut down when idle; its native AI agent runs in your control plane with no API keys inside workspaces.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based server and CLI, Terraform templates and providers, a web admin UI, docs, and install scripts, deployable across EC2, Kubernetes, Docker, and more.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it relies on Terraform for infrastructure definitions, uses WireGuard tunnels for secure connectivity, and supports Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Bedrock, or self-hosted models.
en.hot: With 14,612 stars and 83 added today, ranking 16th on the Go daily trending list, it reflects strong demand for self-hosted, secure cloud dev environments with AI agents.
uses: Platform engineering teams needing unified, cost-controlled cloud dev environments
Enterprises wanting AI coding agents on their own infra without leaking API keys
Organizations using Terraform that require auditable, compliant infrastructure
Engineering teams aiming to onboard developers in seconds instead of days

zh.tag: 可视化搭建 AI 代理与工作流的开源自动化平台
zh.what: n8n 是一个 fair-code 的工作流自动化平台，把可视化画布与自定义代码结合，用来构建和部署 AI 代理及多步骤自动化流程。它支持自托管或云端运行，可连接 1500+ 集成，并灵活切换 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 或开源模型。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 TypeScript 编写的核心引擎与节点系统，包含可视化编辑器前端、后端执行引擎、1500+ 集成节点以及大量示例工作流模板。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，基于 Node.js 运行，依赖 pnpm 工作区管理多包结构，前端采用 Vue，AI 能力集成 LangChain。
zh.hot: 凭借 20.4 万 star 和日增 225 的热度，n8n 成为 AI 代理与自动化领域最受关注的开源项目之一，其可视化加代码的灵活性和丰富集成深受开发者青睐。
uses: 希望快速搭建 AI 代理和自动化流程的开发者与团队
需要自托管、数据可控的企业级自动化场景
想把 AI 接入现有系统并复用 1500+ 集成的工程师
用可视化方式学习工作流与 AI 编排的初学者

en.tag: Fair-code visual platform for building AI agents and workflow automation
en.what: n8n is a fair-code workflow automation platform that blends a visual canvas with custom code to build and deploy AI agents and multi-step workflows. It runs self-hosted or in the cloud, connects to 1500+ integrations, and lets you swap between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or open-source models.
en.content: The repo centers on a TypeScript core engine and node system, including the visual editor frontend, backend execution engine, 1500+ integration nodes, and a large library of example workflow templates.
en.stack: Primarily built with TypeScript on Node.js, using pnpm workspaces for its monorepo, a Vue-based frontend, and LangChain for AI capabilities.
en.hot: With 204k stars and 225 added today, n8n stands out as one of the most watched open-source projects in AI agents and automation, prized for its visual-plus-code flexibility and rich integrations.
uses: Developers and teams wanting to quickly build AI agents and automated workflows
Enterprise scenarios needing self-hosted, data-controlled automation
Engineers connecting AI to existing systems via 1500+ integrations
Beginners learning workflow and AI orchestration through a visual canvas

zh.tag: 树莓派墨水屏鸟框，用本地 AI 听声辨鸟并展示 1800 年代手绘插图
zh.what: 这是一个运行在树莓派上的电子墨水屏相框项目，通过麦克风实时监听鸟鸣，用完全本地的 AI 识别鸟种。识别结果会匹配到真实的 1800 年代手工剪裁鸟类插图上，并显示在墨水屏上。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 主程序、硬件安装与运维文档、插画资源以及一个可在线访问的实时演示站点。核心逻辑是轮询 BirdNET-Go 的 API，匹配物种与插图，仅在鸟种变化时重绘屏幕。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 BirdNET-Go 做音频分类，输出到 Inky Impression 墨水屏，同时提供 Web kiosk 页面。项目采用 MIT 许可，插画部分为 CC-BY-SA 4.0。
zh.hot: 上线不久即获得 2914 颗星，今日新增 592 星，位列 GitHub Trending Python 日榜第 4。它把本地 AI、树莓派硬件和复古鸟类插画结合，兼具实用性与美感，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 树莓派与电子墨水屏爱好者，想做一个有实际功能的桌面摆件
对本地 AI 和音频识别感兴趣的开发者，可学习 BirdNET-Go 集成方式
自然观察者或鸟类爱好者，希望实时了解花园里的鸟种
喜欢复古插画与 DIY 硬件结合的美学项目的人

en.tag: E-ink bird frame for Raspberry Pi: local AI listens for birds and shows 1800s hand-cut illustrations
en.what: This is an e-ink picture frame project for Raspberry Pi that listens to bird songs via microphone and identifies species with fully local AI. Each detected species is matched to a real, hand-cut 1800s bird illustration and rendered on the e-ink display.
en.content: The repo contains the Python application, hardware/install/operations docs, illustration assets, and a live demo site. Core logic polls the BirdNET-Go API, matches species to illustrations, and redraws only when the bird set changes.
en.stack: Primarily Python, relying on BirdNET-Go for audio classification, outputting to an Inky Impression e-ink panel and a web kiosk. Licensed MIT with artwork under CC-BY-SA 4.0.
en.hot: It quickly gained 2,914 stars, with 592 added today, ranking #4 on GitHub Trending Python daily. Combining local AI, Raspberry Pi hardware, and vintage bird illustrations, it appeals for both utility and charm.
uses: Raspberry Pi and e-ink enthusiasts who want a functional desk ornament
Developers interested in local AI and audio recognition, learning BirdNET-Go integration
Nature observers or birders wanting real-time species awareness in their garden
Fans of retro illustrations combined with DIY hardware aesthetics

zh.tag: 为 Claude 打造的红队攻防技能库，78 个 SKILL.md 即插即用
zh.what: claude-red 是面向 Claude Skills 系统的攻击性安全技能库，每个技能都是一份结构化的 SKILL.md，把 Claude 武装成特定攻击面的专家。覆盖从 SQL 注入、shellcode 到 EDR 绕过、ADCS 滥用等场景，按对话触发词按需加载。
zh.content: 仓库包含 78 个技能、23 个分类，按 Web 应用、认证与身份、Active Directory、无线等目录组织，附安装脚本、技能索引与路线图。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主语言，核心产物是 Markdown 格式的 SKILL.md；通过 git clone 或 sparse-checkout 装入 ~/.claude/skills，也可用 claude --system-file 注入。
zh.hot: 上线不久即收获 3602 星、今日新增 113 星并登上日榜第 13，踩中 Claude Skills 生态与红队自动化的双重热点。
uses: 授权红队与渗透测试人员，快速获得专家级攻击方法论
漏洞赏金猎人与安全研究者，用于漏洞分类与攻击面梳理
CTF 选手与安全学员，作为系统化的攻防训练参考
安全团队评估 AI 辅助攻防能力的实验场景

en.tag: Offensive security skill library for Claude — 78 drop-in SKILL.md files
en.what: claude-red is a curated offensive security skill library for the Claude Skills system. Each skill is a structured SKILL.md that primes Claude with expert-level methodology for a specific attack surface, from SQL injection and shellcode to EDR evasion and ADCS abuse, loading on demand via conversational triggers.
en.content: The repo ships 78 skills across 23 categories, organized into directories like Web Application, Auth & Identity, Active Directory and Wireless, plus an install script, skill index and roadmap.
en.stack: Primarily Python with Markdown-based SKILL.md files as the core artifact; installed via git clone or sparse-checkout into ~/.claude/skills, or piped through claude --system-file.
en.hot: It has quickly reached 3,602 stars with 113 added today, ranking 13th on the daily trending list, riding both the Claude Skills ecosystem and red-team automation hype.
uses: Authorized red teamers and pentesters seeking expert-level attack methodology
Bug bounty hunters and security researchers triaging vulnerabilities and mapping attack surfaces
CTF players and security learners wanting structured offensive training material
Security teams evaluating AI-assisted offensive capabilities in lab settings

zh.tag: 开源 LLM 应用层：RAG、深度研究与自定义 Agent 一体化平台
zh.what: Onyx 是面向大模型的开源应用层，提供功能丰富的聊天界面，任何人都能自行部署。它通过 Agentic RAG、联网搜索、代码执行、文件生成、深度研究等能力增强 LLM，并内置 50+ 数据源连接器与 MCP 支持。

zh.hot: 凭借 32k+ stars 的社区基础与 Agentic RAG、深度研究等热门能力，加上单命令部署体验，持续登上 GitHub Trending Python 日榜。

开发者需要可扩展的 RAG 与 Agent 应用底座

en.tag: Open-source LLM application layer with RAG, deep research and custom agents
en.what: Onyx is the open-source application layer for LLMs, offering a feature-rich chat interface that anyone can self-host. It augments models with agentic RAG, web search, code execution, artifact generation and deep research, plus 50+ indexing connectors and MCP support.
en.content: The repo ships a full backend and chat frontend, connector and indexing pipelines, agent and deep-research workflows, plus a one-command install script and docs links.
en.stack: Primarily Python under the MIT license, it works with any LLM and integrates search/crawl providers like Serper, Google PSE, Brave, SearXNG, Firecrawl and Exa.
en.hot: With 32k+ stars and in-demand features like agentic RAG and deep research, plus one-command deployment, it keeps charting on GitHub's Python trending list.

Developers needing an extensible RAG and agent application foundation
Researchers producing reports quickly via the deep-research flow
Individuals building private chat and document Q&A on any LLM

zh.tag: Google 时序预测基础模型，支持多变量与协变量
zh.what: TimesFM 是 Google Research 开发的预训练时序基础模型，用于时间序列预测。它采用 decoder-only 架构，在大量时序数据上预训练，能够进行零样本预测。最新 3.0 版本支持原生多变量预测和协变量，并在多个基准上排名第一。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型源码、预训练权重（Hugging Face）、示例和文档。代码结构分版本管理，最新 3.0 在根目录，旧版本归档在 v1 子目录。
zh.stack: 基于 PyTorch 实现，依赖 Hugging Face Transformers 等。提供 pip 包安装，支持 Python。
zh.hot: 近期发布 3.0 版本，带来多变量预测和协变量支持，在三大基准上排名第一，引发社区关注。今日新增 1618 star，总星标超 3 万。
uses: 时间序列预测研究者：用于零样本预测和模型对比实验
数据科学家：快速进行多变量预测，无需大量训练数据
企业应用开发者：集成到 BigQuery ML 或 Vertex AI 进行规模化预测

en.tag: Google's pretrained time-series foundation model for forecasting, with multivariate & covariate support
en.what: TimesFM is a pretrained time-series foundation model by Google Research for time-series forecasting. It uses a decoder-only architecture pretrained on diverse time-series data, enabling zero-shot forecasting. The latest 3.0 version natively supports multivariate forecasting and covariates, ranking #1 on multiple benchmarks.
en.content: The repo contains model source code, pretrained weights (on Hugging Face), examples, and docs. Code is organized by version; latest 3.0 is at root, older versions archived under v1.
en.stack: Implemented in PyTorch, leveraging Hugging Face Transformers. Installable via pip, Python-based.
en.hot: The recent 3.0 release with native multivariate forecasting and covariates, achieving #1 on three major benchmarks, has sparked interest. Gained 1,618 stars today, total over 30k.
uses: Time-series researchers: for zero-shot forecasting and model benchmarking
Data scientists: for quick multivariate forecasting without extensive training data
Enterprise developers: integrating with BigQuery ML or Vertex AI for scalable forecasting

zh.tag: 模型驱动的开源智能体SDK，支持Python与TypeScript，任意模型与云
zh.what: Strands Agents 是一个开源 SDK，用于在 Python 和 TypeScript 中构建和运行 AI 智能体。它提供完整的智能体循环，包括生命周期控制、工具调用、结构化输出、MCP 支持、多智能体模式、记忆和会话管理，并支持模型可移植性。

企业团队 —— 需要多智能体协作和记忆管理的复杂场景
研究者 —— 探索模型驱动智能体架构和 MCP 集成

en.tag: Model-driven open-source agent SDK for Python & TypeScript, any model, any cloud
en.what: Strands Agents is an open-source SDK for building and running AI agents in Python and TypeScript. It provides a complete agent loop with lifecycle controls, tools, structured output, MCP support, multi-agent patterns, memory, and session management, with model portability.
en.content: The repository contains the SDK core code, an MCP server implementation, samples, and tools, along with documentation links.

Researchers — explore model-driven agent architectures and MCP integration

zh.tag: 面向量化金融的智能体原生知识抽取与检索框架
zh.what: QuantMind 把论文、新闻、财报等原始金融信息精炼成结构化、可追溯的金融知识，供下游检索与推理使用。每条知识都带类型、引用来源和时间戳，可独立持久化并支持时间查询。仓库以智能体为导向设计，开发者描述想要的流水线，编码智能体即可依据仓库契约与技能自动构建。
zh.content: 仓库包含确定性预处理模块（fetch/parse/format/clean）、配置驱动的操作如 PaperFlow、collect_news、batch_run，以及类型化知识结构（如 Paper）和面向智能体的上下文、技能与钩子。它同时是可导入的 Python 库。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python（3.8+），采用 MIT 许可证，依赖异步与配置驱动设计，并围绕编码智能体的技能与钩子机制构建。
zh.hot: 作为量化金融领域的智能体原生知识框架，它切中 LLM 与金融数据结合的热点，且论文被 NeurIPS 2025 GenAI in Finance Workshop 接收，今日新增 81 star 冲上 Python 日榜第 9。
uses: 量化研究员与金融数据工程师，用于把非结构化金融信息转成可检索的结构化知识
构建金融 RAG 或智能体应用的开发者，需要带引用与时间戳的可信知识库
使用编码智能体自动搭建数据处理流水线的团队
关注 LLM 在金融领域落地的研究者与从业者

en.tag: An agent-native knowledge extraction and retrieval framework for quantitative finance
en.what: QuantMind refines raw financial information such as papers, news, and filings into structured financial knowledge that downstream retrieval and reasoning can trust. Every piece of knowledge is typed, keeps its citation, and knows its timestamp, so it persists and supports time queries standalone. The repo is agent-oriented: you describe the pipeline you want and a coding agent builds it against the repo's contracts, skills, and deterministic verification.
en.content: It contains deterministic preprocessing (fetch/parse/format/clean), config-driven operations like PaperFlow, collect_news, and batch_run, plus typed knowledge shapes such as Paper and agent-oriented contexts, skills, and hooks. It is also a fully importable Python library.
en.stack: Primarily Python (3.8+) under the MIT license, built around async and config-driven design with skills and hooks for coding agents.
en.hot: As an agent-native knowledge framework for quantitative finance, it rides the hot intersection of LLMs and financial data, and its paper was accepted at the NeurIPS 2025 GenAI in Finance Workshop, gaining 81 stars today to rank 9th on the Python daily trending list.
uses: Quant researchers and financial data engineers converting unstructured financial information into retrievable structured knowledge
Developers building financial RAG or agent applications who need a trustworthy knowledge base with citations and timestamps
Teams using coding agents to automatically build data processing pipelines
Researchers and practitioners focused on applying LLMs in finance

zh.tag: 让第二代 Echo Dot 变身本地开源语音助手与媒体播放器
zh.what: EchoMuse 用轻量级 Go 服务器替换 Alexa 固件，并搭配 Python 控制器，将每台 Echo Dot 作为原生 ESPHome 语音卫星接入 Home Assistant。它实现完全本地的唤醒词、语音助手和音乐播放，无需云端或自定义集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 服务器、Python 控制器、自定义唤醒词训练工具 oww_forge/ 以及配置文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 和 Go，依赖 openwakeword 进行唤醒词检测，并内置 speexdsp 回声消除。
zh.hot: 今日新增 60 星，登上 GitHub Trending Python 日榜第 10 名，因其让廉价二手设备重获新生并实现完全本地化而受关注。

en.tag: Turn a 2nd-gen Echo Dot into a fully local, open-source voice assistant and media player
en.what: EchoMuse replaces Alexa firmware with a lightweight Go server and pairs it with a Python controller to present each Echo Dot as a native ESPHome voice satellite in Home Assistant. It enables fully local wake word, voice assistant, and music playback without cloud or custom integrations.
en.content: The repo contains a Go server, a Python controller, a custom wake word trainer under oww_forge/, and configuration docs.
en.stack: Primarily Python and Go, with openwakeword for wake detection and vendored speexdsp for echo cancellation.
en.hot: Gained 60 stars today, ranking #10 on GitHub Trending (Python), popular for giving cheap second-hand devices a second life with full local control.
uses: Home Assistant users wanting local voice control
Tinkerers with idle Echo Dot 2nd gen devices
Privacy-focused smart home enthusiasts avoiding cloud
Developers needing multi-room voice and media playback

en.tag: Vercel's filesystem-first framework for durable AI agents

Automation scenarios where agents run recurring cron jobs

en.tag: Open-source SASE platform: zero-trust VPN, reverse proxy and AI gateway in one
en.what: Pangolin is an open-source SASE platform built on WireGuard that unifies a zero-trust VPN, zero-trust reverse proxy, privileged access management and an identity-aware AI gateway into one system. Technical decision-makers evaluating SASE architectures against commercial offerings at low cost

zh.tag: 统一数据流动、存储与计算的零开销发布订阅协议
zh.what: Eclipse Zenoh 是一个用 Rust 实现的开源发布/订阅与查询协议，把数据在传输中、存储中和计算中的状态统一到同一套抽象里。它在传统 pub/sub 之上融合了地理分布式存储、查询与计算能力，同时保持远超主流方案的时空效率。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 zenoh Rust crate（协议参考实现）、提供高级投递保证与轻量序列化的 zenoh-ext、独立路由器守护进程 zenohd、插件 crates、内部 commons crates 以及示例程序。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，采用 Cargo workspace 组织多个 crate；其他语言绑定均基于该 Rust 实现，另有纯 C 的 zenoh-pico。
zh.hot: 作为 Eclipse 基金会项目，Zenoh 以“零开销”定位切入 IoT、机器人与边缘计算场景，今日新增 25 star 登上 Rust 日榜第 10，累计 3190 star 显示持续关注度。
uses: IoT 与边缘计算开发者，需要低延迟、低带宽的分布式数据通信
机器人/自动驾驶团队，在设备间做实时 pub/sub 与查询
分布式系统研究者，探索地理分布式存储与计算融合
Rust 工程师，寻找高性能消息中间件替代方案

en.tag: Zero-overhead pub/sub unifying data in motion, at rest, and computation
en.what: Eclipse Zenoh is an open-source Rust implementation of a pub/sub and query protocol that unifies data in motion, data at rest, and computation. It blends traditional pub/sub with geo-distributed storage, queries, and compute while keeping time and space efficiency well beyond mainstream stacks.
en.content: The repo contains the core zenoh Rust crate (the reference protocol implementation), zenoh-ext with advanced delivery guarantees and lightweight serialization, the standalone zenohd router daemon, plugin crates, internal commons crates, and examples.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, organized as a Cargo workspace of multiple crates; other language bindings wrap this Rust implementation, with a separate pure-C zenoh-pico.
en.hot: As an Eclipse Foundation project, Zenoh targets IoT, robotics, and edge computing with its zero-overhead promise; 25 new stars today put it at #10 on the Rust trending daily list, with 3,190 stars total.
uses: IoT and edge developers needing low-latency, low-bandwidth distributed data communication
Robotics/autonomous driving teams doing real-time pub/sub and queries across devices
Distributed systems researchers exploring geo-distributed storage and compute fusion
Rust engineers looking for a high-performance messaging middleware alternative

zh.tag: 面向 AI、BI 与嵌入式分析的开源语义层
zh.what: Cube Core 是一个开源语义层，让你用代码一次性定义指标、维度、关联和访问规则，再通过 SQL、REST、GraphQL 接口暴露给下游的 BI 工具、自定义应用或 AI 代理。它是无头的，不附带 UI，方便你构建贴合自身产品的分析体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心引擎与 JS/TS 后端服务，提供 Docker 本地运行与自托管方式，并配有文档、示例和 Slack 社区入口。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，同时依赖 Node.js/npm 生态（@cubejs-backend/server），支持各类 SQL 数据源如 Snowflake、Databricks、BigQuery、Presto、Athena 和 Postgres，并内置关系型缓存引擎。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源语义层项目，Cube 已积累 20857 颗星，今日新增 28 星并登上 Rust 日榜第 11 名，反映出 AI 与 BI 融合趋势下对统一指标层的强烈需求。
uses: 数据工程师与分析师：集中管理指标定义，避免各 BI 工具重复建模
AI 应用开发者：为 AI 代理提供标准化的语义查询接口
SaaS 产品团队：构建嵌入式分析，将指标能力开放给终端用户
平台架构师：在多种数据源之上搭建统一、可复用的分析服务层

en.tag: Open-source semantic layer for AI, BI and embedded analytics
en.what: Cube Core is an open-source semantic layer where you define metrics, dimensions, joins and access rules once in code, then expose them via SQL, REST and GraphQL APIs to BI tools, custom apps or AI agents. It is headless with no bundled UI, so you can build the analytics experience that fits your product.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust-powered core engine plus JS/TS backend services, with Docker-based local run and self-hosting, along with docs, examples and a Slack community.
en.stack: Primarily Rust with Node.js/npm ecosystem (@cubejs-backend/server), supporting SQL data sources like Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Presto, Athena and Postgres, plus a built-in relational caching engine.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source semantic layer, Cube has accumulated 20,857 stars, gaining 28 today and ranking 11th on the Rust daily trending list, reflecting strong demand for a unified metrics layer amid the AI-BI convergence.
uses: Data engineers and analysts: centralize metric definitions to avoid re-modeling across BI tools
AI app developers: provide AI agents with a standardized semantic query interface
SaaS product teams: build embedded analytics and expose metrics to end users
Platform architects: build a unified, reusable analytics service layer over multiple data sources

zh.tag: Rust 高性能 Agent 运行时 + 桌面工作台
zh.what: OpenBitFun 把用 Rust 编写的高性能 Agent 运行时与精致的桌面应用结合在一起，提供可高度定制的开源 Agent 工作空间。它既有 Code Agent 的深度，又面向软件开发之外的通用任务场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心运行时、桌面应用前端、data-migrator 数据迁移工具，以及 Mini App 生态与多语言 README、界面截图等文档资源。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 为核心语言实现 Agent 运行时，配套桌面客户端，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux，核心代码采用 MIT 许可。
zh.hot: 上线不久即收获 2271 颗星、今日新增 47 星，并登上 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 12 名，Rust 高性能运行时与桌面 Agent 工作台的组合正切中当下 Agent 工具链热点。
uses: 想用桌面端 Agent 工作台处理日常与复杂任务的个人用户
需要跨设备远程控制、在手机或浏览器继续任务的团队
希望基于 Mini App 或源码深度定制 Agent 工作流的开发者
关注 Rust 高性能 Agent 运行时实现的技术研究者

en.tag: A Rust-powered agent runtime with a polished desktop workspace
en.what: OpenBitFun pairs a high-performance agent runtime written in Rust with a polished desktop application, forming a highly customizable open-source agent workspace. It offers the depth of a Code Agent while staying general-purpose for work beyond software development.
en.content: The repo ships the Rust core runtime, the desktop app frontend, a data-migrator tool, plus a Mini App ecosystem and docs such as multilingual READMEs and UI screenshots.
en.stack: Rust powers the agent runtime, paired with a desktop client supporting Windows, macOS and Linux; the core code is MIT-licensed.
en.hot: It has already reached 2,271 stars with 47 added today, ranking 12th on GitHub Trending's daily Rust list, as its mix of a fast Rust runtime and a desktop agent workspace rides the current agent-tooling wave.
uses: Individuals who want a desktop agent workspace for daily and complex tasks
Teams needing cross-device remote control to continue tasks on phone or browser
Developers who want to customize agent workflows via Mini Apps or source code
Engineers studying high-performance agent runtimes built in Rust

zh.tag: 用 Rust 打造的数据驱动开源游戏引擎
zh.what: Bevy 是一个用 Rust 编写的开源游戏引擎，采用数据驱动的 ECS（实体组件系统）架构，目标是同时提供完整的 2D 与 3D 能力。它强调简单易上手、模块化可替换、并行高性能，并且永久免费开源。
zh.content: 仓库包含引擎核心源码、大量可直接运行的官方示例（examples）、迁移指南与文档，以及 Discord、Reddit 等社区入口。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 语言与 Cargo 生态，依赖 Rust 编译器的最新稳定版（MSRV 紧跟 stable），采用 ECS 数据导向架构，可编译到多平台。
zh.hot: 作为 Rust 生态最受关注的游戏引擎之一，Bevy 已积累 48,246 颗星，今日再增 41 星并登上 Rust 日榜第 13 名，社区热度长期稳定。
uses: Rust 开发者想用熟悉的语言做 2D/3D 游戏或图形实验
想学习 ECS 数据导向架构与并行系统设计的工程师
需要模块化、可自由替换组件的游戏或仿真项目团队
对开源游戏引擎与 Rust 图形生态感兴趣的技术爱好者

en.tag: A refreshingly simple data-driven game engine built in Rust
en.what: Bevy is an open-source game engine written in Rust that uses a data-driven Entity Component System architecture, aiming to offer a complete 2D and 3D feature set. It emphasizes simplicity, modularity, parallelism and being free and open-source forever.
en.content: The repo contains the engine's core source code, a large set of runnable official examples, migration guides and docs, plus community links like Discord and Reddit.
en.stack: Built in Rust with the Cargo ecosystem, tracking the latest stable Rust release as its MSRV, using an ECS data-oriented architecture and compiling to multiple platforms.
en.hot: As one of the most watched game engines in the Rust ecosystem, Bevy has reached 48,246 stars, gaining 41 more today and ranking 13th on the Rust daily trending list, showing sustained community momentum.
uses: Rust developers who want to build 2D/3D games or graphics experiments in a familiar language
Engineers eager to learn ECS data-oriented architecture and parallel system design
Teams needing a modular game or simulation project with swappable components
Tech enthusiasts interested in open-source game engines and the Rust graphics ecosystem

zh.tag: 自托管分布式 Durable Objects 守护进程
zh.what: celld 是一个开源守护进程，让你在自己的机器上运行 Cloudflare Workers 应用，涵盖 Workers、Durable Objects、KV、Queues、D1、R2、Workflows、Cron Triggers 和静态资源，并直接使用现有的 wrangler.json 部署。每个对象是一个 cell，即一个带独立 SQLite 数据库的命名服务器，长期状态存放在你自己拥有的 S3 兼容、GCS 或 Azure Blob 存储桶中。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的 celld 守护进程、协议与保证文档（docs/guarantees.md、docs/cloudflare-compat.md），以及覆盖 Workers、Durable Objects、KV、D1、R2、Workflow 等服务的可部署示例（examples/ 目录）。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，内嵌 V8 执行 Wrangler 打包产物，依赖 S3 兼容对象存储、Google Cloud Storage 或 Azure Blob Storage 作为状态后端，并通过签名对等 HTTP 进行路由与复制日志传输。
zh.hot: 项目今日新增 34 星、总星数达 4724，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 14 名；它把 Cloudflare 的 Durable Objects 模型自托管化，无需控制平面和共识服务，切中开发者对边缘计算平台可移植性与数据主权的需求。
uses: 希望将 Cloudflare Workers 应用迁移到自有基础设施的开发者
需要自托管 Durable Objects 与 SQLite 状态、且要求数据主权和低成本的团队
想研究无共识、基于对象存储租约的分布式复制协议的 Rust 工程师
需要在自有机器上运行 Workers、KV、D1、R2 等完整边缘服务栈的平台运维人员

en.tag: Self-hosted, distributed Durable Objects daemon
en.what: celld is an open-source daemon that runs a Cloudflare Workers application on your own machines, covering Workers, Durable Objects, KV, Queues, D1, R2, Workflows, Cron Triggers, and static assets, deployed from your existing wrangler.json. Each object is a cell: a named server with its own SQLite database, with long-term state stored in a bucket you own — S3-compatible, Google Cloud Storage, or Azure Blob Storage.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust celld daemon, protocol and guarantees docs (docs/guarantees.md, docs/cloudflare-compat.md), and deployable examples for Workers, Durable Objects, KV, D1, R2, Workflow, and more under examples/.
en.stack: Written in Rust, embeds V8 to execute Wrangler bundles, relies on S3-compatible object storage, Google Cloud Storage, or Azure Blob Storage as the state backend, and uses signed peer HTTP for routing and replicated-log transport.
en.hot: It gained 34 stars today for a total of 4,724, ranking 14th on GitHub Trending (Rust) daily; by self-hosting Cloudflare's Durable Objects model without a serving control plane or consensus service, it taps into developer demand for edge-platform portability and data sovereignty.
uses: Developers who want to move Cloudflare Workers apps onto their own infrastructure
Teams needing self-hosted Durable Objects with SQLite state, data sovereignty, and low cost
Rust engineers interested in a consensus-free, object-storage-lease-based replication protocol
Platform operators running the full Workers, KV, D1, R2 edge service stack on their own machines

zh.tag: 用软件工程实践做数据转换的 Rust 重写版 dbt v2.0
zh.what: dbt 让数据分析师和工程师用软件工程的方式（版本控制、测试、文档、依赖管理）来转换数据仓库中的数据。用户只需编写 SELECT 语句作为「模型」，dbt 负责将其编译成表或视图并管理模型间的依赖关系。
zh.content: 本仓库 main 分支是 dbt v2.0 的完整 Apache 2.0 源码，即用 Rust 从零重写的实现；v1 的 Python 实现已移至 1.latest 分支。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写，编译为按操作系统和架构分发的单一自包含二进制，无需 Python 运行时或依赖管理；产物为 Parquet 格式，同时保留 JSON artifacts 以兼容旧版。
zh.hot: 作为数据领域最流行的转换工具，dbt 用 Rust 重写 v2.0 引发广泛关注，仓库已积累约 1.39 万 star，今日再增 11 星并登上 Rust 日榜第 7。
uses: 数据分析师：用 SQL 模型完成数据转换，无需深入工程细节
数据工程师：构建可测试、可文档化、可版本控制的数据管道
平台团队：在大型 dbt 项目上追求更快的解析与编译性能
希望摆脱 Python 运行时、简化部署的数据团队

en.tag: dbt v2.0: a ground-up Rust rewrite of the data transformation framework
en.what: dbt lets data analysts and engineers transform warehouse data using software engineering practices like version control, testing, docs and dependency management. Users write SELECT statements as 'models', and dbt compiles them into tables or views while managing relationships between models.
en.content: The main branch holds the full Apache 2.0 source of dbt v2.0, a from-scratch Rust rewrite; the v1 Python implementation now lives on the 1.latest branch.
en.stack: Written in Rust and shipped as a single self-contained binary per OS/architecture, with no Python runtime or dependency management; it emits Parquet artifacts while still producing JSON artifacts for backwards compatibility.
en.hot: As the most popular transformation tool in data, dbt's Rust rewrite for v2.0 draws wide attention; the repo has ~13.9k stars, gaining 11 today and ranking 7th on the Rust daily trending list.
uses: Data analysts who transform data with SQL models without deep engineering overhead
Data engineers building tested, documented and version-controlled data pipelines
Platform teams needing faster parse and compile times on large dbt projects
Teams wanting to drop the Python runtime and simplify deployment

zh.tag: 完全离线的开源跨平台语音转文字桌面应用
zh.what: Handy 是一款跨平台桌面应用，按下快捷键说话，松开后即可把语音转成文字并自动粘贴到任意输入框。所有识别都在本地完成，音频不会上传云端，兼顾隐私与易用性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的桌面应用源码、各平台构建脚本（BUILD.md）、发布包与安装说明，支持 Homebrew、winget、.deb 等分发方式，并配有 Discord 社区。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，语音识别基于 Whisper（Small/Medium/Turbo/Large，支持 GPU 加速）与 CPU 优化的 Parakeet V3，并用 Silero VAD 过滤静音。
zh.hot: 上线不久即收获 3.18 万 Star，今日再增 84，登上 Rust 日榜第 16 名；免费、开源、可扩展且完全离线的定位正好切中隐私敏感用户的需求。
uses: 需要快速语音输入文字、又不想把音频上传云端的普通用户
注重隐私合规的开发者、记者、律师等文字工作者
希望基于开源代码二次开发或自建语音输入工具的工程师
在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 桌面上寻找轻量听写替代方案的人

en.tag: A free, open-source, offline speech-to-text desktop app
en.what: Handy is a cross-platform desktop app that turns your speech into text: press a shortcut, speak, release, and the transcription is pasted into any text field. Everything runs locally, so audio never leaves your computer.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust desktop app source, platform build scripts (BUILD.md), release artifacts and install instructions for Homebrew, winget and .deb, plus a Discord community.
en.stack: Written in Rust, it uses Whisper models (Small/Medium/Turbo/Large with GPU acceleration) and the CPU-optimized Parakeet V3, with Silero VAD for silence filtering.
en.hot: It has quickly reached 31.8k stars, adding 84 today and ranking 16th on the Rust daily trending list, as its free, open-source, extensible and fully offline pitch resonates with privacy-conscious users.
uses: Everyday users who want fast voice dictation without sending audio to the cloud
Privacy-conscious writers, developers, journalists and lawyers
Engineers who want to fork or extend an open-source speech-to-text tool
Anyone on Windows, macOS or Linux looking for a lightweight dictation alternative

zh.tag: 尊重 gitignore 的超快递归正则搜索工具
zh.what: ripgrep（rg）是一个面向行的搜索工具，能递归地在当前目录中按正则表达式查找内容。默认情况下它会遵循 gitignore 规则，并自动跳过隐藏文件、目录和二进制文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、用户指南（GUIDE.md）、FAQ、CHANGELOG 以及各平台的安装与构建说明，并提供每个版本的二进制下载。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，基于 regex 等 crate，通过 Cargo 构建，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，并提供 shell 补全与配置文件。
zh.hot: 凭借比 grep、ag、git grep 快数倍的搜索性能，它已成为开发者日常必备工具，累计收获 68382 颗星，今日再增 61 星并登上 Rust 日榜第 17 名。
uses: 需要在大型代码库中快速定位代码的开发者
希望替代 grep/ack/ag 以提升搜索效率的工程师
在 CI 或脚本中做文本检索与日志过滤的运维人员
学习 Rust 高性能 CLI 工具实现的开源爱好者

en.tag: A blazing-fast recursive regex search tool that respects your gitignore
en.what: ripgrep (rg) is a line-oriented search tool that recursively searches the current directory for a regex pattern. By default it respects gitignore rules and automatically skips hidden files, directories, and binary files.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust source, a user guide (GUIDE.md), FAQ, CHANGELOG, installation and build instructions, plus binary downloads for every release.
en.stack: Written in Rust on top of crates like regex, built with Cargo, with first-class support for Windows, macOS, and Linux plus shell completions and config files.
en.hot: Its search performance is several times faster than grep, ag, and git grep, making it a daily essential for developers—68,382 stars total, +61 today, ranking #17 on the Rust daily trending list.
uses: Developers who need to quickly locate code in large repositories
Engineers replacing grep/ack/ag to speed up their search workflow
Ops staff doing text search and log filtering in CI or scripts
Open-source fans studying high-performance Rust CLI implementations

zh.tag: 开源版 Loom：快速录屏、本地剪辑与可自托管分享
zh.what: Cap 是一个开源的屏幕录制与视频分享工具，定位为 Loom 的替代品。它支持录制屏幕、摄像头和麦克风，提供即时分享链接与本地精修编辑，并可自托管或接入自有 S3 存储，让团队完全掌控数据。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面端应用（基于 Tauri）、Web 仪表盘与后端服务，提供 Instant 与 Studio 两种录制模式，以及评论、转录、分析、团队工作区和自定义域名等功能。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，桌面端使用 Tauri 框架，前端为 Web 应用，支持 S3 兼容存储与自托管部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 22,346 颗星与本月新增 1,552 星登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 第 21 名，反映出开发者对开源、可自托管录屏协作工具的强烈需求。
uses: 需要快速录制产品演示、Bug 报告或异步站会的开发与产品团队
希望摆脱 Loom 订阅、要求数据自主可控并支持自托管的企业
需要为教程、设计评审或客户更新制作精修视频的内容创作者
关注开源 Rust/Tauri 桌面应用架构的开发者与贡献者

en.tag: Open source Loom alternative: fast screen recording, local editing, self-hostable sharing
en.what: Cap is an open source screen recording and video sharing tool positioned as a Loom alternative. It captures screen, camera, and microphone, offers instant share links plus polished local editing, and can be self-hosted or backed by your own S3 storage so teams fully own their data.
en.content: The repo contains a desktop app built on Tauri, a web dashboard, and backend services, offering Instant and Studio recording modes plus comments, transcripts, analytics, team workspaces, and custom domains.
en.stack: Primary language is Rust, with the desktop app built on Tauri, a web frontend, and support for S3-compatible storage and self-hosted deployment.
en.hot: With 22,346 stars and 1,552 added this month, it ranks 21st on GitHub Trending's monthly Rust list, reflecting strong demand for an open source, self-hostable screen recording and collaboration tool.
uses: Dev and product teams needing fast product demos, bug reports, or async standups
Enterprises wanting to leave Loom and keep data self-hosted and under control
Content creators polishing tutorials, design reviews, or client update videos
Developers interested in the open source Rust/Tauri desktop app architecture

zh.tag: Rust 编写的分布式事务型键值数据库，TiDB 的存储底座
zh.what: TiKV 是一个开源的分布式事务型键值数据库，不仅提供经典 KV API，还提供满足 ACID 的事务 API。它最初由 PingCAP 创建，用于支撑兼容 MySQL 协议的分布式 HTAP 数据库 TiDB。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的存储引擎与 Raft 共识层、PD 调度交互、事务模型（Percolator 风格）代码，以及文档、维护指南和 CI/测试配置。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，基于 Raft 共识算法，共识状态存储在 RocksDB 中，并依赖 Placement Driver (PD) 实现自动分片与数据迁移。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，TiKV 是 TiDB 生态的核心存储组件，拥有约 1.69 万 star，今日新增 10 星并登上 Rust 日榜第 19 名，持续受到分布式数据库开发者关注。
uses: 分布式数据库与存储系统开发者，用于构建高可用、可水平扩展的 KV 存储
TiDB 用户与运维人员，理解底层存储与事务实现

en.tag: A distributed transactional key-value database in Rust, the storage layer behind TiDB
en.what: TiKV is an open-source, distributed, transactional key-value database that offers not only classic key-value APIs but also ACID-compliant transactional APIs. It was originally created by PingCAP to complement TiDB, a MySQL-compatible distributed HTAP database.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust storage engine and Raft consensus layer, PD scheduling integration, the Percolator-style transaction model, plus docs, maintenance guides, and CI/test configuration.
en.stack: Written in Rust, it is powered by the Raft consensus algorithm with consensus state stored in RocksDB, and relies on the Placement Driver (PD) for auto-sharding and data migration.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, TiKV is the core storage component of the TiDB ecosystem, with about 16.9k stars, +10 today, ranking 19th on the Rust daily trending list, drawing steady attention from distributed database developers.
uses: Distributed database and storage developers building highly available, horizontally scalable KV storage
TiDB users and operators seeking to understand the underlying storage and transaction implementation
Cloud-native and CNCF ecosystem contributors working on open-source distributed systems
Engineers learning Raft, the Percolator transaction model, and Rust systems programming

en.tag: Fast native Rust browser automation CLI for AI agents
en.what: agent-browser is a browser automation CLI from Vercel Labs built specifically for AI agents. Written as a fast native Rust binary, it lets agents drive Chrome for web interaction and scraping.

zh.tag: 跨语言声明式原生 GUI 工具包，面向嵌入式与桌面
zh.what: Slint 是一个开源声明式 GUI 工具包，用 .slint 标记语言写一次界面，即可编译成原生应用，运行在嵌入式、桌面、移动和 Web 平台。业务逻辑可用 Rust、C++、JavaScript 或 Python 编写，UI 与逻辑彻底分离。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Slint 编译器与运行时、多语言绑定（Rust/C++/JS/Python）、示例程序（如 Raspberry Pi、STM32、RP2040 上的演示）、VS Code 等编辑器插件，以及 Figma 转 Slint 插件。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 实现，提供 Rust、C++、JavaScript 和 Python 的绑定；UI 由 .slint 声明式语言描述并编译为机器码，支持 GPU 加速渲染，依赖较少，适合资源受限设备。
zh.hot: 项目已积累 23848 颗星，今日新增 25 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 Rust 分类第 21 名。其轻量、跨语言、原生且支持嵌入式的特性，正吸引越来越多需要高性能 GUI 的开发者。
uses: 嵌入式与 IoT 开发者，需要在 MCU 或单板机上构建流畅原生界面
Rust/C++/Python/JS 开发者，希望用声明式 UI 快速搭建跨平台桌面应用

en.tag: Declarative native GUI toolkit for Rust, C++, JS and Python
en.what: Slint is an open-source declarative GUI toolkit that lets you write your UI once in the .slint markup language and compile it into native applications for embedded, desktop, mobile and web. Business logic can be written in Rust, C++, JavaScript or Python, keeping UI and logic cleanly separated.
en.content: The repo contains the Slint compiler and runtime, language bindings for Rust, C++, JavaScript and Python, demo examples (including Raspberry Pi, STM32 and RP2040), editor integrations such as VS Code, and a Figma-to-Slint plugin.
en.stack: The core is written in Rust, with bindings for Rust, C++, JavaScript and Python; UIs are described in the declarative .slint language and compiled to machine code, with GPU-accelerated rendering and minimal dependencies for resource-constrained devices.
en.hot: With 23,848 stars and 25 added today, it ranks 21st on GitHub Trending's daily Rust list. Its lightweight, cross-language, native and embedded-friendly design keeps drawing developers who need high-performance GUIs.
uses: Embedded and IoT developers building smooth native UIs on MCUs or single-board computers
Rust/C++/Python/JS developers who want declarative cross-platform desktop apps
Designer-developer teams wanting parallel UI and logic work via .slint and the Figma plugin
Product teams needing a stable 1.x API and a lightweight runtime

zh.tag: 让编码代理像原始人一样说话，省下 65% token 的代理技能与代理层
zh.what: Caveman 是一个面向 AI 编码代理的技能（skill）与代理（proxy），通过强制代理用极简的“原始人式”语言输出，把 token 消耗削减约 65%。它不改模型本身，而是在代理与模型之间做一层输出压缩，从而直接降低按 token 计费的账单。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 Go 编写的代理/CLI 核心、可一键安装的 skill 包（npx skills add）、10 个原生代理包装配置以及 30+ 代理的兼容说明文档，另附 logo、演示视频与安装指南。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，提供 npm 包 @caveman-ai/cli 与 skills.sh 技能分发，支持 30+ 编码代理、10 个原生包装配置，采用 MIT + BSL 双许可。
zh.hot: 凭借“少 token 多干活”的反差梗和 ThePrimeagen 反应视频迅速走红，登上 GitHub Trending 与 Hacker News 第一，已积累 10.6 万 star，今日仍新增 229 星。
uses: 按 token 计费、想压低 AI 编码代理账单的个人开发者与团队
使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 30+ 代理、希望零改造接入省 token 的用户
关注代理输出压缩与成本优化的 AI 工程与平台工程师
想研究提示词/输出风格对成本与质量影响的 AI 研究者

en.tag: A viral skill + proxy that makes coding agents talk like cavemen to cut 65% of tokens
en.what: Caveman is a skill and proxy for AI coding agents that cuts token usage by roughly 65% by forcing agents to speak in terse, caveman-style language. It doesn't change the model itself; it compresses agent output at the layer between agent and model, directly lowering token-based bills.
en.content: The repo ships a Go-based proxy/CLI core, a one-command installable skill package (npx skills add), 10 native agent wrap profiles, and compatibility docs for 30+ agents, plus logos, a demo video, and install guides.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, distributed via the npm package @caveman-ai/cli and skills.sh, supporting 30+ coding agents and 10 native wrap profiles under an MIT + BSL dual license.
en.hot: It went viral on the back of the 'few token do trick' meme and a ThePrimeagen reaction video, topping GitHub Trending and Hacker News, and now sits at 106k stars with 229 added today.
uses: Individual devs and teams billed by tokens who want to shrink their AI coding agent bills
Users of Claude Code, Cursor and 30+ other agents who want zero-effort token savings
AI and platform engineers interested in agent output compression and cost optimization
AI researchers studying how prompt/output style affects cost and quality

zh.tag: 把 AI 编码代理当队友管理的开源看板工作区
zh.what: Multica 是一个开源、可自托管的协作工作区，让你像给同事派活一样把 issue 分配给 AI 编码代理。代理会认领任务、汇报进度、抛出阻塞点，完成后交回人工评审，从而把散落在各个终端里的代理统一管起来。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 编写的服务端为核心，包含看板式工作区界面、代理调度与任务流转逻辑，以及配套的文档站点（apps/docs）和自托管部署说明。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，提供自托管部署方案，并宣称兼容 26 种代理 CLI（如 Claude Code、Codex 等），强调无供应商锁定。
zh.hot: 它切中了「代理越加越多、人越管越累」的痛点，加上开源可自托管、无锁定，迅速积累 5 万余 star，今日再涨 205 并登上 Go 日榜第 6。

想把 AI 代理纳入现有 issue/看板流程的工程团队

en.tag: An open-source board where AI coding agents work like teammates
en.what: Multica is an open-source, self-hostable workspace where you assign issues to AI coding agents the way you would to a teammate. Agents pick up work, report progress, raise blockers, and hand it back for review, so you stop babysitting scattered terminal sessions.
en.content: The repo centers on a Go backend with a kanban-style workspace UI, agent scheduling and task-flow logic, plus a docs site (apps/docs) and self-hosting guides.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, it ships with self-hosting support and claims compatibility with 26 agent CLIs such as Claude Code and Codex, with no vendor lock-in.
en.hot: It targets the pain of managing ever more agents, and being open-source, self-hostable and lock-in free helped it reach 50k+ stars, gaining 205 today and ranking 6th on the Go daily trending list.

Engineering teams wanting to fold AI agents into their existing issue/board workflow
Organizations needing self-hosting for data sovereignty
Tinkerers curious about multi-agent collaboration and task orchestration

zh.tag: 支撑 E2B 云与自托管的 Firecracker 微虚拟机运行时
zh.what: E2B Runtime 是 E2B 云背后的完整后端，包含控制面 API、节点编排器、VM 内代理、边缘路由和模板构建器。它为每个 AI 代理会话提供独立的 Linux 微虚拟机，可从快照秒级恢复、运行不可信代码，并在代理停止时暂停。
zh.content: 仓库包含控制面 API、节点编排器、VM 内代理、边缘路由、模板构建器，以及可在单机运行的 Embed 包。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 1.26 编写，基于 Firecracker microVM、userfaultfd 懒加载和写时复制根文件系统，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。
zh.hot: 作为 E2B 云的开源核心，它解决了 AI 代理安全执行不可信代码的痛点，今日新增 33 星，登上 Go 日榜第 12 名。
uses: AI 代理平台开发者 —— 需要为代理提供安全隔离的执行环境
基础设施工程师 —— 希望自托管或嵌入 Firecracker 微虚拟机运行时
企业团队 —— 需要专用部署和快照恢复能力
开源贡献者 —— 对 Go 和虚拟化技术感兴趣

en.tag: The Firecracker microVM runtime powering E2B Cloud and self-hosted deployments
en.what: E2B Runtime is the complete backend behind E2B Cloud, including the control-plane API, per-node orchestrator, in-VM agent, edge router, and template builder. It gives every AI agent session its own isolated Linux microVM that resumes from a snapshot, runs untrusted code, and can pause when the agent stops.
en.content: The repo contains the control-plane API, per-node orchestrator, in-VM agent, edge router, template builder, and an Embed package for single-machine use.
en.stack: Written in Go 1.26, built on Firecracker microVMs, userfaultfd lazy paging, and copy-on-write root filesystems, licensed under Apache-2.0.
en.hot: As the open-source core of E2B Cloud, it solves the pain of safely executing untrusted agent code, gaining 33 stars today and ranking #12 on the Go daily trending list.
uses: AI agent platform developers — need secure isolated execution environments for agents
Infrastructure engineers — want to self-host or embed a Firecracker microVM runtime
Enterprise teams — require dedicated deployments and snapshot resume capabilities
Open-source contributors — interested in Go and virtualization

zh.tag: Tailscale 数据平面版 netcat，无需控制平面与账号
zh.what: Tailcat 把 Tailscale 开源组件重新组合成一个类似 netcat 的工具：一端启动监听并生成简短地址，另一端用该地址连接，流量经 WireGuard 端到端加密。它只借用 Tailscale 的数据平面（magicsock + DERP），连接元数据完全由用户自行带外交换，不需要 Tailscale 账号或管理员权限。
zh.content: 仓库包含可导入的 Go 库（github.com/tailscale/tailcat）、cmd/tailcat 命令行工具，以及编译到 WebAssembly 的浏览器演示，另有 INSTALL.md 列出各平台安装方式。
zh.stack: 主语言 Go，核心依赖 Tailscale 的 magicsock 数据平面与 WireGuard 加密，DERP 作为打洞信令与中继，可自建 derper 或使用默认 DERP 地图。
zh.hot: 凭借「Tailscale without Tailscale, by Tailscale」的巧妙定位，项目已获 7420 星，今日新增 149 星，登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 7 名。
uses: 需要点对点加密传输文件或文本、又不想注册账号或改路由表的开发者
希望把 WireGuard 打洞能力嵌入自己 Go 程序的工程师，可直接导入库
在受限网络下用 DERP 中继做临时安全通道的运维与安全人员
想体验浏览器与 CLI 互传文件的用户，可试用 WebAssembly 演示

en.tag: netcat over Tailscale's data plane, no control plane or account required
en.what: Tailcat remixes Tailscale's open source pieces into a netcat-like tool: one side runs a listener and returns a short address, the other connects with it, and all traffic is end-to-end encrypted with WireGuard. It uses only Tailscale's data plane (magicsock + DERP) while connection metadata is exchanged out of band, requiring no Tailscale account or admin rights.
en.content: It ships an importable Go library (github.com/tailscale/tailcat), the cmd/tailcat CLI, and a WebAssembly browser demo, plus INSTALL.md covering install methods per platform.
en.stack: Written in Go, it builds on Tailscale's magicsock data plane and WireGuard encryption, using DERP for hole-punching signaling and relay, with either the default DERP map or a self-hosted derper.
en.hot: With its clever "Tailscale without Tailscale, by Tailscale" pitch, it has reached 7,420 stars, gaining 149 today and ranking 7th on GitHub Trending's daily Go list.
uses: Developers who want encrypted peer-to-peer file or text transfer without accounts or routing changes
Engineers embedding WireGuard hole-punching into their own Go programs via the importable library
Ops and security folks needing a temporary secure channel over DERP in restricted networks
Users curious about browser-to-CLI file transfer via the WebAssembly demo

zh.tag: 命令行模糊查找器与交互式终端工具箱
zh.what: fzf 是一个通用的命令行模糊查找器，能对文件、命令历史、进程等任意列表进行交互式模糊筛选。它同时是一套事件驱动的终端工具箱，可把 shell 脚本变成带菜单和预览的丰富终端应用。

zh.hot: 作为命令行效率工具的经典之作，fzf 已积累约 8.3 万 star，本周仍新增 158 星并登上 GitHub Go 周榜第 14 名，说明其长期活跃且被广泛依赖。
