工具链作者：基于其事件驱动架构构建自定义终端界面

en.tag: A general-purpose command-line fuzzy finder and interactive terminal toolkit
en.what: fzf is a general-purpose command-line fuzzy finder that interactively filters any list such as files, command history, or processes. It is also an event-driven terminal toolkit that turns shell scripts into rich terminal applications with menus and previews.
en.content: The repo centers on Go source code, plus shell integration scripts (Bash/Zsh/Fish/Nushell), a Vim/Neovim plugin, and installation and build docs.
en.stack: Written in Go and shipped as a single static binary with no runtime dependencies; integrates with Bash, Zsh, Fish, Nushell, Vim, and Neovim via shell scripts and plugins.
en.hot: A classic of command-line productivity, fzf has around 83k stars and still gained 158 this week, ranking 14th on GitHub's weekly Go trending list, showing lasting activity and wide reliance.
uses: Terminal power users: fuzzy-find files, directories, and shell history quickly
Developers and ops: add interactive menus, previews, and selection flows to scripts

Tool authors: build custom terminal UIs on its event-driven architecture

zh.tag: 飞书官方 CLI，为人类与 AI 代理打造，覆盖 200+ 命令与 26 项技能。

en.tag: Official Lark/Feishu CLI built for humans and AI Agents, with 200+ commands and 26 Skills.

zh.tag: 为大规模 JavaScript 应用加上可选类型的编译型语言

en.tag: A typed superset of JavaScript that compiles to clean JavaScript
en.what: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript that adds optional static types, enabling type checking and tooling for large-scale applications. It compiles down to readable, standards-based JavaScript that runs in any browser, on any host, on any OS.

Library and framework authors shipping npm packages with type declarations
Tech leads reducing runtime errors in multi-person collaboration via type checking
Learners getting started with typed JavaScript through the handbook and Playground

zh.tag: 面向所有人的现代化 Docker 管理面板
zh.what: Arcane 是一个现代化的 Docker 管理平台，提供直观的 Web 界面来管理容器、镜像、网络与卷等资源。它把原本依赖命令行的 Docker 运维操作图形化，让新手和团队都能轻松上手。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务（backend/v2）与前端界面，配有官方文档站点、多语言翻译（Crowdin）以及 SBOM 软件物料清单。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，采用 BSD-3-Clause 许可证，通过 pkg.go.dev 发布后端模块，并使用 Snyk 做漏洞检测、Crowdin 做本地化。
zh.hot: 凭借 7425 颗星和当日 32 个新增，它登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 12 名，反映出开发者对轻量、易用 Docker 管理工具的强烈需求。
uses: 个人开发者与家庭实验室用户，用图形界面替代繁琐的 Docker 命令行操作
中小团队运维人员，集中查看和管理多主机上的容器与镜像
Docker 初学者，通过可视化面板快速理解容器、网络与卷的概念

en.tag: Modern Docker management, designed for everyone
en.what: Arcane is a modern Docker management platform that offers an intuitive web UI for handling containers, images, networks, and volumes. It turns command-line Docker operations into a graphical experience that both newcomers and teams can pick up easily.
en.content: The repo ships a Go backend (backend/v2) plus a frontend UI, along with an official docs site, Crowdin-based translations, and a published SBOM.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go under the BSD-3-Clause license, with the backend published on pkg.go.dev, plus Snyk for vulnerability scanning and Crowdin for localization.
en.hot: With 7,425 stars and 32 added today, it ranks 12th on GitHub Trending's daily Go list, reflecting strong demand for lightweight, easy-to-use Docker management tools.
uses: Individual developers and homelab users who want a GUI instead of tedious Docker CLI commands
Small-team ops engineers managing containers and images across multiple hosts
Docker beginners learning containers, networks, and volumes through a visual dashboard

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的分布式图结构持久记忆与任务追踪器
zh.what: Beads 为编码代理提供持久化、结构化的记忆，用依赖感知的图取代混乱的 markdown 计划，让代理在长周期任务中不丢失上下文。它本质上是一个由 Dolt 驱动的分布式图 issue 追踪器，支持多机器、多代理协同。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 Go 编写的 CLI 工具（bd），包含安装脚本、文档、以及面向 Codex、Claude、Factory、Cursor 等代理/IDE 的集成配置；核心是 create/ready/claim/close 的图工作流与 dolt push/pull 同步。
zh.stack: 主语言 Go，底层依赖 Dolt 提供版本化、可分布式同步的 SQL 图存储；同时发布 npm 包 @beads/bd 与 PyPI 包 beads-mcp，支持 MCP 接入。
zh.hot: 项目已积累 27262 颗星，今日再增 78 星，登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 13 名；它切中了 AI 代理长任务上下文丢失的痛点，且由知名开发者 Steve Yegge 参与，关注度持续走高。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Codex 等编码代理进行长周期开发的工程师
需要跨机器、跨代理协同追踪任务与共享记忆的团队
希望用结构化依赖图替代 markdown TODO 的开发者
想通过 MCP 把持久记忆接入自有代理工具链的构建者

en.tag: A distributed graph-based persistent memory and issue tracker for coding agents
en.what: Beads gives coding agents persistent, structured memory, replacing messy markdown plans with a dependency-aware graph so agents can handle long-horizon tasks without losing context. It is essentially a distributed graph issue tracker powered by Dolt, supporting collaboration across machines and agents.
en.content: The repo is a Go CLI tool (bd) with install scripts, docs, and integrations for agents/IDEs like Codex, Claude, Factory, and Cursor; its core is a create/ready/claim/close graph workflow plus dolt push/pull sync.
en.stack: Written in Go, it relies on Dolt for versioned, distributable SQL graph storage; it also ships an npm package @beads/bd and a PyPI package beads-mcp for MCP integration.
en.hot: It has accumulated 27,262 stars with 78 added today, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending's daily Go chart; it tackles the pain of context loss in long agent tasks and involves well-known developer Steve Yegge, keeping attention high.
uses: Engineers doing long-horizon development with coding agents like Claude Code and Codex
Teams needing cross-machine, cross-agent task tracking and shared memory
Developers who want a structured dependency graph instead of markdown TODOs
Builders integrating persistent memory into their own agent toolchains via MCP

zh.tag: 本地化光伏充电与家庭能源管理系统
zh.what: evcc 是一个可扩展的电动汽车充电控制器与家庭能源管理系统，核心目标是在不依赖云服务的前提下实现本地能源管理。它能根据光伏发电、电价与电池状态智能调节充电功率，让电动车尽量用太阳能充电。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Go 编写的核心程序，附带 Web UI 截图与配置示例，支持 Docker 镜像、Home Assistant 集成以及 Weblate 多语言翻译。文档站 docs.evcc.io 单独维护，涵盖充电桩、智能开关、热泵等设备支持列表。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，提供 Docker 镜像与 Home Assistant 插件，支持 OCPP、EEBus、Modbus 等协议，通过 MQTT/REST 与各类充电桩、逆变器、智能开关和热泵通信。
zh.hot: 凭借 7235 颗星与今日新增 6 星登上 Go 日榜第 17 名，反映出欧洲能源价格高企下，用户对本地化、免云的光伏充电方案需求旺盛。
uses: 拥有光伏与电动车的家庭用户，希望最大化自用太阳能充电
智能家居玩家，想用 Home Assistant 统一管理充电与用电
充电桩厂商或集成商，需要开源、可扩展的充电控制方案
关注能源独立与隐私、不愿依赖云服务的极客用户

en.tag: Local solar charging and home energy management system
en.what: evcc is an extensible EV charge controller and home energy management system designed to run locally without relying on cloud services. It intelligently adjusts charging power based on solar generation, electricity prices, and battery state so EVs charge primarily on solar energy.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based core application, a web UI, configuration examples, Docker images, Home Assistant integration, and Weblate translations. Documentation lives separately at docs.evcc.io, covering supported chargers, smart switches, heat pumps, and more.
en.stack: Written in Go, distributed as Docker images and a Home Assistant add-on, supporting OCPP, EEBus, and Modbus protocols. It communicates with chargers, inverters, smart switches, and heat pumps via MQTT/REST.
en.hot: With 7,235 stars and 6 added today, it ranks 17th on the Go daily trending list, reflecting strong demand for local, cloud-free solar charging amid high European energy prices.
uses: Homeowners with solar panels and EVs wanting to maximize self-consumed solar charging
Smart home enthusiasts integrating charging and energy management via Home Assistant
Charger vendors or integrators seeking an open, extensible charging control solution
Privacy-conscious users who want energy independence without cloud dependency

zh.tag: Go 语言官方开源仓库，简洁高效编程语言的主场
zh.what: 这是 Go 编程语言的官方源码仓库，由 Google 主导开发并维护。它提供了编译器、运行时、标准库以及完整的工具链，让开发者能轻松构建简单、可靠且高效的软件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 的完整实现：编译器（gc）、运行时、标准库、以及 gofmt、go test 等工具，还有大量测试与文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言自身编写（自举），并包含少量汇编与 C 代码；依赖极简，构建过程自包含。
zh.hot: 作为一门主流编程语言的官方仓库，它长期保持极高关注度，已获 138,857 颗星，本周新增 914 颗，稳居 GitHub Trending 周榜 Go 分类第 7 名。
uses: Go 语言开发者：获取最新源码、提交问题或参与贡献
编程语言爱好者与研究者：学习工业级语言设计与实现
运维与后端工程师：构建高并发、高性能服务端应用

en.tag: The official open-source repository of the Go programming language
en.what: This is the official source repository of the Go programming language, led and maintained by Google. It provides the compiler, runtime, standard library, and a complete toolchain, enabling developers to build simple, reliable, and efficient software.
en.content: The repo contains the full implementation of Go: the compiler (gc), runtime, standard library, and tools like gofmt and go test, plus extensive tests and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go itself (self-hosting), with some assembly and C; dependencies are minimal and the build is self-contained.
en.hot: As the official repository of a mainstream programming language, it maintains extremely high attention with 138,857 stars and 914 new stars this week, ranking 7th on GitHub Trending's weekly Go list.
uses: Go developers: access the latest source, report issues, or contribute
Programming language enthusiasts and researchers: study industrial-grade language design and implementation
DevOps and backend engineers: build high-concurrency, high-performance server applications

zh.tag: 支持 S3、POSIX 与 Iceberg 的分布式存储系统，单机可扛数十亿文件
zh.what: SeaweedFS 是一个简单且高度可扩展的分布式文件系统，目标是存储数十亿文件并快速提供访问。单个 weed 二进制即可同时提供 S3 对象存储、POSIX 文件系统和基于 S3 Tables 的湖仓能力，所有数据共享同一份底层存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心服务与命令行工具（weed），以及 Docker、Helm/Kubernetes 部署配置、客户端 SDK（Java/Maven 等）、白皮书与 Wiki 文档。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，提供 Docker 镜像、Helm Chart 与 Maven 客户端；支持 S3 API、POSIX 挂载、Iceberg 表格式以及云存储分层缓存。
zh.hot: 34,651 颗星、本月新增 628，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Go 第 20 名；在对象存储与湖仓一体需求上升的背景下，其 O(1) 磁盘访问和横向扩展能力持续吸引关注。
uses: 需要自建 S3 兼容对象存储、替代 MinIO 的团队与运维工程师
为海量小文件、图片、视频等场景寻找高吞吐存储后端的开发者
希望用同一套存储同时支撑文件系统与 Iceberg 湖仓的数据平台团队
在 Kubernetes 上部署有状态存储、关注水平扩展与云分层缓存的架构师

en.tag: Distributed storage for S3, POSIX and Iceberg tables, scaling to billions of files
en.what: SeaweedFS is a simple, highly scalable distributed file system built to store billions of files and serve them fast. A single weed binary provides an S3 object store, a POSIX file system, and a lakehouse with S3 Tables, all over the same data.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based core services and the weed CLI, plus Docker and Helm/Kubernetes deployment configs, client SDKs (Java/Maven, etc.), whitepapers and wiki docs.
en.stack: Written in Go, shipped with Docker images, Helm charts and a Maven client; supports the S3 API, POSIX mounts, Iceberg table format, and cloud storage tiering/caching.
en.hot: With 34,651 stars and 628 added this month, it ranks 20th on GitHub's monthly Go trending list; as object storage and lakehouse needs grow, its O(1) disk access and horizontal scaling keep drawing attention.
uses: Teams and SREs building self-hosted S3-compatible object storage as a MinIO alternative
Developers needing a high-throughput storage backend for massive small files, images or videos
Data platform teams wanting one storage layer for both file systems and Iceberg lakehouse tables
Architects deploying stateful storage on Kubernetes with horizontal scaling and cloud tiering in mind

zh.tag: 持久化执行平台，让分布式应用自动容错重试
zh.what: Temporal 是一个持久化执行平台，让开发者构建可扩展的应用时无需牺牲生产力与可靠性。服务端以弹性方式执行称为 Workflow 的应用逻辑单元，自动处理间歇性故障并重试失败操作。它源自 Uber 的 Cadence 分支，由原班人马创立的 Temporal Technologies 维护。
zh.content: 仓库是 Temporal 服务端核心实现，包含 Workflow 引擎、历史/匹配/前端等服务组件，并配套 CLI、Web UI 与 Go/Java 示例。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，依赖 gRPC、Protobuf、Cassandra/MySQL/PostgreSQL 等持久化存储，提供多语言 SDK。
zh.hot: 23k+ star 的成熟基础设施项目，今日再登 Go 日榜第 13，说明持久化执行正成为微服务与 AI 工作流编排的刚需。
uses: 需要构建长流程、多步骤且要求高可靠性的后端工程师
希望用代码而非复杂状态机编排分布式事务的团队
为 AI Agent 或数据处理管道提供可靠执行引擎的开发者
想学习工业级 Go 分布式系统架构的进阶读者

en.tag: Durable execution platform that makes distributed apps fault-tolerant and retryable
en.what: Temporal is a durable execution platform that lets developers build scalable applications without sacrificing productivity or reliability. The server executes units of application logic called Workflows resiliently, automatically handling intermittent failures and retrying failed operations. It originated as a fork of Uber's Cadence and is maintained by Temporal Technologies, founded by Cadence's creators.
en.content: The repo is the core Temporal server implementation, containing the Workflow engine and history/matching/frontend service components, plus CLI, Web UI, and Go/Java samples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, it relies on gRPC, Protobuf, and persistence stores like Cassandra/MySQL/PostgreSQL, with multi-language SDKs.
en.hot: A mature 23k+ star infrastructure project, it re-enters the Go daily trending list at #13, showing durable execution is becoming essential for microservices and AI workflow orchestration.
uses: Backend engineers building long-running, multi-step, highly reliable processes
Teams wanting to orchestrate distributed transactions in code instead of complex state machines
Developers needing a reliable execution engine for AI agents or data pipelines
Advanced readers studying industrial-grade Go distributed system architecture

zh.tag: 云与边缘原生的高性能消息系统服务端
zh.what: NATS 是一个简单、安全、高性能的通信系统，用于连接数字系统、服务和设备。nats-server 是它的核心服务端，可部署在本地、云端、边缘甚至树莓派上。它隶属于 CNCF，支持超过 40 种客户端语言实现。
zh.content: 仓库包含 NATS 服务端完整源码，涵盖核心消息路由、JetStream 持久化、集群与网关、账户与安全认证等模块，并提供 Docker 镜像与多平台发布产物。
zh.stack: 以 Go 语言编写，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，依赖标准 Go 工具链与 CI 测试流程，官方提供 Docker 镜像及多平台二进制发布。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，NATS 是云原生消息中间件的主流选择，已积累 20777 颗星，今日再登 Go 日榜第 10，社区活跃度持续稳定。
uses: 微服务架构师，用于服务间低延迟异步通信与解耦
云原生与边缘计算团队，构建跨云、跨边缘的统一消息总线
IoT 与设备接入开发者，在树莓派等轻量设备上运行消息服务
需要 JetStream 持久化与流式处理的实时数据平台团队

en.tag: High-performance messaging server for cloud and edge native systems
en.what: NATS is a simple, secure and performant communications system for digital systems, services and devices. nats-server is its core server, deployable on-premise, in the cloud, at the edge, or even on a Raspberry Pi. It is a CNCF project with over 40 client language implementations.
en.content: The repo holds the full NATS server source, covering core message routing, JetStream persistence, clustering and gateways, accounts and security, plus Docker images and multi-platform release artifacts.
en.stack: Written in Go under Apache 2.0, built with the standard Go toolchain and CI test workflows, shipping official Docker images and multi-platform binaries.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, NATS is a mainstream choice for cloud-native messaging, with 20,777 stars and another Go daily trending spot at #10, showing steady community activity.
uses: Microservice architects needing low-latency async communication and decoupling between services
Cloud-native and edge teams building a unified message bus across cloud and edge
IoT and device developers running messaging on lightweight hardware like Raspberry Pi
Real-time data platform teams needing JetStream persistence and stream processing

zh.tag: OpenTelemetry Collector 官方贡献组件库，汇聚数百个采集与导出插件
zh.what: 这是 OpenTelemetry Collector 的贡献仓库，提供官方核心之外的大量接收器、处理器、导出器和扩展组件。它让用户无需自己造轮子，即可把各类数据源与后端接入统一的遥测数据管道。
zh.content: 仓库按 receiver、processor、exporter、extension、connector 等目录组织，每个组件都是独立 Go module，并配有 README、示例配置与测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，基于 OpenTelemetry Collector 核心 API 与 pdata 模型，依赖各厂商 SDK 和协议库，通过 Makefile 与 CI 构建测试。
zh.hot: 作为可观测性事实标准 OpenTelemetry 的关键仓库，它拥有近 5000 star，今日新增 30 并登上 Go 日榜第 19，说明可观测性基础设施仍是开发者关注焦点。
uses: 需要将自研或第三方系统接入 OpenTelemetry 管道的平台工程师
希望快速为 Collector 添加新数据源或后端的可观测性开发者
运维与 SRE 团队，用现成组件搭建统一遥测采集与导出链路

en.tag: Official contrib repo for OpenTelemetry Collector, bundling hundreds of receiver, processor and exporter components
en.what: This is the contrib repository for the OpenTelemetry Collector, offering a large set of receivers, processors, exporters and extensions beyond the core distribution. It lets users plug diverse data sources and backends into a unified telemetry pipeline without building components themselves.
en.content: The repo is organized into receiver, processor, exporter, extension and connector directories, each component being its own Go module with README, sample config and tests.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, it builds on the OpenTelemetry Collector core APIs and pdata model, depending on vendor SDKs and protocol libraries, with Makefile and CI for build and test.
en.hot: As a key repo of OpenTelemetry, the de facto observability standard, it has nearly 5,000 stars, gained 30 today and ranked 19th on the Go daily trending list, showing observability infrastructure remains a developer focus.
uses: Platform engineers integrating custom or third-party systems into OpenTelemetry pipelines
Observability developers wanting to quickly add new data sources or backends to the Collector
Ops and SRE teams building unified telemetry collection and export pipelines with ready-made components

zh.tag: 为现有 AI 编程代理提供记忆、工作流与可验证证据的确定性工程环境
zh.what: Gentle-AI 是一个开源配置层，为你已经在用的 AI 编程代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor、OpenCode、Codex、Pi 等 16 种）注入持久记忆、规格驱动开发、精选技能、MCP 服务器、人格设定和可选的有界审查。它不锁定任何代理，目标是让代理写代码后不再失忆，并能证明自己做了什么。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 工具、文档（快速开始、预期用法、Wiki）、品牌资源以及针对不同代理的配置模板和技能库。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，跨平台支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows，采用 MIT 许可证。依赖可能包括各代理的配置接口和 MCP 协议。
zh.hot: 本周新增 411 颗星，总星数达 6911，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Go）第 9 名。它解决了 AI 代理缺乏记忆和工作流的痛点，且支持多种主流代理，无锁定，因此受到开发者关注。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理的开发者，希望增强代理的记忆和工作流能力。
团队需要规格驱动开发和可验证的代理行为，以提升代码质量和可审计性。
希望避免代理锁定，灵活切换或组合多种 AI 编程工具的用户。
对 MCP 服务器、技能库和人格设定等高级功能感兴趣的 AI 工程实践者。

en.tag: A deterministic engineering environment that gives your existing AI coding agents memory, workflow, and evidence.
en.what: Gentle-AI is an open-source configuration layer that injects persistent memory, Spec-Driven Development, curated skills, MCP servers, personas, and optional bounded review into the AI coding agents you already use (16 agents including Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex, and Pi). It avoids agent lock-in and aims to stop your agent from forgetting everything after writing code, while providing evidence of what it did.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based CLI tool, documentation (quickstart, intended usage, wiki), brand assets, and configuration templates and skill libraries for different agents.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, cross-platform for macOS, Linux, and Windows, under MIT license. Dependencies may include configuration interfaces for various agents and the MCP protocol.
en.hot: It gained 411 stars this week, reaching 6,911 total, and ranked 9th on GitHub Trending weekly (Go). It addresses the pain point of AI agents lacking memory and workflow, supports multiple mainstream agents without lock-in, thus attracting developer attention.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor who want to enhance agent memory and workflow.
Teams needing Spec-Driven Development and verifiable agent behavior for better code quality and auditability.
Users who want to avoid agent lock-in and flexibly switch or combine multiple AI coding tools.
AI engineering practitioners interested in advanced features like MCP servers, skill libraries, and personas.

zh.tag: 用声明式配置安全可预测地构建与变更基础设施的 IaC 工具
zh.what: Terraform 是 HashiCorp 推出的基础设施即代码（IaC）工具，用高层配置语法描述数据中心蓝图，把基础设施当作代码来版本化、共享和复用。它通过执行计划（plan）和资源图（graph）在 apply 前展示将要发生的变更，并并行创建无依赖资源，从而安全高效地管理公有云与自建服务商。
zh.content: 该仓库仅包含 Terraform 核心（core）代码，主语言为 Go；文档、教程与认证资料托管在 developer.hashicorp.com 和 HashiCorp Learn 平台，仓库内以官网、论坛、文档、教程和认证考试链接作为入口。
zh.stack: 核心以 Go 语言实现，采用声明式 HCL 配置语法与插件化的 provider 生态；依赖 HashiCorp 自研的插件协议与资源图调度机制，可对接各大云厂商及自建 API。
zh.hot: 近 5 万 star 的 Terraform 是 IaC 领域事实标准，今日再登 Go 日榜第 21 名（+29 star），说明基础设施自动化仍是云原生工程师的刚需。
uses: 云平台与 DevOps 工程师，用声明式配置管理多云基础设施
平台/SRE 团队，把环境蓝图纳入 Git 做版本化与代码评审
需要可复现、可审计基础设施变更的合规与安全团队
准备 HashiCorp Terraform Associate 认证的学习者

en.tag: A source-available IaC tool that codifies APIs into declarative configs to build, change, and version infrastructure safely
en.what: Terraform is HashiCorp's Infrastructure as Code tool that describes infrastructure with a high-level configuration syntax, letting teams version, share, and reuse a datacenter blueprint like any other code. Its planning step and resource graph preview changes before apply and parallelize independent resources, making infrastructure management safe and efficient across public clouds and in-house providers.
en.content: This repository contains only Terraform core, written mainly in Go; docs, tutorials, and certification materials live on developer.hashicorp.com and HashiCorp's Learn platform, with the README serving as an index of website, forum, documentation, tutorial, and certification links.
en.stack: The core is implemented in Go with a declarative HCL configuration syntax and a plugin-based provider ecosystem; it relies on HashiCorp's plugin protocol and resource-graph scheduling to integrate with major clouds and custom APIs.
en.hot: With nearly 50k stars, Terraform is the de facto standard for IaC, and its return to the Go trending list at #21 (+29 stars today) shows infrastructure automation remains a core need for cloud-native engineers.
uses: Cloud and DevOps engineers managing multi-cloud infrastructure with declarative configs
Platform/SRE teams versioning environment blueprints in Git for review and reuse
Compliance and security teams needing reproducible, auditable infrastructure changes
Learners preparing for the HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate exam

zh.tag: GTA 5 增强版的开源作弊菜单 DLL
zh.what: 《GTA 5: Enhanced》的实验性修改菜单（mod menu）：编译成 DLL 后用 Xenos 等注入器在游戏主菜单注入，按 INSERT 或 Ctrl+\ 呼出菜单。建议配合 FSL 把存档数据重定向到本地磁盘以保号，且需要关闭 BattlEye 反作弊（目前没有 BE 绕过，公共战局会被心跳检测踢出）。
zh.content: C++ 源码 + 一份简短 README，讲清使用步骤（FSL → 下载 nightly release → 注入器 → 关 BattlEye → 注入）和常见问题修复（掉线、存档消失、游戏起不来）。
zh.stack: C++，DLL 注入式单机/联机修改器，依赖外部注入器和 FSL，GPL-2.0；默认分支 enhanced。
zh.hot: 它面向 GTA5 增强版 Mod 社区的具体需求，并延续 YimMenu 项目路线，为需要开源菜单的用户提供选择。
uses: GTA5 单机玩家 —— 刷车刷钱体验全部游戏内容
mod 开发者 —— 基于源码学习或二次开发游戏菜单
离线娱乐 —— 关 BattlEye 后在私人战局整活

en.tag: The open-source mod menu DLL for GTA 5: Enhanced
en.what: An experimental mod menu for GTA 5: Enhanced: compile to a DLL, inject at the main menu with an injector like Xenos, then press INSERT or Ctrl+\ to open. Pairing with FSL (redirecting save data to local disk) is recommended to protect your account, and BattlEye anti-cheat must be disabled (there's no BE bypass — public sessions will kick you via heartbeat checks).
en.content: C++ source plus a short README covering the workflow (FSL → nightly release → injector → disable BattlEye → inject) and fixes for common issues (disconnects, missing saves, game won't launch).
en.stack: C++, a DLL-injection single/multiplayer mod menu relying on external injectors and FSL; GPL-2.0; default branch enhanced.
en.hot: It targets a concrete need in the GTA5 Enhanced modding community and continues the familiar YimMenu project line for users seeking an open menu.
uses: GTA5 single-player fans — unlock vehicles and cash to experience all content
mod developers — learn from or fork the source for custom game menus
Offline fun — mess around in private sessions with BattlEye off

zh.tag: 跨平台开源密码管理器，离线加密存储敏感信息
zh.what: KeePassXC 是 Windows 应用 KeePass Password Safe 的社区驱动跨平台移植版，用于安全地存储和管理用户名、密码、URL、附件与笔记等敏感信息。所有数据保存在本地加密的 KDBX 文件中，可放在任意位置，包括私有或公有云盘。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 桌面应用源码，涵盖核心数据库逻辑、GUI、密码生成器、TOTP、浏览器集成与自动输入等模块，并配有测试、CI 配置和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 与 Qt 框架开发，依赖 libgcrypt、Argon2、zlib 等加密与压缩库，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源密码管理器，它已积累 28739 颗星，本月新增 485 星并登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 C++ 第 17 名，反映出用户对本地优先、可审计安全工具的持续需求。
uses: 注重隐私、希望密码完全离线自管的个人用户
需要在 Windows/macOS/Linux 多平台同步使用同一密码库的用户
想审计或自行编译安全软件的开发者与安全爱好者
为团队或家庭搭建本地密码共享方案的技术人员

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source password manager with offline encrypted storage
en.what: KeePassXC is a community-driven, cross-platform port of the Windows KeePass Password Safe, built to securely store and manage sensitive data such as usernames, passwords, URLs, attachments, and notes. Everything lives in a local encrypted KDBX file that can be kept anywhere, including private or public cloud storage.
en.content: The repo holds the full C++ desktop application source, covering core database logic, GUI, password generator, TOTP, browser integration, and auto-type modules, along with tests, CI configs, and docs.
en.stack: Built mainly in C++ with the Qt framework, depending on libgcrypt, Argon2, zlib and other crypto/compression libraries, targeting Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source password manager, it has accumulated 28,739 stars with 485 added this month, ranking 17th on GitHub Trending's monthly C++ list, reflecting steady demand for local-first, auditable security tools.
uses: Privacy-conscious individuals who want fully offline, self-hosted password storage
Users who need the same password vault across Windows, macOS, and Linux
Developers and security enthusiasts who want to audit or self-compile security software
Technical users setting up local password sharing for teams or families

zh.tag: 用 React 构建原生应用的跨平台框架
zh.what: React Native 让你用 React 和 JavaScript 编写代码，渲染为 Android、iOS 等平台的原生 UI 组件。它提供原生手势、文本缩放和无障碍支持，并可通过原生模块扩展平台能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架核心源码（C++/Java/Objective-C 等）、React 组件与 API、文档、示例和构建工具，以及贡献指南和社区支持文件。
zh.stack: 主要用 C++ 编写，同时包含 Java、Objective-C、JavaScript 等；依赖 React、Node.js、npm 包管理，并支持 Android/iOS 原生工具链。
zh.hot: 作为跨平台移动开发的事实标准，React Native 拥有超过 12.6 万 star，今日新增 22 星，持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 移动应用开发者：用一套代码构建 Android 和 iOS 原生应用。
React 前端开发者：将 Web 技能扩展到移动端开发。
需要快速迭代的团队：利用 Fast Refresh 实现秒级热更新。
希望复用原生模块的项目：通过原生模块调用平台特定功能。

en.tag: A framework for building native apps with React
en.what: React Native lets you write React and JavaScript code that renders to native UI components on Android, iOS, and more. It offers native gestures, text scaling, accessibility, and extensibility via native modules.
en.content: The repo contains core framework source (C++/Java/Objective-C, etc.), React components and APIs, documentation, examples, build tooling, plus contribution guides and community support files.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with Java, Objective-C, and JavaScript; depends on React, Node.js, npm, and supports Android/iOS native toolchains.
en.hot: As the de facto standard for cross-platform mobile development, React Native has over 126k stars and gained 22 today, continuously attracting developer attention.
uses: Mobile app developers: build native Android and iOS apps with one codebase.
React web developers: extend web skills to mobile development.
Teams needing fast iteration: use Fast Refresh for instant updates.
Projects needing native modules: call platform-specific features from JavaScript.

zh.tag: 专为 RTX 5090 打造的单卡 C++/CUDA 推理引擎
zh.what: NInfer 是一个从零编写的 C++/CUDA 推理引擎，专门针对单张 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 上的特定 Qwen 检查点进行极致优化。它支持文本、图像和视频输入，可通过本地 CLI 或兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic 的 HTTP API 调用。运行时高度特化：单 GPU、单常驻模型、启动时固定 1 到 8 个并发请求容量。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++/CUDA 源码、CMake 构建系统，以及五个预注册的模型工件（Qwen3.6-27B、Qwen3.8-27B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 groupwise-int 与 nvfp4 版本）。每个工件内嵌 tokenizer、聊天模板和媒体前端资源，需从 Hugging Face 单独下载。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 C++20、CUDA 13.1+（仅支持 sm_120a 架构）、CMake 3.28+、Ninja，并依赖 FFmpeg 开发库（libavformat/libavcodec/libavutil/libswscale）和 libcurl。要求 64 位 Linux 系统。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1306 颗星，总星数达 1600，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 C++ 第 10 名。它精准切中了 RTX 5090 用户对本地高性能单卡推理的需求，且以极致特化换取性能，在 AI 推理社区引发关注。
uses: 拥有 RTX 5090 并希望在本地运行 Qwen 大模型的开发者
需要低延迟、高吞吐单卡推理服务的 AI 应用部署者
对 C++/CUDA 推理引擎实现感兴趣的系统级工程师
想通过 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API 接入本地模型的研究人员

en.tag: A from-scratch C++/CUDA inference engine tuned for single-GPU RTX 5090
en.what: NInfer is a from-scratch C++/CUDA inference engine purpose-built for explicitly registered Qwen checkpoints on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090. It handles text, image, and video prompts via a local CLI or OpenAI-/Anthropic-compatible HTTP APIs. The runtime is deliberately specialized: one GPU, one resident model, and a startup-fixed capacity of one to eight active requests.
en.content: The repo contains C++/CUDA source code, a CMake build system, and five pre-registered model artifacts (groupwise-int and nvfp4 variants of Qwen3.6-27B, Qwen3.8-27B, and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B). Each artifact embeds its tokenizer, chat template, and media frontend resources, and must be downloaded separately from Hugging Face.
en.stack: Tech stack: C++20, CUDA 13.1+ (sm_120a only), CMake 3.28+, Ninja, plus FFmpeg dev libraries (libavformat/libavcodec/libavutil/libswscale) and libcurl. Requires a 64-bit Linux system.
en.hot: It gained 1,306 stars this month (1,600 total), ranking #10 on GitHub Trending's monthly C++ list. It hits a sweet spot for RTX 5090 owners seeking high-performance local single-GPU inference, and its extreme specialization for speed has caught the AI inference community's attention.
uses: Developers with an RTX 5090 who want to run Qwen models locally
AI application deployers needing low-latency, high-throughput single-GPU inference
Systems engineers interested in C++/CUDA inference engine implementation
Researchers wanting to access local models via OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs

zh.tag: 高性能可移植 SIMD 库，支持运行时指令集分发
zh.what: Highway 是一个 C++ 库，提供可移植的 SIMD/向量内建函数，让同一份代码在不同 CPU 架构上高效运行。它支持运行时动态选择最佳指令集，也支持静态编译，兼顾性能与可移植性。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库源码、大量测试与基准测试、示例代码以及详细文档。主要目录有 hwy/（核心实现）、g3doc/（文档）、examples/ 等。
zh.stack: 基于 C++17，支持 x86、ARM、RISC-V 等七种架构，兼容 GCC、Clang、MSVC 等编译器。依赖较少，可独立使用。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 开源的高性能 SIMD 库，Highway 解决了跨平台向量编程的痛点，今日新增 21 星，登上 C++ 日榜第 5 名，受到性能敏感开发者的关注。
uses: 需要极致性能的 C++ 开发者，如图像处理、视频分析、压缩等领域。
希望代码在多种 CPU 架构上高效运行的跨平台项目。
对 SIMD 编程感兴趣，想学习可移植向量化技术的研究者或学生。
需要利用运行时分发在异构云或客户端设备上部署高性能应用。

en.tag: Performance-portable SIMD library with runtime dispatch
en.what: Highway is a C++ library that provides portable SIMD/vector intrinsics, enabling the same code to run efficiently across different CPU architectures. It supports runtime dynamic dispatch to select the best instruction set, as well as static compilation, balancing performance and portability.
en.content: The repository contains the core library source, extensive tests and benchmarks, examples, and detailed documentation. Main directories include hwy/ (core implementation), g3doc/ (docs), examples/, etc.
en.stack: Based on C++17, supports seven architectures including x86, ARM, RISC-V, and is compatible with GCC, Clang, MSVC, etc. It has minimal dependencies and can be used standalone.
en.hot: As Google's open-source high-performance SIMD library, Highway addresses the pain points of cross-platform vector programming. With 21 new stars today, it ranks 5th on the C++ daily trending list, attracting attention from performance-sensitive developers.
uses: C++ developers needing extreme performance, e.g., in image processing, video analysis, compression.
Cross-platform projects that require efficient execution on multiple CPU architectures.
Researchers or students interested in SIMD programming and portable vectorization techniques.
Deploying high-performance applications on heterogeneous clouds or client devices using runtime dispatch.

zh.tag: 微软出品的 Windows Terminal 分支，把 AI 代理原生集成进命令行
zh.what: Intelligent Terminal 是 Windows Terminal 的实验性分支，在终端内原生集成了 AI 代理。它兼容任意支持 Agent Client Protocol (ACP) 的代理 CLI，默认搭配 GitHub Copilot CLI，让用户直接在命令行里与代理协作。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的终端源码（C++），以及代理状态栏、代理面板、代理管理、错误检测、命令面板等模块，并配有安装说明、快捷键、配置文档和 FAQ。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 Windows Terminal 代码库，依赖 Windows 10 2004 及以上系统，并通过 ACP 协议与外部代理 CLI 通信。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方实验项目，它把热门的 AI 代理能力直接嵌入开发者日常使用的终端，上线不久即获约 1990 星，今日新增 20 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 6。
uses: 习惯在命令行工作的开发者，希望不切换窗口就能调用 AI 代理
使用 GitHub Copilot 或其他 ACP 兼容代理 CLI 的用户
想体验微软终端 AI 集成方向的 Windows 用户
关注终端工具链与代理协议演进的开发者

en.tag: Microsoft's Windows Terminal fork with native AI agent integration in the command line
en.what: Intelligent Terminal is an experimental fork of Windows Terminal with native agent integration. It works with any Agent Client Protocol (ACP)-compatible agent CLI, defaulting to GitHub Copilot CLI, so users can collaborate with agents right inside the command line.
en.content: The repo contains the full terminal source (C++) plus modules for the Agent Status Bar, Agent Pane, Agent Management, Error Detection, and Command Palette, along with install guides, keyboard shortcuts, configuration docs, and an FAQ.
en.stack: Primarily built in C++ on top of the Windows Terminal codebase, requiring Windows 10 2004 or later, and communicating with external agent CLIs via the ACP protocol.
en.hot: As an official Microsoft experiment, it embeds hot AI agent capabilities directly into the terminal developers use daily, quickly reaching ~1,990 stars with 20 added today and ranking #6 on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Developers who live in the command line and want AI agents without switching windows
Users of GitHub Copilot or other ACP-compatible agent CLIs
Windows users curious about Microsoft's terminal AI integration direction
Developers tracking terminal tooling and agent protocol evolution

zh.tag: 在 ARM64 Linux 上高速运行 x86/x86-64 程序的用户态模拟器
zh.what: FEX 是一个用户态模拟器，允许你在 ARM64 Linux 设备上运行 x86 和 x86-64 应用程序，类似 qemu-user 和 box64。它支持 32 位和 64 位二进制，并能与 Wine/Proton 配合运行 Windows 游戏。
zh.content: 仓库包含 FEX 核心模拟器、RootFS 获取工具 FEXRootFSFetcher、图形配置工具 FEXConfig，以及详细的文档（如 SourceOutline.md 和中文 README）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 ARMv8.0+ 硬件，支持多种 Linux 发行版（如 Arch、Fedora、Ubuntu 等），并需要 x86-64 RootFS。
zh.hot: FEX 在 GitHub 上拥有 8036 颗星，今日新增 12 星，登上 C++ 日榜第 7 名，因其在 ARM 设备上高效运行 x86 程序（尤其是游戏）的能力而备受关注。
uses: ARM64 Linux 用户，希望在本地运行 x86/x86-64 应用程序
游戏玩家，想在 ARM 设备上通过 Wine/Proton 玩 Windows 游戏
开发者，需要测试或移植 x86 软件到 ARM 平台

en.tag: A fast usermode x86 and x86-64 emulator for Arm64 Linux
en.what: FEX is a usermode emulator that allows you to run x86 and x86-64 applications on ARM64 Linux devices, similar to qemu-user and box64. It offers broad compatibility with both 32-bit and 64-bit binaries and can be used with Wine/Proton to play Windows games.
en.content: The repository contains the FEX core emulator, the FEXRootFSFetcher tool for obtaining root filesystems, the FEXConfig GUI for per-app settings, and detailed documentation (e.g., SourceOutline.md and Chinese README).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it requires ARMv8.0+ hardware, supports various Linux distributions (e.g., Arch, Fedora, Ubuntu), and needs an x86-64 RootFS.
en.hot: FEX has 8,036 stars on GitHub, with 12 new stars today, ranking 7th on the C++ daily trending list, attracting attention for its ability to efficiently run x86 programs (especially games) on ARM devices.
uses: ARM64 Linux users who want to run x86/x86-64 applications locally
Gamers who want to play Windows games on ARM devices via Wine/Proton
Developers who need to test or port x86 software to ARM platforms

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 原生单元测试与微基准框架，支持 TDD/BDD
zh.what: Catch2 是一个主要面向 C++ 的单元测试框架，同时提供基础的微基准测试功能和简单的 BDD 宏。它的主要优势是使用简单自然：测试名称不必是合法标识符，断言看起来就像普通的 C++ 布尔表达式，而 section 提供了一种优雅且局部化的方式来共享 setup 和 teardown 代码。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Catch2 的完整源代码、头文件、构建脚本、测试用例、文档以及示例。v3 版本已发布，不再采用单头文件形式，而是作为普通库提供多个头文件和单独编译的源文件。
zh.stack: 基于 C++14/C++17 及更新标准（C++11 支持在 v2.x 分支，C++03 在 Catch1.x 分支），使用 CMake 构建，依赖标准库，无第三方运行时依赖。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 社区最受欢迎的测试框架之一，Catch2 拥有 21486 颗星，今日登上 GitHub Trending 日榜（C++）第 8 名，其简洁的 API 和活跃的维护持续吸引开发者。
uses: C++ 开发者进行单元测试、TDD 或 BDD 开发
需要轻量级微基准测试的 C++ 项目
希望以自然语法编写测试的团队
教学或学习 C++ 测试框架的师生

en.tag: A modern, C++-native test framework for unit-tests, TDD and BDD, with micro-benchmarking
en.what: Catch2 is mainly a unit testing framework for C++, but it also provides basic micro-benchmarking features and simple BDD macros. Its main advantage is that using it is both simple and natural: test names do not have to be valid identifiers, assertions look like normal C++ boolean expressions, and sections provide a nice and local way to share set-up and tear-down code in tests.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, headers, build scripts, test cases, documentation, and examples of Catch2. v3 has been released and is no longer a single-header library; it now behaves as a normal library with multiple headers and separately compiled sources.
en.stack: Built on C++14/C++17 and later (C++11 support in v2.x branch, C++03 in Catch1.x branch), uses CMake for building, depends only on the standard library with no third-party runtime dependencies.
en.hot: As one of the most popular testing frameworks in the C++ community, Catch2 has 21,486 stars and ranks 8th on today's GitHub Trending (C++) daily list, with its clean API and active maintenance continuously attracting developers.
uses: C++ developers doing unit testing, TDD, or BDD
C++ projects needing lightweight micro-benchmarking
Teams wanting to write tests with natural syntax
Teachers and students learning C++ testing frameworks

zh.tag: AMD ROCm 系统级组件超级仓库，统一开发与 CI
zh.what: 这是 AMD ROCm 的超级仓库，把原本分散的多个 ROCm 系统级项目合并到一处，以简化开发、CI 与集成流程。首批项目聚焦于构建 PyTorch 所需的底层组件。
zh.content: 仓库以组件目录形式组织，包含 amdsmi、aqlprofile、clr、hip、hipfile、hip-tests、rdc、rocdecode、rocjpeg、rocm-core、rocminfo、rocm-smi-lib、rocprofiler 等，README 用表格标注各组件迁移状态与 CI 健康度。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主，涉及 HIP、ROCm 运行时、性能分析器与媒体库等底层 GPU 软件栈，依赖 CMake 构建与 GitHub Actions CI。
zh.hot: 作为 AMD 官方整合 ROCm 生态的关键动作，它把众多底层项目收拢到一处，对关注 PyTorch on ROCm 与 GPU 基础设施的开发者很有吸引力，今日登上 C++ 日榜第 7。
uses: AMD GPU 与 ROCm 平台的系统/驱动开发者，需要追踪底层组件源码
构建或调优 PyTorch on ROCm 的工程师与研究者
关注 GPU 性能分析、调试与媒体编解码库的开发者
想参与 ROCm 开源生态贡献的 C++ 开发者

en.tag: AMD ROCm systems super-repo consolidating core GPU runtime components
en.what: This is AMD's ROCm super-repo, consolidating multiple ROCm systems projects into a single repository to streamline development, CI, and integration. The first batch of projects targets the requirements for building PyTorch.
en.content: It organizes components as directories, including amdsmi, aqlprofile, clr, hip, hipfile, hip-tests, rdc, rocdecode, rocjpeg, rocm-core, rocminfo, rocm-smi-lib, and rocprofiler, with a README table tracking each project's migration status and CI health.
en.stack: Primarily C++, spanning HIP, ROCm runtime, profilers, and media libraries in the low-level GPU software stack, built with CMake and GitHub Actions CI.
en.hot: As AMD's key move to unify the ROCm ecosystem by gathering many low-level projects in one place, it appeals to developers working on PyTorch-on-ROCm and GPU infrastructure, landing at #7 on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: System/driver developers on AMD GPU and ROCm platform tracking low-level component sources
Engineers and researchers building or tuning PyTorch on ROCm
Developers interested in GPU profiling, debugging, and media codec libraries
C++ developers wanting to contribute to the ROCm open-source ecosystem

zh.tag: 通用列式内存格式与多语言工具箱，加速数据交换与分析
zh.what: Apache Arrow 定义了一种高效的列式内存格式，并提供了多语言库，用于在不同系统间快速交换数据和在内存中进行分析。它包含 IPC 格式、Flight RPC 协议、ADBC 数据库连接等组件，旨在消除数据序列化开销。
zh.content: 仓库包含列式格式规范、IPC 格式、Flight RPC 协议定义，以及 C++、Python、Java、Go、JavaScript 等多语言实现，还有 Gandiva 表达式编译器和 ADBC 驱动。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，提供 C GLib、.NET、Go、Java、JavaScript、Julia、Python 等语言绑定，依赖 LLVM（用于 Gandiva）和 CMake 构建系统。
zh.hot: 作为大数据和 AI 领域的关键基础设施，Arrow 被众多知名项目（如 Pandas、Spark、DuckDB）集成，拥有 17k+ stars，今日新增 7 星，持续受到关注。
uses: 数据工程师和分析师 —— 用于构建高效的数据管道和内存分析应用
数据库和查询引擎开发者 —— 集成 Arrow 格式以加速数据交换
AI/ML 工程师 —— 在特征工程和模型训练中利用列式内存格式
跨语言系统架构师 —— 使用 Arrow 实现多语言环境下的零拷贝数据共享

en.tag: Universal columnar format and multi-language toolbox for fast data interchange and in-memory analytics
en.what: Apache Arrow defines an efficient columnar in-memory format and provides multi-language libraries for fast data interchange and in-memory analytics across systems. It includes the IPC format, Flight RPC protocol, ADBC database connectivity, and more, aiming to eliminate data serialization overhead.
en.content: The repository contains the columnar format specification, IPC format, Flight RPC protocol definitions, and multi-language implementations in C++, Python, Java, Go, JavaScript, etc., plus the Gandiva expression compiler and ADBC drivers.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, with bindings for C GLib, .NET, Go, Java, JavaScript, Julia, Python, etc., depending on LLVM (for Gandiva) and the CMake build system.
en.hot: As critical infrastructure in big data and AI, Arrow is integrated by many well-known projects (e.g., Pandas, Spark, DuckDB), with 17k+ stars and 7 new stars today, maintaining steady attention.
uses: Data engineers and analysts — for building efficient data pipelines and in-memory analytics applications
Database and query engine developers — integrating Arrow format to accelerate data exchange
AI/ML engineers — leveraging columnar memory format in feature engineering and model training
Cross-language system architects — using Arrow for zero-copy data sharing in multi-language environments

zh.tag: 生产级客户端追踪与性能分析套件，Android 和 Chromium 的默认追踪系统。
zh.what: Perfetto 是一套开源 SDK、守护进程和工具集，通过追踪技术帮助开发者理解复杂系统的行为，定位客户端和嵌入式系统的功能与性能问题。它是 Android 操作系统和 Chromium 浏览器的默认追踪系统，支持从多进程采集数据、低开销应用插桩、系统级探针以及基于 SQL 的轨迹分析。
zh.content: 仓库包含高性能追踪守护进程、C++17 追踪 SDK、操作系统级探针、基于浏览器的可视化 UI 以及 SQL 分析库，并附有完整文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SQLite、Protocol Buffers 等，支持 Android、Linux、macOS、Windows 等多平台。
zh.hot: 作为 Android 和 Chromium 的默认追踪系统，Perfetto 在性能分析领域具有权威地位，拥有 6516 颗星，今日新增 7 星，位列 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 11 名。
uses: Android 应用与平台开发者：调试启动慢、掉帧、内存泄漏等性能问题。
C/C++ 开发者（Linux/macOS/Windows）：使用追踪 SDK 插桩应用，分析执行流和瓶颈。
Linux 内核与系统开发者：通过 ftrace 可视化调度、系统调用等内核行为。
性能工程师与 SRE：利用 SQL 接口分析多种格式的追踪数据。

en.tag: Production-grade client-side tracing and profiling suite, default tracing system for Android and Chromium.
en.what: Perfetto is an open-source suite of SDKs, daemons, and tools that use tracing to help developers understand complex system behavior and root-cause functional and performance issues on client and embedded systems. It is the default tracing system for Android and Chromium, supporting multi-process capture, low-overhead app instrumentation, OS-level probes, and SQL-based trace analysis.
en.content: The repo contains high-performance tracing daemons, a C++17 tracing SDK, OS-level probes, a browser-based UI, and a SQL analysis library, along with comprehensive documentation and examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with dependencies like SQLite and Protocol Buffers, and supports multiple platforms including Android, Linux, macOS, and Windows.
en.hot: As the default tracing system for Android and Chromium, Perfetto is authoritative in performance analysis, with 6,516 stars and 7 new stars today, ranking 11th on GitHub Trending (C++ daily).
uses: Android app and platform developers: debug performance issues like slow startup, jank, and memory leaks.
C/C++ developers (Linux/macOS/Windows): instrument apps with the tracing SDK to analyze execution flow and bottlenecks.
Linux kernel and system developers: visualize scheduling, syscalls, and other kernel behavior via ftrace.
Performance engineers and SREs: analyze traces from various formats using the SQL interface.

zh.tag: 符合 YAML 1.2 规范的 C++ 解析与生成库
zh.what: yaml-cpp 是一个用 C++ 编写的 YAML 解析器和生成器，遵循 YAML 1.2 规范。它让 C++ 程序可以方便地读取和写出 YAML 格式的配置文件与数据。

en.tag: A C++ YAML parser and emitter matching the YAML 1.2 spec
en.what: yaml-cpp is a C++ library for parsing and emitting YAML, conforming to the YAML 1.2 specification. It lets C++ programs easily read and write YAML configuration files and data.

en.hot: As a mature and stable YAML library in the C++ ecosystem, yaml-cpp has 6,136 stars, gained 2 today, and ranked 12th on GitHub Trending for C++ daily, continuing to attract C++ developers.

Teams building cross-platform C++ apps wanting a unified config format
Students and researchers studying YAML spec or C++ parser implementation

zh.tag: 用配置文件远程控制 ESP 系列微控制器的智能家居系统

物联网开发者 —— 快速原型设计和部署基于 ESP 的物联网项目。

硬件爱好者 —— 利用丰富的组件库和社区支持进行 DIY 项目。

en.tag: A system to control ESP32, ESP8266, BK72xx, RP2040 via simple configuration files and Home Automation

zh.tag: 开源 XDR 与 SIEM 安全平台，统一防护端点与云工作负载
zh.what: Wazuh 是一个免费开源的安全平台，用于威胁预防、检测与响应，覆盖本地、虚拟化、容器和云环境。它由部署在被监控系统上的端点安全 Agent 和负责收集分析数据的中央管理服务器组成。
zh.content: 仓库包含端点 Agent、管理服务器以及配套的规则引擎、解码器和集成组件，并与 Wazuh Indexer 配合提供搜索与告警可视化。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为核心实现，配合规则/解码器配置与 Python 等脚本，依赖 Wazuh Indexer（基于 OpenSearch）做数据存储与可视化。
zh.hot: 作为成熟的免费 SIEM/XDR 替代方案，Wazuh 已积累 16892 颗星，今日新增 20 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 9，持续吸引关注安全合规与自建安全运营的开发者。

运维与 DevSecOps 工程师做日志分析、文件完整性监控与漏洞检测

en.tag: Open source XDR and SIEM platform for unified endpoint and cloud workload protection
en.what: Wazuh is a free and open source platform for threat prevention, detection, and response across on-premises, virtualized, containerized, and cloud environments. It consists of an endpoint security agent deployed on monitored systems and a management server that collects and analyzes the data gathered by agents.
en.content: The repo contains the endpoint agent, management server, plus rule engine, decoders, and integration components, working with the Wazuh Indexer for search and alert visualization.

Security researchers and learners setting up intrusion detection and threat response labs

zh.tag: 工业级开源无人机自动驾驶仪栈，多机型通用
zh.what: PX4 是一套面向无人机与无人载具的开源自动驾驶仪软件栈，支持多旋翼、固定翼、VTOL、无人车等多种平台。它运行在 NuttX、Linux 和 macOS 上，从竞速穿越机到工业测绘飞机都能使用。

工业巡检、测绘、农业等场景的集成商，寻找可商用的开源飞控方案

en.tag: The industry-grade open-source autopilot stack for drones and unmanned vehicles
en.what: PX4 is an open-source autopilot stack for drones and unmanned vehicles, supporting multirotors, fixed-wing, VTOL, rovers and more. It runs on NuttX, Linux and macOS, powering everything from racing quads to industrial survey aircraft.
en.content: The repo contains flight-control modules, the uORB publish/subscribe middleware, MAVLink and DDS/ROS 2 bridges, SITL simulation, hardware-in-the-loop testing, log analysis tools, plus drivers for many boards and sensors.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, built on the NuttX RTOS with uORB and DDS-compatible middleware, deeply integrated with MAVLink and ROS 2, under a BSD 3-Clause license.

zh.tag: ONNX Runtime 的生成式 AI 扩展，让 LLM 在设备端高效运行

zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 ONNX Runtime 进行推理，提供 Python、C#、Java 等语言绑定。支持 CPU、CUDA、DirectML、OpenVINO、QNN、WebGPU 等多种硬件加速。

en.tag: Generative AI extensions for ONNX Runtime, enabling efficient on-device LLM inference
en.what: ONNX Runtime GenAI implements the full generative AI loop for ONNX models, including pre/post-processing, inference, logits processing, search and sampling, KV cache management, and grammar specification for tool calling. It provides an easy, flexible, and performant API for running LLMs on-device.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ implementation, multi-language API bindings (Python, C#, C/C++, Java, etc.), sample code, build scripts, and documentation. It supports various model architectures and hardware acceleration backends.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it depends on ONNX Runtime for inference and provides bindings for Python, C#, Java, and more. It supports hardware acceleration via CPU, CUDA, DirectML, OpenVINO, QNN, WebGPU, and others.
en.hot: As an official Microsoft project, it powers Foundry Local, Windows ML, and the VS Code AI Toolkit, and supports popular models like Llama, Phi, and Qwen. It trended at #16 on GitHub Trending (C++) today with 1,122 stars.

Application developers looking to integrate generative AI using C++, C#, Python, etc.
Engineers researching ONNX model inference optimization and hardware acceleration
AI enthusiasts wanting to run LLMs locally with GPU/NPU acceleration

zh.tag: 让 vLLM 在昇腾 NPU 上跑起来的社区硬件插件

zh.tag: 微软研究院出品的工业级定理证明器与 SMT 求解器

学习形式化方法与 SMT 理论的学生和工程师
需要求解调度、配置等复杂约束问题的工业应用开发者

en.tag: Microsoft Research's industrial-strength theorem prover and SMT solver
en.what: Z3 is a high-performance theorem prover from Microsoft Research, built around an SMT (Satisfiability Modulo Theories) solver. It decides the satisfiability of first-order logic formulas and is widely used for program verification, symbolic execution, constraint solving, and formal methods.
en.content: The repo contains the C++ core solver source, multiple build systems (CMake, Makefile, Visual Studio, Bazel), bindings for many languages such as Python, OCaml, Java, and .NET, plus an online Z3 Guide.
en.stack: Implemented in C++ with CMake, vcpkg, and Bazel build support, offering bindings for Python, OCaml, Java, .NET, and WASM alongside extensive CI workflows.
en.hot: As a cornerstone of formal verification and program analysis, Z3 has long been adopted across academia and industry; its 12.6k stars reflect lasting impact, with 12 new stars today landing it at #14 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Program verification and static analysis researchers proving correctness or finding bugs
Symbolic execution and fuzzing tool developers needing an efficient constraint-solving backend
Students and engineers learning formal methods and SMT theory
Industrial developers solving complex constraint problems like scheduling or configuration

zh.tag: 让编程 Agent 先给答案、别绕弯子的输出规范技能
zh.what: 这是一个给编程助手（coding agent）用的输出风格技能，强制它先给行动、再给解释，用编号步骤代替长篇铺垫。它不改变模型能力，只改变回答的组织方式，让结果像给 ADHD 用户看的一样直接。
zh.content: 仓库核心是 skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md 里的 10 条规则，外加 INSTALL.md 安装说明、AGENTS.md 给 agent 的指引，以及多语言 README 和 logo。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主语言，本质是 Markdown 技能文件，通过 Claude 插件市场（claude plugin marketplace）安装，可 fork 后自行改规则。
zh.hot: 它精准戳中「AI 回答又长又绕」的痛点，用极简规则给出可感知的前后对比，今日新增 4650 star、总数 34632，直接冲上 GitHub 日榜第一。
uses: 每天被 AI 长回复淹没、只想快速拿到下一步操作的开发者
用 Claude 等 coding agent 写代码、希望输出更紧凑的团队
想自定义 agent 输出规范、愿意 fork 改 SKILL.md 的进阶用户

en.tag: A skill that stops your coding agent from burying the answer
en.what: It's an output-style skill for coding agents that forces action-first answers with numbered steps instead of long preambles. It doesn't change model capability, only how responses are organized, making them ADHD-friendly and to the point.
en.content: The core is a 10-rule SKILL.md under skills/i-have-adhd/, plus INSTALL.md, an AGENTS.md for agents, multilingual READMEs, and a logo.
en.stack: Python is the listed language, but it's essentially a Markdown skill file installed via the Claude plugin marketplace and forkable for custom rules.
en.hot: It nails the pain of bloated AI answers with a simple rule set and a clear before/after demo, gaining 4,650 stars today to 34,632 total and hitting #1 on GitHub Trending.
uses: Developers drowning in long AI replies who just want the next action
Teams using coding agents like Claude who want tighter, more actionable output
Advanced users who want to fork and customize the SKILL.md rules

zh.what: 这是一个在浏览器中运行的间谍卫星模拟器，但数据是真实的。它在一个逼真的3D地球上实时展示飞机、船舶、卫星、地震、交通和公共摄像头等公开信号，并支持语音控制。

en.what: A spy-satellite simulator in your browser with real data. It visualizes live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras on a photorealistic 3D globe, with hands-free voice control.
en.content: The repo contains the full web app source code, including 3D globe rendering, live data layers, a voice-controlled AI agent, and clear labeling of simulated vs. live feeds.

Educational settings for demonstrating real-time data sources and 3D visualization techniques.

zh.tag: AI 编码代理的上下文优化层，削减 98% 工具输出
zh.what: Context Mode 是专为 AI 编码代理设计的上下文窗口优化工具。它通过沙箱化工具输出（减少 98% 的 token 占用）、持久化会话记忆，并借助 MCP 和 hooks 在 17 个平台间强制路由，从而解决 AI 编程中的“上下文另一半”问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 核心库、MCP 服务器、编辑器/平台扩展（如 VS Code、JetBrains）、CLI 工具、hooks 示例及文档。提供 npm 包、GitHub Marketplace 集成，并附带统计徽章与使用指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，依赖 MCP（Model Context Protocol）与平台 hooks，支持 npm 分发与 GitHub Marketplace 安装。
zh.hot: GitHub 星标超 2 万，今日新增 35，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 6。因解决 AI 编码代理的上下文溢出痛点，且被 Microsoft、Google 等大厂团队采用，并登上 Hacker News 榜首。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程工具的开发者，希望减少上下文浪费、提升长任务稳定性。
团队需要跨平台统一管理 AI 代理的上下文与记忆，适用于多 IDE 或 CI 环境。
对 MCP 生态感兴趣，想通过 hooks 定制工具输出过滤与路由的进阶用户。

en.tag: Context optimization layer for AI coding agents, cutting tool output by 98%
en.what: Context Mode is a context window optimization tool for AI coding agents. It sandboxes tool output (98% token reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP and hooks, addressing the 'other half' of the context problem in AI coding.
en.content: The repo contains a TypeScript core library, MCP server, editor/platform extensions (VS Code, JetBrains, etc.), CLI tools, hooks examples, and docs. Includes npm package, GitHub Marketplace integration, with stats badges and usage guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, relies on MCP (Model Context Protocol) and platform hooks, distributed via npm and GitHub Marketplace.
en.hot: With 20k+ stars and +35 today, ranking #6 on TypeScript daily trending. It solves context overflow for AI coding agents, adopted by teams at Microsoft, Google, etc., and hit #1 on Hacker News.
uses: Developers using AI coding tools like Claude Code or Cursor who want to reduce context waste and improve long-task stability.
Teams needing unified context and memory management across platforms, suitable for multi-IDE or CI environments.
Advanced users interested in MCP ecosystem, wanting to customize tool output filtering and routing via hooks.

Teams needing to integrate tools like Figma and Notion into AI workflows.
Learners studying official plugin structure and best practices.

zh.tag: 面向并行 AI 代理工作流的 Git worktree 管理 CLI
zh.what: Worktrunk 是一个用 Rust 编写的命令行工具，用于管理 Git worktree，让开发者可以在同一仓库中并行维护多个工作目录。它专为并行 AI 代理工作流设计，使多个代理或任务能各自在独立工作区中同时运行而不互相干扰。

在本地并行开发多个分支或功能、频繁切换上下文的工程师
希望用 CLI 简化 Git worktree 创建、切换与清理流程的团队
构建代理编排或自动化流水线、需要可靠工作区管理的工具作者

en.tag: A CLI for Git worktree management, built for parallel AI agent workflows
en.what: Worktrunk is a Rust-based CLI for managing Git worktrees, letting developers keep multiple working directories of the same repository in parallel. It is designed for parallel AI agent workflows, so multiple agents or tasks can run simultaneously in isolated workspaces without stepping on each other.
en.content: The repo centers on Rust source code implementing the CLI, alongside documentation at worktrunk.dev plus CI and Codecov configuration, and is published as a crate.

en.hot: With roughly 6,984 stars, +44 today, and a No. 18 spot on GitHub Trending's daily Rust list, it rides strong demand in the hot area of parallel AI agent development.
uses: Developers running multiple AI coding agents at once, isolating each task in its own worktree
Engineers developing several branches or features in parallel and switching contexts frequently
Teams wanting a CLI to simplify creating, switching, and cleaning up Git worktrees
Tool authors building agent orchestration or automation pipelines that need reliable workspace management

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的技能框架与软件开发方法论
zh.what: Superpowers 是一套面向编码代理的完整软件开发方法论，建立在可组合的 skills 之上，并配有初始指令确保代理自动调用这些技能。它让代理在动手写代码前先厘清需求、产出规格与实现计划，再以子代理驱动的方式逐项完成任务。
zh.content: 仓库以 Shell 脚本和技能定义文件为主，包含安装与集成说明、基础工作流文档、技能目录（What's Inside）以及哲学与贡献指南等部分。
zh.stack: 以 Shell 为主要语言，围绕 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、GitHub Copilot CLI 等多种编码代理 harness 提供插件式安装与技能触发机制。
zh.hot: 凭借 28.4 万 star、日增 688 并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 3，说明开发者对「让编码代理真正按工程方法论工作」的需求极为强烈。
uses: 希望让编码代理遵循 TDD、YAGNI、DRY 等工程规范的开发团队
使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等代理工具并想提升自主开发可靠性的个人开发者
需要在企业环境中引入代理开发流程与商业支持的技术负责人

en.tag: An agentic skills framework and software development methodology for coding agents
en.what: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for coding agents, built on composable skills plus initial instructions that make sure the agent actually uses them. Instead of jumping straight into code, the agent teases out a spec, produces an implementation plan, then runs a subagent-driven development loop task by task.
en.content: The repo is mostly Shell scripts and skill definition files, including install/integration docs, the basic workflow, a skills catalog (What's Inside), plus philosophy and contributing sections.
en.stack: Primarily Shell, with plugin-style installation and skill-triggering mechanisms across many coding-agent harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot CLI.
en.hot: With 284k stars, +688 today and #3 on the GitHub Trending daily chart, it shows huge demand for making coding agents actually follow a real engineering methodology.
uses: Dev teams that want coding agents to follow engineering practices like TDD, YAGNI and DRY
Individual developers using Claude Code, Codex or Cursor who want more reliable autonomous coding
Tech leads looking to adopt agent-driven development workflows with enterprise support

zh.tag: AI 文本去味剂，让机器写作更自然
zh.what: 一个便携的代理技能，用于去除文本中 AI 写作的痕迹，使其听起来更自然、更像人类。它基于维基百科的“AI 写作迹象”指南，并包含二次润色和防幻觉机制。

开发者 —— 集成到代理工作流中，自动优化 AI 生成的文本输出
学术写作者 —— 确保论文或报告中的 AI 辅助内容更符合人类写作习惯

en.tag: Remove AI-generated writing signs, make text sound human
en.what: A portable agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text, making it sound more natural and human. It is based on Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing' guide and includes a second rewrite pass with hallucination prevention.

en.stack: Plain Markdown skill file with no external dependencies, runs in any harness that supports skill-style instructions.
en.hot: Gained 1504 stars this week, total 31573, ranked #16 on Python weekly trending. It addresses the pain point of AI-generated text being easily detectable, and is extremely easy to install and use.
uses: Content creators — polish AI drafts into natural human style to avoid detection
Developers — integrate into agent workflows to automatically optimize AI-generated text output
Academic writers — ensure AI-assisted content in papers or reports reads more naturally

zh.tag: 微软出品的文件转 Markdown 工具，为 LLM 喂料而生
zh.what: MarkItDown 是一个轻量级 Python 工具，能把 PDF、Office 文档、图片、音频、HTML、ZIP、YouTube 链接等多种格式统一转换成 Markdown。它重点保留标题、列表、表格、链接等文档结构，输出主要面向 LLM 与文本分析管线，而非高保真的人用排版。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 包形式组织，核心是 markitdown 包及其各类格式转换器，另含 CLI 入口、可选依赖分组（如 [all]）与安全注意事项文档。

uses: 需要把大量异构文档转成 Markdown 再喂给 LLM 的 RAG 与数据工程开发者
想快速把 PDF、Word、PPT 转成纯文本做检索或摘要的研究与内容团队
在命令行或脚本里批量处理 Office 文档、图片 OCR、音频转写的自动化用户

en.tag: Microsoft's file-to-Markdown converter built to feed LLMs
en.what: MarkItDown is a lightweight Python utility that converts PDFs, Office documents, images, audio, HTML, ZIP files, YouTube URLs and more into Markdown. It focuses on preserving document structure like headings, lists, tables and links, targeting LLM and text-analysis pipelines rather than high-fidelity human-facing output.
en.content: The repo is organized as a Python package, with the core markitdown package and per-format converters, plus a CLI entry point, optional dependency groups (e.g. [all]) and security documentation.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+, installed via pip, compatible with uv/venv/conda, and pulls in optional dependencies for PDF, OCR and speech transcription as needed.
en.hot: As an official Microsoft project, it hits the sweet spot of LLM data preprocessing, racking up about 182k stars, adding 4,579 this week and ranking 16th on GitHub Trending's weekly chart.
uses: RAG and data engineers who need to turn heterogeneous documents into Markdown for LLMs
Research and content teams wanting to convert PDFs, Word and PPT into plain text for search or summarization
Automation users batch-processing Office docs, image OCR and audio transcription from CLI or scripts

zh.what: Home Assistant 是一个开源家庭自动化平台，把本地控制和隐私放在首位，让用户在自己的服务器或树莓派上统一接入并联动各类智能设备。它由全球 DIY 爱好者社区驱动，通过模块化集成支持成千上万种设备与动作。

zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，采用模块化架构以便轻松扩展新设备或动作，可运行在树莓派或本地服务器上。

en.tag: Open-source, local-first home automation platform
en.what: Home Assistant is an open-source home automation platform that puts local control and privacy first, letting users unify and automate smart devices on their own server or Raspberry Pi. Driven by a worldwide DIY community, it supports thousands of devices and actions through modular integrations.

Privacy-conscious users who avoid handing home data to cloud vendors
DIYers and developers building custom integrations or automation components
Raspberry Pi / home server owners seeking a long-term self-hosted hub

zh.tag: 面向多任务并行的 AI 代理编排发行版，一个主代理指挥一队编码代理
zh.what: firstmate 让你只与一个「大副」代理对话，由它自动派生并监督多个自主编码代理，每个代理在独立的 git worktree 中并行处理修复、调研、规划、审计等任务。任务完成后，它会交付可直接合并的 PR、本地合并结果或独立调研报告，免去你手动切换标签页和复制上下文的麻烦。
zh.content: 仓库本身就是一个「代理发行版」：包含 AGENTS.md 指令、内置的 firstmate 技能集和辅助脚本，任何终端编码代理都能按这些约定运行。没有需要安装的应用，克隆下来的目录即是发行版。
zh.stack: 以 Shell 为主，依赖 tmux、Herdr、zellij、cmux 或 Orca 等可见会话后端，并借助 treehouse 管理 git worktree；支持 macOS 与 Linux。
zh.hot: 它切中了多代理并行时「标签页地狱」的痛点，用「一个联络人 + 可见船员」的模型给出清晰解法，本周新增 873 star、总计 6201，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 12 名。
uses: 需要同时推进多个编码任务、又不想手动管理多个代理会话的开发者
希望让代理在隔离的 git worktree 中并行工作、避免仓库冲突的工程团队
想用自然语言指挥一队代理完成修复、调研、审计并直接拿到 PR 的个人开发者
需要跨本机或 SSH 主机扩展代理舰队规模的高级用户

en.tag: An agent distro that lets one lead agent orchestrate a crew of coding agents
en.what: firstmate lets you talk to a single 'first mate' agent that spawns and supervises a crew of autonomous coding agents, each working in its own clean git worktree on parallel tasks like fixes, investigations, plans, and audits. It hands back finished PRs, approved local merges, or standalone investigation reports, removing the need to juggle tabs and copy context between repos.
en.content: The repo itself is the 'agent distro': it bundles AGENTS.md instructions, firstmate skills, and helper scripts that any terminal coding agent can follow. There is no app to install—the cloned directory is the distro.
en.stack: Primarily Shell, relying on visible session backends like tmux, Herdr, zellij, cmux, or Orca, plus treehouse for git worktree management; supports macOS and Linux.
en.hot: It tackles the 'tab-juggling hell' of running multiple agents in parallel with a clear 'one liaison, visible crew' model, gaining 873 stars this week for a total of 6,201 and ranking #12 on GitHub Trending weekly.
uses: Developers who need to push multiple coding tasks in parallel without manually babysitting agent sessions
Engineering teams wanting agents to work in isolated git worktrees to avoid repo collisions
Solo developers who want to command a crew of agents via natural language and receive finished PRs
Advanced users who need to scale agent fleets across local machines or SSH-reachable hosts

zh.tag: 清除 20+ 种 AI 味套路的写作编辑技能
zh.what: No AI Slop 是一个可安装到 ChatGPT、Claude Code、Codex 等编码代理中的写作技能，用于识别并删除「It's not X. It's Y.」这类典型 AI 腔调。它在去套路的同时尽量保留作者原有的用词、节奏与个人语气。
zh.content: 核心是 skills/no-ai-slop/SKILL.md（编辑规则与流程）和 eval.md（自检清单），另有 .codex-plugin/plugin.json 插件元数据与 build_plugin.py 打包校验脚本。
zh.stack: 以 Python 编写构建与校验脚本，技能本身以 Markdown 规则文件形式分发，通过 npx skills 或直接粘贴提示词安装，依赖宿主代理运行。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1056 star、总数达 7851 并登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 20 名，说明「去 AI 味」正切中大量创作者对千篇一律 AI 文风的厌倦。
uses: 内容创作者与自媒体作者，用来润色稿件、去掉明显的 AI 腔调
经常用 ChatGPT 或编码代理改稿、希望保留个人语气的写作者
编辑与审校人员，需要快速检测一段文字是否带有 AI 套路
想拿 AI 套路做讽刺模仿、生成「最尬 AI 文」的玩梗用户

en.tag: A writing skill that strips 20+ patterns of AI slop
en.what: No AI Slop is a skill you install into ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, or other coding agents to detect and remove telltale AI writing patterns like "It's not X. It's Y." It cleans up the slop while trying to preserve your own vocabulary, cadence, and voice.
en.content: The core is skills/no-ai-slop/SKILL.md (editing rules and workflow) plus eval.md (self-check list), alongside .codex-plugin/plugin.json plugin metadata and build_plugin.py for packaging and validation.
en.stack: Python powers the build and validation scripts, while the skill itself ships as Markdown rule files installed via npx skills or a pasted prompt, running inside a host agent.
en.hot: It gained 1,056 stars this week for 7,851 total and hit #20 on GitHub Trending, showing how many writers are fed up with same-sounding AI prose.
uses: Content creators and bloggers polishing drafts to remove obvious AI tone
Writers who edit with ChatGPT or coding agents but want to keep their own voice
Editors and reviewers who need to quickly flag AI-slop patterns in a text
Users who want to satirically generate the cringiest possible AI slop

zh.tag: 并行多智能体编排的桌面级 ADE，自带订阅即可跑任意编码代理
zh.what: Orca 是一个面向编码代理的 ADE（Agent Development Environment），让你把 Codex、ClaudeCode、OpenCode、Pi 等代理并排运行，每个代理跑在独立的 git worktree 里并统一追踪。它支持桌面端、移动端伴侣 App 与远程运行时，用你自己的订阅即可驱动任意编码代理。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 编写的桌面应用为主体，包含 resources 图标与构建资源、docs 多语言 README（中/日/韩/西/法/葡）与功能演示 GIF、移动端伴侣 App（iOS/TestFlight/Android APK）以及远程运行时相关代码。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，基于 Electron 风格的跨平台桌面应用（macOS/Windows/Linux），配套 iOS/Android 移动端与远程运行时，MIT 许可，依赖各编码代理 CLI 与 git worktree 机制。
zh.hot: 本周新增 5362 star、总量约 6.95 万，冲上 GitHub Trending 周榜 TypeScript 第 14 名；多代理并行编排正是当下最热的开发范式，而 Orca 让用户用自己的订阅跑多个代理，切中成本与效率痛点。
uses: 同时使用多个编码代理、需要并行对比结果的开发者
希望用自有订阅而非额外付费来驱动代理的个人与团队
需要在手机上监控和跟进代理进度、随时发指令的工程师
想用 git worktree 隔离实验、再择优合并的工程团队

en.tag: A desktop ADE for orchestrating a fleet of parallel coding agents on your own subscription
en.what: Orca is an Agent Development Environment for running a fleet of coding agents in parallel. It runs Codex, ClaudeCode, OpenCode or Pi side-by-side, each in its own isolated git worktree, tracked in one place, and works on desktop, mobile companion app and remote runtime using your own subscription.
en.content: The repo centers on a TypeScript desktop app, with build resources and icons, multilingual docs (zh-CN, ja, ko, es, fr, pt) plus feature GIFs, a mobile companion app (iOS App Store, TestFlight, Android APK) and remote runtime code.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript as a cross-platform desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux), paired with iOS/Android companions and a remote runtime, MIT-licensed, and relying on coding-agent CLIs plus git worktrees.
en.hot: It gained 5,362 stars this week to reach ~69.5k total, landing at #14 on GitHub Trending's weekly TypeScript chart. Parallel multi-agent orchestration is the hottest dev paradigm right now, and Orca's bring-your-own-subscription model hits both cost and efficiency pain points.
uses: Developers running multiple coding agents and comparing results in parallel
Individuals and teams wanting to drive agents with their own existing subscriptions
Engineers who need to monitor and steer agents from their phone on the go
Teams wanting isolated git worktree experiments and merging the winner

zh.tag: 一条 CLI 给 AI Agent 装上全网读取与搜索能力
zh.what: Agent Reach 是一个 Python 命令行工具，让 AI Agent 无需申请各家 API key 就能读取和搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台内容。它替用户选好并维护当下最稳定的接入方式，把多平台数据获取统一到一条命令里。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 包形式提供 CLI 入口，配套 docs 目录含中英日韩多语言 README、赞助商素材与设计理念说明，并附 Trendshift、Star History 徽章。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+，MIT 许可，采用 CLI 形态封装各平台抓取与搜索逻辑，依赖较轻、开箱即用。
zh.hot: 上线即冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 6，累计 81255 star、今日新增 651，说明「零 API 费用 + 多平台统一接入」正好击中 Agent 开发者的数据获取痛点。
uses: 做 AI Agent 的开发者，需要给 Agent 补上实时互联网数据源
想低成本抓取社交平台内容做分析或舆情监控的团队
需要跨 Twitter/Reddit/YouTube/B站/小红书统一检索的研究者
不想维护各家 API key 与频繁更换接入方式的个人开发者

en.tag: One CLI that gives AI agents internet-wide reading and search
en.what: Agent Reach is a Python CLI that lets AI agents read and search content across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and XiaoHongShu without paying for each platform's API. It picks and maintains the currently most reliable access method so users don't have to keep up with changing interfaces.
en.content: The repo ships a Python package with a CLI entry point, plus a docs folder containing multilingual READMEs (EN/JA/KO), sponsor assets and design notes, along with Trendshift and Star History badges.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+ under the MIT license, it wraps per-platform scraping and search logic into a lightweight, ready-to-run CLI.
en.hot: It hit #6 on GitHub Trending with 81,255 stars and 651 added today, showing that zero-API-fee, unified multi-platform access hits a real pain point for agent builders.
uses: AI agent developers who need to feed their agents live internet data
Teams doing social content analysis or sentiment monitoring on a budget
Researchers who need unified search across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili and XiaoHongShu
Solo developers tired of managing API keys and chasing changing access methods

zh.tag: 把各类 AI 编程工具接到 40+ 免费/廉价模型上的智能路由与省 token 网关
zh.what: 9Router 是一个本地运行的 AI 路由网关，把 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Cline、Copilot 等编程工具统一接到 40+ 家供应商、100+ 模型上。它通过订阅→廉价→免费的自动降级、多账号轮询和 RTK token 压缩，让开发者尽量不撞限额、少花钱。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 JavaScript 项目，核心是本地路由服务（默认 http://localhost:20128/v1）与 Web 仪表盘，包含 RTK token 压缩、格式转换（OpenAI ↔ Claude）、配额追踪与自动刷新等模块，并提供 npm 包、Docker 镜像与多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主语言 JavaScript，以 npm 包和 Docker/ GHCR 镜像分发，对外暴露 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 接口，依赖各 AI 供应商的 API 与订阅凭证。
zh.hot: 它以“无限免费 AI 编程”和 20-40% token 节省直击开发者成本痛点，已积累 28k+ star，今日再涨 186，冲上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 4。
uses: 日常用 Claude Code、Cursor、Cline 等工具但担心额度与费用的个人开发者
需要统一管理多家 AI 供应商、做成本与配额控制的小团队
希望用免费或廉价模型替代高价 API 的独立开发者与创业者
想自建本地 AI 网关、避免供应商锁定的技术用户

en.tag: Smart router that connects AI coding tools to 40+ free/cheap model providers while saving tokens
en.what: 9Router is a locally-run AI routing gateway that connects coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline and Copilot to 40+ providers and 100+ models. It uses subscription→cheap→free auto-fallback, multi-account round-robin and RTK token compression so developers rarely hit limits or overspend.
en.content: It's a JavaScript project centered on a local routing server (default http://localhost:20128/v1) plus a web dashboard, with modules for RTK token compression, OpenAI↔Claude format translation, quota tracking and auto token refresh, shipped via npm, Docker and multi-language READMEs.
en.stack: Written mainly in JavaScript, distributed as an npm package and Docker/GHCR image, exposing an OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint and relying on various provider APIs and subscription credentials.
en.hot: It hits developers' cost pain with "unlimited free AI coding" and 20-40% token savings, racking up 28k+ stars and another 186 today to rank #4 on GitHub Trending (JavaScript).
uses: Individual developers using Claude Code, Cursor or Cline who worry about quotas and costs
Small teams needing unified multi-provider management with cost and quota control
Indie developers and founders wanting free or cheap models instead of pricey APIs
Technical users who want a self-hosted local AI gateway to avoid vendor lock-in

zh.tag: GitHub 官方的规格驱动开发工具包，让任意 AI 编码代理先写规格再写代码
zh.what: Spec Kit 是 GitHub 开源的一套规格驱动开发（Spec-Driven Development）工具包，主张在动手写代码之前先把「要构建什么」定义清楚。它提供一套开箱即用的流程，也可以接入你自己的流程，并支持与各类 AI 编码代理配合使用。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 编写的 Specify CLI 为核心，配套文档站点、扩展与预设（Extensions & Presets）、面向角色的 Bundles 方案，以及各 AI 编码代理的集成说明。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，通过 Specify CLI 分发；依赖 GitHub Releases 与 GitHub Pages 文档，并适配多家 AI 编码代理的集成接口。
zh.hot: 背靠 GitHub 官方、主打与 AI 编码代理协作的规范流程，发布一年即达 1.0.0，累计约 13.6 万 star，今日再涨 1015 并登上日榜第 15 名。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Copilot 等 AI 编码代理的开发者，希望先定规格再生成代码
团队负责人想统一需求、设计与实现之间的协作流程
想用扩展和预设把 Spec Kit 改造成自家研发规范的组织
需要评估新想法或修复缺陷时，用规格流程做结构化拆解的工程师

en.tag: GitHub's spec-driven development toolkit that makes any AI coding agent define specs before writing code
en.what: Spec Kit is GitHub's open source toolkit for Spec-Driven Development, which puts defining what to build before building it. It ships a ready-to-use process (or lets you bring your own) and works with any AI coding agent.
en.content: The repo centers on a Python-based Specify CLI, plus a docs site, extensions and presets, role-based bundles, and integration guides for various AI coding agents.
en.stack: Primarily Python, distributed via the Specify CLI; it relies on GitHub Releases and GitHub Pages docs, and adapts to multiple AI coding agent integrations.
en.hot: Backed by GitHub and pitched as a spec-first workflow for AI coding agents, it hit 1.0.0 in its first year and now sits at ~135.8k stars, gaining 1,015 today for #15 on the daily trending list.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Copilot who want specs before code
Team leads aiming to unify requirements, design, and implementation workflows
Organizations wanting to customize Spec Kit via extensions and presets for their own standards
Engineers who want a structured spec process for assessing ideas or fixing bugs

zh.tag: 最主流的开源模型定义与训练推理框架
zh.what: Transformers 是 Hugging Face 推出的模型定义框架，统一了文本、视觉、音频和多模态的 SOTA 模型接口。它同时支持推理与训练，让用户用几行代码即可加载、微调和部署各类预训练模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库 src/transformers（模型、分词器、pipeline、Trainer 等），以及 examples、tests、docs 和 i18n 多语言 README。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 与 PyTorch、TensorFlow、JAX 等深度学习后端，依赖 tokenizers、safetensors、huggingface_hub 等组件。
zh.hot: 作为 AI 领域事实标准库，它已积累 16.5 万+ star，今日再增 152 并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 19 名，热度长期稳定。
uses: AI 研究者与工程师：快速加载、微调和评测各类预训练模型
应用开发者：用 pipeline 在几行代码内集成 NLP、视觉与语音能力
企业团队：基于统一接口构建和部署生产级模型服务
学习者：通过丰富示例与文档入门深度学习与大模型实践

en.tag: The leading open-source model-definition framework for training and inference
en.what: Transformers is Hugging Face's model-definition framework that unifies state-of-the-art models across text, vision, audio, and multimodal tasks. It supports both inference and training, letting users load, fine-tune, and deploy pretrained models with just a few lines of code.
en.content: The repo contains the core library under src/transformers (models, tokenizers, pipelines, Trainer, etc.), plus examples, tests, docs, and i18n multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Built in Python on top of deep learning backends like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX, depending on tokenizers, safetensors, and huggingface_hub.
en.hot: As the de facto standard library in AI, it has amassed over 165k stars, gaining another 152 today and ranking 19th on GitHub Trending, showing sustained popularity.
uses: AI researchers and engineers: quickly load, fine-tune, and evaluate pretrained models
App developers: integrate NLP, vision, and speech with pipelines in a few lines
Enterprise teams: build and deploy production-grade model services on a unified API
Learners: get started with deep learning and large models via rich examples and docs

zh.tag: Python 官方解释器 CPython 的源码仓库
zh.what: CPython 是 Python 语言的官方参考实现，用 C 语言编写解释器核心，同时提供完整的标准库。它把 Python 源码编译为字节码并在虚拟机中执行，是绝大多数开发者日常使用的 Python。
zh.content: 仓库包含解释器核心（Objects、Python、Parser 等 C 源码）、标准库 Lib/、测试套件、文档以及各平台构建脚本（PCbuild、Mac 等）。当前主分支为 3.16.0 alpha 0 开发版。
zh.stack: 以 C 语言实现核心，辅以 Python 编写的标准库，构建依赖 autoconf/configure、make 及平台相关工具链（如 Windows 的 MSVC）。
zh.hot: 作为 Python 语言的官方实现，它拥有 77,202 颗星，本周新增 1,064，稳居 GitHub Trending 周榜 Python 分类第 10 名，热度源于语言本身的持续演进与庞大生态。
uses: 想深入理解 Python 内部机制、阅读解释器源码的进阶开发者
希望为 Python 语言本身贡献代码或修复 bug 的开源贡献者
需要从源码编译定制 Python 发行版的平台与运维工程师
关注新版本特性、想提前试用 3.16 开发版的早期采用者

en.tag: The official CPython interpreter source repository
en.what: CPython is the official reference implementation of the Python language, written in C with a complete standard library. It compiles Python source into bytecode and runs it on a virtual machine, and is the Python most developers use daily.
en.content: The repo contains the interpreter core (C sources in Objects, Python, Parser), the Lib/ standard library, the test suite, docs, and platform build scripts (PCbuild, Mac, etc.). The main branch is currently the 3.16.0 alpha 0 development line.
en.stack: Core implemented in C with a Python-written standard library; builds rely on autoconf/configure, make, and platform toolchains such as MSVC on Windows.
en.hot: As the official Python implementation it holds 77,202 stars, gaining 1,064 this week and ranking 10th on GitHub Trending's weekly Python chart, driven by the language's ongoing evolution and huge ecosystem.
uses: Advanced developers who want to understand Python internals by reading interpreter source
Open-source contributors who want to fix bugs or add features to the language itself
Platform and ops engineers who need to build custom Python distributions from source
Early adopters who want to try upcoming 3.16 development features ahead of release

zh.tag: 开源 AI Agent 教材：10 章正文 + 109 个配套实验
zh.what: 这是李博杰所著《深入理解 AI Agent：设计原理与工程实践》的开源主仓库，围绕“Agent = LLM + 上下文 + 工具”这一核心公式，把 AI Agent 从原理讲到工程实战。全书正文、配图与配套实验代码全部开源，并提供编译好的 PDF/EPUB 供离线阅读。
zh.content: 仓库包含 10 章正文与配图、109 个按章配套实验（含本地项目与外部复现轨道）、多语言 README 与在线电子书站点，以及 PDF/EPUB 构建产物。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主要语言编写配套实验代码，书稿通过 GitHub Actions 自动构建为 PDF/EPUB 并发布到 GitHub Pages 在线阅读站点，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。
zh.hot: 48k+ stars 且本周新增 2731，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 Python 第 11 名，说明系统化、可动手的 Agent 学习资料正是当下刚需。
uses: 想系统入门 AI Agent 的开发者与学生，可按章阅读并动手跑实验
正在做 Agent 产品的工程师，可参考上下文、工具与评估等工程实践
高校教师与培训讲师，可将其作为课程教材与实验素材
需要多语言资料的学习者，可选用 15 种语言译本与 PDF/EPUB 离线阅读

en.tag: Open-source AI Agent textbook: 10 chapters plus 109 hands-on labs
en.what: This is the open-source home of Bojie Li's book 'AI Agents in Depth: Design Principles and Engineering Practice', which walks through AI agents from first principles to production engineering around the formula 'Agent = LLM + context + tools'. The full text, figures, and companion lab code are all open source, with compiled PDF/EPUB builds for offline reading.
en.content: The repo contains 10 chapters of text and figures, 109 chapter-aligned labs (both local projects and external reproduction tracks), multilingual READMEs and an online book site, plus PDF/EPUB build artifacts.
en.stack: Companion lab code is written mainly in Python; the manuscript is auto-built into PDF/EPUB via GitHub Actions and published to a GitHub Pages reading site, under the Apache-2.0 license.
en.hot: With 48k+ stars and 2,731 added this week, it hit #11 on GitHub's weekly Python trending list, showing strong demand for systematic, hands-on agent learning material.
uses: Developers and students new to AI agents who want a structured path with runnable labs
Engineers building agent products who need practical guidance on context, tools, and evaluation
Teachers and trainers looking for a ready-made textbook and lab materials
Learners needing multilingual resources, with 15 translations and offline PDF/EPUB

zh.tag: 本地优先的全能语音工作室
zh.what: VoiceStudio 是一个开源的、完全本地运行的语音工具集，提供类似 ElevenLabs 的功能，包括声音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转录和有声书制作，支持 646 种语言。无需账户、API 密钥或订阅，所有处理都在用户自己的硬件上完成。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的应用代码、文档、安装指南、架构说明和 API 文档，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 及 Docker。集成了 16 种 TTS 引擎和 11 种 ASR 引擎，提供图形界面和命令行工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，依赖多种开源 TTS/ASR 引擎（如 Coqui、Whisper 等），支持跨平台桌面环境与 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 作为本地优先的 ElevenLabs 替代品，VoiceStudio 在隐私和成本敏感的用户中迅速走红，单日新增 1672 星，总星数达 16279，反映出对自主语音处理工具的高需求。
uses: 内容创作者：需要为视频配音或制作多语言音频，但不想依赖云服务。
隐私敏感用户：希望语音数据完全留在本地，避免上传到第三方。
开发者：需要集成语音克隆或转录功能的 API，且要求离线运行。
语言学习者：利用 646 种语言支持进行听力练习或生成自定义语音内容。

en.tag: Fully-local voice studio: clone, dub, transcribe & more
en.what: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully-local voice toolkit offering ElevenLabs-like features: voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation across 646 languages. No account, API key, or subscription required—everything runs on your own hardware.
en.content: The repository includes full application code, docs, installation guides, architecture, and API docs, supporting macOS, Windows, Linux, and Docker. It integrates 16 TTS engines and 11 ASR engines, offering both GUI and CLI tools.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, leveraging various open-source TTS/ASR engines (e.g., Coqui, Whisper), with cross-platform desktop support and Docker deployment.
en.hot: As a local-first ElevenLabs alternative, VoiceStudio is gaining rapid traction among privacy- and cost-conscious users, adding 1,672 stars in a day to reach 16,279 total, reflecting high demand for self-hosted voice tools.
uses: Content creators needing video dubbing or multilingual audio without cloud dependency.
Privacy-conscious users who want voice data to stay entirely on-device.
Developers seeking offline APIs for voice cloning or transcription integration.
Language learners leveraging 646-language support for listening practice or custom audio.
