zh.tag: 把 Claude Code 变成深度研究代理，产出可溯源、可审计的持久研究知识库
zh.what: Hyperresearch 是一个面向 Claude Code 的深度研究框架：输入一个提示词，经过 16 步自适应流水线，产出带完整来源溯源的对抗式审计报告。它读取的每个来源都会沉淀进持久、可搜索的知识库，让每次研究会话都比上一次更聪明。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 包形式发布在 PyPI（Python 3.11+，MIT 许可），核心是研究流水线、引用核查器、独立性与对抗审计模块，以及 `hpr scholar search` 等 CLI 工具，另含基准测试图表与文档。
zh.stack: Python 3.11+ 实现，通过 PyPI 分发，深度集成 Claude Code 作为代理运行时；学术检索层统一接入 OpenAlex、Crossref、CORE、DOAB、ClinicalTrials.gov、SEC EDGAR 和 FRED。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1469 星、总数 3373，冲上 GitHub Trending Python 周榜第 17 名；它宣称在 DeepResearch-Bench RACE 榜领先 Gemini 与 OpenAI Deep Research，单次可覆盖 250+ 来源并逐条验证引用，正好切中 AI 研究可信度痛点。
uses: 需要写深度调研报告的分析师、咨询与投资研究人员
做文献综述、需要跨库检索论文与临床试验的科研人员
想给 Claude Code 加上持久研究记忆与引用审计的 AI 工程师
关注 AI 研究可信度、需要对抗式事实核查的媒体与事实核查团队

en.tag: Turns Claude Code into a deep research agent that builds a persistent, auditable research vault
en.what: Hyperresearch is a deep research harness for Claude Code: one prompt runs through a tier-adaptive 16-step pipeline that produces an adversarially-audited report with full source provenance. Every source it reads lands in a persistent, searchable vault, so each session starts smarter than the last.
en.content: Shipped as a Python package on PyPI (Python 3.11+, MIT), it centers on the research pipeline, cite-checker, independence and adversarial audit modules, plus CLI tools like `hpr scholar search`, alongside benchmark charts and docs.
en.stack: Built in Python 3.11+ and distributed via PyPI, it integrates Claude Code as the agent runtime; its scholarly layer unifies OpenAlex, Crossref, CORE, DOAB, ClinicalTrials.gov, SEC EDGAR and FRED behind one client.
en.hot: It gained 1,469 stars this week (3,373 total), hitting #17 on GitHub Trending's Python weekly chart; it claims to lead the DeepResearch-Bench RACE leaderboard ahead of Gemini and OpenAI Deep Research, covering 250+ sources per run with per-citation verification—exactly the trust gap in AI research.
uses: Analysts, consultants and investors who need deep, source-backed research reports
Researchers doing literature reviews across papers, books and clinical trials
AI engineers wanting persistent research memory and citation auditing for Claude Code
Media and fact-checking teams focused on the trustworthiness of AI-generated research

en.tag: An Agent designed for mathematical modeling that auto-generates submission-ready papers
en.what: MathModelAgent is an automated agent for mathematical modeling competitions that handles problem analysis, modeling, coding, error correction, and paper writing to produce a complete, submission-ready paper. It supports multi-agent collaboration (modeler, coder, writer) and multi-LLM configuration, with built-in RAG knowledge base and web search.

Researchers or data analysts needing automated modeling and paper writing
Beginners learning mathematical modeling workflows and paper writing
Educators or teams needing to batch-generate modeling reports

en.tag: A practical Douyin batch downloader with watermark removal for videos, galleries, collections and music
en.what: This is a practical Douyin downloader that handles both single-item and profile batch downloads, saving videos, image-notes, collections, favorites and original music. en.tag: Open-source framework turning HTML/CSS into deterministic MP4 videos, built for AI agents
en.what: HyperFrames is an open-source framework that converts HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. It can be used locally via CLI, as skills for AI coding agents, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, CLI tools, skill packages (SKILL.md), documentation, examples, and showcase pages. The core enables agents to generate videos by writing HTML, with support for seekable animations.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, requires Node.js >= 22, distributed via npm, and integrates AI agent skill systems (e.g., Claude and Agents skills).
en.hot: With over 44k stars and 220 daily additions, it precisely meets the demand for AI-agent-driven video generation, seamlessly combining HTML authoring with video rendering, making it a star on GitHub Trending.
uses: AI agent developers: enable agents to automatically generate video content like product intros or tutorials.
Video creators: quickly produce customizable, deterministic videos by writing HTML, without traditional editing software.
Automation workflows: integrate video rendering into CI/CD or content pipelines for batch generation.
Frontend developers: leverage familiar HTML/CSS skills to create animations and video effects.

zh.tag: 开放代理技能生态的 CLI 工具，让技能即插即用
zh.what: skills 是一个命令行工具，用于安装、使用和管理 AI 编码代理的技能（skills）。它支持 OpenCode、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 80 多种代理，通过 npx 即可快速添加或直接运行技能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 源码、CLI 入口、技能解析与安装逻辑，以及文档和示例。核心是 skills 命令行工具，支持从 GitHub、GitLab、本地路径等多种来源添加技能。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 和 Node.js 构建，通过 npx 分发。依赖 Git 进行仓库操作，并集成 GitHub CLI 等认证方式。
zh.hot: 凭借 Vercel 品牌影响力和对多代理生态的广泛支持，该项目迅速获得 30k+ stars。今日新增 125 星，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 10，反映出开发者对标准化代理技能管理的强烈需求。
uses: AI 编码代理用户 —— 快速为 Claude Code、Cursor 等代理添加新技能
技能开发者 —— 发布和分享可复用的代理技能包
团队协作 —— 统一管理项目所需的代理技能，确保环境一致
探索者 —— 无需安装即可试用技能，通过 npx skills use 生成提示

en.tag: The CLI for the open agent skills ecosystem, making skills plug-and-play
en.what: skills is a CLI tool for installing, using, and managing skills for AI coding agents. It supports OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and 80+ other agents, enabling quick addition or direct execution of skills via npx.
en.content: The repo contains TypeScript source code, CLI entry points, skill resolution and installation logic, plus documentation and examples. At its core is the skills CLI, supporting skill addition from GitHub, GitLab, local paths, and more.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Node.js, distributed via npx. It relies on Git for repository operations and integrates authentication methods like GitHub CLI.
en.hot: With Vercel's brand influence and broad support for multiple agent ecosystems, the project quickly gained 30k+ stars. Adding 125 stars today and ranking 10th on the TypeScript daily chart, it reflects strong developer demand for standardized agent skill management.
uses: AI coding agent users — quickly add new skills to agents like Claude Code and Cursor
Skill developers — publish and share reusable agent skill packages
Team collaboration — uniformly manage project-required agent skills for consistent environments
Explorers — try skills without installation by generating prompts via npx skills use

zh.tag: 跨千余市场的开源自主 AI 交易代理，支持预测市场与加密合约
zh.what: Clodds 是一个自托管的个人 AI 交易终端，基于 Claude 驱动，可在预测市场、加密现货、永续合约、代币发行和 Bittensor 子网挖矿中自主扫描套利机会并即时执行。它还能通过自然对话管理投资组合，并内置机器对机器支付的代理商业协议。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的交易代理核心、118+ 交易策略、21 个消息平台接入、WebChat 界面，以及覆盖 10 个预测市场和 7 个期货交易所的适配器。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js 22+ 和 TypeScript 5.3，通过 npm 全局安装，依赖 Claude 模型，集成 Solana（Jupiter、Pump.fun、Raydium 等）与多条 EVM 链。
zh.hot: 上线 12 天即获 1647 星、今日新增 277 星，冲上 GitHub 日榜第 4，14 天内被克隆 10.7k 次，叠加 Colosseum 黑客松与加密交易热度。
uses: 加密交易者：希望用 AI 自动扫描预测市场与合约套利机会
开发者：想研究或二次开发自主交易代理与代理支付协议
量化爱好者：需要多交易所、多链的统一交易终端与策略库
自托管用户：重视隐私，想在自己机器上运行交易机器人

en.tag: Open-source autonomous AI trading agent across 1000+ prediction and crypto markets
en.what: Clodds is a self-hosted personal AI trading terminal powered by Claude that autonomously scans for edge and executes trades across prediction markets, crypto spot, perpetual futures, token launches, and Bittensor subnet mining. It also manages portfolios through natural conversation and ships an agent commerce protocol for machine-to-machine payments.
en.content: The repo contains a TypeScript trading agent core, 118+ trading strategies, integrations for 21 messaging platforms, a WebChat UI, and adapters covering 10 prediction markets and 7 futures exchanges.
en.stack: Built on Node.js 22+ and TypeScript 5.3, installed globally via npm, powered by Claude, with Solana (Jupiter, Pump.fun, Raydium, etc.) and multiple EVM chain integrations.
en.hot: It gained 1,647 stars in 12 days with 277 added today, ranking #4 on GitHub Trending, plus 10.7k clones in 14 days, fueled by the Colosseum hackathon and crypto trading hype.
uses: Crypto traders who want AI to auto-scan prediction markets and futures arbitrage
Developers researching or extending autonomous trading agents and agent payment protocols
Quant enthusiasts needing a unified multi-exchange, multi-chain trading terminal and strategy library
Self-hosting users who value privacy and want to run a trading bot on their own machine

zh.tag: 开源自托管 AI 销售 CRM，原生 AI 代理接管 WhatsApp 聊天
zh.what: DeskcommCRM 是一个开源的 AI 销售操作系统，把能接待、筛选并促成成交的 AI 代理直接嵌进 CRM，通过 WhatsApp（WAHA）与客户对话。它是 Kommo、Octadesk、Intercom 的开源替代品，数据自持、无月费、无功能锁。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Next.js 应用主体、WAHA 的 WhatsApp 集成、Supabase 数据库与认证、多租户与 LGPD 合规逻辑，以及 hostgator-setup-kit 一键部署脚本和架构/路线图文档。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 TypeScript（strict）+ Next.js 16，后端依赖 Supabase（Postgres、Auth、Storage），WhatsApp 通道使用 WAHA，支持 MCP、多租户与自托管部署。
zh.hot: 上线不久即冲到 GitHub Trending 日榜第 4，今日新增 152 star、总数 1347，说明拉美市场对「开源 + WhatsApp 原生 AI 销售」的需求被长期压抑。
uses: 通过 WhatsApp 成交的中小企业与销售团队，想摆脱 Kommo/Octadesk 的月费与功能锁定
需要数据主权与 LGPD 合规、希望把 CRM 跑在自己 VPS 上的巴西及拉美公司
想给现有销售流程加 AI 代理、并接入 MCP 生态的开发者与集成商
寻找 Intercom 开源替代、重视自托管与多租户能力的 SaaS 团队

en.tag: Open-source self-hosted AI sales CRM with native AI agents on WhatsApp
en.what: DeskcommCRM is an open-source AI sales OS that embeds AI agents capable of greeting, qualifying and closing deals directly inside a CRM, conversing with customers over WhatsApp (WAHA). It positions itself as the open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk and Intercom, with self-owned data, no monthly fees and no locked features.
en.content: The repo contains the Next.js app, WhatsApp integration via WAHA, Supabase database and auth, multi-tenant and LGPD compliance logic, plus a hostgator-setup-kit one-command deploy script and architecture/roadmap docs.
en.stack: Built with strict TypeScript and Next.js 16, backed by Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage), using WAHA for the WhatsApp channel, with MCP support, multi-tenancy and self-hosted deployment.
en.hot: It hit #4 on GitHub Trending with 152 stars added today and 1,347 total, showing pent-up demand in LATAM for an open-source, WhatsApp-native AI sales tool.
uses: SMBs and sales teams closing deals on WhatsApp who want to escape Kommo/Octadesk monthly fees and locked features
Brazilian and LATAM companies needing data sovereignty and LGPD compliance by running the CRM on their own VPS
Developers and integrators adding AI agents to existing sales flows and plugging into the MCP ecosystem
SaaS teams seeking an open-source Intercom alternative with self-hosting and multi-tenancy

zh.tag: 面向网络安全分析师的图化OSINT调查平台
zh.what: Flowsint 是一个开源的 OSINT 图探索工具，专为合乎伦理的调查、透明度和验证而设计。它让网络安全分析师和调查人员能够以可视化、灵活且可扩展的方式，对实体及其关系进行图谱化调查。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端应用、核心逻辑和 API 服务等模块，采用 Docker 化部署，提供完整的本地或团队调查环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，依赖 Docker 和 Make 进行构建与部署，支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。
zh.hot: 凭借 8341 颗星和今日新增 280 星，Flowsint 登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 18 名，反映出网络安全与 OSINT 工具在开源社区的高关注度。
uses: 网络安全分析师 —— 用于可视化调查网络威胁和实体关系
OSINT 调查人员 —— 进行开源情报收集与图谱分析
安全团队 —— 在内部网络中部署协作调查平台
隐私关注者 —— 所有数据存储在本地，保障调查隐私

en.tag: A graph-based OSINT investigation platform for cybersecurity analysts
en.what: Flowsint is an open-source OSINT graph exploration tool designed for ethical investigation, transparency, and verification. It enables cybersecurity analysts and investigators to visually, flexibly, and extensibly investigate entities and their relationships as graphs.
en.content: The repository contains frontend app, core logic, and API service modules, with Docker-based deployment for a complete local or team investigation environment.
en.stack: Primarily built with TypeScript, relying on Docker and Make for building and deployment, supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows.
en.hot: With 8,341 stars and 280 new stars today, Flowsint ranks 18th on GitHub Trending daily, reflecting strong community interest in cybersecurity and OSINT tools.
uses: Cybersecurity analysts — for visual investigation of cyber threats and entity relationships
OSINT investigators — for open-source intelligence gathering and graph analysis
Security teams — deploy a collaborative investigation platform on internal networks
Privacy-conscious users — all data is stored locally, ensuring investigation privacy

zh.tag: 跨平台 iOS 侧载工具，一键安装 SideStore 并导入配对文件
zh.what: iloader 是一款面向普通用户的 iOS 侧载工具，帮助你在电脑上给 iPhone/iPad 安装 SideStore 等应用。它会自动导入证书和 rppairing/lockdown 配对文件，并支持导入任意 IPA、管理配对文件与吊销开发证书。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 TypeScript 编写的桌面应用源码（含本地化文件 src/loc*）、构建工作流与发布配置，官网 iloader.app 是唯一官方下载渠道。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，桌面端应用，依赖 usbmuxd（Windows 需 iTunes，macOS 自带，Linux 视发行版而定），并提供 NixOS flake 与社区维护的 Homebrew/AUR/COPR 包。
zh.hot: iOS 侧载长期缺少好用的跨平台图形工具，iloader 把繁琐的配对与证书流程自动化，今日新增 50 star、总数 2908，冲上 GitHub 日榜第 3。
uses: 想给 iPhone/iPad 安装 SideStore 或任意 IPA 的普通 iOS 用户
需要在 Windows/macOS/Linux 上管理配对文件与开发证书的进阶玩家
希望本地化 iloader 到更多语言的翻译贡献者

en.tag: Cross-platform iOS sideloader that installs SideStore and imports pairing files with ease
en.what: iloader is a user-friendly iOS sideloading tool that helps you install SideStore and other apps onto your iPhone/iPad from a computer. It automatically imports certificates and rppairing/lockdown pairing files, and supports importing any IPA, managing pairing files, and revoking development certificates.
en.content: The repo contains the TypeScript desktop app source (including localization files under src/loc*), build workflows, and release configuration; iloader.app is the only official download channel.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript as a desktop app, it depends on usbmuxd (iTunes on Windows, built-in on macOS, distro-dependent on Linux), and ships a NixOS flake plus community-maintained Homebrew/AUR/COPR packages.
en.hot: iOS sideloading has long lacked a good cross-platform GUI tool; iloader automates the tedious pairing and certificate flow, gaining 50 stars today for a total of 2,908 and hitting #3 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Everyday iOS users who want to install SideStore or any IPA on their iPhone/iPad
Advanced users managing pairing files and development certificates on Windows/macOS/Linux
Translation contributors who want to localize iloader into more languages

zh.tag: 自动构建个人知识库的跨平台桌面应用
zh.what: LLM Wiki 是一款跨平台桌面应用，能自动将你的文档转化为结构化、互链的知识库。它不采用传统 RAG 每次从零检索的方式，而是让 LLM 增量构建并维护一个持久的 Wiki。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，涵盖多格式文档解析、多模态图像处理、知识图谱构建、向量语义搜索、持久化摄入队列以及 Rust 后端聊天代理等模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，结合 Rust 后端，依赖 LanceDB 进行向量搜索，支持 OpenAI 兼容的模型端点，并集成 Tavily、SerpApi、SearXNG 等搜索服务。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 142 颗星，总星数达 18105，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 14 名，因其创新的自动知识库构建方式和强大的多模态处理能力受到关注。
uses: 研究人员和学生——需要从大量文档中自动构建可检索知识库
知识工作者——希望将分散的文档、网页和媒体整合成结构化 Wiki
开发者——想要一个可本地部署、支持自定义模型的 AI 知识管理工具
团队——需要跨设备迁移和共享项目档案的协作场景

en.tag: Cross-platform desktop app that auto-builds a personal knowledge base
en.what: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that automatically turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base. Instead of traditional RAG, the LLM incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki from your sources.
en.content: The repository contains the full desktop app source code, covering multi-format document parsing, multimodal image processing, knowledge graph construction, vector semantic search, persistent ingest queue, and a Rust backend chat agent.
en.stack: Primarily built with TypeScript and a Rust backend, using LanceDB for vector search, supporting OpenAI-compatible model endpoints, and integrating search services like Tavily, SerpApi, and SearXNG.
en.hot: With 142 stars added today and a total of 18,105 stars, it ranks 14th on GitHub Trending daily, gaining attention for its innovative auto-knowledge-base approach and powerful multimodal capabilities.
uses: Researchers and students — need to automatically build a searchable knowledge base from large document sets
Knowledge workers — want to integrate scattered documents, web clips, and media into a structured wiki
Developers — seek a locally deployable AI knowledge management tool with custom model support
Teams — require cross-device migration and sharing of project archives for collaboration

zh.tag: 分析AI编程助手使用情况，提升代理工程效率
zh.what: AI Engineer Coach 是一款 VS Code 扩展，通过读取本地 AI 会话日志，提供可操作的洞察，帮助开发者优化 AI 编程助手的使用。它跟踪进度、检测反模式、衡量输出，并发现可复用的技能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 VS Code 扩展的源代码、构建脚本和文档，主要用 TypeScript 编写，提供仪表板、反模式检测、技能发现等功能。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 和 VS Code 扩展 API，依赖 Node.js 和 npm 进行构建，可能使用 Webview 展示仪表板。
zh.hot: 本周新增 565 星，总星数 4226，登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 周榜第 16 名，因其解决 AI 编程助手使用中的痛点而受欢迎。
uses: 使用 AI 编程助手的开发者，希望优化使用习惯和提升效率
团队负责人，需要评估 AI 工具对开发流程的影响
AI 工程学习者，想了解最佳实践和反模式

en.tag: Analyze AI coding assistant usage for better agentic engineering
en.what: AI Engineer Coach is a VS Code extension that reads local AI session logs and turns them into actionable insights to help developers optimize their AI coding assistant usage. It tracks progress, detects anti-patterns, measures output, and discovers reusable skills.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, build scripts, and documentation for the VS Code extension, primarily written in TypeScript, offering features like dashboards, anti-pattern detection, and skill discovery.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and the VS Code Extension API, relying on Node.js and npm for building, and possibly using Webviews for dashboards.
en.hot: Gained 565 stars this week, totaling 4226, and ranked 16th on GitHub Trending TypeScript weekly, popular for addressing pain points in AI coding assistant usage.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants who want to optimize usage and improve efficiency
Team leads assessing the impact of AI tools on development workflows
AI engineering learners seeking best practices and anti-patterns

zh.tag: 面向生产环境的开源 LLM 可观测、评测与治理平台
zh.what: LangWatch 是一个面向生产环境的开源 LLM 平台，用于追踪、测试、路由和治理公司内的每一次 LLM 调用，覆盖自研 Agent 到工程师使用的编码助手。它把可观测性、Agent 测试、评测、Prompt 管理、AI 网关与治理整合到同一套系统中。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 主代码库、Python 与 npm 客户端包、自托管服务端（npx @langwatch/server），以及覆盖 LLM Ops、编码 Agent、AI Gateway、AI Governance 四大模块的文档与示例。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，提供 Python（PyPI）与 npm 双端 SDK，自托管仅需 Node.js，采用 Apache 2.0 开源核心加企业版扩展的开源商业模式。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1256 星、总数达 4784，冲上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 周榜第 20 名，反映出团队对 LLM 生产可观测与评测工具的真实需求。
uses: AI 工程团队：为生产环境的 LLM 应用和 Agent 搭建可观测与评测体系
平台/基础设施团队：统一接入各家模型，做网关路由、预算与虚拟密钥管理
企业合规与安全团队：治理公司内所有 AI 调用，包括工程师使用的编码助手
独立开发者或小团队：用自托管方式低成本获得 LLM Ops 与 Prompt 管理能力

en.tag: Open-source platform for LLM observability, evaluation and governance in production
en.what: LangWatch is an open-source platform for AI in production, letting you trace, test, route and govern every LLM call in your company, from the agents you build to the coding assistants your engineers use. It bundles observability, agent testing, evaluations, prompt management, an AI gateway and governance into one system.
en.content: The repo contains the TypeScript codebase, Python and npm client packages, a self-hostable server (npx @langwatch/server), plus docs and examples covering four areas: LLM Ops, Coding Agents, AI Gateway and AI Governance.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Python (PyPI) and npm SDKs; self-hosting only needs Node.js. It follows an open-core model: Apache 2.0 core plus an Enterprise extension.
en.hot: It gained 1,256 stars this week for a total of 4,784, landing at #20 on GitHub Trending's weekly TypeScript chart, reflecting real demand for production LLM observability and evaluation tooling.

Platform/infra teams needing a unified gateway for routing, budgets and virtual keys across model providers
Enterprise compliance and security teams governing all AI usage, including coding assistants used by engineers
Indie developers and small teams wanting self-hosted LLM Ops and prompt management at low cost

zh.tag: 腾讯开源的团队级 AI 代理配置与知识同步 CLI
zh.what: TeamAI 是一个命令行工具，用于在 Claude Code、Codex、CodeBuddy、Cursor 等多种 AI 代理之间统一管理团队的技能、规则、MCP 配置与知识库。团队管理员把共享经验仓库托管在 Git 上，成员执行 init 后每次 AI 会话都会自动拉取最新的技能与规则。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的 CLI 源码、多语言 README（中/英/日/韩/泰）、使用指南文档，以及 assets 中的 logo 等资源，配套 teamai-hub 模板组织提供预制技能与审查代理。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，通过 npm 全局安装（npm install -g teamai-cli），依赖 Node.js 生态，并集成 Git 托管服务（GitHub、GitLab、GitCode、CNB、TGit 等）作为团队配置仓库。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1846 star、总数达 4662，冲上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 周榜第 13 名；腾讯出品加上多代理统一治理的刚需，让它在 AI 编码工具爆发期迅速走红。
uses: 团队技术负责人：统一为成员分发技能、规则与 MCP 配置
使用多种 AI 编码代理的开发者：一处配置，跨 Claude Code、Cursor 等生效
希望沉淀团队知识库与代码库上下文的工程组织
想快速体验预制技能与审查代理的个人开发者

en.tag: Tencent's CLI to sync team skills, rules and MCP across AI agents
en.what: TeamAI is a CLI that manages a team's skills, rules, MCP configs and knowledge across AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, CodeBuddy, Cursor and more. Admins host a shared-experience repo on Git, and after members run init every AI session auto-pulls the latest skills and rules.
en.content: The repo contains the TypeScript CLI source, multilingual READMEs (EN/ZH/JA/KO/TH), usage-guide docs, and assets like the logo, plus a companion teamai-hub org with prebuilt skills and review agents.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript and installed globally via npm (npm install -g teamai-cli), it relies on the Node.js ecosystem and integrates Git hosts (GitHub, GitLab, GitCode, CNB, TGit, etc.) as the team config repo.
en.hot: It gained 1,846 stars this week for a total of 4,662, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending's weekly TypeScript list; Tencent's backing plus the real need to govern multiple AI coding agents made it take off fast.

Developers using multiple AI coding agents: configure once, apply across Claude Code, Cursor and more
Engineering orgs wanting to accumulate team knowledge and codebase context
Solo developers wanting prebuilt skills and review agents out of the box

zh.tag: 跨平台开源 JavaScript 运行时，服务端 JS 的事实标准
zh.what: Node.js 是一个开源、跨平台的 JavaScript 运行时环境，让 JavaScript 可以脱离浏览器在服务器和命令行中运行。它基于 V8 引擎与事件驱动、非阻塞 I/O 模型，适合构建高并发的网络服务与工具链。
zh.content: 仓库是 Node.js 的核心源码与治理中心，包含 lib、src、deps、test、doc 等目录，以及 GOVERNANCE、发布流程、TSC 与协作者名单等社区文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 与 C++ 编写，核心依赖 V8、libuv、OpenSSL、zlib 等；通过 CMake/GYP 与 Python 构建，支持多平台二进制分发。
zh.hot: 作为服务端 JavaScript 的基石，它已积累 122003 颗星，本周再增 1098 星并登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 周榜第 7，说明生态关注度长期稳定。
uses: 后端与全栈开发者，用于构建 API、微服务与实时应用
前端/工具链工程师，运行构建脚本、CLI 与打包工具
DevOps 与平台团队，部署高并发网络服务与 Serverless 函数
学习者与教学场景，用同一门语言贯通前后端开发

en.tag: The open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime that powers server-side JS
en.what: Node.js is an open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime that lets JavaScript run outside the browser, on servers and the command line. Built on the V8 engine with an event-driven, non-blocking I/O model, it suits high-concurrency network services and tooling.
en.content: The repo is the core source and governance hub of Node.js, with lib, src, deps, test and doc directories plus GOVERNANCE, release process, TSC and collaborator docs.
en.stack: Written mainly in JavaScript and C++, depending on V8, libuv, OpenSSL and zlib; built via CMake/GYP and Python, with multi-platform binary distribution.
en.hot: As the cornerstone of server-side JavaScript, it has reached 122,003 stars, adding 1,098 this week and ranking 7th on GitHub Trending's weekly JavaScript list, showing sustained ecosystem attention.
uses: Backend and full-stack developers building APIs, microservices and realtime apps
Frontend and tooling engineers running build scripts, CLIs and bundlers
DevOps and platform teams deploying high-concurrency services and serverless functions
Learners and educators using one language across frontend and backend

zh.tag: 各大 AI 聊天机器人系统提示词泄露合集，持续更新
zh.what: 这个仓库逐字收集并整理各大 AI 产品在用户发出第一条消息前所收到的隐藏系统提示词与规则，涵盖 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、xAI 等厂商。内容按厂商与模型分门别类，并持续追踪最新版本。
zh.content: 仓库以 Markdown 文件为主，按厂商目录（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、xAI、Meta 等）存放各模型提示词，如 Claude Fable 5.1、Codex GPT-6-Astra、Gemini 3.7 Flash、Grok 4.6 等，并附最近更新表格。
zh.stack: 以 JavaScript 为主语言，仓库本身基本是纯文本 Markdown 内容，依赖极少，主要靠社区 PR 与定期人工抓取维护。
zh.hot: 凭借 64,573 颗星和日增 125 星登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 5，加上《华盛顿邮报》等媒体基于其内容做报道，关注度持续走高。
uses: AI 研究者与提示词工程师，用于分析各家模型的隐藏规则与对齐策略
产品经理与创业者，参考竞品系统提示词来设计自己的 AI 产品
记者与内容创作者，挖掘大模型行为背后的规则并做报道
普通开发者与爱好者，了解 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等实际收到的指令

en.tag: A regularly updated collection of leaked system prompts from major AI chatbots
en.what: This repo collects verbatim the hidden system prompts and rules that major AI products receive before a user's first message, covering Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI and more. Files are organized by vendor and model, and are continuously updated as new versions ship.
en.content: It mainly consists of Markdown files organized into vendor folders (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, Meta, etc.), each holding prompts for models like Claude Fable 5.1, Codex GPT-6-Astra, Gemini 3.7 Flash and Grok 4.6, plus a recent-changes table.
en.stack: JavaScript is the primary language, but the repo is essentially plain-text Markdown with minimal dependencies, maintained through community PRs and regular manual captures.
en.hot: With 64,573 stars and 125 added today, it ranks 5th on GitHub Trending's JavaScript daily list, and coverage by outlets like The Washington Post keeps attention high.
uses: AI researchers and prompt engineers analyzing hidden rules and alignment strategies across models
Product managers and founders referencing competitors' system prompts when designing their own AI products
Journalists and content creators investigating and reporting on the rules behind model behavior
General developers and enthusiasts curious about the actual instructions ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and others receive

zh.tag: 构建 Web 与原生界面的声明式 UI 库
zh.what: React 是用于构建用户界面的 JavaScript 库，以声明式、组件化的方式开发交互式 UI。它既能在浏览器端渲染，也能通过 Node 做服务端渲染，并借助 React Native 驱动移动应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 React 核心运行时源码（packages/react、react-dom、react-native-renderer 等）、React Compiler 编译器、测试套件与官方文档站点源码。
zh.stack: 以 JavaScript/TypeScript 编写，使用 Flow 类型标注、Rollup/Jest 构建测试，通过 npm 包分发，依赖 Node 生态。
zh.hot: 作为前端事实标准，React 已积累约 25 万 star，本周仍新增 1116 star 并登上 JavaScript 周榜第 18 名，社区活跃度长期居高。
uses: 前端开发者构建 Web 单页应用与交互界面
移动端团队用 React Native 复用逻辑开发原生应用
需要服务端渲染或全栈框架（如 Next.js）的项目
希望渐进式引入组件化架构的既有项目

en.tag: The declarative library for web and native user interfaces
en.what: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces in a declarative, component-based way. It renders in the browser, on the server via Node, and powers mobile apps through React Native.
en.content: The repo holds the React core runtime (packages/react, react-dom, react-native-renderer, etc.), the React Compiler, test suites, and the source for the official docs site.
en.stack: Written in JavaScript/TypeScript with Flow annotations, built and tested via Rollup/Jest, distributed as npm packages, and dependent on the Node ecosystem.
en.hot: As the de facto frontend standard, React has ~250k stars, still gained 1,116 this week, and ranked 18th on the JavaScript weekly trending list, showing sustained community momentum.
uses: Frontend developers building web SPAs and interactive UIs
Mobile teams reusing logic with React Native for native apps
Projects needing SSR or full-stack frameworks like Next.js
Existing projects adopting component architecture incrementally

zh.tag: 免越狱 iOS 虚拟定位，通过代理 MITM 修改 Apple 定位服务坐标
zh.what: 这是一个利用代理软件（如 Shadowrocket、Surge 等）的 HTTPS 解密（MITM）功能，拦截并修改 Apple 定位服务返回的 Wi-Fi 和基站坐标，从而让 iPhone 在不越狱的情况下虚拟定位到世界任何角落。它只影响网络定位，不修改 GPS 硬件，在系统层面被视为真实定位。
zh.content: 仓库包含针对 Shadowrocket、Surge、Loon、Quantumult X、Stash 五个代理平台的模块文件（如 .sgmodule、.lnplugin 等），以及一个核心 JavaScript 脚本 location-spoofer.js，还提供了详细的中文图文教程和常见问题排查指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写核心脚本，依赖代理软件的 MITM 功能，兼容 iOS 12 及以上系统，支持多平台模块格式。
zh.hot: 该项目本周新增 252 星，总星数达 4147，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（JavaScript）第 11 名。它解决了 iOS 用户免越狱虚拟定位的痛点，且适配多个主流代理平台，教程详尽，因此受到广泛关注。
uses: 需要虚拟定位的 iOS 用户，如游戏、社交、打卡等场景
已使用 Shadowrocket、Surge 等代理软件并熟悉 MITM 配置的用户
对 iOS 定位机制感兴趣的安全研究人员或开发者

en.tag: Jailbreak-free iOS location spoofer that modifies Apple location service coordinates via proxy MITM
en.what: This project uses proxy software (e.g., Shadowrocket, Surge) with HTTPS decryption (MITM) to intercept and modify the Wi-Fi and cell tower coordinates returned by Apple's location service, allowing an iPhone to spoof its location anywhere without jailbreaking. It only affects network-based location, not GPS hardware, and is treated as real location at the system level.
en.content: The repository contains module files for five proxy platforms (Shadowrocket, Surge, Loon, Quantumult X, Stash), a core JavaScript script location-spoofer.js, and detailed Chinese tutorials and troubleshooting guides.
en.stack: Primarily uses JavaScript for the core script, relies on proxy software's MITM capabilities, compatible with iOS 12 and above, and supports multiple platform module formats.
en.hot: The project gained 252 stars this week, reaching 4,147 total stars, and ranked 11th on GitHub Trending weekly (JavaScript). It addresses the pain point of jailbreak-free location spoofing for iOS users, supports multiple mainstream proxy platforms, and provides detailed tutorials, thus attracting widespread attention.
uses: iOS users needing location spoofing for gaming, social media, check-ins, etc.
Users already using proxy software like Shadowrocket or Surge and familiar with MITM configuration
Security researchers or developers interested in iOS location mechanisms

zh.tag: AI 代理技能，一键生成可验证的交互式系统架构图
zh.what: Archify 是一个 AI 代理技能，可将代码库或系统描述转化为精美的交互式系统地图。它支持五种图表类型、四种预设、明暗主题和内置品牌标识，并能生成自包含的 HTML 文件，方便演示和分享。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、文档、示例和生成器代码，支持通过 npx 命令安装到 Raven、Cursor、Claude Code 等代理。提供项目页面、场景指南和画廊，展示不同用例。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML，使用 TypeScript 生成确定性校验的 JSON IR，并输出 HTML、PNG、SVG、WebM 等格式。依赖 npx 进行安装，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 18k+ 星标和日增千星的势头，Archify 满足了开发者对可视化架构文档的迫切需求，尤其在 AI 辅助开发场景下，能快速生成可验证的图表，提升代码审查和沟通效率。
uses: 开发者希望在代码审查前快速生成架构对比图，确保变更可验证。
技术写作者或架构师需要为系统设计生成交互式演示文档，便于向团队或客户展示。
AI 代理用户希望将代码库映射为可视化图表，以便更直观地理解系统结构和数据流。

en.tag: Agent skill that turns codebases into beautiful, verifiable interactive architecture diagrams
en.what: Archify is an agent skill that transforms a codebase or system description into a polished, interactive system map. It supports five diagram types, four presets, dark/light themes, and built-in brand marks, producing self-contained HTML files for easy presentation and sharing.
en.content: The repository contains skill definitions, documentation, examples, and generator code, installable via npx into agents like Raven, Cursor, and Claude Code. It includes a project page, scenario guide, and gallery showcasing various use cases.
en.stack: Primarily HTML-based, using TypeScript to generate deterministically checked JSON IR, outputting HTML, PNG, SVG, WebM, and more. Installed via npx, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 18k+ stars and a daily gain of 1k, Archify addresses the urgent need for visual architecture documentation, especially in AI-assisted development, enabling quick generation of verifiable diagrams that boost code review and communication efficiency.
uses: Developers who want to quickly generate architecture comparison diagrams before code review to ensure changes are verifiable.
Technical writers or architects needing interactive presentation documents for system designs to share with teams or clients.
AI agent users who want to map codebases into visual diagrams for better understanding of system structure and data flow.

zh.tag: 洛雪音乐播放器的第三方音源脚本合集
zh.what: 这是一个为洛雪音乐（LX Music）桌面版与移动版提供音源脚本的合集仓库，用户通过导入其中的 JS 链接即可扩展播放器的搜索与播放能力。内容来源于网络，聚合了多个第三方音源提供方的接口脚本。
zh.content: 仓库按音源提供方分目录存放，如 sixyin、huibq、flower、lx、changqing、huanyin、ikun、grass、juhe、qdy，每个目录下提供 latest.js 脚本文件，README 给出原始链接与多种 GitHub 加速链接。
zh.stack: 以 JavaScript 编写，作为洛雪音乐自定义音源脚本运行，无复杂构建依赖，主要依赖 GitHub Raw 托管与 ghproxy 等加速代理分发。
zh.hot: 洛雪音乐本身用户基数大，而官方音源受限，社区音源需求旺盛，仓库已积累 8826 星，本周新增 261 星，登上 JavaScript 周榜第 13 名。
uses: 洛雪音乐用户 —— 想导入第三方音源以扩展可搜索和播放的曲库
网络受限用户 —— 可借助仓库提供的加速链接导入音源脚本
音源脚本维护者 —— 参考各提供方的脚本结构与分发方式

en.tag: A collection of third-party music source scripts for LX Music
en.what: This repo collects music source scripts for LX Music (desktop and mobile), letting users extend the player's search and playback by importing JS links. The content is sourced from the internet and aggregates scripts from several third-party source providers.
en.content: Sources are organized into per-provider folders such as sixyin, huibq, flower, lx, changqing, huanyin, ikun, grass, juhe and qdy, each containing a latest.js script; the README lists both raw links and several GitHub proxy/accelerated links.
en.stack: Written in JavaScript as custom LX Music source scripts, with no heavy build dependencies; distribution relies on GitHub Raw hosting plus proxy services like ghproxy.
en.hot: LX Music has a large user base but limited official sources, driving strong demand for community sources; the repo has reached 8,826 stars with 261 added this week, ranking 13th on the JavaScript weekly trending list.
uses: LX Music users — want to import third-party sources to expand searchable and playable tracks
Users with restricted networks — can use the accelerated links provided to import source scripts
Source script maintainers — can reference the structure and distribution of each provider's scripts

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的市场营销技能库
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）设计的营销技能集合，涵盖转化率优化、文案写作、SEO、分析和增长工程。它帮助技术营销人员和创始人利用 AI 编码代理自动执行营销任务，并遵循 Agent Skills 规范。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个 Markdown 格式的技能文件，每个技能提供特定营销任务的框架和最佳实践。技能之间相互引用，以 product-marketing 为基础，其他技能先读取它来了解产品、受众和定位。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，但核心是 Markdown 技能文件。兼容支持 Agent Skills 规范的代理，如 Claude Code、OpenAI Codex、Cursor 等。
zh.hot: 星标数达 4.6 万，今日新增 154，登上 JavaScript 日榜。它填补了 AI 代理在营销领域的空白，将营销专业知识结构化，让 AI 代理能直接应用，因此受到技术营销者和创始人的追捧。
uses: 技术营销人员：希望利用 AI 代理自动执行营销任务，提升效率。
创始人：需要 AI 辅助进行转化优化、文案和 SEO，以驱动增长。
AI 代理开发者：希望集成营销技能到自己的代理中，扩展功能。

en.tag: Marketing skills library for AI agents
en.what: A collection of AI agent skills for marketing tasks, including CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering. It enables technical marketers and founders to leverage AI coding agents for marketing automation, following the Agent Skills spec.
en.content: The repo contains multiple Markdown skill files, each providing frameworks and best practices for specific marketing tasks. Skills reference each other, with product-marketing as the foundation that others read first to understand product, audience, and positioning.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, but the core is Markdown skill files. Compatible with agents supporting the Agent Skills spec, such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, and others.
en.hot: With 46k stars and 154 new today, it hit the JavaScript daily trending. It fills a gap by structuring marketing expertise for AI agents, making it directly applicable, thus attracting technical marketers and founders.
uses: Technical marketers: want to automate marketing tasks with AI agents for efficiency.
Founders: need AI assistance for CRO, copywriting, and SEO to drive growth.
AI agent developers: integrate marketing skills into their agents to extend capabilities.

zh.tag: 社区共建的 GitHub Copilot 定制资源大全
zh.what: 这是 GitHub 官方维护的社区贡献合集，汇集了自定义 agents、instructions、skills、hooks、workflows 与 plugins，用来增强 GitHub Copilot 的能力。用户可以直接安装插件或按需取用各类配置，让 Copilot 更贴合自己的开发流程。
zh.content: 仓库按 Agents、Instructions、Skills、Plugins 分类整理，并附带 Cookbook 与 Learning Hub 文档，同时提供官网全文检索和面向 AI agent 的 llms.txt 结构化清单。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，配套官网与文档站点，依赖 GitHub Copilot CLI/VS Code 插件市场机制进行分发安装。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 官方背书的 Copilot 定制资源中心，它精准踩中 AI 编程助手定制化需求，已累积约 3.9 万 star，今日再登 JavaScript 日榜第 4。
uses: 希望深度定制 GitHub Copilot 行为的开发者
想快速获取现成 agents、skills 与 instructions 的团队
需要为特定工作流打包插件配置的工程团队
想学习 Copilot 定制最佳实践的 AI 编程新手

en.tag: A community-built collection of GitHub Copilot customizations
en.what: This is a GitHub-maintained, community-contributed collection of custom agents, instructions, skills, hooks, workflows, and plugins designed to supercharge GitHub Copilot. Users can install plugins or pick individual resources to tailor Copilot to their own workflows.
en.content: The repo organizes resources into Agents, Instructions, Skills, and Plugins, alongside a Cookbook and Learning Hub docs; it also offers a searchable website and a machine-readable llms.txt for AI agents.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with a companion website and docs; distribution relies on the GitHub Copilot CLI/VS Code plugin marketplace mechanism.
en.hot: As an officially backed hub for Copilot customization, it hits the surging demand for tailored AI coding assistants, racking up ~38.9k stars and landing 4th on today's JavaScript trending list.
uses: Developers who want to deeply customize GitHub Copilot behavior
Teams seeking ready-made agents, skills, and instructions
Engineering teams packaging plugin configs for specific workflows
AI coding newcomers learning Copilot customization best practices

zh.tag: 免费领取高颜值 .is-a.dev 子域名的开源注册服务
zh.what: is-a.dev 是一个面向开发者的免费子域名服务，任何人都可以为自己搭建的个人网站、博客或项目申请一个简洁好看的 .is-a.dev 子域名。申请者通过向仓库提交 Pull Request 来登记自己的 DNS 记录，合并后几分钟内即可生效。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 domains 目录，里面按子域名存放一份份 JSON 配置文件，记录该子域名的 DNS 记录；此外还有文档链接、滥用举报模板和 Discord 社区入口。
zh.stack: 以 JavaScript 为主，核心是 JSON 格式的 DNS 记录配置，DNS 托管由 Cloudflare 的 Project Alexandria 计划支持，注册流程依托 GitHub PR 与 CI 校验。
zh.hot: 免费又好看的开发者子域名几乎是刚需，加上 11k+ star 的社区口碑和极低的使用门槛，让它持续登上 JavaScript 日榜。
uses: 想给个人主页、博客或作品集配一个简洁域名的独立开发者
预算有限但希望拥有专业感网址的学生与开源爱好者
需要为小型项目或演示站点快速绑定域名的团队
想学习 DNS 记录与 GitHub PR 协作流程的新手

en.tag: A free service giving developers a sweet-looking .is-a.dev subdomain
en.what: is-a.dev is a free subdomain service that lets any developer claim a clean, sweet-looking .is-a.dev subdomain for their personal site, blog, or project. You register by opening a pull request with your DNS records, and they go live within minutes of being merged.
en.content: The repo is essentially a domains directory holding one JSON config file per subdomain that defines its DNS records, plus docs links, an abuse-report template, and a Discord community.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with DNS records stored as JSON configs; DNS hosting is backed by Cloudflare's Project Alexandria, and registration runs through GitHub PRs and CI checks.
en.hot: A free, good-looking developer subdomain is near-universal demand, and with 11k+ stars of community trust and a very low barrier to entry, it keeps trending on the JavaScript daily chart.
uses: Indie developers wanting a clean domain for a personal homepage, blog, or portfolio
Students and open-source hobbyists who want a professional-looking URL on a budget
Teams needing a quick domain for a small project or demo site
Beginners learning DNS records and the GitHub PR workflow

zh.tag: 一站式下载器：课程、视频、音乐、书籍，无需命令行
zh.what: OmniGet 是一款免费开源的桌面应用，支持从 Udemy、Hotmart、YouTube 等 1800+ 网站下载课程、视频、音乐和电子书。内置播放器、PDF/EPUB 阅读器和音乐库，所有文件保存在本地，无需命令行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 后端、Svelte/Tauri 前端、桌面安装包及多语言 README。提供图形界面、快捷键下载、内置播放器等功能，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 Tauri 构建，使用 Svelte 作为前端框架，依赖 yt-dlp 进行下载。
zh.hot: 今日新增 102 星，总星数达 9480，在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Rust）排名第 10。其精准的 SEO 标签策略使其在多个下载器细分领域（如课程下载、YouTube 下载）中排名第一，吸引了大量用户。
uses: 在线学习者：需要下载 Udemy、Hotmart 等平台的付费课程以便离线观看。
内容创作者：希望保存 YouTube、TikTok 等平台的视频素材用于二次创作。
音乐与书籍爱好者：想要下载音乐和电子书并在应用内管理阅读。
技术小白：希望无需命令行即可轻松下载网络资源。

en.tag: All-in-one downloader for courses, videos, music & books — no terminal needed
en.what: OmniGet is a free, open-source desktop app that downloads courses, videos, music, and books from 1,800+ sites including Udemy, Hotmart, and YouTube. It features a built-in player, PDF/EPUB reader, and music library, keeping all files on your computer with no terminal required.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust backend, Svelte/Tauri frontend, desktop installers, and multilingual READMEs. It offers a GUI, hotkey downloads, built-in player, and supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Tauri, using Svelte for the frontend, and powered by yt-dlp for downloads.

zh.tag: 用 git worktree 与 tmux 窗口实现零摩擦并行开发

zh.tag: 为AI代理压缩命令输出的CLI代理，节省高达90%token
zh.what: RTK是一个高性能的CLI代理，在命令输出进入LLM上下文之前进行过滤和压缩，可减少60-90%的token消耗。它拦截shell命令，将冗长的输出转换为紧凑格式，例如将ls输出转为带文件计数的树形结构，仅保留git diff的关键变更等。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个用Rust编写的单一二进制文件，支持100多种命令，如ls、cat、grep、git、cargo test等。还提供安装脚本、文档（包括架构说明）和多语言README。
zh.stack: 纯Rust实现，零依赖，单一二进制文件，开销小于10ms。
zh.hot: 随着AI编程助手普及，token成本成为痛点，RTK能大幅削减成本，且安装简单、性能高，因此迅速走红。
uses: 使用Claude Code、Codex等AI编程助手的开发者，希望减少token消耗和费用。
需要处理大量命令行输出的DevOps工程师，通过压缩日志和状态信息提高效率。
对Rust高性能工具感兴趣的开发者，可学习其架构和实现。

en.tag: CLI proxy that compresses command output for AI agents, cutting token usage by up to 90%
en.what: RTK is a high-performance CLI proxy that filters and compresses command output before it reaches the LLM context, reducing token consumption by 60-90%. It intercepts shell commands and converts verbose output into compact formats, such as turning ls output into a tree with file counts and keeping only essential changes from git diff.
en.content: The repository contains a single Rust binary supporting over 100 commands like ls, cat, grep, git, cargo test, etc. It also includes installation scripts, documentation (including architecture), and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Pure Rust implementation, zero dependencies, single binary, overhead under 10ms.
en.hot: As AI coding assistants become popular, token costs are a pain point. RTK significantly cuts costs, is easy to install, and performs well, hence its rapid rise.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Codex who want to reduce token usage and costs.
DevOps engineers dealing with large command outputs, improving efficiency by compressing logs and status info.
Developers interested in high-performance Rust tools, who can learn from its architecture and implementation.

zh.what: RuView 把普通 WiFi 路由器发出的无线电波变成空间感知系统：通过 CSI 信号捕捉人体对电磁波的扰动，实现穿墙人员检测、人数统计、动作追踪，以及呼吸和心率等生命体征测量。全程不需要摄像头或可穿戴设备，只靠物理信号。
zh.content: 仓库以 Rust 实现为核心，包含 CSI 信号采集与处理管线、姿态/生命体征推断模型、以及面向智能家居的集成层：Home Assistant 的 MQTT 发布器、Apple Home 的 HAP-1.1 桥、Matter 端点，并提供 21 个实体（11 个原始信号 + 10 个语义状态）和 3 个 HA Blueprint。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，依赖低成本 ESP32 传感器采集 CSI 数据；通过 MQTT、HAP-1.1、Matter 等协议对接 Home Assistant、Apple Home、Google Home、Alexa 等生态。
zh.hot: 以 93841 颗星、今日新增 383 星冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 12 名，凭借“用 WiFi 穿墙感知、无需摄像头”的隐私友好卖点，加上对主流智能家居生态的原生支持，迅速引发关注。
uses: 智能家居用户：想在不装摄像头的情况下实现房间级存在检测与老人看护

健康与养老机构：需要非接触式呼吸、心率及活动异常监测的远程照护方案

en.tag: Turn commodity WiFi signals into through-wall sensing, pose estimation and vital-sign monitoring
en.what: RuView turns ordinary WiFi radio waves into a spatial sensing system: it captures human-induced disturbances in Channel State Information (CSI) to detect people through walls, count them, track movement, and measure breathing and heart rate. No cameras or wearables are needed — just physics.
en.content: The repo centers on a Rust implementation with a CSI acquisition and processing pipeline, pose/vital-sign inference models, and smart-home integration layers: an MQTT publisher for Home Assistant, a HAP-1.1 bridge for Apple Home, and a Matter endpoint. It ships 21 entities per node (11 raw signals + 10 semantic states) plus 3 starter HA Blueprints.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it relies on low-cost ESP32 sensors for CSI data collection and integrates with Home Assistant, Apple Home, Google Home and Alexa via MQTT, HAP-1.1 and Matter.
en.hot: With 93,841 stars and 383 added today, it ranks 12th on GitHub Trending's daily list. Its privacy-friendly pitch — through-wall sensing with WiFi and no cameras — plus native support for major smart-home ecosystems has driven rapid attention.
uses: Smart-home users who want room-level presence detection and elderly care without cameras
Privacy-sensitive spaces like bathrooms or bedrooms needing vital-sign and fall-risk monitoring
IoT/embedded developers building WiFi sensing apps on ESP32 and Rust
Health and elder-care providers needing contactless breathing, heart-rate and activity anomaly monitoring

zh.content: 仓库主体是编译器（rustc）与标准库源码，另含文档、构建脚本、测试套件，以及 INSTALL.md、CONTRIBUTING.md、LICENSE 等工程文件。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 自身实现（自举），依赖 LLVM 作为后端代码生成，配套 Cargo、rustfmt、Clippy、rust-analyzer 等工具链。
zh.hot: 作为语言核心仓库，它长期是 GitHub 上星标最多的项目之一，118950 颗星且本周新增 1187，稳居 Rust 周榜第 18 名，反映社区持续活跃。
uses: 系统与嵌入式开发者，需要高性能且内存安全的底层语言
后端与基础设施工程师，构建高并发、低延迟服务
想学习所有权、借用等现代类型系统概念的程序员
希望为编译器或标准库贡献代码的开源爱好者

en.tag: The official Rust language repo: compiler, standard library, and docs
en.what: This is the main source repository for the Rust programming language, containing the rustc compiler, the standard library, and documentation. Rust is known for performance, memory and thread safety, and a strong toolchain, making it suited to systems programming, embedded devices, and high-performance services.
en.content: The repo mainly holds the compiler (rustc) and standard library sources, plus documentation, build scripts, test suites, and project files such as INSTALL.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and LICENSE.
en.stack: Written in Rust itself (self-hosted), it relies on LLVM as the code-generation backend and ships with tooling like Cargo, rustfmt, Clippy, and rust-analyzer.
en.hot: As the language's core repository, it is one of the most starred projects on GitHub, with 118,950 stars and 1,187 added this week, ranking 18th on the weekly Rust trending list and reflecting an active community.
uses: Systems and embedded developers needing a fast, memory-safe low-level language
Backend and infrastructure engineers building high-concurrency, low-latency services
Programmers wanting to learn modern type-system concepts like ownership and borrowing
Open-source contributors hoping to work on the compiler or standard library

zh.tag: 跨多服务器构建与部署软件的开源工具
zh.what: Komodo 是一个用于在多台服务器上构建、部署和管理软件的工具，支持连接任意数量的服务器。它提供 Web 界面来管理构建、堆栈、Compose、环境变量、同步、更新与统计等操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心服务、Web 前端界面、periphery 代理安装脚本、路线图文档以及大量明暗主题的界面截图。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 开发，采用 GPL-V3 开源协议，依赖 Docker/Compose 生态进行部署与容器管理。
zh.hot: 凭借 12,321 颗星和本周 120 新增，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 周榜第 18 名，其无服务器数量限制和自动化 API 理念吸引大量运维与自托管用户。
uses: 需要跨多台服务器统一部署和管理的运维工程师
希望用 Web 界面管理 Docker/Compose 堆栈的自托管爱好者
寻求开源替代方案以替代商业部署平台的小型团队
需要自动化构建与更新流程的 DevOps 开发者

en.tag: An open-source tool to build and deploy software across many servers
en.what: Komodo is a tool for building, deploying, and managing software across many servers, with no limit on the number of servers you can connect. It offers a web UI for managing builds, stacks, Compose, environments, sync, updates, and stats.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core service, a web frontend, periphery agent setup scripts, a roadmap document, and many light/dark theme UI screenshots.
en.stack: Primarily built in Rust under GPL-V3, relying on the Docker/Compose ecosystem for deployment and container management.
en.hot: With 12,321 stars and 120 added this week, it ranks 18th on GitHub Trending Rust weekly, attracting ops and self-hosting users with its unlimited-server and automation API philosophy.
uses: DevOps engineers managing deployments across multiple servers
Self-hosting enthusiasts wanting a web UI for Docker/Compose stacks
Small teams seeking an open-source alternative to commercial deploy platforms
Developers needing automated build and update pipelines

zh.tag: 不发送邮件即可验证邮箱是否真实存在的 Rust 库
zh.what: check-if-email-exists 是一个用 Rust 编写的邮箱验证工具，通过 SMTP 握手、MX 记录查询、语法与域名检查等方式判断邮箱地址是否真实存在，全程不发送任何邮件。它既可以作为 Rust 库集成，也提供 CLI 和 HTTP 后端服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 库、独立的 CLI 二进制，以及一个基于 Docker 的 HTTP 后端（backend 目录），并提供在线演示 reacher.email。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Tokio 异步运行时进行 SMTP 通信，发布在 crates.io 和 docs.rs，后端以 Docker 镜像形式分发。
zh.hot: 邮箱验证是营销、注册风控等场景的刚需，而该项目以纯 Rust 实现、零邮件发送、开箱即用的 Docker 后端获得近万 star，今日新增 98 星再次登上 Rust 日榜。
uses: 需要清洗邮件列表、降低退信率的营销与增长团队
在注册/登录流程中做邮箱真实性校验的后端开发者
希望以 Rust 库或 CLI 形式集成邮箱验证的工程师
需要自建 HTTP 邮箱验证服务并控制数据的运维人员

en.tag: Rust library that verifies if an email address exists without sending any email
en.what: check-if-email-exists is a Rust tool that determines whether an email address actually exists by performing SMTP handshakes, MX record lookups, syntax and domain checks, all without sending any email. It works as a Rust library, a CLI, or an HTTP backend service.
en.content: The repo contains the core Rust library, a standalone CLI binary, and a Docker-based HTTP backend (backend directory), plus a live demo at reacher.email.
en.stack: Written in Rust with the Tokio async runtime for SMTP communication, published on crates.io and docs.rs, with the backend distributed as a Docker image.
en.hot: Email verification is a hard requirement for marketing and signup fraud prevention, and this project's pure-Rust implementation, zero-email-sending approach, and ready-to-use Docker backend have earned it nearly 10k stars, with 98 added today pushing it back onto the Rust trending list.
uses: Marketing and growth teams cleaning email lists to reduce bounce rates
Backend developers validating email authenticity during signup or login flows
Engineers wanting to integrate email verification as a Rust library or CLI
Ops teams self-hosting an HTTP email verification service for data control

zh.tag: Rust 从零打造的 macOS 容器与虚拟机运行时，主打 AI 代理沙箱
zh.what: ArcBox 是 macOS 上的开源容器与虚拟机运行时，用纯 Rust 从零实现自己的 VMM、VirtIO 设备、文件系统共享和网络数据通路。它提供兼容 Docker 的引擎、原生 Kubernetes、AI 代理用的微虚拟机沙箱，以及完整的 Linux 和 macOS 虚拟机。
zh.content: 仓库包含运行时核心（自研 VMM、VirtIO、文件共享与网络）、abctl 命令行工具、Docker 兼容层与 Kubernetes 支持，另有独立的 arcbox-desktop 桌面应用仓库。
zh.stack: 纯 Rust 编写，要求 Rust 1.96+，采用 MIT/Apache-2.0 双许可，通过 Homebrew 或安装脚本分发，兼容 OCI 与 Docker 生态。
zh.hot: 作为闭源 OrbStack 的开源替代品，它切中 macOS 上快速运行 Docker 与 AI 代理沙箱的痛点，本周新增 2436 star，迅速冲上 GitHub Trending Rust 周榜第 20 名。
uses: macOS 上想要开源 Docker Desktop / OrbStack 替代方案的开发者
需要在本地隔离环境中运行 AI 代理或不可信代码的团队
希望用同一运行时管理容器、Kubernetes 与完整虚拟机的工程师
关注 Rust 系统编程与自研 VMM 实现的技术爱好者

en.tag: A from-scratch Rust container and VM runtime for macOS, built for AI agent sandboxes
en.what: ArcBox is an open-source container and VM runtime for macOS, written from scratch in Rust with its own VMM, VirtIO devices, filesystem sharing, and network datapath. It offers a drop-in Docker engine, native Kubernetes, disposable microVM sandboxes for AI agents, and full Linux and macOS VMs.
en.content: The repo contains the runtime core (custom VMM, VirtIO, filesystem sharing, networking), the abctl CLI, a Docker-compatible layer, and Kubernetes support, plus a separate arcbox-desktop app repo.
en.stack: Written purely in Rust, requiring Rust 1.96+, dual-licensed MIT/Apache-2.0, distributed via Homebrew or an install script, and compatible with OCI and the Docker ecosystem.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to the closed-source OrbStack, it targets the pain of running Docker and AI agent sandboxes quickly on macOS, gaining 2,436 stars this week and hitting #20 on the GitHub Trending Rust weekly chart.
uses: Developers on macOS wanting an open-source Docker Desktop / OrbStack alternative
Teams needing to run AI agents or untrusted code in local isolated environments
Engineers who want containers, Kubernetes, and full VMs under one runtime
Rust systems-programming enthusiasts interested in a from-scratch VMM implementation

zh.tag: 面向严苛审查网络的 Rust 抗审查隧道客户端
zh.what: Aether 是一款抗审查客户端，能在 DPI、协议指纹识别、UDP 限速和端点封锁普遍的网络中自动发现可用线路并建立加密隧道，再通过本地 SOCKS5 代理供应用使用。它基于 MASQUE（HTTP/3 与 HTTP/2）构建，并支持 WireGuard 及嵌套隧道模式。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、Docs 目录下的英文与波斯文完整文档、跨平台预编译发行包（Windows/macOS/Linux/OpenWrt/Android Termux）以及一键安装脚本 aether.sh。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，核心依赖 MASQUE（HTTP/3/HTTP/2）、WireGuard、TLS ClientHello 分片与 Tor 出口等网络协议组件，支持 glibc 与 musl 静态构建。
zh.hot: 本周新增 154 star、总数 1909，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 周榜第 21 名；在审查趋严的背景下，其自动端点验证和嵌套隧道等实用特性吸引了大量关注。
uses: 需要在严格审查网络下稳定翻墙的普通用户
希望自建或研究抗审查隧道方案的网络工程师
在 OpenWrt 路由器或 Android Termux 上部署代理的进阶玩家
关注 MASQUE/HTTP3 与 DPI 对抗技术的安全研究者

en.tag: A Rust censorship-circumvention tunnel client for heavily restricted networks
en.what: Aether is a censorship-circumvention client that automatically discovers reachable routes and builds an encrypted tunnel even in networks with DPI, protocol fingerprinting, UDP throttling and endpoint blocking, then exposes a local SOCKS5 proxy for apps. It is built around MASQUE over HTTP/3 and HTTP/2, with WireGuard and nested-tunnel modes.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust source, full English and Persian docs under Docs/, cross-platform prebuilt release archives (Windows/macOS/Linux/OpenWrt/Android Termux) and a one-line install script aether.sh.
en.stack: Written in Rust, it relies on MASQUE (HTTP/3/HTTP/2), WireGuard, TLS ClientHello fragmentation and optional Tor exit, with both glibc and fully static musl builds.
en.hot: It gained 154 stars this week for a total of 1,909, ranking 21st on GitHub Trending's weekly Rust list; amid tightening censorship, its end-to-end endpoint validation and nested-tunnel features draw strong interest.
uses: Everyday users needing reliable access under heavy censorship
Network engineers studying or self-hosting anti-censorship tunnels
Advanced users deploying proxies on OpenWrt routers or Android Termux
Security researchers interested in MASQUE/HTTP3 and DPI evasion

zh.tag: 可插拔传输的 TCP 隧道与网络栈研究工具
zh.what: OpenFlux 是一个网络栈研究工具，提供 TCP 隧道并支持可插拔传输、批量+zstd 编解码，以及两种出口节点后端（L3 原始转发 / L4 gVisor 代理）。它允许客户端通过多种传输方式连接到出口节点，再访问互联网，适用于网络架构实验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 实现的 CLI 客户端和出口节点，支持 macOS、Linux、Windows，并有独立的 Android APK 和 iOS TestFlight 测试版。核心模块包括传输层（Yandex.Docs、Volga、MAX、Cups、Mail.ru）、编解码器以及 L3/L4 出口后端。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 gVisor 用户态网络栈实现 L4 代理，并集成 zstd 压缩。客户端和出口节点均以 CLI 形式提供，支持跨平台构建。
zh.hot: 本周新增 888 星，总星数达 1704，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Go）第 3 名。其可插拔传输和两种出口模式的设计，以及对多平台客户端的支持，吸引了网络研究者和开发者的关注。
uses: 网络研究人员和开发者，用于实验 TCP 隧道和可插拔传输架构。
需要跨平台（macOS/Linux/Windows/Android/iOS）网络工具的技术爱好者。
学习 gVisor 用户态网络栈和 L3/L4 转发机制的学生或工程师。
希望自建出口节点进行网络测试的运维人员。

en.tag: TCP tunnel with pluggable transports for network stack research
en.what: OpenFlux is a network stack research tool offering a TCP tunnel with pluggable transports, batched+zstd codec, and two exit-node backends (L3 raw forward / L4 gVisor proxy). It lets clients connect to an exit node via various transports to reach the internet, suitable for network architecture experiments.
en.content: The repo contains Go-based CLI clients and exit nodes for macOS, Linux, and Windows, plus standalone Android APK and iOS TestFlight beta. Core modules include transports (Yandex.Docs, Volga, MAX, Cups, Mail.ru), codec, and L3/L4 exit backends.
en.stack: Primarily built in Go, leveraging gVisor userspace network stack for L4 proxy and integrating zstd compression. Both client and exit node are CLI-based, supporting cross-platform builds.
en.hot: Gained 888 stars this week, reaching 1,704 total, ranking 3rd on GitHub Trending weekly (Go). Its pluggable transports, dual exit modes, and multi-platform client support attract network researchers and developers.
uses: Network researchers and developers experimenting with TCP tunnels and pluggable transport architectures.
Tech enthusiasts needing a cross-platform (macOS/Linux/Windows/Android/iOS) network tool.
Students or engineers learning gVisor userspace network stack and L3/L4 forwarding mechanisms.
Ops personnel wanting to self-host exit nodes for network testing.

zh.tag: 自主AI渗透测试代理系统
zh.what: PentAGI 是一个全自主的 AI 代理系统，能够执行复杂的渗透测试任务。它利用先进的人工智能技术，为信息安全专业人员、研究人员和爱好者提供强大且灵活的安全测试解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的系统代码、架构文档、快速入门指南、LLM 提供商配置（如 OpenAI、Anthropic、Ollama 等）、Docker 镜像配置、开发与测试工具（如 ftester）以及社区链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，支持多种 LLM 提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、AWS Bedrock 等），集成 Docker 进行隔离，并支持 Langfuse 监控和知识图谱（Graphiti）。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 与网络安全结合的热度上升，PentAGI 作为自动化渗透测试的领先项目，在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，今日新增 89 星，总星数达 22519，位居 Go 语言趋势榜第一。
uses: 安全研究人员：利用 AI 代理自动执行渗透测试，提高效率。
红队与蓝队：在授权环境中进行自动化安全评估。
AI 爱好者：探索 AI 在网络安全领域的实际应用。

en.tag: Autonomous AI agent system for complex penetration testing
en.what: PentAGI is a fully autonomous AI agent system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks. It leverages advanced AI technologies to provide a powerful and flexible security testing solution for infosec professionals, researchers, and enthusiasts.
en.content: The repository includes full system code, architecture docs, quick start guides, LLM provider configurations (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama), Docker image setup, development and testing tools (like ftester), and community links.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, supports multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, etc.), integrates Docker for isolation, and supports Langfuse monitoring and knowledge graph (Graphiti).
en.hot: With the rising intersection of AI and cybersecurity, PentAGI as a leading autonomous pentesting project has gained rapid traction on GitHub, adding 89 stars today to reach 22,519 total, ranking #1 in Go trending.
uses: Security researchers: leverage AI agents to automate penetration testing and improve efficiency.
Red and blue teams: conduct automated security assessments in authorized environments.
AI enthusiasts: explore practical applications of AI in cybersecurity.

zh.tag: 生产级容器编排与集群管理系统
zh.what: Kubernetes（K8s）是一个开源系统，用于跨多台主机管理容器化应用，提供服务部署、维护与扩缩容的基础机制。它源于 Google 十五年大规模生产经验（Borg 系统），现由 CNCF 托管。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kubernetes 核心源码（Go 编写），涵盖 API Server、调度器、控制器、kubelet、kubectl 等组件，以及构建脚本、测试套件和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 etcd、容器运行时（containerd/CRI-O）、CNI 网络插件等云原生生态组件。
zh.hot: 作为云原生领域的基石项目，Kubernetes 拥有 127,814 颗星，今日新增 29 星，稳居 GitHub Go 语言日榜第 14 名，持续吸引全球开发者关注。
uses: 运维工程师与平台团队：用于大规模容器化应用的部署、扩缩容与故障自愈
开发者：通过 kubectl 和 API 管理微服务架构，实现持续交付
企业架构师：构建混合云/多云环境下的统一调度与资源管理平台
云原生学习者：通过源码和文档深入理解容器编排原理

en.tag: Production-grade container scheduling and cluster management
en.what: Kubernetes (K8s) is an open source system for managing containerized applications across multiple hosts, providing basic mechanisms for deployment, maintenance, and scaling. It builds on Google's 15 years of production experience with Borg and is hosted by the CNCF.
en.content: The repo contains Kubernetes core source code in Go, including the API server, scheduler, controllers, kubelet, kubectl, plus build scripts, test suites, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it depends on etcd, container runtimes (containerd/CRI-O), CNI network plugins, and other cloud-native ecosystem components.
en.hot: As the cornerstone of cloud-native computing, Kubernetes has 127,814 stars with 29 added today, ranking 14th on GitHub's daily Go trending list, continuously drawing global developer attention.
uses: DevOps engineers and platform teams: deploy, scale, and self-heal containerized applications at scale
Developers: manage microservices architecture via kubectl and API for continuous delivery
Enterprise architects: build unified scheduling and resource management across hybrid/multi-cloud
Cloud-native learners: study source code and docs to understand container orchestration principles

zh.tag: 为 AI Agent 打造的毫秒级硬件隔离安全沙箱服务
zh.what: CubeSandbox 是腾讯云开源的高性能安全沙箱服务，基于 RustVMM 与 KVM 构建，可在 60ms 内创建硬件级隔离的沙箱环境，内存开销低于 5MB。它兼容 E2B SDK，支持单机部署并平滑扩展为多节点集群，为 AI Agent 提供安全、并发、轻量的代码执行环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心服务代码、RustVMM/KVM 虚拟化集成、E2B 兼容 API 层、快速开始与部署文档（docs/guide、docs/index.md）、中文文档及变更日志，并提供 PyPI 上的 cubesandbox 客户端包。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，底层依赖 RustVMM 与 KVM 实现硬件级虚拟化隔离，对外提供兼容 E2B SDK 的 API，并发布 PyPI 客户端包，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。
zh.hot: 上线即获 12512 星、今日新增 259 星，位列 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 2。AI Agent 爆发式增长让安全代码执行沙箱成为刚需，而 CubeSandbox 以 60ms 启动、5MB 开销和 E2B 兼容切中痛点，加上腾讯云背书与 CNCF Landscape 收录，迅速吸引开发者关注。
uses: AI Agent 开发者：为代码解释器、自动化任务提供安全隔离的执行环境
平台工程与基础设施团队：需要高并发、高密度的沙箱调度能力
已使用 E2B 的团队：希望平滑迁移到自托管、硬件级隔离方案
安全敏感场景：运行不可信代码时要求硬件级隔离与轻量开销

en.tag: Instant, hardware-isolated secure sandbox service for AI agents
en.what: CubeSandbox is a high-performance secure sandbox service open-sourced by Tencent Cloud, built on RustVMM and KVM. It creates hardware-isolated sandboxes in under 60ms with less than 5MB memory overhead, is E2B SDK compatible, and scales from single-node to multi-node clusters for safe AI agent code execution.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based core service, RustVMM/KVM virtualization integration, an E2B-compatible API layer, quickstart and deployment docs (docs/guide, docs/index.md), Chinese documentation, a changelog, and a cubesandbox client package on PyPI.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, it relies on RustVMM and KVM for hardware-level virtualization isolation, exposes an E2B SDK-compatible API, ships a PyPI client package, and is licensed under Apache 2.0.
en.hot: It quickly reached 12,512 stars with 259 added today, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending (Go). The AI agent boom makes secure code-execution sandboxes essential, and CubeSandbox's 60ms startup, 5MB overhead, and E2B compatibility hit the sweet spot—boosted by Tencent Cloud backing and CNCF Landscape listing.
uses: AI agent developers: provide isolated execution for code interpreters and automated tasks
Platform and infra teams: need high-concurrency, high-density sandbox scheduling
Teams already on E2B: want to migrate to a self-hosted, hardware-isolated solution
Security-sensitive workloads: run untrusted code with hardware-level isolation and low overhead

zh.tag: Kubernetes 上标准化分布式生成式与预测式 AI 推理平台
zh.what: KServe 是一个运行在 Kubernetes 上的标准化分布式 AI 推理平台，同时统一支持生成式 AI（LLM）与预测式 AI（传统机器学习模型）的部署。它提供 OpenAI 兼容的推理协议、多框架支持以及自动扩缩容能力，让从快速试用到企业级大规模推理都能用同一套平台完成。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 语言实现，包含控制器、CRD、推理运行时与 Webhook 等核心组件，并配有 docs 图表与示例；同时集成 vLLM、llm-d、Hugging Face 等生成式后端，以及 TensorFlow、PyTorch、scikit-learn、XGBoost、ONNX 等预测式框架。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 Go 为主，基于 Kubernetes 的 CRD/Controller 模式构建，依赖 Knative、Istio 等云原生组件，并支持 GPU 加速、模型缓存与 KV Cache 卸载。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 孵化项目，KServe 已被众多组织采用，今日以 5926 星、日增 21 星登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 16 名，反映出云原生 AI 推理基础设施的持续热度。
uses: 需要在 Kubernetes 上统一部署生成式与预测式 AI 模型的平台工程师
希望用 OpenAI 兼容协议快速接入 LLM 推理服务的应用开发者
追求自动扩缩容、多框架支持与模型可解释性的企业 MLOps 团队

en.tag: Standardized distributed generative and predictive AI inference platform on Kubernetes
en.what: KServe is a standardized distributed AI inference platform on Kubernetes that unifies both generative AI (LLMs) and predictive AI (traditional ML models) deployment. It offers an OpenAI-compatible inference protocol, multi-framework support, and autoscaling, so everything from quick experiments to enterprise-scale inference runs on one platform.
en.content: The repo is implemented in Go and contains controllers, CRDs, inference runtimes, and webhooks, along with docs diagrams and examples. It integrates generative backends like vLLM, llm-d, and Hugging Face, plus predictive frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost, and ONNX.
en.stack: Built primarily in Go using Kubernetes CRD/Controller patterns, it depends on cloud-native components like Knative and Istio, and supports GPU acceleration, model caching, and KV cache offloading.
en.hot: As a CNCF incubating project adopted by many organizations, KServe hit GitHub Trending's Go daily list at #16 with 5,926 stars and 21 new stars today, reflecting sustained interest in cloud-native AI inference infrastructure.
uses: Platform engineers who need to unify generative and predictive AI model deployment on Kubernetes
Application developers who want to quickly integrate LLM inference via an OpenAI-compatible protocol
Enterprise MLOps teams seeking autoscaling, multi-framework support, and model explainability

zh.tag: 自托管音乐流媒体服务器，打造个人版 Spotify
zh.what: Navidrome 是一个开源、基于 Web 的音乐收藏服务器与流媒体播放器，让你从任意浏览器或移动设备收听自己的音乐库。它兼容 Subsonic/Airsonic API，可搭配大量现成客户端使用，无需为音乐订阅付费。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web UI 前端、数据库迁移脚本、Docker 与多平台构建配置，以及文档和主题/翻译相关资源。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，前端使用 React/TypeScript，支持 SQLite、PostgreSQL、MySQL 等数据库，常通过 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 23,497 颗星和活跃的社区，Navidrome 已成为自托管音乐流媒体的事实标准，今日再登 Go 日榜第 13 名，持续吸引想摆脱订阅制的用户。
uses: 想搭建私人音乐流媒体服务的自托管爱好者
拥有大量本地音乐收藏、希望随时随地收听的用户
希望用 Subsonic 兼容客户端接入自有音乐库的开发者
想摆脱音乐订阅费用、追求数据自主的普通听众

en.tag: Self-hosted music streaming server — your personal Spotify
en.what: Navidrome is an open-source, web-based music collection server and streamer that lets you listen to your own library from any browser or mobile device. It implements the Subsonic/Airsonic API, so it works with a wide range of existing clients without paying for music subscriptions.
en.content: The repo contains a Go backend service, a web UI frontend, database migration scripts, Docker and multi-platform build configs, plus docs and resources for themes and translations.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go with a React/TypeScript frontend, it supports SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL, and is commonly deployed via Docker.
en.hot: With 23,497 stars and an active community, Navidrome has become the de facto standard for self-hosted music streaming, trending again at #13 on the Go daily chart as users look to escape subscriptions.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts who want a private music streaming service
Users with large local music collections who want to listen anywhere
Developers who want to plug their own library into Subsonic-compatible clients
Listeners seeking to escape subscription fees and keep control of their data

zh.tag: Kubernetes 声明式 GitOps 持续交付工具
zh.what: Argo CD 是面向 Kubernetes 的声明式 GitOps 持续交付工具，以 Git 仓库中的清单作为期望状态，持续对比并自动同步集群实际状态。它让应用定义、配置与环境全部版本化、可审计，实现自动化部署与生命周期管理。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Argo CD 的核心控制器、API 服务、CLI、Web UI 以及 Helm Chart、文档和示例清单，并配有集成测试与安全评分徽章。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，基于 Kubernetes 控制器模式与 CRD，依赖 Helm、Kustomize、Jsonnet 等清单工具，并提供容器镜像与 Helm Chart 分发。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，Argo CD 是 GitOps 事实标准之一，24k+ star 且本周仍新增 65，稳居 Go 周榜第 6，社区与企业采用度持续走高。
uses: 平台与 DevOps 工程师，用 GitOps 管理多集群 Kubernetes 部署
需要审计与回滚能力的团队，将应用配置全部版本化
希望统一 Helm/Kustomize 发布流程的云原生组织
学习 GitOps 与声明式持续交付的开发者与运维人员

en.tag: Declarative GitOps continuous delivery for Kubernetes
en.what: Argo CD is a declarative GitOps continuous delivery tool for Kubernetes that treats Git manifests as the desired state and continuously reconciles it with the live cluster. It makes application definitions, configurations, and environments version-controlled, auditable, and automated.
en.content: The repo contains Argo CD's core controllers, API server, CLI, web UI, Helm charts, docs, and example manifests, along with integration tests and security scorecards.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, it uses Kubernetes controller patterns and CRDs, integrates Helm, Kustomize, and Jsonnet, and ships as container images and Helm charts.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, Argo CD is a de facto GitOps standard with 24k+ stars and 65 added this week, ranking 6th on the Go weekly trending list amid strong community and enterprise adoption.
uses: Platform and DevOps engineers managing multi-cluster Kubernetes deployments with GitOps
Teams needing auditability and rollback by version-controlling all app configs
Cloud-native orgs wanting a unified Helm/Kustomize release workflow
Developers and operators learning GitOps and declarative continuous delivery

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理提供持久记忆的 Go 单文件方案
zh.what: Engram 是一个面向 AI 编码代理的持久记忆系统，让代理在会话结束后仍能记住项目上下文与历史决策。它通过 SQLite + FTS5 存储与检索记忆，并以 MCP 服务器、HTTP API、CLI 和 TUI 多种形态对外提供能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 实现的单一二进制程序，以及 docs 目录下的安装、架构、代理接入、插件、团队使用等文档，另有品牌素材与 Engram Cloud 相关说明。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，存储层使用 SQLite 配合 FTS5 全文检索，对外提供 MCP server、HTTP API、CLI 与 TUI，并强调零依赖、单二进制部署。
zh.hot: 它切中了 AI 编码代理「会话即失忆」的痛点，加上代理无关、单二进制零依赖的轻量设计，本周新增约 195 star，累计 6508 star，登上 GitHub Go 周榜第 18 名。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编码代理、希望跨会话保留上下文的开发者
需要在本地或云端为团队统一管理代理记忆的工程团队
想通过 MCP/HTTP API 把记忆能力接入自研代理工具的开发者

en.tag: Persistent memory for AI coding agents in a single Go binary
en.what: Engram is a persistent memory system for AI coding agents, letting them retain project context and past decisions across sessions. It stores and retrieves memories with SQLite + FTS5 and exposes them through an MCP server, HTTP API, CLI, and TUI.
en.content: The repo ships a single Go binary plus a docs folder covering installation, architecture, agent setup, plugins, and team usage, along with branding assets and Engram Cloud docs.
en.stack: Written in Go with SQLite + FTS5 for storage and full-text search, exposing an MCP server, HTTP API, CLI, and TUI, with an emphasis on zero dependencies and single-binary deployment.
en.hot: It targets the 'amnesia between sessions' pain of AI coding agents, and its agent-agnostic, single-binary, zero-dependency design helped it gain ~195 stars this week to reach 6,508, ranking 18th on GitHub's weekly Go trending list.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor who want context to survive across sessions
Engineering teams needing local or cloud-shared memory management for their agents
Developers integrating memory into custom agent tooling via MCP or HTTP API

zh.tag: Kubernetes 上的有状态单例沙箱编排器，为 AI 代理运行时与强化学习提供隔离环境
zh.what: agent-sandbox 是 Kubernetes SIG Apps 下的项目，提供 Sandbox CRD 与控制器，用于声明式管理隔离、有状态、单例的工作负载。它把底层容器隔离交给 gVisor、Kata Containers 等安全运行时，自身专注于沙箱编排，适合 AI 代理运行时和强化学习等场景。
zh.content: 仓库核心是 Sandbox CRD 与控制器，另有 extensions 模块提供 SandboxTemplate、SandboxClaim、SandboxWarmPool 等扩展 CRD，并附有 examples、docs 站点与 roadmap。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 编写，基于 Kubernetes controller 模式与 CRD/Operator 机制，依赖 RuntimeClass 对接 gVisor、Kata Containers 等安全沙箱运行时。
zh.hot: AI 代理与强化学习需要大量隔离、有状态且可快速分配的运行环境，而 Kubernetes 原生 Deployment/StatefulSet 并不贴合这一模型；项目本周新增 114 star、总计 3893 star，登上 Go 周榜第 7。
uses: AI 代理平台团队：为每个代理会话提供隔离、有状态且可持久化的运行沙箱
强化学习工程团队：批量创建和回收训练/推理环境，缩短环境准备时间
Kubernetes 平台工程师：需要单容器 VM 式体验而非无状态副本或编号 StatefulSet 的场景
安全敏感场景：借助 gVisor/Kata 等运行时隔离不可信代码或第三方代理插件

en.tag: A Kubernetes sandbox orchestrator for isolated, stateful singleton workloads like AI agent runtimes and RL
en.what: agent-sandbox is a Kubernetes SIG Apps project that provides a Sandbox CRD and controller for declaratively managing isolated, stateful, singleton workloads. It delegates low-level container isolation to secure runtimes like gVisor or Kata Containers, focusing on sandbox orchestration for AI agent runtimes and reinforcement learning.
en.content: At its core are the Sandbox CRD and controller, plus an extensions module with SandboxTemplate, SandboxClaim, and SandboxWarmPool CRDs, along with examples, a docs site, and a roadmap.
en.stack: Written in Go, it follows the Kubernetes controller pattern with CRDs/operators, and relies on RuntimeClass to integrate secure sandbox runtimes such as gVisor and Kata Containers.
en.hot: AI agents and RL need many isolated, stateful, quickly allocatable runtimes, which native Deployments/StatefulSets don't fit well; the project gained 114 stars this week for 3,893 total, ranking 7th on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: AI agent platform teams: give each agent session an isolated, stateful, persistent runtime sandbox
RL engineering teams: batch-create and recycle training/inference environments to cut setup time
Kubernetes platform engineers: scenarios needing a single-container VM-like experience instead of stateless replicas or numbered StatefulSets
Security-sensitive workloads: isolate untrusted code or third-party agent plugins via gVisor/Kata runtimes

zh.tag: 一键本地运行开源大模型的跨平台工具
zh.what: Ollama 是一个让用户轻松在本地运行和管理开源大模型的工具，支持 Kimi、GLM、DeepSeek、Qwen、Gemma 等众多模型。它提供命令行界面、REST API 和多种编程语言库，方便集成到现有应用或作为 AI 助手使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Ollama 的完整源代码，包括安装脚本、命令行工具、REST API 服务器、模型管理功能，以及 Python 和 JavaScript 客户端库的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 llama.cpp 等推理后端，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 和 Docker。
zh.hot: Ollama 已获得 18 万星标，本月新增近 3000，因其让本地运行大模型变得极其简单，成为开发者和 AI 爱好者的首选工具。
uses: 开发者希望在本地快速测试或运行开源模型，无需复杂配置
需要将大模型集成到自己的应用或代理中的团队
关注隐私，希望数据不出本机的个人用户

en.tag: Run open-source LLMs locally with one command
en.what: Ollama is a tool that lets users easily run and manage open-source LLMs locally, supporting models like Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, Gemma, and more. It provides a CLI, REST API, and libraries for multiple languages, making it easy to integrate into existing apps or use as an AI assistant.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Ollama, including installation scripts, CLI tools, REST API server, model management features, and documentation/examples for Python and JavaScript client libraries.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging inference backends like llama.cpp, supporting macOS, Windows, Linux, and Docker.
en.hot: With 180k stars and nearly 3k added this month, Ollama is the go-to tool for developers and AI enthusiasts due to its simplicity in running LLMs locally.
uses: Developers who want to quickly test or run open-source models locally without complex setup
Teams needing to integrate LLMs into their applications or agents
Privacy-conscious users who prefer to keep data on their own machines

zh.tag: 开源可自托管的轻量 Markdown 速记工具
zh.what: Memos 是一个开源、可自托管的短笔记工具，主打快速捕捉想法。用 Markdown 记录日常笔记、链接、工作日志和片段，按时间线组织，数据完全由自己掌控。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 后端服务、Web 前端界面、Docker 部署配置，以及浏览器 Web Clipper 扩展，整体是一个可直接自托管运行的完整应用。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 编写，前端为 Web 应用，支持 Docker 一键部署，数据存储于本地卷，采用 MIT 许可证。
zh.hot: 凭借 63k+ stars 和极简自托管理念长期受欢迎，本周新增 279 星并登上 Go 周榜第 18 名，反映出用户对数据自主和轻量笔记工具的持续需求。
uses: 希望数据完全自托管、注重隐私的个人用户
需要快速记录碎片想法和日志的知识工作者
想搭建轻量笔记服务的开发者和自托管爱好者

en.tag: Open-source, self-hosted lightweight Markdown note-taking tool
en.what: Memos is an open-source, self-hosted tool for short-form notes, built for quick capture. It stores daily notes, links, work logs, and snippets as Markdown in a chronological timeline that you fully control.
en.content: The repo contains a Go backend, a web frontend, Docker deployment configs, and a browser Web Clipper extension, forming a complete self-hostable application.
en.stack: Backend written in Go, with a web frontend, one-command Docker deployment, local volume storage, and MIT license.
en.hot: With 63k+ stars and a minimalist self-hosted philosophy, it stays popular; this week it gained 279 stars and ranked 18th on the Go trending list, reflecting ongoing demand for data ownership and lightweight note tools.
uses: Individuals who want fully self-hosted, privacy-focused note-taking
Knowledge workers needing to quickly capture fragmented thoughts and logs
Developers and self-hosting enthusiasts wanting a lightweight notes service

zh.tag: 免费开源的跨平台 2D/3D 游戏引擎
zh.what: Godot 是一个功能丰富、跨平台的游戏引擎，让开发者通过统一界面制作 2D 和 3D 游戏。它内置大量常用工具，并支持一键导出到桌面、移动端、Web 及主机平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含引擎完整 C++ 源码、编辑器、模块与平台导出模板，以及构建脚本、文档和官方演示项目。
zh.stack: 核心用 C++ 编写，采用 MIT 许可，依赖 SCons 构建系统，并集成 Vulkan/OpenGL 渲染后端与 GDScript 脚本语言。
zh.hot: 作为最受欢迎的开源游戏引擎之一，Godot 已积累超过 11.7 万 star，今日再增 43 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 7，社区热度持续高涨。
uses: 独立游戏开发者寻找免费、无版税的 2D/3D 引擎
教育机构用于游戏开发与编程教学
希望从 Unity/Unreal 迁移到开源方案的团队
想参与开源引擎贡献的 C++ 开发者

en.tag: Free and open-source cross-platform 2D and 3D game engine
en.what: Godot is a feature-packed, cross-platform game engine for creating 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. It ships with a comprehensive set of common tools and supports one-click export to desktop, mobile, web, and console platforms.
en.content: The repo contains the full C++ source of the engine, the editor, modules and platform export templates, plus build scripts, documentation, and official demo projects.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++ under the MIT license, it uses the SCons build system and integrates Vulkan/OpenGL rendering backends with the GDScript language.
en.hot: As one of the most popular open-source game engines, Godot has over 117k stars, gaining 43 more today and ranking 7th on the C++ trending list, showing sustained community momentum.
uses: Indie game developers seeking a free, royalty-free 2D/3D engine
Educational institutions teaching game development and programming
Teams looking to migrate from Unity/Unreal to an open-source solution
C++ developers wanting to contribute to an open-source engine

zh.tag: 谷歌开源的端到端机器学习框架，人人可用
zh.what: TensorFlow 是谷歌大脑团队开源的端到端机器学习平台，覆盖从研究到生产部署的完整流程。它提供稳定的 Python 与 C++ API，并配套工具、库与社区资源，帮助研究者推进前沿、开发者快速构建 ML 应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架源码（C++ 内核与 Python 前端）、Keras 高层 API、编译构建脚本、安装指南与 API 文档入口，以及大量测试与安全/模糊测试配置。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 实现核心计算内核，主推 Python 接口，支持 GPU 加速、Docker 容器与源码编译，依赖 Bazel 构建系统及大量第三方库。
zh.hot: 作为深度学习领域最老牌、生态最完整的框架之一，TensorFlow 累积了超过 20 万 star，今日再登 C++ 日榜第 8，长期热度依旧稳固。
uses: 机器学习研究者与工程师，用于训练和部署神经网络模型
企业团队构建生产级 AI 应用，如推荐、视觉与 NLP 服务
学生与初学者，通过官方教程和 Keras 快速入门深度学习
需要在 C++/移动端/边缘设备上运行推理的开发者

en.tag: Google's end-to-end open source machine learning framework for everyone
en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open source machine learning platform originally built by Google Brain, covering the full path from research to production deployment. It offers stable Python and C++ APIs plus a broad ecosystem of tools, libraries and community resources for building and shipping ML-powered applications.
en.content: The repo contains the core framework source (C++ kernels and Python frontend), the Keras high-level API, build scripts, install guides and API docs entry points, plus extensive tests and security/fuzzing configurations.
en.stack: Core computation kernels are written in C++ with a primary Python interface; it supports GPU acceleration, Docker containers and source builds, relying on the Bazel build system and many third-party libraries.
en.hot: As one of the oldest and most complete deep learning ecosystems, TensorFlow has accumulated over 200,000 stars and still charts 8th on the daily C++ trending list, showing enduring popularity.
uses: ML researchers and engineers training and deploying neural network models
Enterprise teams building production AI services such as recommendation, vision and NLP
Students and beginners learning deep learning via official tutorials and Keras
Developers who need to run inference in C++, mobile or edge environments

zh.tag: 开源专业金融终端，集行情分析、投研与经济数据于一体
zh.what: FinceptTerminal 是一款现代金融桌面应用，提供高级市场分析、投资研究和经济数据工具。它面向交互式探索与数据驱动决策，让用户在一个友好界面里完成行情查看、研究与分析。
zh.content: 仓库以 C++20 + Qt6 构建的桌面终端为主体，并配套 Python 3.11+ 的数据与分析脚本，采用 AGPL-3.0 开源许可。README 同时推广其闭源 Enterprise 版与 Quantcept AI 研究服务。
zh.stack: 核心使用 C++20 与 Qt6 构建跨平台 GUI，辅以 Python 3.11+ 处理数据与分析任务，依赖现代 C++ 工具链与 Qt 生态。
zh.hot: 作为少见的开源专业金融终端，它以 31735 星、本周新增 475 星冲上 GitHub Trending C++ 周榜第 3 名。免费开源加企业版商业化的组合，也持续吸引金融与技术圈关注。
uses: 个人投资者与量化爱好者，用于查看行情、做投研与数据分析
金融科技开发者，想基于开源终端二次开发或集成自有数据源
研究机构与高校师生，用于经济数据探索与教学演示
关注开源金融工具选型的团队，评估其架构与商业化路径

en.tag: Open-source professional finance terminal for market analytics, research and economic data
en.what: FinceptTerminal is a modern finance desktop application offering advanced market analytics, investment research and economic data tools. It targets interactive exploration and data-driven decision-making inside a user-friendly environment.
en.content: The repo centers on a C++20 + Qt6 desktop terminal, paired with Python 3.11+ scripts for data and analytics, released under AGPL-3.0. Its README also promotes a proprietary Enterprise edition and the Quantcept AI research service.
en.stack: Built on C++20 and Qt6 for the cross-platform GUI, with Python 3.11+ handling data and analytics, relying on a modern C++ toolchain and the Qt ecosystem.
en.hot: As a rare open-source professional finance terminal, it hit No.3 on GitHub Trending's weekly C++ chart with 31,735 stars and 475 added this week. The mix of a free open-source core and a commercial enterprise edition keeps drawing finance and tech attention.
uses: Individual investors and quant enthusiasts exploring markets and research
Fintech developers wanting to fork or integrate their own data sources
Researchers and students doing economic data exploration and teaching demos
Teams evaluating open-source finance tooling and its architecture or business model

zh.tag: 基于 Citra 的开源 3DS 模拟器，支持 PC 与移动端。
zh.what: Azahar 是一款免费开源的任天堂 3DS 模拟器，旨在让 3DS 玩家在 PC 和移动设备上以更高分辨率、现代控制器支持和即时存档等功能重温游戏库。它也是自制软件开发者的调试中心，以及 3DS 生态的研究与保存平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源代码，主要用 C++ 编写，并提供了 Windows、macOS 和 Android 的构建版本。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 C++ 为核心，依赖 CMake 构建系统，并使用了 Qt 等图形界面库。

uses: 3DS 游戏玩家 —— 在 PC 或手机上以更高画质和便捷功能游玩 3DS 游戏。
