游戏保存研究者 —— 用于 3DS 生态的研究与保存。

en.tag: An open-source 3DS emulator based on Citra, supporting PC and mobile.
en.what: Azahar is a free and open-source Nintendo 3DS emulator that lets 3DS owners enjoy their game library on PC and mobile with enhancements like higher resolutions, modern controller support, and save states. It also serves as a debugging hub for homebrew developers and a research and preservation platform for the 3DS ecosystem.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, primarily written in C++, with builds available for Windows, macOS, and Android.
en.stack: The tech stack is centered on C++, with CMake as the build system and libraries like Qt for the graphical interface.
en.hot: As a continuation of Citra, Azahar inherits its mature technology and is actively developed, earning 8,102 stars with 12 new stars today, ranking 4th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: 3DS game players — enjoy 3DS games on PC or mobile with enhanced graphics and convenient features.
Homebrew developers — use the emulator for debugging and testing.
Game preservation researchers — for research and preservation of the 3DS ecosystem.

zh.tag: 用 ESP32-CAM 把老式水电气表数字化的边缘 AI 方案
zh.what: 这是一个基于 ESP32-CAM 的边缘计算项目，用摄像头拍摄传统机械式水表、电表、燃气表的读数，再通过本地运行的神经网络识别数字，把模拟表盘变成可联网的智能设备。整个过程在设备端完成，无需上云，成本低、易部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 固件源码（code/）、TensorFlow Lite 模型与训练工具、Web 配置界面、外壳 3D 打印文件、MkDocs 文档以及烧录工具和发布包。
zh.stack: 主语言为 C++，运行在 ESP32 上，集成 TensorFlow Lite Micro 做本地推理，配 Web 前端界面和 SD 卡存储，依赖 ESP-IDF 工具链。
zh.hot: 8731 颗星且今日新增 45，登上 C++ 日榜第一；它把边缘 AI 落到极其实用的抄表场景，硬件便宜、教程完整，吸引了大量 DIY 和物联网爱好者。
uses: 想把家里老式水表/电表/燃气表接入智能家居的 DIY 玩家
做物联网、边缘计算教学或课程项目的师生
需要低成本远程抄表方案的物业或小型公用事业运营者
对 ESP32 与 TensorFlow Lite 嵌入式 AI 感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: Edge AI on ESP32-CAM to digitize old water, gas and power meters
en.what: This is an edge-computing project built on the ESP32-CAM that photographs traditional mechanical water, power and gas meters and uses an on-device neural network to read the digits, turning analog meters into connected smart devices. Everything runs locally without the cloud, keeping it cheap and easy to deploy.
en.content: The repo ships C++ firmware source (code/), TensorFlow Lite models and training tools, a web configuration interface, 3D-printable casing files, MkDocs documentation, plus flashing tools and release packages.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++ and running on the ESP32, it integrates TensorFlow Lite Micro for on-device inference, with a web frontend and SD-card storage, built on the ESP-IDF toolchain.
en.hot: With 8,731 stars and 45 added today, it tops the C++ daily trending list; it applies edge AI to the very practical task of meter reading, with cheap hardware and thorough docs that appeal to DIY and IoT enthusiasts.
uses: DIY hobbyists wanting to connect old water, power or gas meters to their smart home
Teachers and students doing IoT or edge-computing coursework
Property managers or small utilities needing low-cost remote meter reading
Developers curious about ESP32 and TensorFlow Lite embedded AI

zh.tag: 基于 ggml 的纯 C++ 音频推理引擎，无需 Python
zh.what: audio.cpp 是一个高性能的纯 C++ 音频推理框架，基于 ggml 构建，旨在让本地音频模型变得实用、便携且快速。它支持 TTS、STT、VAD、语音转换、音乐生成等多种任务，并可在 Windows、Linux、macOS 上运行，支持 NVIDIA、AMD、Apple Silicon 和纯 CPU。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 推理引擎源码、GGUF 模型加载与优化、Arena 对比 UI、文档和性能报告，以及 Hugging Face 和 ModelScope 上的 GGUF 模型包。
zh.stack: 基于 ggml 张量库，使用纯 C++ 编写，支持 CUDA、Metal、CPU 等多种后端，通过 GGUF 格式加载量化模型，无 Python 依赖。
zh.hot: 今日新增 89 星，总星数达 2590，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 类别第一。其纯 C++ 无 Python 依赖、高性能（CUDA 下 TTS 比 Python 快 1.8-8 倍）和广泛模型支持吸引了大量关注。
uses: 需要在本地部署音频模型（TTS/STT/语音转换）的 C++ 开发者
希望摆脱 Python 环境依赖、追求高性能推理的工程师
在边缘设备或 CPU 上运行音频 AI 的研究人员
需要对比不同音频模型效果的 AI 应用开发者

en.tag: A pure C++ audio inference engine built on ggml, no Python required
en.what: audio.cpp is a high-performance pure C++ audio inference framework built on top of ggml, designed to make local audio models practical, portable, and fast. It supports TTS, STT, VAD, voice conversion, music generation, and more, running on Windows, Linux, macOS with NVIDIA, AMD, Apple Silicon, and CPU-only support.
en.content: The repo contains the full C++ inference engine source, GGUF model loading and optimization, an Arena comparison UI, documentation and performance reports, plus GGUF model packages on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
en.stack: Built on the ggml tensor library in pure C++, with support for CUDA, Metal, CPU and other backends, loading quantized models via GGUF format, with no Python dependency.
en.hot: It gained 89 stars today, reaching 2,590 total, and topped GitHub Trending daily for C++. Its pure C++ no-Python approach, high performance (1.8-8x faster TTS on CUDA vs Python), and broad model support attract significant attention.
uses: C++ developers deploying local audio models (TTS/STT/voice conversion)
Engineers seeking high-performance inference without Python dependencies
Researchers running audio AI on edge devices or CPU-only machines
AI app developers comparing different audio model outputs

zh.tag: 自托管游戏串流服务端，配合 Moonlight 使用
zh.what: Sunshine 是一个自托管的游戏串流服务端，兼容 Moonlight 客户端。它允许用户将 PC 上的游戏和应用串流到其他设备，支持低延迟和高画质。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建脚本、文档和图标资源。提供多种安装方式，如 Docker、Flatpak、Windows 安装包等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 FFmpeg、CUDA 等编解码库。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 4 万星标，本月新增 1103 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 22 名。其受欢迎程度源于对 NVIDIA GameStream 的替代需求，以及开源社区对自托管串流方案的青睐。
uses: 游戏玩家：将 PC 游戏串流到局域网内的其他设备，如笔记本、手机或电视。
远程办公或学习：远程访问高性能 PC 上的应用，实现移动办公。
开源爱好者：自建串流服务，摆脱对商业服务的依赖，保障隐私和自由度。

en.tag: Self-hosted game streaming host for Moonlight
en.what: Sunshine is a self-hosted game stream host that works with Moonlight clients. It enables users to stream games and applications from their PC to other devices with low latency and high quality.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, build scripts, documentation, and icon assets. Multiple installation methods are available, including Docker, Flatpak, Windows installers, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, relying on FFmpeg, CUDA, and other codec libraries. Supports Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms.
en.hot: With over 40,000 stars and 1,103 new stars this month, ranking 22nd on the C++ monthly trending list, its popularity stems from the need for a replacement for NVIDIA GameStream and the community's preference for self-hosted streaming solutions.
uses: Gamers: stream PC games to other devices on the local network, such as laptops, phones, or TVs.
Remote work or study: remotely access applications on a high-performance PC for mobile productivity.
Open-source enthusiasts: self-host streaming services to avoid commercial dependencies, ensuring privacy and freedom.

zh.tag: 纯C/C++的高性能LLM推理引擎
zh.what: llama.cpp 是一个用纯 C/C++ 编写的高性能大语言模型推理引擎，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。它针对本地部署和资源受限环境进行了优化，无需依赖庞大的深度学习框架。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理库 libllama、命令行工具、REST API 服务器（llama-server）以及 WebUI。支持多种量化格式（如 GGUF）和模型架构（如 LLaMA、GPT-OSS）。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 实现，依赖 ggml 张量库，可选支持 CUDA、Vulkan、Metal 等 GPU 加速后端。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的本地 LLM 推理方案之一，llama.cpp 持续获得社区关注，今日新增 159 星，总星数突破 12 万。其高性能、跨平台和易用性使其成为 AI 开发者和爱好者的首选。
uses: AI 开发者：在本地或边缘设备上运行和测试大语言模型
隐私敏感用户：无需联网即可使用 LLM，数据完全本地化
研究人员：探索模型量化、推理优化和自定义模型架构

en.tag: High-performance LLM inference engine in pure C/C++
en.what: llama.cpp is a high-performance LLM inference engine written in pure C/C++, optimized for CPU and GPU execution. It enables efficient local deployment without heavy deep learning frameworks.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference library libllama, CLI tools, a REST API server (llama-server), and a WebUI. It supports various quantization formats (e.g., GGUF) and model architectures (e.g., LLaMA, GPT-OSS).
en.stack: Pure C/C++ implementation, relies on the ggml tensor library, with optional GPU backends like CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal.
en.hot: As one of the most popular local LLM inference solutions, llama.cpp continues to gain community traction with 159 new stars today, surpassing 120K total. Its performance, cross-platform support, and ease of use make it a top choice for AI developers and enthusiasts.
uses: AI developers: run and test LLMs locally or on edge devices
Privacy-conscious users: use LLMs offline with full data locality
Researchers: explore quantization, inference optimization, and custom model architectures

zh.tag: OpenAI Whisper 语音识别模型的纯 C/C++ 高性能推理实现
zh.what: whisper.cpp 是 OpenAI Whisper 自动语音识别模型的 C/C++ 移植版，无需依赖即可运行。它面向多平台提供高性能、可离线、端侧部署的语音转文字能力。
zh.content: 核心实现集中在 include/whisper.h 与 src/whisper.cpp，其余依赖 ggml 机器学习库；仓库还包含 iOS、Android、WASM、Java 等多平台示例与绑定。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 编写，基于 ggml 张量库，支持 ARM NEON、Metal、Core ML、AVX、Vulkan、CUDA、ROCm、OpenVINO 等硬件加速与整数量化。
zh.hot: 凭借 53668 颗星与本周 192 新增，它稳居 C++ 周榜第 13 名，是端侧语音识别最受信赖的开源方案之一。
uses: 需要在手机、树莓派等边缘设备上离线运行语音识别的开发者
希望把语音转文字集成进桌面或移动应用的工程师
研究 ASR 模型量化与跨平台推理优化的技术团队
对隐私敏感、要求数据不出本地的语音处理场景

en.tag: High-performance C/C++ inference of OpenAI's Whisper ASR model
en.what: whisper.cpp is a dependency-free C/C++ port of OpenAI's Whisper automatic speech recognition model. It delivers high-performance, offline, on-device speech-to-text across many platforms.
en.content: The core lives in include/whisper.h and src/whisper.cpp, with the rest built on the ggml ML library; the repo also ships examples and bindings for iOS, Android, WASM, Java and more.
en.stack: Written in plain C/C++ on top of the ggml tensor library, with ARM NEON, Metal, Core ML, AVX, Vulkan, CUDA, ROCm and OpenVINO acceleration plus integer quantization.
en.hot: With 53,668 stars and 192 added this week, it ranks 13th on the C++ trending list, cementing its status as a go-to open-source solution for on-device speech recognition.
uses: Developers needing offline speech recognition on phones, Raspberry Pi and other edge devices
Engineers integrating speech-to-text into desktop or mobile apps
Teams researching ASR quantization and cross-platform inference optimization
Privacy-sensitive scenarios where audio must stay on-device

zh.tag: Tenstorrent AI 加速器的开源算子库与底层内核编程模型
zh.what: TT-Metalium 是面向 Tenstorrent 硬件的底层内核编程模型，TT-NN 则是构建其上的 Python/C++ 神经网络算子库。它为 Tenstorrent 的 AI 加速卡提供从底层内核到高层算子的完整软件栈。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TT-NN 算子库、TT-Metalium 内核编程接口、模型示例（如 Llama 3.3 70B、Qwen 2.5 7B 等）以及安装文档和性能基准。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Python，依赖 CMake 构建系统，支持 Tenstorrent 的 Wormhole 和 Blackhole 等硬件。
zh.hot: 作为 Tenstorrent 开源软件栈的核心，随着 AI 硬件竞争加剧和开源生态发展，本周获得 13 颗新星，登上 C++ 周榜第 10 名。
uses: AI 硬件开发者：为 Tenstorrent 加速卡编写和优化底层内核
机器学习工程师：在 Tenstorrent 硬件上部署和优化神经网络模型
研究人员：探索新型 AI 加速器编程模型和算子实现

en.tag: Open-source operator library and low-level kernel programming model for Tenstorrent AI accelerators
en.what: TT-Metalium is a low-level kernel programming model for Tenstorrent hardware, while TT-NN is a Python/C++ neural network operator library built on top of it. It provides a full software stack from low-level kernels to high-level operators for Tenstorrent AI accelerators.
en.content: The repository contains the TT-NN operator library, TT-Metalium kernel programming interfaces, model demos (e.g., Llama 3.3 70B, Qwen 2.5 7B), installation docs, and performance benchmarks.
en.stack: Primarily C++ and Python, with CMake build system, supporting Tenstorrent Wormhole and Blackhole hardware.
en.hot: As the core of Tenstorrent's open-source software stack, it gained 13 new stars this week amid growing AI hardware competition and open-source ecosystem development, ranking 10th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: AI hardware developers: write and optimize low-level kernels for Tenstorrent accelerators
Machine learning engineers: deploy and optimize neural network models on Tenstorrent hardware
Researchers: explore novel AI accelerator programming models and operator implementations

zh.tag: 任天堂 Switch 定制固件，实现自定义系统与虚拟 NAND
zh.what: Atmosphère 是一个针对任天堂 Switch 的开源定制固件项目，通过替换和修改系统各个组件（如引导加载器、TrustZone、系统模块等）来实现自定义功能。它允许用户运行自制软件、备份和虚拟化 NAND 等。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个组件：Fusée（第一阶段加载器）、Exosphère（自定义 TrustZone）、Thermosphère（emuNAND 支持）、Stratosphère（自定义系统模块）、Troposphère（应用程序级补丁），以及相关文档和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 libnx、devkitA64 工具链、FatFs、hekate 等开源项目。
zh.hot: 作为 Switch 破解社区的核心项目，Atmosphère 拥有近 2 万星标，今日新增 13 星，位列 C++ 日榜第二，持续受到关注。
uses: Switch 破解玩家：用于运行自制软件和备份游戏
安全研究人员：研究 Switch 系统安全与漏洞
自制软件开发者：基于 Atmosphère 开发自定义模块

en.tag: Custom firmware for Nintendo Switch enabling custom OS and emuNAND
en.what: Atmosphère is an open-source custom firmware for the Nintendo Switch that replaces and modifies various system components (such as bootloader, TrustZone, sysmodules) to enable custom features. It allows users to run homebrew, backup and virtualize NAND, and more.
en.content: The repository contains multiple components: Fusée (first-stage loader), Exosphère (custom TrustZone), Thermosphère (emuNAND support), Stratosphère (custom sysmodules), Troposphère (application-level patches), along with documentation and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on libnx, devkitA64 toolchain, FatFs, hekate, and other open-source projects.
en.hot: As a core project in the Switch hacking community, Atmosphère has nearly 20k stars, with 13 added today, ranking second on the C++ daily trending list, showing sustained interest.
uses: Switch hacking enthusiasts: to run homebrew and backup games
Security researchers: to study Switch system security and vulnerabilities
Homebrew developers: to build custom modules based on Atmosphère

zh.tag: 跨显卡厂商的通用超分与帧生成桥接工具
zh.what: OptiScaler 是一款游戏画质增强工具，允许玩家在已支持 DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS 的游戏中替换超分方案，并管理帧生成功能。它还能通过实验性 OptiFG 在 DX12 游戏中启用帧生成，甚至支持 Nukem 模组将 DLSSG 转为 FSR3 帧生成。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 源代码、编译脚本、安装说明、已知问题列表以及详细的 Wiki 文档，并提供稳定版和 nightly 版下载。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 DirectX 12、Vulkan 等图形 API，并涉及 DLSS、FSR、XeSS 等超分技术。
zh.hot: 凭借跨显卡厂商的通用超分与帧生成能力，解决了玩家在非 Nvidia 显卡上无法使用 DLSS 等痛点，已获得 10726 颗星，今日新增 60 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 分类第 13 名。
uses: PC 游戏玩家：希望在非 Nvidia 显卡上使用 DLSS 或启用帧生成功能。
游戏模组爱好者：想要自定义游戏画质设置，替换超分方案。
技术研究者：对超分和帧生成技术跨平台实现感兴趣。
低配置玩家：通过帧生成提升游戏流畅度。

en.tag: Universal upscaling and frame generation bridge across GPU vendors
en.what: OptiScaler is a tool that lets you replace upscalers in games already supporting DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS, and manage frame generation. It can enable frame generation in DX12 games via experimental OptiFG, and supports the Nukem mod to convert DLSSG to FSR3 frame generation.
en.content: The repo contains C++ source code, build scripts, installation instructions, a known issues list, and detailed Wiki documentation, with stable and nightly releases available.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it depends on graphics APIs like DirectX 12 and Vulkan, and integrates upscaling technologies such as DLSS, FSR, and XeSS.
en.hot: With its cross-vendor upscaling and frame generation capabilities, it solves the pain point of using DLSS on non-Nvidia GPUs, earning 10,726 stars with 60 added today, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending daily list for C++.
uses: PC gamers: want to use DLSS or enable frame generation on non-Nvidia GPUs.
Game modding enthusiasts: want to customize graphics settings and replace upscalers.
Tech researchers: interested in cross-platform implementations of upscaling and frame generation.
Low-spec players: improve game smoothness through frame generation.

zh.tag: 把ESP32变成多协议硬件黑客工具，网页CLI全协议通吃
zh.what: ESP32 Bit Pirate 是一款开源固件，把 ESP32 设备变成类似经典 Bus Pirate 的多协议开发与分析工具。它支持 I2C、SPI、UART、1-Wire 等有线协议，以及蓝牙、Wi-Fi、Sub-GHz、RFID 等无线协议，可通过串口终端或网页 CLI 进行嗅探、发送、脚本编写和交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含固件源码、硬件指南、Web 工具（在线烧录、Web CLI）、配方示例和 Wiki 文档，并配有演示 GIF 和 Logo 素材。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 ESP32 平台（ESP-IDF/Arduino 框架），依赖 LittleFS 文件系统，并集成蓝牙、Wi-Fi、USB 等协议栈。
zh.hot: 凭借 5864 颗星和本周 107 颗新增，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 C++ 第 15 名，因其将昂贵的专业硬件黑客工具功能浓缩到廉价的 ESP32 上而备受关注。
uses: 硬件安全研究员和渗透测试人员，用于协议分析与漏洞挖掘
嵌入式开发者和电子爱好者，用于快速调试 I2C/SPI/UART 等外设
CTF 选手和硬件黑客，用于 RFID、蓝牙、Wi-Fi 等无线攻防实验
创客和教育工作者，用于教学演示和低成本硬件实验平台

en.tag: Turn your ESP32 into a multi-protocol hardware hacking tool with a web-based CLI
en.what: ESP32 Bit Pirate is open-source firmware that turns an ESP32 device into a multi-protocol development and analysis tool inspired by the legendary Bus Pirate. It supports wired protocols like I2C, SPI, UART, and 1-Wire, plus wireless protocols such as Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Sub-GHz, and RFID, all controllable via a serial terminal or web-based CLI for sniffing, sending, scripting, and interacting.
en.content: The repo contains firmware source code, hardware guides, web tools (web flasher, web CLI), recipes, and wiki documentation, along with demo GIFs and logo assets.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ for the ESP32 platform (ESP-IDF/Arduino framework), it uses the LittleFS file system and integrates Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and USB protocol stacks.
en.hot: With 5,864 stars and 107 added this week, it ranks 15th on GitHub Trending's weekly C++ list, attracting attention for condensing expensive professional hardware hacking tools into a cheap ESP32.
uses: Hardware security researchers and penetration testers for protocol analysis and vulnerability discovery
Embedded developers and electronics hobbyists for quickly debugging I2C/SPI/UART peripherals
CTF players and hardware hackers for wireless attack experiments like RFID, Bluetooth, and Wi-Fi
Makers and educators for teaching demos and low-cost hardware experimentation

zh.tag: 谷歌出品的 C++ 微基准测试支持库
zh.what: google/benchmark 是一个用于对代码片段进行微基准测试的 C++ 库，用法类似单元测试框架。你只需把待测代码放进 benchmark::State 的循环里，用 BENCHMARK 宏注册，就能得到稳定的耗时统计。
zh.content: 仓库包含头文件与源码实现、CMake/Bazel 构建配置、docs 用户指南与工具文档、Python 绑定，以及大量测试与 CI 工作流。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 编写，使用需 C++11、构建需 C++17，依赖 CMake 或 Bazel，并提供 Python 绑定。
zh.hot: 作为谷歌维护的基准测试事实标准，它已积累约 1.04 万 star，本周新增 21 星并登上 C++ 周榜第 16 名，是性能敏感项目的常备依赖。
uses: C++ 库作者：为算法或数据结构编写可复现的性能基准
性能工程师：对比不同实现、编译器或平台的运行耗时
CI 维护者：把基准测试接入流水线，监控性能回归
学习 C++ 性能优化的人：用标准工具量化优化效果

en.tag: Google's microbenchmark support library for C++
en.what: google/benchmark is a C++ library for microbenchmarking code snippets, used much like a unit-testing framework. You wrap the code under test in a benchmark::State loop, register it with the BENCHMARK macro, and get stable timing statistics.
en.content: The repo contains headers and sources, CMake/Bazel build configs, docs including a user guide and tooling docs, Python bindings, plus extensive tests and CI workflows.
en.stack: Written in C++; usable with C++11 and buildable with C++17, depending on CMake or Bazel, with Python bindings available.
en.hot: As Google's de facto standard for benchmarking, it has accumulated about 10.4k stars, gained 21 this week, and ranked 16th on the C++ weekly trending list, making it a staple dependency for performance-sensitive projects.
uses: C++ library authors: write reproducible performance benchmarks for algorithms or data structures
Performance engineers: compare runtimes across implementations, compilers, or platforms
CI maintainers: integrate benchmarks into pipelines to catch performance regressions
Anyone learning C++ optimization: quantify improvements with a standard tool

zh.tag: DHH 打造的精致现代 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Omarchy 是一个由 DHH（Ruby on Rails 创始人）打造的 Linux 发行版，注重美观、现代和明确的观点。它提供了一套完整的桌面环境，包括终端、编辑器、AI 工具等，并配有详尽的用户手册。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 manual/ 目录，内含 51 篇 Markdown 格式的手册章节，涵盖入门、导航、应用、配置等主题。此外还有安装脚本和配置文件，用于构建和定制系统。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Shell 脚本进行系统配置和安装，依赖 Linux 生态中的各种开源工具（如 Neovim、终端模拟器等）。手册使用 Markdown 编写，并托管在 learn.omacom.io。
zh.hot: 凭借 DHH 的知名度和对美观、现代体验的强调，Omarchy 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 6475 星，总星数达 34824，登上趋势榜第三。
uses: 喜欢 DHH 风格、追求开箱即用且美观的 Linux 桌面用户
希望从 Mac/Windows 迁移到 Linux 并希望有完整指南的用户
对 Linux 发行版定制和配置感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: A beautiful, modern & opinionated Linux distro by DHH
en.what: Omarchy is a Linux distribution created by DHH (creator of Ruby on Rails), focusing on beauty, modernity, and strong opinions. It provides a complete desktop environment including terminal, editor, AI tools, and comes with an extensive user manual.
en.content: The repository contains a manual/ directory with 51 Markdown chapters covering topics like getting started, navigation, applications, and configuration. It also includes installation scripts and configuration files for building and customizing the system.
en.stack: Primarily uses Shell scripts for system configuration and installation, relying on various open-source tools from the Linux ecosystem (e.g., Neovim, terminal emulators). The manual is written in Markdown and hosted on learn.omacom.io.
en.hot: Thanks to DHH's fame and the emphasis on beautiful, modern experience, Omarchy quickly gained popularity on GitHub, adding 6,475 stars this week to reach 34,824 total, ranking #3 on the trending list.
uses: Linux desktop users who appreciate DHH's style and want a beautiful, out-of-the-box experience
Users migrating from Mac/Windows to Linux who want a comprehensive guide
Developers interested in customizing and configuring a Linux distribution

zh.tag: Claude 社区插件市场，只读镜像，每日同步
zh.what: 这是 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code 的社区插件市场仓库，包含可安装的插件列表。它由 Anthropic 内部审核流程同步，所有插件都经过安全扫描和批准。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含一个 marketplace.json 文件，列出了所有社区插件及其元数据。此外还有 README 说明如何使用和提交插件。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 Python，但仓库本身是静态 JSON 数据，由自动化流程同步。
zh.hot: 今日新增 190 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜，因为 Claude 插件生态正在快速增长，开发者需要官方认可的插件来源。
uses: Claude Code 用户：通过命令行快速安装社区插件，扩展功能。
插件开发者：提交插件到官方市场，获得分发和曝光。
企业团队：在受控环境中使用经过安全审核的插件。

en.tag: Read-only mirror of Claude community plugin marketplace, synced nightly
en.what: This is the community plugin marketplace for Claude Cowork and Claude Code, containing a list of installable plugins. It is synced from Anthropic's internal review pipeline, and all plugins have passed security scanning and approval.
en.content: The repository mainly contains a marketplace.json file listing all community plugins with their metadata, plus a README explaining how to use and submit plugins.
en.stack: Primary language is Python, but the repo itself is static JSON data synced by automated processes.
en.hot: Gained 190 stars today and hit the trending list, as the Claude plugin ecosystem is rapidly growing and developers need an official source for plugins.
uses: Claude Code users: quickly install community plugins via CLI to extend functionality.
Plugin developers: submit plugins to the official marketplace for distribution and visibility.
Enterprise teams: use security-reviewed plugins in controlled environments.

zh.tag: Cursor 官方插件规范与插件集合
zh.what: 这是 Cursor 官方维护的插件规范与插件仓库，定义了 agent 插件如何以独立目录加 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 清单的形式组织。仓库同时收录了一批面向开发者工具、框架和 SaaS 产品的官方插件，覆盖代码审查、任务编排、学习记忆等场景。
zh.content: 仓库根目录下每个插件是一个独立目录，各自带有 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 清单，README 用表格列出插件名、作者、分类与描述。已收录 teaching、continual-learning、cursor-team-kit、thermos、create-plugin、ralph-loop、orchestrate、pstack、advisor、grok-voice 等十余个插件。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，插件以清单文件加目录结构的形式分发，部分插件依赖 Cursor SDK 与 CLI 能力。整体是围绕 Cursor agent 生态的插件化扩展方案。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4683 star，总 star 达 7254，冲上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 3 名。Cursor 官方亲自下场定义插件规范，加上 agent 工具链正处风口，让开发者迅速涌入关注。
uses: Cursor 深度用户：想用官方插件扩展 agent 的代码审查、编排与学习能力
插件开发者：需要遵循官方规范脚手架并发布自己的 agent 插件
团队工程负责人：关注 CI、代码评审与本地自动化的内部工作流插件
AI 工具链研究者：想了解 agent 插件规范与生态的组织方式

en.tag: Cursor plugin spec and official plugin collection
en.what: This is Cursor's official plugin specification and plugin collection, defining how agent plugins are structured as standalone directories with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest. It also ships a set of official plugins for popular developer tools, frameworks, and SaaS products, covering code review, task orchestration, and learning memory.
en.content: Each plugin lives in its own directory at the repo root with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest, and the README tabulates name, author, category, and description. It already includes a dozen-plus plugins such as teaching, continual-learning, cursor-team-kit, thermos, create-plugin, ralph-loop, orchestrate, pstack, advisor, and grok-voice.
en.stack: The primary language is TypeScript, and plugins are distributed as manifest files plus directory structures, with some relying on the Cursor SDK and CLI capabilities. Overall it is a plugin-based extension scheme around the Cursor agent ecosystem.
en.hot: It gained 4,683 stars this month for a total of 7,254, reaching No. 3 on GitHub Trending's monthly chart. Cursor itself stepping in to define the plugin spec, amid the agent tooling boom, quickly drew developer attention.
uses: Heavy Cursor users: extend agent code review, orchestration, and learning via official plugins
Plugin developers: scaffold and publish their own agent plugins following the official spec
Team engineering leads: interested in internal workflow plugins for CI, code review, and local automation
AI tooling researchers: want to understand how agent plugin specs and ecosystems are organized

zh.tag: 用 Rust 写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品
zh.what: OpenLogi 是一个开源的罗技外设配置工具，通过 HID++ 协议直接与设备通信，支持按键重映射、DPI 调节和 SmartShift 等功能。它无需罗技账号，不收集遥测数据，所有配置以本地 TOML 文件保存，强调隐私和本地优先。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个组件：OpenLogi GUI（GPUI 桌面应用，提供交互式鼠标图示、按键动作选择器、DPI 预设、SmartShift、RGB 键盘灯效、按应用配置文件等）、OpenLogi agent（后台服务，负责输入钩子和设备 I/O）以及相关的文档和配置示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，GUI 基于 GPUI（Zed 编辑器所用的框架），通过 HID++ 协议与罗技设备通信，支持 Logi Bolt、Unifying 接收器、蓝牙直连和 USB 连接。
zh.hot: 作为罗技官方 Options+ 的开源替代品，它解决了用户对官方软件臃肿、遥测和账号要求的痛点，在 Rust 社区和追求隐私的用户中迅速走红，GitHub 星标已超 8600，今日新增 115。
uses: 罗技外设用户：希望摆脱官方 Options+ 的臃肿和遥测，获得本地优先的配置体验
Rust 开发者：对 GPUI 桌面应用开发或 HID++ 协议实现感兴趣的开发者
隐私倡导者：拒绝账号绑定和数据收集，偏好开源软件的用户

en.tag: A native, local-first Logitech Options+ alternative in Rust
en.what: OpenLogi is an open-source Logitech peripheral configuration tool that communicates directly with devices via HID++, supporting button remapping, DPI adjustment, and SmartShift. It requires no Logitech account, collects no telemetry, and stores all configuration in local TOML files, emphasizing privacy and local-first principles.
en.content: The repository contains three components: OpenLogi GUI (a GPUI desktop app with interactive mouse diagram, per-button action picker, DPI presets, SmartShift, RGB keyboard lighting, per-application profiles), OpenLogi agent (background service owning input hook and device I/O), plus documentation and config examples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, the GUI is built with GPUI (the framework used by Zed editor), communicates with Logitech devices via HID++ protocol, supporting Logi Bolt, Unifying receivers, Bluetooth-direct, and USB connections.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Logitech's official Options+, it addresses user pain points with bloat, telemetry, and account requirements, quickly gaining popularity in the Rust community and among privacy-conscious users, with over 8.6k stars and 115 added today.
uses: Logitech peripheral users who want a local-first config experience without bloat and telemetry
Rust developers interested in GPUI desktop app development or HID++ protocol implementation
Privacy advocates who reject account requirements and data collection, preferring open-source software

zh.tag: 一键开启沉浸式多智能体课堂
zh.what: OpenMAIC 是一个开源的多智能体交互式课堂平台，让用户通过点击即可获得沉浸式的多智能体学习体验。它模拟真实课堂环境，由多个 AI 智能体扮演不同角色（如教师、学生），进行互动教学。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端界面（Next.js/React）、后端逻辑（LangGraph 编排）、智能体配置、部署模板（Vercel）、文档和社区资源。支持 OpenClaw 集成和 Lemonade 本地 AI。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Next.js 16、React 19、LangGraph 1.1 构建，支持多种 LLM 提供商（如 OpenAI、Anthropic）的 API 密钥配置。
zh.hot: 凭借创新的多智能体教学理念和极简的一键部署体验，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，24 小时内新增 907 星，总星数突破 2.2 万，位列 Trending 日榜第 5。
uses: 教育工作者：快速搭建 AI 驱动的互动课堂，探索新型教学模式。
AI 开发者：研究多智能体协作与交互，参考其架构和实现。
学习者：通过沉浸式多智能体对话，获得个性化学习体验。
开源爱好者：部署和定制自己的智能体课堂，参与社区贡献。

en.tag: One-click immersive multi-agent learning classroom
en.what: OpenMAIC is an open-source multi-agent interactive classroom platform that provides an immersive learning experience with one click. It simulates a real classroom where multiple AI agents play different roles (e.g., teacher, students) to conduct interactive teaching.
en.content: The repo includes frontend UI (Next.js/React), backend logic (LangGraph orchestration), agent configurations, deployment templates (Vercel), documentation, and community resources. Supports OpenClaw integration and Lemonade local AI.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, using Next.js 16, React 19, LangGraph 1.1, and supports multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) via API keys.
en.hot: Its innovative multi-agent teaching concept and one-click deployment experience have made it viral on GitHub, gaining 907 stars in 24 hours, surpassing 22k total stars, and ranking #5 on the daily trending list.
uses: Educators: Quickly set up AI-driven interactive classrooms to explore new teaching models.
AI developers: Study multi-agent collaboration and interaction, referencing its architecture and implementation.
Learners: Gain personalized learning experiences through immersive multi-agent dialogues.
Open-source enthusiasts: Deploy and customize their own agent classroom, contributing to the community.

zh.tag: GPT-Image2 工业级提示词引擎与模板库
zh.what: 这是一个为 GPT-Image2 图像生成模型打造的提示词工程资源库，包含 500+ 逆向工程案例和 20+ 工业级模板，将提示词视为代码进行管理和复用。项目提供可视化网站用于浏览和复制提示词，并持续更新。
zh.content: 仓库包含数据目录（案例图片与提示词）、源码（网站前端）、模板库、技能提炼文档，以及多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主要基于 JavaScript，可能使用前端框架（如 React/Vue）构建可视化网站，依赖 GitHub Pages 或类似服务部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 500+ 逆向工程案例和 20+ 工业级模板，为 GPT-Image2 用户提供高质量提示词参考，今日新增 409 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: AI 图像生成爱好者：快速获取高质量提示词，提升生成效果。
提示词工程师：学习逆向工程案例，提炼可复用的技能。
产品团队：将提示词作为代码管理，实现工业化生成流程。

en.tag: Industrial prompt engine & template library for GPT-Image2
en.what: This is a prompt engineering resource library for the GPT-Image2 image generation model, featuring 500+ reverse-engineered cases and 20+ industrial templates, treating prompts as code for management and reuse. It provides a visual website for browsing and copying prompts, with continuous updates.
en.content: The repository contains data directories (case images and prompts), source code (website frontend), template library, skill extraction docs, and multilingual README.
en.stack: Primarily based on JavaScript, likely using a frontend framework (e.g., React/Vue) for the visual website, deployed via GitHub Pages or similar.
en.hot: With 500+ reverse-engineered cases and 20+ industrial templates, it offers high-quality prompt references for GPT-Image2 users, gaining 409 stars today and trending on GitHub.
uses: AI image generation enthusiasts: quickly obtain high-quality prompts to improve output.
Prompt engineers: learn from reverse-engineered cases and extract reusable skills.
Product teams: manage prompts as code for industrial generation workflows.

zh.tag: 一个菜单栏图标，替代十几个付费 Mac 应用
zh.what: Vorssaint 是一个免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏工具包，将音量控制、系统监控、窗口管理等多种实用功能整合到一个菜单栏图标中。它旨在替代多个付费应用，提供简洁统一的用户体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Swift 项目源码，包括菜单栏面板（如混音器、系统监控、窗口控制）、文档、CI 配置和发布资源。
zh.stack: 使用 Swift 开发，面向 macOS 14+ 和 Apple Silicon，采用 GPL-3.0 许可证，并依赖 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1.1 万星，总星数达 1.5 万，因其免费开源、功能强大且替代多个付费应用而广受欢迎，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: 希望减少付费 Mac 应用数量、追求性价比的用户
需要快速访问音量、系统监控和窗口管理的效率工作者
对开源和隐私保护有要求的 macOS 用户

en.tag: One menu bar icon replacing a dozen paid Mac apps
en.what: Vorssaint is a free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit that consolidates volume control, system monitoring, window management, and other utilities into a single menu bar icon. It aims to replace multiple paid apps with a clean, unified experience.
en.content: The repository contains the full Swift project source, including menu bar panels (mixer, system monitor, window controls), documentation, CI config, and release assets.
en.stack: Built with Swift, targeting macOS 14+ and Apple Silicon, licensed under GPL-3.0, and uses GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: Gained 11k stars this month, reaching 15k total, popular for being free, open-source, and replacing multiple paid apps, trending on GitHub.
uses: Users wanting to reduce paid Mac apps and seek cost-effectiveness
Productivity workers needing quick access to volume, system monitoring, and window controls
macOS users who value open-source and privacy

zh.tag: 为 AI 编程助手提供 38 种编辑级图表模板
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Codex 和 Pi）设计的技能包，提供 38 种编辑级质量的图表类型。它生成自包含的 HTML+SVG 文件，无需构建步骤或外部依赖，并强调无阴影、无 Mermaid 风格的设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含 38 种图表类型的定义，每种都有浅色、深色和全编辑三种静态变体，以及文档和截图。还包含语义模式系统，可将行为与布局分离，并支持从 draw.io 或 Mermaid 源重绘图表。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML 和 SVG，无 JavaScript 或外部图像依赖。设计为与 Claude Code、Codex、Pi 等 AI 代理兼容，并支持 Agent Skills 标准。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得超过 30.9k 星标，今日新增 437 星。它解决了 AI 生成图表质量差的痛点，提供了设计师认可的高质量模板，并持续更新新图表类型。
uses: 开发者使用 Claude Code 或 Codex 生成架构图、流程图等，避免手动调整样式
内容创作者需要快速制作编辑级图表，用于博客、文档或演示
团队希望统一图表风格，通过读取网站自动匹配品牌视觉

en.tag: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi
en.what: A skill pack for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, offering 38 editorial-quality diagram types. It generates self-contained HTML+SVG files with no build step or external dependencies, emphasizing a clean design without shadows or Mermaid-style output.
en.content: The repo contains definitions for 38 diagram types, each with minimal light, minimal dark, and full-editorial static variants, plus docs and screenshots. It also includes a semantic pattern system that separates behavior from layout, and can redraw draw.io or Mermaid sources.
en.stack: Primarily HTML and SVG, with no JavaScript or external image dependencies. Designed to work with AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, and compatible with Agent Skills.
en.hot: The repo has gone viral on GitHub with over 30.9k stars and 437 stars today. It addresses the pain point of low-quality AI-generated diagrams by offering designer-approved templates, and it continuously adds new diagram types.
uses: Developers using Claude Code or Codex to generate architecture diagrams, flowcharts, etc., without manual styling
Content creators needing quick editorial-quality diagrams for blogs, docs, or presentations
Teams wanting consistent diagram styling, with automatic brand matching by reading a website

zh.tag: 在 Mac 上虚拟运行 iPhone 的命令行工具
zh.what: vphone-cli 利用 Apple 的 Virtualization.framework 和 PCC 研究虚拟机基础设施，在 macOS 上启动虚拟 iPhone。它自动化了从下载固件、修补引导链到 DFU 恢复和首次启动的完整流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含命令行工具 vphone-cli、用于管理虚拟机的子命令（vm、fw、restore、cfw 等），以及构建脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Swift 编写，依赖 Python、aria2、wget、openssl、libusb 等工具，通过 Homebrew 安装。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub Trending 周榜排名第 8，本周新增近 2000 star，总 star 过万，因其能在 Mac 上虚拟运行 iPhone 的突破性能力而备受关注。
uses: iOS 开发者和安全研究人员，希望在 Mac 上快速启动虚拟 iPhone 进行测试。
对 iOS 内部机制感兴趣的技术爱好者，想探索 PCC 研究虚拟机基础设施。
需要多设备测试环境的人员，可通过克隆快速创建多个虚拟 iPhone。

en.tag: CLI tool to boot a virtual iPhone on Apple Silicon Macs
en.what: vphone-cli leverages Apple's Virtualization.framework and PCC research VM infrastructure to boot a virtual iPhone on macOS. It automates the entire pipeline from firmware download, boot chain patching, DFU restore, to first boot.
en.content: The repository includes the vphone-cli command-line tool, subcommands for VM management (vm, fw, restore, cfw, etc.), build scripts, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Swift, with dependencies on Python, aria2, wget, openssl, libusb, etc., installed via Homebrew.
en.hot: Ranked #8 on GitHub Trending this week with ~2000 new stars, surpassing 10k total, it gains attention for its groundbreaking ability to run a virtual iPhone on a Mac.
uses: iOS developers and security researchers who want to spin up virtual iPhones on a Mac for testing.
Tech enthusiasts interested in iOS internals, exploring PCC research VM infrastructure.
Those needing multiple test devices, can quickly clone virtual iPhones for parallel testing.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，日志即运行时
zh.what: Apache Maka 是一个本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，用于实际工作而非仅仅回答问题。它通过受控权限检查项目、执行工具、生成工件，并将模型消息和工具调用记录为可恢复的执行事实。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（Electron + React）、终端 TUI 和 CLI（maka, maka run）、评估工具（maka eval run），以及核心的 Runtime Host 和 Runtime Event Log 实现。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，桌面端基于 Electron 和 React，支持多种模型连接（云 API、本地模型或兼容网关），并包含本地工具如 Read、Write、Edit、Bash、Glob 和 Grep。
zh.hot: 今日新增 460 星，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜第 7，因其本地优先、日志即运行时的创新架构，以及 Apache 孵化项目的背书，吸引了关注 AI 代理可靠性和可恢复性的开发者。
uses: 日常 AI 辅助开发：在本地项目中安全地让代理读写文件、执行命令。
需要可审计、可恢复的 AI 代理工作流的团队，用于记录和回溯每次工具调用。
AI 代理评估：使用 maka eval 进行可复现的基准测试。
偏好本地优先、数据不出机器的隐私敏感用户。

en.tag: Local-first AI agent workspace with log-as-runtime architecture
en.what: Apache Maka is a local-first AI agent workspace built for real work. It inspects projects, executes tools, produces artifacts with controlled permissions, and preserves model messages and tool calls as recoverable execution facts.
en.content: The repo includes a desktop app (Electron + React), a terminal TUI and CLI (maka, maka run), an evaluation tool (maka eval run), and the core Runtime Host and Runtime Event Log implementation.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Electron and React for the desktop app, supporting multiple model connections (cloud API, local model, or compatible gateway), and local tools including Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, and Grep.
en.hot: With 460 stars added today and ranking #7 on the TypeScript trending list, its local-first, log-as-runtime architecture and Apache incubation status attract developers focused on AI agent reliability and recoverability.
uses: Daily AI-assisted development: let agents safely read/write files and run commands in local projects.
Teams needing auditable and recoverable AI agent workflows, with logs of every tool call.
AI agent evaluation: use maka eval for reproducible benchmark experiments.
Privacy-conscious users preferring local-first, data-stays-on-machine solutions.

zh.tag: 本地多智能体框架，复用现有订阅，打造你的克隆办公室
zh.what: Munder Difflin 是一个本地多智能体运行框架，能将你已有的 Claude Code、Codex 等终端编码 CLI 转化为你的克隆体，让它们在你离开时继续工作。它协调整个智能体办公室，在你的机器上并行处理任务，并支持消息传递、路由和记忆。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 桌面应用，提供可视化办公室楼层，智能体以头像形式在工位上并行工作，并配有指挥中心和实时终端。核心组件包括智能体协调器、消息路由和记忆系统。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 Electron 和 React 作为桌面框架，Pixi.js 渲染可视化，xterm.js 和 node-pty 提供终端模拟。支持多种 CLI 工具和本地 LLM。
zh.hot: 本月新增 6210 星，总星数达 7432，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 12 名，因其能复用现有订阅、免费开源且性能出色而迅速走红。
uses: 开发者希望自动化日常编码任务，同时利用现有 AI 订阅
团队需要并行处理多个编码任务，提高效率
个人用户想要一个本地、可定制的多智能体工作环境

en.tag: Local multi-agent harness that reuses your subscriptions to run an office of clones
en.what: Munder Difflin is a local multi-agent harness that turns your existing terminal coding CLIs, like Claude Code and Codex, into clones of you that keep working while you're away. It coordinates an entire office of agents on your own machine, with messaging, routing, and memory.
en.content: The repo contains an Electron desktop app featuring a visual office floor where agents work in parallel as avatars at desks, along with a command center and live agent terminals. Core components include an agent coordinator, message routing, and memory system.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, using Electron and React for the desktop app, Pixi.js for visualization, and xterm.js with node-pty for terminal emulation. Supports various CLI tools and local LLMs.
en.hot: Gained 6,210 stars this month, reaching 7,432 total, and ranked #12 on GitHub Trending monthly. It's hot because it reuses existing subscriptions, is free and open source, and performs well.
uses: Developers looking to automate daily coding tasks while leveraging existing AI subscriptions
Teams needing to parallelize multiple coding tasks for efficiency
Individuals wanting a local, customizable multi-agent work environment

zh.tag: 2小时从零训练64M超小语言模型，全流程开源教程
zh.what: MiniMind 是一个从零开始训练超小语言模型（64M参数）的开源项目，仅需3块钱成本和2小时即可在单张消费级GPU上完成训练。项目覆盖从数据清洗、预训练到SFT、RLHF、Agentic RL等完整链路，并扩展了视觉、多模态等变体。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的训练代码、模型结构定义、数据预处理脚本、训练教程和多个模型变体（如MiniMind-V、MiniMind-O）。所有核心算法均用PyTorch原生实现，不依赖高层封装库。
zh.stack: 基于Python和PyTorch，从零实现Transformer、MoE、LoRA、DPO、PPO等算法，不依赖transformers/trl等库。
zh.hot: 以极低成本（3元/2小时）训练LLM的颠覆性理念，加上全流程开源和教程性质，吸引了大量希望深入理解LLM的开发者。56k星标和日增近500星，说明其精准切中了个人开发者复现大模型的需求。
uses: LLM初学者：通过从零实现和训练，深入理解大模型内部机制，而非仅使用现成库。
个人开发者/研究者：在消费级GPU上快速实验预训练、微调、RLHF等全流程。
教育场景：作为高校或培训机构的AI课程实战项目，低成本复现前沿技术。
对模型压缩和高效训练感兴趣者：探索64M小模型的性能边界和扩展方向。

en.tag: Train a 64M LLM from scratch in 2h with full pipeline, open-source tutorial
en.what: MiniMind is an open-source project to train a tiny 64M-parameter LLM from scratch, costing only $0.4 and 2 hours on a single consumer GPU. It covers the full pipeline from data cleaning, pretraining to SFT, RLHF, Agentic RL, and extends to vision and multimodal variants.
en.content: The repo contains full training code, model architecture definitions, data preprocessing scripts, tutorials, and several model variants (e.g., MiniMind-V, MiniMind-O). All core algorithms are implemented natively in PyTorch without high-level wrappers.
en.stack: Built with Python and PyTorch, implementing Transformer, MoE, LoRA, DPO, PPO from scratch, without relying on libraries like transformers/trl.
en.hot: The disruptive idea of training an LLM for just $0.4 and 2 hours, combined with full open-source pipeline and tutorial nature, attracts developers eager to understand LLMs deeply. With 56k stars and ~500 daily additions, it hits the need for personal reproduction of LLMs.
uses: LLM beginners: gain deep understanding of LLM internals by implementing and training from scratch, not just using off-the-shelf libraries.
Individual developers/researchers: quickly experiment with pretraining, fine-tuning, RLHF on consumer GPUs.
Educational settings: as a hands-on project for AI courses, reproducing cutting-edge techniques at low cost.
Those interested in model compression and efficient training: explore the performance limits of 64M small models.

zh.tag: 统一 AI 开发与部署平台，含 MAX 框架与 Mojo 语言
zh.what: Modular Platform 是一个开源平台，旨在统一 AI 开发与部署流程，包含 MAX 框架（用于模型推理和部署）和 Mojo 语言（一种面向 AI 的高性能编程语言）。它提供从模型编译、优化到服务部署的完整工具链，并支持 OpenAI 兼容的端点。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Mojo 编译器、Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库、MAX 推理服务器、MAX 模型流水线以及大量代码示例。目录结构清晰，分为 /KGEN、/mojo、/max 等模块，方便开发者浏览和贡献。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Mojo 语言编写，同时涉及 Python（用于 MAX 的 Python API）和 C++（底层内核）。依赖 LLVM 等编译器基础设施，并遵循 Apache 2.0 许可证（含 LLVM 例外）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 268 星，总星数 27933，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。Mojo 语言和 MAX 框架的独特定位吸引了大量 AI 开发者，其高性能和统一平台理念备受关注。
uses: AI 开发者：使用 Mojo 语言编写高性能 AI 模型，或利用 MAX 框架进行模型部署和推理。
MLOps 工程师：通过 MAX 推理服务器快速搭建 OpenAI 兼容的模型服务。
研究人员：在 MAX 流水线中集成自定义模型架构，并利用加速器库优化性能。
开源贡献者：参与 Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库等模块的开发和改进。

en.tag: Unified AI development & deployment platform, including MAX framework and Mojo language
en.what: The Modular Platform is an open-source platform that unifies AI development and deployment, including the MAX framework for model inference and deployment, and the Mojo language, a high-performance programming language for AI. It provides a complete toolchain from model compilation and optimization to service deployment, with OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
en.content: The repo contains the Mojo compiler, Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, MAX inference server, MAX model pipelines, and numerous code examples. The directory structure is clear, with modules like /KGEN, /mojo, /max, making it easy to navigate and contribute.
en.stack: Primarily written in Mojo, with Python for MAX's Python API and C++ for low-level kernels. It relies on LLVM and other compiler infrastructure, and is licensed under Apache 2.0 with LLVM exceptions.
en.hot: With 268 stars added today and 27,933 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. The unique positioning of Mojo and MAX attracts AI developers, drawing attention to its high performance and unified platform concept.
uses: AI developers: Use Mojo to write high-performance AI models or leverage MAX for deployment and inference.
MLOps engineers: Quickly set up OpenAI-compatible model serving with the MAX inference server.
Researchers: Integrate custom model architectures in MAX pipelines and optimize performance with the accelerator library.
Open-source contributors: Contribute to the Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, and more.

zh.tag: 聚合34家免费LLM提供商的统一API网关
zh.what: FreeLLMAPI 是一个开源项目，将数十家免费 LLM 提供商的免费额度聚合到一个 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 端点后面。它提供智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥管理，让开发者无需管理多个 API 密钥即可访问大量免费模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 TypeScript 编写的 API 网关，支持 Docker 自托管、桌面应用（macOS/Windows）和 Android 应用。它提供了一个仪表板，用于监控每月 token 预算，并包含一个自动更新的模型目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，支持 Docker 部署，并提供桌面和移动端应用。依赖 OpenAI 兼容 API 标准，集成多个 LLM 提供商。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得近 2 万星标，日增 174 星。它解决了开发者对免费 LLM 资源分散、难以管理的痛点，提供了一站式解决方案。
uses: 个人开发者：快速集成多个免费 LLM，无需单独注册和付费。
原型开发：在项目初期使用免费模型验证想法，降低开发成本。
学习与研究：探索不同 LLM 的能力，进行对比实验。
自动化工具：为聊天机器人、内容生成等应用提供统一 API 接口。

en.tag: Unified API gateway aggregating 34 free LLM providers
en.what: FreeLLMAPI is an open-source project that aggregates free tiers from dozens of LLM providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. It offers smart routing, automatic failover, and encrypted key management, allowing developers to access a vast array of free models without managing multiple API keys.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based API gateway with Docker self-hosting, desktop apps for macOS/Windows, and an Android app. It includes a dashboard for monitoring monthly token budgets and an auto-updating model catalog.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Docker deployment and desktop/mobile apps. Relies on OpenAI-compatible API standards and integrates multiple LLM providers.
en.hot: The project has gained nearly 20k stars with 174 new stars today, addressing the pain point of scattered free LLM resources by offering a one-stop solution.
uses: Individual developers: Quickly integrate multiple free LLMs without separate registrations and payments.
Prototyping: Validate ideas with free models in early stages, reducing development costs.
Learning and research: Explore capabilities of different LLMs and run comparative experiments.
Automation tools: Provide a unified API for chatbots, content generation, and more.

zh.tag: 为专业 AI 编程代理打造的安全验证技能注册表
zh.what: 这是一个面向 AI 编程代理的技能注册表，提供经过验证、测试且安全的能力包，用于扩展 Antigravity、Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等工具。它针对市面上超过 13% 的技能存在严重漏洞的问题，主打安全可信。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能包集合、MCP 服务器实现、文档站点以及贡献指南，以 TypeScript 编写的 CLI 和库形式发布到 npm。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript（100%）和 Node.js（>=22），使用 Nx Cloud 进行构建，采用 semantic-release 管理版本，并发布为 npm 包 @tech-leads-club/agent-skills。
zh.hot: 项目今日新增 265 星，总星数达 5658，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 4 名，反映出开发者对 AI 代理技能安全性的高度关注。
uses: AI 编程代理用户，希望安全地扩展 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具的能力
开发团队，需要为内部 AI 代理引入经过验证的技能包
安全工程师，关注 AI 技能供应链漏洞并寻求可信来源
技能贡献者，想要发布和维护经过审核的代理技能

en.tag: The secure, validated skill registry for professional AI coding agents
en.what: This is a skill registry for AI coding agents, offering verified, tested, and safe capability packages to extend tools like Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot. It addresses the fact that over 13% of marketplace skills contain critical vulnerabilities, focusing on security and trust.
en.content: The repo contains a collection of skill packages, an MCP server implementation, documentation site, and contribution guidelines, published to npm as a TypeScript CLI and library.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript (100%) and Node.js (>=22), using Nx Cloud for builds, semantic-release for versioning, and published as the npm package @tech-leads-club/agent-skills.
en.hot: It gained 265 stars today, reaching 5,658 total and ranking 4th on GitHub Trending daily, reflecting strong developer interest in the security of AI agent skills.
uses: AI coding agent users who want to safely extend tools like Claude Code and Cursor
Development teams needing verified skill packages for internal AI agents
Security engineers concerned about AI skill supply chain vulnerabilities and seeking trusted sources
Skill contributors who want to publish and maintain vetted agent skills

zh.tag: 开源自托管个人财务管理器，隐私优先
zh.what: Securo 是一款开源的个人财务管理工具，运行在你自己的服务器上，让你完全掌握账户、支出与消费习惯数据。它强调隐私优先，不把任何财务数据交给第三方公司。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 后端与独立前端，提供 Docker/Podman 一键安装脚本、docker compose 部署、演示站与文档，并配有 CI、覆盖率徽章和 Discord 社区。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，前端独立打包为容器镜像，依赖 Docker 或 Podman 运行，支持 Postgres 等数据库，并通过 OFX/QIF/CAMT/CSV 导入与银行同步 provider 接入数据。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1902 star、总数达 3541，冲上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 21 名，反映出用户对自托管、数据自主的财务工具需求强烈。
uses: 注重隐私、希望自己托管财务数据的个人用户
想统一管理多账户、预算与储蓄目标的家庭理财者
需要 OFX/QIF/CAMT/CSV 导入与自动分类的记账用户
喜欢用 Docker 自建服务、愿意折腾的开源爱好者

en.tag: Open-source, self-hosted personal finance manager with a privacy-first design
en.what: Securo is an open-source personal finance manager that runs on your own infrastructure, giving you full visibility into your accounts, spending and habits. It is privacy-first, so no corporation ever sits between you and your financial data.
en.content: The repo ships a Python backend plus a separate frontend, one-line Docker/Podman install scripts, docker compose deployment, a live demo, docs, CI and coverage badges, and a Discord community.
en.stack: Primarily Python with a separately containerized frontend, it runs via Docker or Podman, uses a database such as Postgres, and ingests data through OFX/QIF/CAMT/CSV imports and bank-sync providers.
en.hot: It gained 1,902 stars this month for a total of 3,541, landing at #21 on GitHub Trending monthly, reflecting strong demand for self-hosted, data-sovereign finance tools.
uses: Privacy-conscious individuals who want to self-host their financial data
Households managing multiple accounts, budgets and savings goals in one place
Users who need OFX/QIF/CAMT/CSV import and auto-categorization rules
Self-hosting enthusiasts comfortable running services with Docker

zh.tag: 把任意 AI 代理变成科学家的技能库，覆盖生物、化学、医学等 163 个技能
zh.what: 这是一个开源的科学 Agent 技能库，提供 163 个即用型技能和 100+ 科学数据库，覆盖生物学、化学、医学和药物发现。它兼容 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理，并遵循开放的 Agent Skills 标准，让任何 AI 代理都能执行科学任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、测试用例、文档和示例，以及一个可选的本地 AI 协同科学家工具 K-Dense BYOK。技能以标准格式组织，便于集成和扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Agent Skills 标准，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3.47 万星标和 17.5 万科学家用户，它填补了 AI 代理在科学领域应用的空白，成为最受欢迎的科学技能库。
uses: 科研人员：快速让 AI 代理执行文献分析、实验设计等任务。
开发者：为 AI 代理集成科学技能，构建垂直领域应用。
教育者：在教学中使用 AI 辅助科学探索，提升学生参与度。

en.tag: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist with 163 validated skills and 100+ scientific databases.
en.what: An open-source library of scientific Agent Skills, offering 163 ready-to-use skills and 100+ scientific databases across biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. It works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other AI agents, following the open Agent Skills standard, enabling any agent to perform scientific tasks.
en.content: The repo contains skill definitions, tests, documentation, examples, and an optional local AI co-scientist tool K-Dense BYOK. Skills are organized in a standard format for easy integration and extension.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, relying on the Agent Skills standard, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 34.7k stars and 175k+ scientist users, it fills a gap in AI agent applications for science, becoming the most popular scientific skills library.
uses: Researchers: quickly enable AI agents to perform literature analysis, experiment design, etc.
Developers: integrate scientific skills into AI agents to build domain-specific applications.
Educators: use AI-assisted scientific exploration in teaching to boost student engagement.

zh.tag: 全自动去除语言模型审查的优化工具
zh.what: Heretic 是一个无需昂贵后训练即可移除 Transformer 语言模型审查（安全对齐）的工具。它结合方向消融（abliteration）与基于 TPE 的参数优化器，自动寻找高质量消融参数，同时最小化拒绝次数和与原始模型的 KL 散度，从而保留模型智能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 实现、命令行界面、自动优化流程、支持多种模型架构（稠密、MoE、混合如 Qwen3.5），并提供示例配置和基准测试结果。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch、Transformers、Optuna（TPE 优化器）等，实现方向消融和参数优化。
zh.hot: 2.87 万星标，日增 150，登上日榜第 6。它让非专家也能一键去除模型审查，且效果媲美人工调优，引发广泛关注。
uses: AI 研究人员和开发者，希望快速去除模型审查而不损失性能。
对模型安全对齐机制感兴趣，想探索方向消融技术的实践者。
需要定制模型行为、去除内容限制的普通用户，无需深入理解内部原理。

en.tag: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models via TPE-based optimization
en.what: Heretic is a tool that removes censorship (safety alignment) from transformer-based language models without expensive post-training. It combines directional ablation (abliteration) with a TPE-based parameter optimizer to automatically find high-quality parameters that minimize refusals and KL divergence from the original model, preserving intelligence.
en.content: The repository contains a full Python implementation, CLI, automatic optimization pipeline, support for dense, MoE, and hybrid models (e.g., Qwen3.5), along with example configs and benchmark results.
en.stack: Built with Python, leveraging PyTorch, Transformers, and Optuna for TPE-based optimization, implementing directional ablation.
en.hot: With 28.7k stars and +150 daily, ranking #6 on the daily trend, it enables non-experts to decensor models with one command, rivaling manual abliteration, sparking wide interest.
uses: AI researchers and developers seeking to remove model censorship quickly without performance loss.
Practitioners interested in safety alignment mechanisms and directional ablation techniques.
General users who need to customize model behavior or remove content restrictions without deep technical knowledge.

zh.tag: 截图秒变前端代码的AI工具
zh.what: 这是一个利用AI将截图、设计稿、Figma设计甚至屏幕录制转换为干净、可运行的前端代码（如HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue）的工具。用户只需上传图片或录制视频，即可获得对应的功能原型或代码实现。
zh.content: 仓库包含React/Vite前端和FastAPI后端，支持多种技术栈（HTML+Tailwind、React+Tailwind、Vue+Tailwind等），并集成多个AI模型（如Gemini、GPT、Claude）用于代码生成和图像处理。
zh.stack: 主要使用Python（FastAPI）作为后端，前端采用React/Vite，依赖OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini等AI模型API，以及Replicate用于图像生成和编辑。
zh.hot: 凭借75.5K星标和今日新增326星，该工具因其直观的“截图转代码”功能而广受欢迎，大幅降低了前端开发门槛，尤其适合快速原型制作。
uses: 前端开发者快速将设计稿或截图转化为可用的HTML/CSS/React代码
产品经理或设计师验证UI概念，无需手动编写代码

en.tag: Turn screenshots into clean frontend code with AI

en.content: The repository contains a full browser server implementation with REST API, element refs, session isolation, cookie import, file upload, proxy support, and more. It includes startup scripts and an npm package for easy integration.

全栈开发者寻求轻量级替代 React/Vue 的方案，用于快速原型或小型项目
喜欢 HATEOAS 和超媒体理念的开发者，希望构建符合 REST 架构的 Web 应用

uses: Content creators: use with Claude Code to rewrite articles in bulk, removing AI-isms for better readability.
Developers: run Detect mode in CI or locally to audit AI-generated docs/commit messages for robotic tone.
Teams: standardize content tone via voice profiles (casual, professional, warm, etc.).
Agent builders: integrate this skill into custom agents to enhance text post-processing.
