zh.what: Stremio Web 是 Stremio 的官方网页界面，提供自由流媒体体验。它允许用户通过插件发现电影、剧集和频道，并同步跨设备的媒体库。
zh.content: 仓库包含 React 前端应用，与 Rust 核心（stremio-core）通过 WebAssembly 通信，并集成 stremio-video 处理播放。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript/React，依赖 Node.js 22+ 和 pnpm。核心逻辑在 Rust 编译为 WASM 的 stremio-core 中。
zh.hot: Stremio 作为流行的媒体中心，其 Web UI 因开源和易用性而备受关注，今日新增 122 星，总星数达 13477。
uses: 希望在一个界面中整合多个流媒体服务的用户。
开发者想要学习如何构建基于 WASM 的复杂前端应用。
喜欢通过插件扩展功能的媒体爱好者。

en.tag: Official web UI of Stremio, a one-stop media center for video entertainment
en.what: Stremio Web is the official web UI of Stremio, offering freedom to stream. It lets users discover movies, series, and channels via addons, and syncs library and progress across devices.
en.content: The repo contains a React frontend app that communicates with the Rust core (stremio-core) via WebAssembly, and integrates stremio-video for playback.
en.stack: Mainly JavaScript/React, requires Node.js 22+ and pnpm. Core logic is in stremio-core, a Rust engine compiled to WebAssembly.
en.hot: As a popular media center, Stremio's web UI gains attention for being open-source and user-friendly, with 122 stars added today, totaling 13477.
uses: Users who want to consolidate multiple streaming services into one interface.
Developers interested in building complex frontend apps with WebAssembly.
Media enthusiasts who enjoy extending functionality via addons.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理提供跨工具、跨机器的长期记忆与交接协议
zh.what: ai-memory 为 AI 编码 CLI 提供长期记忆层，让不同厂商的代理共享同一份项目记忆。中途退出 Claude Code 后，可在同目录用 Codex 继续任务，无需重新解释架构、失败尝试和未决问题。记忆存放在自托管服务器上，支持跨机器与团队共享。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的单二进制服务端与生命周期钩子，记忆以 git 管理的普通 Markdown wiki 为真源，数据库只是可重建的派生索引。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 1.95+ 编写，MIT 许可，依赖自托管服务器与 git 仓库，默认路径零 LLM 调用、无需 API key。
zh.hot: 本月新增 5269 星、总数达 6694，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 13 名，切中多代理协作中记忆孤岛的痛点。
uses: 在多个 AI 编码 CLI 之间切换的开发者，希望任务无缝交接
需要跨台式机与笔记本共享项目记忆的个人开发者
希望团队共享代理会话知识并保留审计日志的工程团队
偏好用 Markdown 和 git 管理记忆、不想维护向量库的用户

en.tag: Long-term memory and handoff protocol for AI coding agents across tools and machines
en.what: ai-memory provides a long-term memory layer for AI coding CLIs, letting agents from different vendors share one project memory. Quit Claude Code mid-task, open Codex in the same directory, and continue without re-explaining the architecture, failed approaches, or open questions. Memory lives on a self-hosted server, enabling cross-machine and team sharing.
en.content: The repo contains a single Rust binary server plus lifecycle hooks; memory's source of truth is a git-backed wiki of plain Markdown files, with the database as a rebuildable derived index.
en.stack: Written in Rust 1.95+ under MIT license, relying on a self-hosted server and git repo; the default path uses zero LLM calls and needs no API key.
en.hot: Gained 5,269 stars this month for 6,694 total, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending monthly, hitting the pain point of memory silos in multi-agent workflows.
uses: Developers switching between multiple AI coding CLIs who want seamless task handoff
Solo developers wanting shared project memory across desktop and laptop
Engineering teams needing shared agent session knowledge with audit logs
Users who prefer Markdown and git over maintaining a vector store

zh.tag: 一条命令为你的硬件找到最合适的 LLM 模型
zh.what: llmfit 是一个终端工具，能根据你的系统 RAM、CPU 和 GPU 自动检测硬件，并为数百个模型和提供商评分，告诉你哪些模型能在你的机器上流畅运行。它提供交互式 TUI 和经典 CLI 两种模式，支持多 GPU、MoE 架构、动态量化选择、速度估算以及本地运行时提供商（如 Ollama、llama.cpp 等）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、TUI 和 CLI 实现、基准测试指南（docs/benchmarking.md）、TUI 指南（docs/tui.md），以及用于演示的 demo.gif 和图标资源。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和模型推理后端（Ollama、llama.cpp、MLX 等），通过 crates.io 分发。
zh.hot: 星标数达 32k，今日新增近 200，因其解决了本地 LLM 选型的痛点，且新版本支持基准测试并贡献结果，让用户获得真实硬件上的实测数据，迅速走红。
uses: 本地 LLM 爱好者：快速找到适合自己电脑配置的模型，避免下载后跑不动的尴尬。
开发者：在开发环境中评估不同模型的性能，优化推理速度和资源占用。
硬件评测者：通过基准测试功能，分享自己机器上的实测数据，帮助社区完善模型适配信息。

en.tag: One command to find the right LLM for your hardware
en.what: llmfit is a terminal tool that detects your hardware and scores hundreds of models across quality, speed, fit, and context dimensions, telling you which ones will run well on your machine. It features an interactive TUI and classic CLI mode, supporting multi-GPU setups, MoE architectures, dynamic quantization, speed estimation, and local runtime providers like Ollama and llama.cpp.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, TUI and CLI implementations, benchmarking guide (docs/benchmarking.md), TUI guide (docs/tui.md), plus demo.gif and icon assets.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and model inference backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, etc.), distributed via crates.io.
en.hot: With 32k stars and ~200 new today, it solves the pain point of choosing the right local LLM, and the new benchmarking feature lets users contribute real measured data, driving its popularity.
uses: Local LLM enthusiasts: quickly find models that fit your hardware, avoiding downloads that won't run.
Developers: evaluate model performance in dev environments to optimize inference speed and resource usage.
Hardware reviewers: use benchmarking to share real measured data and improve community model-fit information.

zh.tag: 本地优先的跨平台个人 AI 超级智能体
zh.what: OpenHuman 是一款面向 Mac、Windows 和 Linux 的开源个人 AI，强调本地优先的记忆能力、智能体编排与深度研究。它把「记住一切的大脑」、编排器和研究员三合一，让个人数据留在本地。
zh.content: 仓库以 Rust 实现核心，包含 GitBook 文档目录（gitbooks/）与演示截图，并配有 Discord、Reddit、X 等社区入口。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，提供跨平台桌面应用；文档基于 GitBook，社区与分发依托 GitHub Discussions、Discord 与 Product Hunt。
zh.hot: 上线即获 Product Hunt 日榜/周榜 Top Post，GitHub 星标已达 39586，本月新增 3715，位列 Rust 月榜第 20 名，本地优先隐私叙事正好踩中当下热点。
uses: 希望把个人 AI 助手跑在本地、数据不出设备的隐私敏感用户
需要长期记忆与深度研究能力的知识工作者和研究者
想用 Rust 构建或扩展桌面 AI 智能体的开发者

en.tag: A local-first personal AI superintelligence for Mac, Windows and Linux
en.what: OpenHuman is an open source personal AI for Mac, Windows and Linux, built around local-first memory, agent orchestration and deep research. It combines a brain that remembers everything, an orchestrator and a deep researcher into one local-first assistant.
en.content: The repo ships a Rust core, a GitBook docs directory (gitbooks/) with demo screenshots, plus community links to Discord, Reddit and X.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust as a cross-platform desktop app; docs are built with GitBook, with community and distribution via GitHub Discussions, Discord and Product Hunt.
en.hot: It landed Product Hunt daily and weekly top-post badges, and has reached 39,586 stars with 3,715 added this month, ranking 20th on the Rust monthly trending list — its local-first privacy pitch rides today's wave.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want a personal AI assistant running locally with data kept on-device
Knowledge workers and researchers needing long-term memory and deep research capabilities
Developers who want to build or extend a desktop AI agent in Rust

zh.tag: 为 LLM 应用按成本与能力智能路由模型，兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 原生 API
zh.what: Switchyard 为每次 LLM 调用挑选最便宜但仍能完成任务的模型，从而在保持准确率的同时降低总成本。它不改变你的 agent 代码，而是作为路由层插入现有网关或独立代理中。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心库 switchyard-libsy、LLM 客户端 switchyard-llm-client、独立代理服务器 switchyard-server，以及 NeMo Relay 插件和 LiteLLM 集成示例。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 为主，提供 Python 包 nemo-switchyard 和 Rust crate switchyard-libsy，可嵌入 LiteLLM、NeMo Relay 或自建网关。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1493 stars，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 第 7 名，反映出开发者对 LLM 成本优化与多模型路由的强烈需求。
uses: 正在构建 LLM agent 或应用的开发者，希望在不改代码的情况下降低推理成本
需要跨多个模型提供商做基准测试和性能/成本权衡的团队
已有 LiteLLM 或 NeMo Relay 网关、想加入智能路由能力的平台工程师
想用 Claude Code、Codex CLI 等工具但希望按轮次自动选择模型的高级用户

en.tag: Route LLM calls across models and providers while keeping native OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility
en.what: Switchyard picks the cheapest model that can still do the job for each LLM call, cutting total cost while preserving accuracy. It requires no changes to your agent code, acting as a routing layer inside existing gateways or as a standalone proxy.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core library switchyard-libsy, an LLM client switchyard-llm-client, a standalone proxy server switchyard-server, plus a NeMo Relay plugin and LiteLLM integration examples.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, with a Python package nemo-switchyard and Rust crate switchyard-libsy, embeddable into LiteLLM, NeMo Relay, or custom gateways.
en.hot: It gained 1,493 stars this month and ranked 7th on GitHub Trending's monthly Rust list, reflecting strong demand for LLM cost optimization and multi-model routing.
uses: Developers building LLM agents or apps who want to cut inference costs without changing code
Teams benchmarking across multiple model providers and balancing cost versus performance
Platform engineers with existing LiteLLM or NeMo Relay gateways who want to add smart routing
Power users of Claude Code, Codex CLI, or similar tools who want per-turn model selection

zh.tag: 为无服务器计算打造的安全高速 microVM 虚拟化技术
zh.what: Firecracker 是 AWS 开源的轻量级虚拟化技术，用 microVM 运行容器与函数工作负载。它把硬件虚拟化的安全隔离性与容器的速度、灵活性结合起来，专为多租户无服务器场景设计。
zh.content: 核心是一个基于 Linux KVM 的虚拟机监控器（VMM），采用极简设计，剔除多余设备与 guest 功能以缩小内存占用和攻击面；仓库还包含构建工具链、快速入门与生产主机配置文档。
zh.stack: 主要用 Rust 编写，依赖 Linux KVM 与 Unix/Linux 主机环境，可通过 Docker 开发容器和 bash 脚本构建。
zh.hot: 作为 AWS Lambda 与 Fargate 的底层虚拟化引擎，Firecracker 是云原生安全隔离的事实标准之一，本月新增 707 star、总数达 36739，稳居 Rust 月榜第 12 名。
uses: 云平台与无服务器服务商：需要安全多租户隔离的容器/函数运行环境
容器运行时开发者：如 Kata Containers、Flintlock 等集成 microVM 隔离
基础设施与安全工程师：评估轻量虚拟化的启动速度、内存开销与攻击面
学习虚拟化与 KVM 的 Rust 开发者：研究生产级 VMM 实现

en.tag: Secure and fast microVMs for serverless computing
en.what: Firecracker is an open-source virtualization technology from AWS that runs container and function workloads inside lightweight microVMs. It combines the security and isolation of hardware virtualization with the speed and flexibility of containers, purpose-built for multi-tenant serverless services.
en.content: At its core is a minimalist KVM-based virtual machine monitor (VMM) that strips out unnecessary devices and guest-facing features to cut memory footprint and attack surface; the repo also ships a build toolchain, quickstart guide, and production host setup docs.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it relies on Linux KVM and a Unix/Linux host, and can be built via a Docker dev container and bash scripts.
en.hot: As the virtualization engine behind AWS Lambda and Fargate, Firecracker is a de facto standard for secure cloud-native isolation, gaining 707 stars this month for a total of 36,739 and ranking 12th on the monthly Rust trending list.
uses: Cloud and serverless providers needing secure multi-tenant isolation for containers and functions
Container runtime developers integrating microVM isolation, such as Kata Containers and Flintlock
Infrastructure and security engineers evaluating lightweight virtualization for boot speed, memory overhead, and attack surface
Rust developers learning virtualization and KVM by studying a production-grade VMM

zh.tag: 友好且类型安全的可扩展系统编程语言
zh.what: Gleam 是一门静态类型编程语言，旨在构建类型安全且可扩展的系统。它编译到 Erlang 和 JavaScript，让开发者能利用 BEAM 虚拟机的并发与容错能力，或在前端/Node.js 环境中运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Gleam 编译器的 Rust 源代码、标准库、构建工具以及文档和示例。主要目录有 compiler-core（编译器核心）、compiler-cli（命令行工具）和 test 等。
zh.stack: Gleam 编译器使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Rust 生态的库如 serde、clap 等。运行时目标为 Erlang/OTP 和 JavaScript，因此需要相应的运行时环境。
zh.hot: Gleam 因其友好的错误信息、强大的类型系统和多目标编译能力而受到关注，本月新增 194 颗星，总星数达 21894，在 GitHub Trending 月榜（Rust）中排名第 15。
uses: 希望构建高并发、容错后端系统的开发者，可利用 Erlang 生态。
需要类型安全且能编译到 JavaScript 的前端或全栈开发者。
对函数式编程和静态类型语言感兴趣的学习者与研究者。
寻求替代 TypeScript 或 Elixir 等语言的团队，用于构建可扩展应用。

en.tag: A friendly language for building type-safe, scalable systems
en.what: Gleam is a statically typed programming language designed for building type-safe and scalable systems. It compiles to Erlang and JavaScript, allowing developers to leverage the concurrency and fault-tolerance of the BEAM virtual machine or run in frontend/Node.js environments.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust source code for the Gleam compiler, standard library, build tool, and documentation/examples. Key directories include compiler-core (compiler core), compiler-cli (CLI tool), and test.
en.stack: The Gleam compiler is written in Rust, depending on Rust ecosystem crates like serde and clap. Runtime targets are Erlang/OTP and JavaScript, requiring corresponding runtime environments.
en.hot: Gleam gains attention for its friendly error messages, powerful type system, and multi-target compilation. It added 194 stars this month, reaching 21,894 total stars, ranking 15th on GitHub Trending monthly (Rust).
uses: Developers building highly concurrent, fault-tolerant backend systems leveraging the Erlang ecosystem.
Frontend or full-stack developers needing type safety with JavaScript compilation.
Learners and researchers interested in functional programming and statically typed languages.
Teams seeking alternatives to TypeScript or Elixir for building scalable applications.

zh.tag: 跨 50+ 编程工具的 AI 技能统一管理桌面应用
zh.what: Skills Manager 是一个轻量级桌面应用，用于统一管理、同步和组织 AI 代理的技能（skills），支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Copilot、Gemini CLI 等 50 多种编程工具。它提供一个集中的技能库，用户可以从 Git 仓库、本地文件夹、压缩包或 skills.sh 市场安装技能，并支持全局、代理、项目等多种工作区。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的桌面应用源码，提供技能库、市场浏览、全局/代理/项目工作区、备份与多设备同步等功能，并配有界面截图和概念图。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 开发，可能涉及 Tauri 或类似框架，依赖 Git 和文件系统操作，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 本周新增 228 星，总星数达 4283，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Rust）第 13 名。AI 编程工具激增，跨工具管理技能的需求旺盛，该应用填补了这一空白。
uses: AI 编程工具用户：统一管理 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具的技能，避免重复配置。
开发者团队：通过备份与多设备同步，确保团队成员技能配置一致。
技能开发者：在市场中发布技能，并利用工作区测试和部署。

en.tag: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools
en.what: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, and Gemini CLI. It provides a unified skill library, allowing users to install skills from Git repos, local folders, archives, or the skills.sh marketplace, with support for global, agent, and project workspaces.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-based desktop app source code, featuring a unified skill library, marketplace browsing, global/agent/project workspaces, backup and multi-device sync, along with UI screenshots and a concept map.
en.stack: Built primarily with Rust, likely using Tauri or similar framework, with dependencies on Git and file system operations, supporting cross-platform.
en.hot: Gained 228 stars this week, reaching 4,283 total, and ranked #13 on GitHub Trending (Rust) weekly. With the proliferation of AI coding tools, the need to manage skills across tools is high, and this app fills that gap.
uses: AI coding tool users: centrally manage skills for Claude Code, Cursor, etc., avoiding duplicate configurations.
Development teams: ensure consistent skill configurations across members via backup and multi-device sync.
Skill developers: publish skills to the marketplace and use workspaces for testing and deployment.

zh.tag: 终端里的轻量 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的本地运行编码代理，能在终端中直接执行代码任务。它支持与 ChatGPT 计划集成，也可通过 API 密钥使用，提供命令行交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具，提供安装脚本、二进制发布包及文档，支持 npm、Homebrew 等安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 OpenAI API 或 ChatGPT 认证，支持跨平台（macOS、Linux、Windows）。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方开源项目，今日新增 2729 星，总星数突破 11 万，登顶 GitHub 日榜，开发者期待在终端中直接使用 AI 编程。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中快速执行 AI 辅助编码任务，无需离开命令行环境。
使用 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 等计划的用户，可无缝集成现有订阅进行编程。
需要轻量级、可脚本化的代码生成与修改工具的技术团队。

en.tag: Lightweight AI coding agent that runs in your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. It executes coding tasks directly in the terminal, integrates with ChatGPT plans, and can also be used with an API key.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based CLI tool, installation scripts, binary release assets, and documentation, with support for npm and Homebrew installation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, it relies on OpenAI API or ChatGPT authentication, and supports cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows).
en.hot: As an official OpenAI open-source project, it gained 2,729 stars today, surpassing 110k total stars and topping the daily GitHub trending list. Developers are eager to use AI coding directly in the terminal.
uses: Developers who want to perform AI-assisted coding tasks quickly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Users with ChatGPT Plus/Pro plans who can seamlessly integrate their existing subscription for coding.
Tech teams needing a lightweight, scriptable tool for code generation and modification.

zh.tag: Rust 原生高性能量化交易平台
zh.what: NautilusTrader 是一个基于 Rust 的高性能量化交易平台，采用确定性事件驱动架构，专为生产环境设计。它提供低延迟、高吞吐量的交易执行和回测能力，同时支持 Python 接口，便于策略开发和集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心交易引擎、回测模块、市场数据适配器、策略框架以及多种交易所连接器。代码主要用 Rust 编写，同时提供 Python 绑定，包含完整的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，支持 Python 3.12-3.14，兼容 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。依赖包括 PyO3 用于 Python 绑定，以及 Arrow 等用于数据处理。
zh.hot: 凭借 25.9k 星标和今日新增 120 星，NautilusTrader 因其生产级 Rust 性能、确定性架构和活跃社区而备受关注，成为量化交易领域的热门选择。
uses: 量化交易员和算法工程师：用于构建低延迟交易策略和执行系统。
金融科技公司：作为交易基础设施的核心组件，支持回测和实盘交易。
研究人员：利用其高性能回测引擎进行策略研究和数据分析。
开发者：通过 Python API 快速原型设计，或使用 Rust 进行深度定制。

en.tag: Production-grade Rust-native algorithmic trading platform
en.what: NautilusTrader is a high-performance algorithmic trading platform built in Rust with a deterministic event-driven architecture, designed for production use. It offers low-latency, high-throughput execution and backtesting capabilities, with a Python API for strategy development and integration.
en.content: The repository contains the core trading engine, backtesting module, market data adapters, strategy framework, and various exchange connectors. The code is primarily in Rust with Python bindings, including comprehensive documentation and examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Python bindings for 3.12-3.14, supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows. Dependencies include PyO3 for Python bindings and Arrow for data handling.
en.hot: With 25.9k stars and 120 new stars today, NautilusTrader gains attention for its production-grade Rust performance, deterministic architecture, and active community, making it a popular choice in algorithmic trading.
uses: Quant traders and algo engineers: for building low-latency trading strategies and execution systems.
Fintech companies: as a core component of trading infrastructure for backtesting and live trading.
Researchers: leveraging its high-performance backtesting engine for strategy research and data analysis.
Developers: rapid prototyping via Python API or deep customization with Rust.

zh.tag: 更聪明的 cd 命令，记住常用目录实现秒级跳转
zh.what: zoxide 是一个受 z 和 autojump 启发的智能目录跳转工具，它会记录你访问最频繁的目录，让你用几个按键就能跳转过去。它同时兼容 cd 的常规用法，并支持所有主流 shell。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心二进制、各 shell 的初始化脚本与补全、安装文档、配置说明以及第三方集成示例，并配有演示动图。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，通过 crates.io 分发，支持 Nix 构建，并依赖 fzf 实现交互式选择。
zh.hot: 作为经典效率工具，zoxide 已积累 39,323 颗星，今日再增 57 星并登上 Rust 日榜第 18 名，说明终端用户对快速导航的需求持续旺盛。
uses: 经常在终端中切换目录的开发者与运维人员，可大幅减少 cd 输入
使用 bash、zsh、fish 等主流 shell 并希望提升命令行效率的用户
喜欢 fzf 交互式选择、追求个性化终端工作流的高级用户

en.tag: A smarter cd command that remembers your most-used directories for instant jumps
en.what: zoxide is a smarter cd command inspired by z and autojump. It remembers which directories you use most frequently so you can jump to them in just a few keystrokes, while still working like a regular cd command across all major shells.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core binary, shell init scripts and completions, installation and configuration docs, third-party integration examples, plus a demo GIF.
en.stack: Written in Rust, distributed via crates.io, built with Nix support, and relies on fzf for interactive selection.
en.hot: As a classic productivity tool, zoxide has reached 39,323 stars, gaining 57 more today and ranking 18th on the Rust daily trending list, showing sustained demand for fast terminal navigation.
uses: Developers and sysadmins who frequently switch directories in the terminal and want to cut down on cd typing
Users of bash, zsh, fish and other major shells looking to boost command-line efficiency
Power users who enjoy fzf interactive selection and a personalized terminal workflow

zh.tag: 快速、节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器
zh.what: pnpm 是一个快速且节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器，通过内容寻址存储来链接文件，避免重复下载。它支持 monorepo，提供严格的依赖访问控制，并具有确定性的锁文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 pnpm 的完整源代码、文档、基准测试脚本，以及一个用 Rust 编写的实验性 CLI 移植版本（pacquet）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript/TypeScript 编写，并包含 Rust 组件（pacquet）。依赖 Node.js 生态，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。
zh.hot: pnpm 因其卓越的性能和磁盘效率而广受欢迎，在 GitHub 上拥有 36,310 颗星，并持续获得关注。其 Rust 移植版本也吸引了开发者的兴趣。
uses: 适用于大型 monorepo 项目，可显著减少依赖安装时间和磁盘占用。
适合对包管理性能有严格要求的开发团队，尤其是 CI/CD 环境。
适合希望使用严格依赖隔离和确定性锁文件的 Node.js 开发者。

en.tag: Fast, disk space efficient package manager for Node.js
en.what: pnpm is a fast and disk space efficient package manager for Node.js. It links files from a single content-addressable storage to avoid duplication, supports monorepos, enforces strict dependency access, and provides deterministic lockfiles.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, benchmark scripts, and an experimental Rust port of the CLI called pacquet.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript/TypeScript with a Rust component (pacquet). Depends on Node.js ecosystem, supports Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: pnpm is popular for its superior performance and disk efficiency, with 36,310 stars on GitHub and ongoing attention. Its Rust port also attracts developers.
uses: Ideal for large monorepo projects, significantly reducing install time and disk usage.
Suitable for teams with strict performance requirements, especially in CI/CD environments.
Great for Node.js developers who want strict dependency isolation and deterministic lockfiles.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的轻量级 Bitwarden 兼容密码服务器
zh.what: Vaultwarden 是 Bitwarden 客户端 API 的非官方服务端实现，用 Rust 编写，兼容官方 Bitwarden 客户端。它专为自托管场景设计，在资源占用上远低于官方服务，适合在低配服务器或家庭 NAS 上运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Rust 服务端源码、Docker 部署文件、数据库迁移脚本以及 Web 管理界面等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Rocket 框架、Diesel ORM 和 SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL 数据库，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 67,526 颗星和今日新增 115 星登上 GitHub 日榜第 10 名，其轻量、自托管友好的特性深受隐私意识强的用户欢迎。
uses: 希望自托管密码管理服务的个人或家庭用户
在低配服务器或 NAS 上部署密码库的运维人员
注重数据隐私、不愿依赖官方云服务的团队
需要 Bitwarden 兼容 API 的开发者或集成商

en.tag: A lightweight Bitwarden-compatible password server rewritten in Rust
en.what: Vaultwarden is an unofficial server implementation of the Bitwarden Client API, written in Rust and compatible with official Bitwarden clients. It is designed for self-hosted deployments where running the official resource-heavy service may not be ideal, offering a much lighter footprint.
en.content: The repository contains the full Rust server source code, Docker deployment files, database migration scripts, and a web admin interface.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust, using the Rocket framework, Diesel ORM, and SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL databases, with Docker deployment support.
en.hot: With 67,526 stars and 115 new stars today, it ranks 10th on GitHub Trending daily, popular among privacy-conscious users for its lightweight, self-hosting-friendly nature.
uses: Individuals or families wanting to self-host a password manager
Sysadmins deploying a password vault on low-spec servers or NAS
Teams prioritizing data privacy over official cloud services
Developers or integrators needing a Bitwarden-compatible API

zh.tag: 用 Rust 打造的超高速消息流平台，Apache 顶级项目
zh.what: Apache Iggy 是一个用 Rust 编写的高性能消息流平台，主打极低延迟与高吞吐，可作为 Kafka、NATS 等传统消息中间件的轻量替代。它面向持久化流式消息场景，支持多种语言的官方客户端，方便在分布式系统中做事件驱动与实时数据管道。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心服务端实现、多语言 SDK（Rust、JavaScript、Python、Java、.NET）、官方文档站点与示例，以及 Docker 部署配置和基准测试工具。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写并发布到 crates.io，同时提供 npm、PyPI、Maven Central、NuGet 等多平台包；采用 Apache 2.0 许可，依赖精简，适合容器化部署。
zh.hot: 作为 Apache 软件基金会项目，Iggy 凭借 Rust 带来的性能优势和活跃的多语言生态，本月新增 367 star，总 star 达 4876，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 分类第 22 名。
uses: 需要低延迟高吞吐消息队列的后端与基础设施工程师
想用 Rust 替代 Kafka/NATS 做事件驱动架构的团队
在微服务与实时数据管道中集成多语言客户端的开发者
关注 Apache 开源项目与流式数据技术的技术选型者

en.tag: Apache Iggy: hyper-efficient message streaming at laser speed, built in Rust
en.what: Apache Iggy is a high-performance message streaming platform written in Rust, designed for extremely low latency and high throughput as a lightweight alternative to Kafka and NATS. It targets persistent streaming workloads and ships official clients in multiple languages for event-driven and real-time data pipelines.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core server, multi-language SDKs (Rust, JavaScript, Python, Java, .NET), documentation site and examples, plus Docker deployment configs and benchmarking tools.
en.stack: Core is written in Rust and published to crates.io, with packages on npm, PyPI, Maven Central and NuGet; licensed under Apache 2.0 with lean dependencies, well suited to containerized deployment.
en.hot: As an Apache Software Foundation project, Iggy stands out for its Rust-powered performance and active multi-language ecosystem, gaining 367 stars this month for a total of 4,876 and ranking 22nd on GitHub Trending's monthly Rust list.
uses: Backend and infrastructure engineers needing low-latency, high-throughput messaging
Teams looking to replace Kafka/NATS with Rust for event-driven architectures
Developers integrating multi-language clients into microservices and real-time pipelines
Technical decision-makers tracking Apache open-source and streaming data projects

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的超高速 JavaScript/TypeScript 工具链
zh.what: Oxc（The Oxidation Compiler）是一套用 Rust 编写的高性能 JavaScript 与 TypeScript 工具集合，涵盖解析、转换、压缩、模块解析、Lint 与格式化等能力。它是 VoidZero 统一高性能 JS 工具链愿景的一部分，为 Rolldown（Vite 的打包器）等新一代工具提供底层支持。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Parser、Transformer、Minifier、Resolver 等核心 crate，以及可直接使用的 Oxlint 与 Oxfmt 命令行工具，并配有官网文档、Playground 与贡献指南。
zh.stack: 核心使用 Rust 编写，通过 npx 即可调用 Oxlint/Oxfmt，依赖较少且强调性能，采用 MIT 许可并配有 CI、覆盖率与 CodSpeed 基准测试。
zh.hot: 凭借 22,784 颗星与 Rust 日榜第 8 的成绩，Oxc 因被 Rolldown、Nuxt、Preact、Shopify、字节跳动等广泛采用而持续走红，代表了 JS 工具链 Rust 化的趋势。
uses: 前端/Node.js 开发者，希望用更快的 Lint 与格式化替代 ESLint/Prettier
构建工具与打包器作者，需要高性能的 JS/TS 解析、转换与压缩能力
Vite/Rolldown 生态用户，想体验下一代超快开发工具链
Rust 开发者，对用 Rust 重写前端基础设施感兴趣并参与贡献

en.tag: A high-performance JavaScript/TypeScript toolchain written in Rust
en.what: Oxc (The Oxidation Compiler) is a collection of high-performance JavaScript and TypeScript tools written in Rust, covering parsing, transformation, minification, module resolution, linting and formatting. It is part of VoidZero's vision for a unified, high-performance JS toolchain and powers Rolldown (Vite's bundler) and other next-generation tools.
en.content: The repo contains core crates such as Parser, Transformer, Minifier and Resolver, plus ready-to-use CLI tools Oxlint and Oxfmt, along with website docs, a playground and contribution guides.
en.stack: Written in Rust, with Oxlint/Oxfmt invocable via npx; it has minimal dependencies and a performance focus, MIT-licensed with CI, coverage and CodSpeed benchmarks.
en.hot: With 22,784 stars and #8 on the Rust daily trending list, Oxc stays hot thanks to adoption by Rolldown, Nuxt, Preact, Shopify and ByteDance, representing the Rust-ification trend of the JS toolchain.
uses: Frontend/Node.js developers wanting faster linting and formatting than ESLint/Prettier
Build tool and bundler authors needing high-performance JS/TS parsing, transformation and minification
Vite/Rolldown ecosystem users eager to try the next-gen ultra-fast toolchain
Rust developers interested in rewriting frontend infrastructure and contributing

zh.tag: 零配置的终端 IDE，融合 VS Code 与 Sublime 的体验
zh.what: Fresh 是一款现代、功能全面的终端文本编辑器，主打零配置，提供熟悉的快捷键、鼠标支持和 IDE 级功能，无需学习曲线。它专为处理超大文件而优化，性能卓越。
zh.content: 仓库包含编辑器核心代码、安装脚本、文档和演示 GIF，涵盖命令面板、多光标编辑、主题定制、LSP 支持、Orchestrator 多任务等功能。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和 LSP 协议实现，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 本月新增 607 星，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 榜第 14 名。其零配置、易用性和高性能吸引了大量开发者，尤其是对终端编辑器感兴趣的用户。
uses: 适合喜欢在终端中工作但不想学习复杂快捷键的开发者，如 Vim/Emacs 新手。
需要处理超大文件（如日志文件）的开发者，Fresh 能高效加载。
希望获得 IDE 级功能（如 LSP、多光标）但偏好轻量级工具的用户。
对 Rust 和终端 UI 开发感兴趣的贡献者。

en.tag: Zero-config terminal IDE blending VS Code & Sublime UX
en.what: Fresh is a modern, full-featured terminal text editor with zero configuration, offering familiar keybindings, mouse support, and IDE-level features without a learning curve. It is optimized for handling huge files with high performance.
en.content: The repository includes the editor's core code, installation scripts, documentation, and demo GIFs, featuring command palette, multi-cursor editing, themes, LSP support, and the Orchestrator for multitasking.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and LSP protocol, cross-platform.
en.hot: Gained 607 stars this month, ranking #14 on GitHub Trending Rust. Its zero-config, ease of use, and high performance attract developers, especially terminal editor enthusiasts.
uses: Developers who prefer terminal work but dislike steep learning curves, e.g., Vim/Emacs beginners.
Those handling huge files (e.g., logs) that need efficient loading.
Users wanting IDE-level features (LSP, multi-cursor) in a lightweight tool.
Contributors interested in Rust and terminal UI development.

zh.tag: 基于 GPUI 的 Rust 跨平台桌面 UI 组件库
zh.what: GPUI Kit 是一个用于构建高性能跨平台桌面应用的 Rust 框架，提供 60+ 生产级 UI 组件和完整的数据、布局、编辑能力。它基于 Zed 编辑器使用的 GPUI 构建，并支持 JavaScript 扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个子 crate：gpui-base（无样式行为、状态和基础设施）、gpui-shell（JavaScript 扩展）、gpui-component（完整样式化 UI 系统）。主 crate 重新导出所有层，应用只需依赖 gpui-kit 即可。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 GPUI（Zed 编辑器使用的 GPU 加速 UI 框架），支持 macOS、Windows、Linux，集成 Tree-sitter、LSP 等。
zh.hot: 凭借 13.9K stars 和日增 179 登顶 Rust 日榜，因为它是首个将 GPUI 从 Zed 中解耦并打包成通用组件库的项目，填补了 Rust 桌面 UI 生态的空白。
uses: Rust 开发者希望用 Rust 构建跨平台桌面应用，并追求高性能和原生体验。
需要数据表格、虚拟列表、代码编辑器等复杂组件的桌面应用开发场景。
希望复用 Zed 编辑器 UI 能力但不想直接依赖 Zed 的团队。
对 GPUI 感兴趣，想学习其架构或基于 gpui-base 自定义 UI 系统的开发者。

en.tag: Rust desktop UI component library built on GPUI for cross-platform apps
en.what: GPUI Kit is a Rust framework for building high-performance cross-platform desktop apps, offering 60+ production-ready UI components and full data, layout, and editing capabilities. It is built on GPUI, the UI framework used by Zed editor, and supports JavaScript extensions.
en.content: The repo contains three sub-crates: gpui-base (unstyled behavior, state, and infrastructure), gpui-shell (JavaScript extensions), and gpui-component (complete styled UI system). The main crate re-exports all layers, so apps only need to depend on gpui-kit.
en.stack: Built on Rust and GPUI (GPU-accelerated UI framework used by Zed editor), supports macOS, Windows, Linux, integrates Tree-sitter, LSP, etc.
en.hot: With 13.9K stars and +179 today, it tops the Rust daily chart as the first project to decouple GPUI from Zed and package it as a general-purpose component library, filling a gap in the Rust desktop UI ecosystem.
uses: Rust developers who want to build cross-platform desktop apps with high performance and native feel.
Desktop app development requiring complex components like data tables, virtual lists, and code editors.
Teams that want to reuse Zed's UI capabilities without depending on Zed directly.
Developers interested in GPUI, learning its architecture, or building custom UI systems on gpui-base.

zh.tag: Rust 编写、极速的 DataFrame 查询引擎
zh.what: Polars 是一个用 Rust 从零构建的分析型 DataFrame 查询引擎，主打速度、易用与表达力。它支持惰性与即时执行、查询自动优化，并能通过流式引擎处理超出内存的数据集。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心引擎及 Python、Node.js、R、SQL 等多语言绑定，配套用户指南、插件系统（I/O 与表达式插件）以及面向 AI 代理的 Skill 和 MCP 集成。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写，采用多线程、向量化（SIMD）执行，基于 Apache Arrow 列式格式实现零拷贝互操作，并可选支持 NVIDIA GPU 加速。
zh.hot: 近 4 万 star 且本月再增 439，位列 GitHub Trending Rust 月榜第 19 名，反映出数据社区对高性能、内存友好型 DataFrame 引擎的持续追捧。
uses: 数据科学家与分析工程师，用更快的 DataFrame 替代 pandas 处理大规模数据
需要处理超出内存数据集的团队，借助流式引擎与惰性查询优化
Rust/Node.js/R 开发者，希望在各自语言中直接使用高性能查询引擎
构建 AI 代理或数据管道的开发者，可接入其 Skill 与 MCP 集成

en.tag: Extremely fast DataFrame query engine written in Rust
en.what: Polars is an analytical DataFrame query engine built from the ground up in Rust, designed to be fast, easy to use and expressive. It supports lazy and eager execution with out-of-the-box query optimization, and its streaming engine handles datasets larger than RAM.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core engine plus multi-language bindings for Python, Node.js, R and SQL, along with a user guide, a plugin system (I/O and expression plugins), and Skill/MCP integrations for AI agents.
en.stack: The core is written in Rust with multi-threaded, vectorized (SIMD) execution, uses the Apache Arrow columnar format for zero-copy interoperability, and optionally supports NVIDIA GPU acceleration.
en.hot: With nearly 40k stars and 439 added this month, ranking 19th on GitHub's monthly Rust trending list, it reflects the data community's sustained demand for a high-performance, memory-friendly DataFrame engine.
uses: Data scientists and analytics engineers replacing pandas with a faster DataFrame for large-scale data
Teams handling larger-than-RAM datasets via the streaming engine and lazy query optimization
Rust/Node.js/R developers wanting a high-performance query engine natively in their language
Developers building AI agents or data pipelines who can plug into its Skill and MCP integrations

zh.tag: 纯 Rust 的即时模式 GUI 库，Web 与原生通吃
zh.what: egui 是一个用纯 Rust 编写的简单、快速、高度可移植的即时模式 GUI 库。它既能跑在 Web 上，也能原生运行于 Linux、Mac、Windows、Android，还能嵌入各种游戏引擎。官方框架 eframe 让开发者用同一套代码构建跨平台应用。
zh.content: 仓库以 Rust crate 形式组织，核心是 egui 库，配套官方框架 eframe，另有 examples/ 示例目录、集成适配层以及文档与 Discord 社区。
zh.stack: 纯 Rust 实现，禁止 unsafe，依赖极少；通过 eframe 支持 Web（WASM）、桌面与 Android，可对接 wgpu/glow 等渲染后端。
zh.hot: 已积累约 30,602 颗星，本月新增 573，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 第 23 名；Rust GUI 生态长期缺位，egui 以易用和跨平台成为热门选择。
uses: Rust 开发者想快速给自己的工具或原型加上图形界面
需要一套代码同时发布 Web 与桌面应用的团队
游戏或引擎开发者想在渲染循环里嵌入调试/编辑器 UI
对 unsafe 敏感、追求内存安全 GUI 方案的项目

en.tag: An easy-to-use immediate mode GUI in pure Rust, running on both web and native
en.what: egui is a simple, fast and highly portable immediate mode GUI library written in pure Rust. It runs on the web, natively on Linux/Mac/Windows/Android, and inside your favorite game engine. The official eframe framework lets you build cross-platform apps from a single codebase.
en.content: The repo is organized as Rust crates: the core egui library, the official eframe framework, an examples/ folder, integration adapters, plus docs and a Discord community.
en.stack: Pure Rust with unsafe forbidden and minimal dependencies; eframe targets Web (WASM), desktop and Android, and can plug into renderers like wgpu/glow.
en.hot: It has around 30,602 stars with 573 added this month, ranking 23rd on GitHub Trending's monthly Rust list; with Rust's GUI ecosystem long underserved, egui stands out for ease of use and portability.
uses: Rust developers who want to quickly add a GUI to tools or prototypes
Teams that need one codebase shipping both web and desktop apps
Game or engine developers embedding debug/editor UI in the render loop
Projects sensitive to unsafe code that want a memory-safe GUI solution

zh.tag: 命令行下载 App Store 的 ipa 包工具
zh.what: ipatool 是一个命令行工具，允许用户从 App Store 搜索 iOS、iPadOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用，并下载其 ipa 文件。它支持认证、搜索、购买和列出已购应用等操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具源码，提供 auth、search、purchase、list-purchases 等子命令，支持文本和 JSON 输出格式，并附带演示 GIF 和详细文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 App Store 的 API，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，可通过 Homebrew 安装。
zh.hot: 该工具为开发者和安全研究人员提供了便捷的 ipa 下载方式，在 GitHub 上获得 1 万+ star，今日新增 58 个，登上日榜第 8 名。
uses: iOS 开发者需要获取 ipa 包进行测试或分析
安全研究人员分析应用包内容
需要备份或归档 App Store 应用的用户

en.tag: CLI tool to search and download ipa packages from App Store
en.what: ipatool is a command-line tool that allows users to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS apps on the App Store and download their ipa files. It supports authentication, searching, purchasing, and listing purchased apps.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of a Go-based CLI tool with subcommands like auth, search, purchase, and list-purchases, supporting text and JSON output formats, along with a demo GIF and detailed documentation.
en.stack: Developed in Go, it relies on the App Store API and supports Windows, Linux, and macOS, installable via Homebrew.
en.hot: This tool provides a convenient way for developers and security researchers to download ipa files, gaining over 10k stars on GitHub with 58 new stars today, ranking 8th on the daily trending list.
uses: iOS developers needing ipa packages for testing or analysis
Security researchers analyzing app package contents
Users who want to back up or archive App Store apps

zh.tag: 自托管信息聚合仪表盘，把所有订阅源集中到一个页面
zh.what: Glance 是一个轻量、高度可定制的自托管仪表盘，把 RSS、Reddit、Hacker News、YouTube、Twitch、天气、股价、Docker 状态和服务器指标等各类信息流汇聚到统一界面。它通过 YAML 配置文件定义页面与小组件，支持多标签页、自定义 CSS 和主题，并针对移动端做了优化。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的服务端源码、docs 下的配置与主题文档、预配置页面示例、Logo 与截图资源，以及社区小组件仓库的链接。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，前端使用极简的原生 JavaScript，配置采用 YAML，可编译为小于 20MB 的单文件二进制，并提供同样小巧的 Docker 镜像。
zh.hot: 凭借 37090 颗星和本月新增 756 星登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Go 语言第 4 名，其低内存占用、少依赖和高度可定制的特性正好契合自托管社区对轻量聚合面板的需求。
uses: 自托管爱好者：想把 RSS、社交动态和服务器状态集中到一个私人主页
家庭实验室与 Homelab 用户：需要监控 Docker 容器和服务器指标
注重隐私的用户：不希望依赖第三方在线仪表盘服务
移动端用户：希望在手机上随时查看个性化信息流

en.tag: A self-hosted dashboard that puts all your feeds in one place
en.what: Glance is a lightweight, highly customizable self-hosted dashboard that aggregates RSS, Reddit, Hacker News, YouTube, Twitch, weather, market prices, Docker container status, and server stats into one unified interface. It uses YAML configuration to define pages and widgets, supports multiple tabs, custom CSS and themes, and is optimized for mobile devices.
en.content: The repo contains the Go server source code, configuration and theme docs under docs/, preconfigured page examples, logo and screenshot assets, plus links to the community widgets repository.
en.stack: Written in Go with minimal vanilla JavaScript on the frontend, configured via YAML, and shipped as a single sub-20MB binary plus an equally small Docker image.
en.hot: With 37,090 stars and 756 added this month, it ranks 4th on the GitHub Trending monthly Go list, as its low memory usage, few dependencies, and high customizability match the self-hosting community's demand for a lightweight aggregation panel.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts who want RSS, social feeds, and server status on one private homepage
Homelab users who need to monitor Docker containers and server metrics
Privacy-conscious users who prefer not to rely on third-party online dashboards
Mobile users who want to check a personalized feed on the go

zh.tag: 用命令行自动化 App Store Connect 全流程的 Go 工具
zh.what: 这是一个用 Go 编写的 App Store Connect 命令行工具，把 TestFlight、构建、提交审核、签名、分析、截图、订阅管理等 iOS/macOS/tvOS/visionOS 发布流程搬到终端里。它面向脚本和 CI/CD 设计，可以在 IDE、流水线或本地一键完成原本要在网页后台反复点击的操作。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Go 实现的 asc 命令，包含大量子命令与文档；还提供 asc install-skills 安装 25 个 Agent Skills，把常见工作流封装成可复用的技能包，并附带 Homebrew、安装脚本和 WinGet 等分发方式。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，通过 go.mod 管理依赖，提供 Homebrew、curl 安装脚本和 WinGet 等安装方式，并支持作为 Agent Skills 集成到 AI 编码助手。
zh.hot: 本周新增 663 star、总数达 7232，并登上 GitHub Trending Go 周榜第 4 名。它切中了 iOS 开发者对发布流程自动化的刚需，加上 Agent Skills 与 CI/CD 场景的契合，热度快速攀升。
uses: iOS/macOS 开发者：想把 TestFlight、构建和提交审核从网页后台搬到命令行
DevOps/CI 工程师：需要在流水线中自动完成签名、上传和发布
使用 AI 编码助手的团队：通过 asc install-skills 把发布流程变成可复用技能
独立开发者与小团队：希望用脚本减少 App Store Connect 上的重复手工操作

en.tag: A fast, scriptable Go CLI for automating the App Store Connect API
en.what: A Go-based CLI for the App Store Connect API that automates TestFlight, builds, submissions, signing, analytics, screenshots, subscriptions and more across iOS, macOS, tvOS and visionOS. It is built for scripting and CI/CD, letting you run release workflows from a terminal, IDE or pipeline instead of the web dashboard.
en.content: The repo centers on the Go-based asc command with many subcommands and docs, plus asc install-skills which installs 25 agent skills for common workflows. It also ships Homebrew, install-script and WinGet distribution paths.
en.stack: Written in Go with go.mod, distributed via Homebrew, a curl install script and WinGet, and integrable as Agent Skills for AI coding assistants.
en.hot: It gained 663 stars this week for a total of 7,232, ranking 4th on GitHub Trending's weekly Go chart. It hits a real pain point in iOS release automation, and its Agent Skills plus CI/CD fit are driving rapid adoption.
uses: iOS/macOS developers who want TestFlight, builds and submissions in the terminal instead of the web UI
DevOps/CI engineers automating signing, uploads and releases in pipelines
Teams using AI coding assistants that want release workflows as reusable skills via asc install-skills
Indie developers and small teams looking to script away repetitive App Store Connect chores

zh.tag: 基于 Envoy 的 AI 与 Agent 流量开源控制平面
zh.what: Agent Router 为应用团队提供统一、兼容 OpenAI 的 API，用来访问托管模型、自托管推理和 MCP 服务器等各类模型与工具。平台团队则通过它集中管理凭证、路由、配额、故障转移和用量归因，由 Envoy 与 Envoy Gateway 实际执行。
zh.content: 仓库包含控制平面组件、CLI（aigw）、CRD 定义（AIGatewayRoute、AIServiceBackend、BackendSecurityPolicy 等）以及文档站点，支持本地单机运行和 Kubernetes 部署。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，构建在 Envoy 与 Envoy Gateway 之上，遵循 Apache 2.0 许可，提供 Helm charts 与容器镜像。
zh.hot: 作为 Envoy AI Gateway 更名后的 Agentic AI Foundation 项目，它延续原有代码与维护者，本月新增 188 star，总数达 2116，登上 GitHub Go 月榜第 6 名。
uses: 需要统一接入多家模型供应商的应用开发团队
负责 AI 网关、配额与故障转移的平台工程团队
在 Kubernetes 上部署自托管推理服务并需要精细流量控制的运维人员
希望用兼容 OpenAI 接口快速本地试验多种模型的开发者

en.tag: The open source control plane for AI and agent traffic, powered by Envoy
en.what: Agent Router gives application teams one consistent, OpenAI-compatible API for every model and tool, from hosted providers to self-hosted inference and MCP servers. Platform teams keep credentials, routing, quotas, failover, and usage attribution in one place, enforced by Envoy and Envoy Gateway.
en.content: The repo contains control plane components, the aigw CLI, CRD definitions (AIGatewayRoute, AIServiceBackend, BackendSecurityPolicy, etc.), and a documentation site, supporting both local standalone runs and Kubernetes deployments.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on Envoy and Envoy Gateway, licensed under Apache 2.0, and shipped with Helm charts and container images.
en.hot: As the renamed Agentic AI Foundation project formerly known as Envoy AI Gateway, it keeps the same code and maintainers, gaining 188 stars this month for a total of 2,116 and ranking 6th on GitHub's monthly Go trending list.
uses: Application teams needing unified access to multiple model providers
Platform engineering teams managing AI gateways, quotas, and failover
Operators deploying self-hosted inference on Kubernetes with fine-grained traffic control
Developers wanting to quickly test multiple models locally via an OpenAI-compatible API

zh.tag: 自托管网页文件管理器，功能强大且免费
zh.what: FileBrowser Quantum 是一个自托管的网页文件管理器，让用户通过浏览器轻松访问和管理文件。它提供现代响应式界面，支持用户管理、访问控制、文件分享、预览和编辑等高级功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的文件浏览器应用，支持多源配置、OIDC/LDAP/JWT 等多种登录方式，以及实时搜索、缩略图（办公、视频、专辑封面、3D模型）等功能。提供 config.yaml 配置文件和 Docker 镜像。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖前端技术（如 JavaScript/CSS）构建响应式界面，支持 Docker 部署，并集成多种认证协议（OIDC, LDAP, JWT）。
zh.hot: 本月新增 488 星，总星数达 8168，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 21 名。作为 filebrowser 的大幅改进分支，它提供了更丰富的功能和更好的用户体验，且完全免费开源，吸引了大量自托管用户。
uses: 个人用户：在家庭服务器或 NAS 上部署，随时随地通过浏览器管理文件。
团队协作：利用用户管理和分享功能，实现文件的安全共享与协作。
开发者：作为自托管文件管理解决方案，可集成到现有系统中，支持多种认证方式。
运维人员：通过 Docker 快速部署，提供轻量级文件访问入口。

en.tag: Powerful free self-hosted web file manager
en.what: FileBrowser Quantum is a self-hosted web-based file manager that allows users to easily access and manage files through a browser. It offers a modern responsive interface with advanced features for user management, access control, sharing, file preview, and editing.
en.content: The repository contains a full-featured file browser application with multi-source configuration, multiple login methods (OIDC, LDAP, JWT), real-time search, and thumbnails for office, video, album art, and 3D models. It includes a config.yaml file and Docker images.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with frontend technologies (JavaScript/CSS) for the responsive UI, supports Docker deployment, and integrates authentication protocols like OIDC, LDAP, and JWT.
en.hot: Gained 488 stars this month, reaching 8,168 total, ranking #21 on the Go trending list. As a massive fork of filebrowser with enhanced features and UX, it attracts many self-hosters due to being free and open-source.
uses: For individuals: deploy on home servers or NAS to manage files from anywhere via browser.
For teams: use user management and sharing features for secure file collaboration.
For developers: integrate as a self-hosted file management solution with multiple auth methods.
For admins: quick Docker deployment for a lightweight file access point.

zh.tag: 开源 Linux 服务器管理面板，兼 AI 管理平台
zh.what: 1Panel 是一个现代开源的 Linux 服务器管理面板，提供直观的 Web 界面来管理服务器、网站、数据库、容器等。它还集成了轻量级 AI 管理功能，支持部署和管理 AI 应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的面板源码、文档（多语言）、安装脚本、Docker 镜像配置等。主要目录包括 cmd、frontend、backend、docs 等。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 语言，前端采用 Vue.js，依赖 Docker 和 Docker Compose 进行容器管理，支持多种数据库（如 MySQL、PostgreSQL）。
zh.hot: 1Panel 拥有超过 250 万自托管用户，GitHub 星标 36,831，本月新增 452，因其功能全面且易用而广受欢迎。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队快速管理多台 Linux 服务器，无需命令行操作。
需要部署和管理 Docker 容器、网站、数据库的系统管理员。
希望轻松运行 AI 应用或模型，并集成到服务器管理中的用户。
教育或学习用途，用于理解服务器管理面板的架构与实现。

en.tag: Open-source Linux server management panel with AI platform capabilities
en.what: 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel offering an intuitive web interface to manage servers, websites, databases, containers, and more. It also integrates lightweight AI management features for deploying and managing AI applications.
en.content: The repository contains full panel source code, multi-language documentation, installation scripts, Docker image configurations, etc. Main directories include cmd, frontend, backend, docs.
en.stack: Backend is written in Go, frontend uses Vue.js, relies on Docker and Docker Compose for container management, supports multiple databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL).
en.hot: With over 2.5M self-hosters and 36,831 GitHub stars (452 added this month), 1Panel is popular for its comprehensive features and ease of use.
uses: Individual developers or small teams quickly manage multiple Linux servers without CLI operations.
System administrators needing to deploy and manage Docker containers, websites, and databases.
Users who want to easily run AI applications or models integrated into server management.
Educational or learning purposes to understand the architecture of a server management panel.

zh.tag: 为 Web 应用提供单点登录与多因素认证的门户
zh.what: Authelia 是一个开源的身份认证服务器，为 Web 应用提供单点登录（SSO）和多因素认证（MFA）功能。它可作为反向代理的认证层，支持 LDAP、OIDC 等集成，并已通过 OpenID 认证，且为后量子密码学做好准备。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 语言编写的核心服务、命令行工具、配置示例、文档站点（authelia.com）以及用于构建和测试的 CI/CD 配置。代码结构清晰，包含认证、授权、会话管理等模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种 Go 库，支持 LDAP、OIDC、TOTP、U2F 等协议。前端可能涉及少量 JavaScript，用于登录页面。
zh.hot: 本月新增 359 星，总星数达 2.88 万，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 10。其安全性和对现代认证标准的支持吸引了大量自托管和隐私敏感用户。
uses: 自托管服务（如 Nextcloud、Grafana）的统一登录与二次验证
企业或团队内部应用的单点登录，集成现有 LDAP 或 OIDC
希望为 Web 应用添加安全认证层，但不希望使用商业 SSO 的开发者
对后量子密码学感兴趣，希望提前适配未来安全标准的技术团队

en.tag: Single Sign-On and Multi-Factor Authentication portal for web apps
en.what: Authelia is an open-source authentication server providing Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for web applications. It acts as an authentication layer for reverse proxies, integrates with LDAP and OIDC, and is OpenID Certified and Post-Quantum Cryptography Ready.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based core service, command-line tools, configuration examples, documentation site (authelia.com), and CI/CD setup for building and testing. The code is well-organized into modules for authentication, authorization, session management, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging various Go libraries. Supports LDAP, OIDC, TOTP, U2F, and other protocols. The frontend may include minimal JavaScript for the login page.
en.hot: With 359 new stars this month and a total of 28.8k stars, it ranks 10th on the Go trending list. Its security focus and support for modern auth standards attract many self-hosters and privacy-conscious users.
uses: Centralized login and 2FA for self-hosted services like Nextcloud and Grafana
SSO for internal enterprise apps, integrating with existing LDAP or OIDC
Developers wanting to add secure auth to web apps without commercial SSO
Tech teams interested in post-quantum cryptography readiness

zh.tag: 自托管的开源任务管理器，数据完全自主掌控
zh.what: Vikunja 是一个功能全面的任务管理工具，支持看板、列表、表格等多种视图，以及团队协作、时间跟踪、文件附件等特性。它强调用户对数据的完全掌控，可自托管部署，也提供云端托管服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含后端服务（Go 编写）、前端 Web 应用、桌面客户端（Electron）以及移动端应用（通过 Flutter 实现），并提供完整的 API 文档和安装指南。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 语言，支持 SQLite、PostgreSQL 和 MySQL 数据库；前端基于 Vue.js，桌面端使用 Electron，移动端使用 Flutter。
zh.hot: 本周新增 78 星，总星数 5258，位列 Go 语言周榜第 19 名。其自托管、数据自主的理念受到关注，且项目活跃，持续迭代。
uses: 个人用户希望完全掌控自己的任务数据，避免依赖第三方云服务
团队需要自建任务管理系统，并希望有看板、时间跟踪等高级功能
开发者想研究 Go 后端与前端分离的完整项目架构

en.tag: Self-hosted open-source task manager with full data ownership
en.what: Vikunja is a feature-rich task manager supporting kanban, list, table views, team collaboration, time tracking, file attachments, and more. It emphasizes full data ownership, allowing self-hosting or using the hosted cloud service.
en.content: The repository includes a backend service written in Go, a frontend web app, a desktop client (Electron), and mobile apps (via Flutter), along with comprehensive API docs and installation guides.
en.stack: Backend in Go with SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL support; frontend built with Vue.js; desktop via Electron; mobile via Flutter.
en.hot: Gained 78 stars this week, total 5258, ranking #19 on the Go weekly trending. Its self-hosting and data ownership philosophy attracts attention, with active development.
uses: Individuals who want full control over their task data without relying on third-party cloud services
Teams needing a self-hosted task management system with advanced features like kanban and time tracking
Developers interested in studying a full-stack project with Go backend and separate frontend

zh.tag: 自建私有搜索引擎，索引浏览记录与本地文件
zh.what: Hister 是一个注重隐私的搜索引擎，可以索引你访问过的网页和本地文件的内容，支持全文搜索。它提供 Web 界面、终端界面和 MCP 接口，方便你随时找回信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web UI（基于 Svelte）、浏览器扩展（Firefox/Chrome）以及终端客户端。支持多用户、语义搜索、爬虫和浏览器历史导入。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 CGO（需要 C 编译器），Web 前端使用 npm 和 Svelte。
zh.hot: 今日新增 142 星，登上 Go 趋势榜第 4。在隐私担忧加剧的背景下，自托管搜索引擎需求上升，Hister 提供完整功能且易于部署。
uses: 注重隐私的个人用户，希望本地搜索自己的浏览历史和文件。
团队或组织，需要内部文档和网页的私有搜索解决方案。
开发者，希望集成 MCP 到 AI 助手，实现个性化信息检索。

en.tag: Self-hosted private search engine for your browsing history and local files
en.what: Hister is a privacy-focused search engine that indexes the full content of pages you visit and files you keep, enabling full-text search. It offers web, terminal, and MCP interfaces for easy information retrieval.
en.content: The repository includes a Go backend, a web UI (Svelte-based), browser extensions for Firefox/Chrome, and a terminal client. It supports multi-user, semantic search, crawler, and browser history import.
en.stack: Primarily Go, with CGO dependencies (requires C compiler), and npm/Svelte for the web frontend.
en.hot: Gained 142 stars today, ranking #4 on Go trending. Amid growing privacy concerns, self-hosted search engines are in demand, and Hister offers full features with easy deployment.
uses: Privacy-conscious individuals who want to search their browsing history and files locally.
Teams or organizations needing a private search solution for internal documents and web pages.
Developers who want to integrate MCP into AI assistants for personalized information retrieval.

zh.tag: 终端里的 Winamp 风格音乐播放器，支持海量流媒体与本地音乐
zh.what: cliamp 是一个在终端中运行的复古风格音乐播放器，灵感来自 Winamp。它不仅能播放本地音乐文件，还支持 YouTube、Spotify、SoundCloud、Bilibili、网易云音乐等众多流媒体平台，以及 Navidrome、Plex、Jellyfin 等媒体服务器。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的终端播放器主程序，支持频谱可视化、参数均衡器和播放列表管理。还提供了 Android 移动客户端和安装脚本、Homebrew、AUR、Nix 等多种安装方式。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，基于 Bubbletea 和 Lip Gloss 构建 TUI，Beep 处理音频，go-librespot 支持 Spotify。依赖 ALSA（Linux）和 FLAC、Vorbis 等编解码库。
zh.hot: 凭借复古 Winamp 情怀与强大的多平台流媒体支持，cliamp 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 4220 颗星，本月新增 1100 星，位列 Go 趋势月榜第 14 名。
uses: 终端爱好者与复古 UI 粉丝 —— 在命令行中享受 Winamp 风格的播放体验。
需要统一播放多平台音乐的用户 —— 一个播放器搞定本地、流媒体和媒体服务器。
开发者与运维人员 —— 在编码或工作时用终端听音乐，不离开工作流。
Android 用户 —— 通过 cliamp mobile 在手机上收听广播、播客和相同服务器内容。

en.tag: A retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp, supporting local files and many streaming services.
en.what: cliamp is a retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp. It plays local files and streams from YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, Bilibili, NetEase Cloud Music, and many other services, as well as media servers like Navidrome, Plex, and Jellyfin.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based terminal player with a spectrum visualizer, parametric EQ, and playlist manager. It also offers an Android mobile client and multiple installation methods including script, Homebrew, AUR, and Nix.
en.stack: Built in Go with Bubbletea and Lip Gloss for TUI, Beep for audio, and go-librespot for Spotify. Depends on ALSA (Linux) and codec libraries like FLAC and Vorbis.
en.hot: With its retro Winamp nostalgia and extensive streaming support, cliamp has quickly gained popularity on GitHub, earning 4,220 stars with 1,100 added this month, ranking 14th on the Go trending monthly list.
uses: Terminal enthusiasts and retro UI fans — enjoy a Winamp-style player in the command line.
Users needing unified playback across platforms — one player for local, streaming, and media servers.
Developers and sysadmins — listen to music in the terminal without leaving the workflow.
Android users — use cliamp mobile to listen to radio, podcasts, and the same servers on phones.

zh.tag: 70 个网络安全实战项目与认证路线图，游戏化学习
zh.what: 这是一个面向网络安全学习者的项目合集，提供从零基础到高级的 70 个实战项目，并配有认证路线图和学习资源。任何人都可以跟着学、在此基础上扩展、当作参考，甚至直接复制使用。
zh.content: 仓库分为 PROJECTS、ROADMAPS、RESOURCES 三大板块：项目按 Foundations、Beginner、Intermediate、Advanced 四个难度层级组织，目前 42/70 已有完整源码；路线图覆盖 SOC 分析师、渗透测试、安全工程师等 10 条职业路径。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，项目涉及网络安全工具与脚本开发；仓库本身以 Markdown 文档、徽章和源码目录为主，依赖较少。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1987 星、总数达 7062，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Go 类第 15 名；结构化难度分级加认证路线图，正好切中安全初学者缺少系统实战路径的痛点。
uses: 网络安全初学者，想从零开始按难度递进做实战项目
准备 SOC、渗透测试等安全认证的考生，需要路线图指引
安全讲师或培训者，可直接引用或改编项目作为教学素材
想快速搭建安全工具原型的开发者，可参考或复制现成源码

Certification candidates for SOC, pentesting, and similar roles needing roadmap guidance

zh.tag: 云原生高性能向量数据库，支撑十亿级向量检索
zh.what: Milvus 是一个为大规模场景打造的高性能向量数据库，用于高效组织和检索文本、图像、多模态等非结构化数据，为 AI 应用提供底层检索能力。它支持单机 Standalone、轻量 Milvus Lite 以及全分布式 K8s 原生部署多种形态。

en.tag: Cloud-native high-performance vector database for billion-scale ANN search
en.what: Milvus is a high-performance vector database built for scale, organizing and searching large amounts of unstructured data such as text, images and multi-modal information to power AI applications. en.content: The repo contains the core database engine, distributed coordination and storage components, SDKs, deployment scripts (Docker/Helm), docs and tutorials, plus community channels like Slack and Discord.

en.hot: As key infrastructure for RAG and AI applications, Milvus has reached 46,122 stars, adding 536 this month and ranking 18th on GitHub Trending's monthly Go list, showing steady momentum.

Enterprise teams handling billions of vectors with high concurrency and low latency
Python users who want a quick pip-install vector search prototype
Platform engineers deploying cloud-native data infrastructure on Kubernetes

zh.tag: 通用代理平台，一站式网络代理工具箱
zh.what: sing-box 是一个用 Go 编写的通用代理平台，把多种代理协议、路由规则和入站出站能力统一到一个内核里。它既能当客户端也能当服务端，覆盖从个人翻墙到自建节点分发的常见需求。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 源码为主体，包含协议实现、配置解析、路由引擎与多平台构建脚本，配套文档托管在 sing-box.sagernet.org。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，采用模块化协议抽象与 JSON 配置，依赖较少，可交叉编译到 Linux、macOS、Windows、Android 与 iOS。
zh.hot: 作为新一代代理内核，它凭统一配置和活跃维护积累了 38092 颗星，本月再增 1147，稳居 Go 月榜第 17 名。
uses: 需要统一管理多种代理协议的自建节点用户
希望用单一内核替代多款代理客户端的进阶玩家
在路由器或服务器上部署透明代理的网络爱好者
关注代理内核实现、想二次开发或集成的开发者

en.tag: The universal proxy platform for all-in-one network proxying
en.what: sing-box is a universal proxy platform written in Go that unifies multiple proxy protocols, routing rules, and inbound/outbound capabilities into a single core. It works as both client and server, covering everything from personal circumvention to self-hosted node distribution.
en.content: The repo is mainly Go source code with protocol implementations, config parsing, a routing engine, and multi-platform build scripts, with docs hosted at sing-box.sagernet.org.
en.stack: Primarily Go with a modular protocol abstraction and JSON configuration, minimal dependencies, cross-compilable to Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and iOS.
en.hot: As a next-gen proxy core, its unified config and active maintenance have earned 38,092 stars, adding 1,147 this month and ranking 17th on the Go monthly trending list.
uses: Self-hosted node users who need to manage multiple proxy protocols in one place
Advanced users wanting a single core to replace several proxy clients
Network enthusiasts deploying transparent proxies on routers or servers
Developers interested in proxy core internals for integration or forks

zh.tag: 专为 Kubernetes 打造的不可变安全 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Talos Linux 是一个专为运行 Kubernetes 而设计的现代 Linux 发行版，主打安全、不可变与极简。它没有 shell 和交互式控制台，所有系统管理都通过 API 完成，并使用双向 TLS（mTLS）认证保护访问。

zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，深度集成 Kubernetes 与容器运行时，依赖 Linux 内核、mTLS 及不可变基础设施理念，采用原子更新机制。
zh.hot: 凭借 11143 颗星和本月新增 240 星登上 GitHub Go 月榜第 15 名，反映出社区对安全、可预测的 Kubernetes 底层操作系统的强烈需求。
uses: 运维与平台工程师：用于构建安全、不可变的 Kubernetes 节点
企业 IT 团队：需要减少配置漂移并简化集群升级
安全敏感场景：希望缩小攻击面并通过 API 管理主机
Kubernetes 爱好者：想体验无 shell 的极简操作系统

en.tag: A modern, immutable, secure Linux distribution built for Kubernetes
en.what: Talos Linux is a modern Linux distribution purpose-built for running Kubernetes, emphasizing security, immutability, and minimalism. It has no shell or interactive console; all system management is done via an API secured with mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication.
en.content: The repo contains the full source of the Talos OS written in Go, covering kernel configs, system services, the API layer, install/upgrade tooling, plus documentation and community files.
en.stack: Primarily built in Go, deeply integrated with Kubernetes and container runtimes, relying on the Linux kernel, mTLS, and immutable-infrastructure principles with atomic updates.
en.hot: With 11,143 stars and 240 added this month, ranking 15th on GitHub's monthly Go trending list, it reflects strong community demand for a secure, predictable Kubernetes OS.

Enterprise IT teams needing to reduce config drift and simplify cluster upgrades
Security-sensitive environments wanting a smaller attack surface and API-driven host management
Kubernetes enthusiasts curious about a minimal OS with no shell

zh.tag: Cloudflare Tunnel 官方命令行客户端，安全连接内网服务
zh.what: cloudflared 是 Cloudflare Tunnel 的守护进程和命令行客户端，它在 Cloudflare 网络与你的源站之间建立加密隧道，将外部请求代理到内部服务，无需在防火墙上开放端口。它还支持通过隧道访问 TCP 服务（如 SSH、RDP），并可与 WARP 客户端配合使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 cloudflared 的 Go 源代码、构建脚本、测试以及文档链接。主要功能分为隧道管理（cloudflared tunnel）和访问受保护服务（cloudflared access）。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Cloudflare 的 quic-go 等库，支持多种平台（Linux、macOS、Windows）和包格式（二进制、Docker、Debian、RPM、Homebrew）。
zh.hot: 作为 Cloudflare 官方隧道客户端，它解决了内网服务安全暴露的痛点，本月新增 446 stars，总 stars 达 15683，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜（Go）第 20 名。
uses: 运维工程师：安全地将内部 Web 服务发布到公网，无需开放防火墙端口
开发者：通过隧道远程访问家庭或办公室的 SSH、RDP 等 TCP 服务
企业 IT：结合 Cloudflare Zero Trust 实现私有应用的零信任访问

en.tag: Official CLI client for Cloudflare Tunnel, securely connecting private services
en.what: cloudflared is the daemon and command-line client for Cloudflare Tunnel, creating a secure tunnel between Cloudflare's network and your origin to proxy traffic without opening firewall ports. It also supports accessing TCP services (e.g., SSH, RDP) through tunnels and integrates with the WARP client.
en.content: The repository contains the Go source code for cloudflared, build scripts, tests, and documentation links. Main functionalities are divided into tunnel management (cloudflared tunnel) and accessing protected services (cloudflared access).
en.stack: Developed in Go, it depends on Cloudflare's quic-go and other libraries, supporting multiple platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows) and package formats (binary, Docker, Debian, RPM, Homebrew).
en.hot: As Cloudflare's official tunnel client, it addresses the pain point of securely exposing internal services, gaining 446 stars this month and reaching 15,683 total stars, ranking 20th on GitHub Trending monthly (Go).
uses: DevOps engineers: securely expose internal web services to the internet without opening firewall ports
Developers: remotely access SSH, RDP, and other TCP services at home or office via tunnels
Enterprise IT: implement zero-trust access to private applications with Cloudflare Zero Trust

zh.tag: 可编程的混合模型路由层，为异构 LLM 推理按需选路
zh.what: vLLM Semantic Router 是一个可编程路由层，用于构建跨异构 LLM 基础设施的 Mixture-of-Models 系统。它根据请求信号、用户偏好和应用策略，为每个请求选择或组合合适的模型路径，从而在不改动应用代码的前提下优化质量、成本、延迟、隐私与安全。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的路由核心、安装脚本（install.sh）、在线 Playground 与文档站点（website/），以及面向 Hugging Face 的模型资源与博客、论文等资料。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go 1.25，提供 curl 一键安装脚本，并支持 pip、uv 及 agent 驱动安装；配套在线 Playground、文档站与 Hugging Face 模型仓库。
zh.hot: 作为 vLLM 项目旗下新作，它切中多模型混用与异构推理的痛点，本周新增 181 star、总数达 5741，登上 GitHub Trending Go 周榜第 8 名。
uses: AI 平台工程师：需要在多模型、多算力间做统一路由与成本优化
应用开发者：希望不写死路由逻辑就能按用户偏好切换或组合模型
企业架构师：关注数据边界、隐私与安全合规的推理部署
研究者与爱好者：想体验可编程 Mixture-of-Models 路由的实验能力

en.tag: A programmable Mixture-of-Models routing layer for heterogeneous LLM inference
en.what: vLLM Semantic Router is a programmable routing layer for building Mixture-of-Models systems across heterogeneous LLM infrastructure. It evaluates request signals, user preferences, and application policies to select or compose the right model path per request, improving quality, cost, latency, privacy, and safety without hard-coding routing logic into applications.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based routing core, an install script (install.sh), an online playground and documentation site (website/), plus Hugging Face model assets, blog posts, and publications.

en.hot: As a new vLLM-project effort, it targets the pain of mixing multiple models and heterogeneous inference; it gained 181 stars this week to reach 5,741 total, ranking #8 on GitHub Trending's weekly Go chart.
uses: AI platform engineers: need unified routing and cost optimization across multiple models and compute
App developers: want to switch or compose models by user preference without hard-coding routing
Enterprise architects: care about data boundaries, privacy, and safety compliance in inference
Researchers and enthusiasts: want to experiment with programmable Mixture-of-Models routing

zh.tag: 轻量级服务器监控平台，支持 Docker 统计、历史数据与告警
zh.what: Beszel 是一个轻量级的服务器监控平台，提供 Docker 统计、历史数据和告警功能。它拥有友好的 Web 界面，配置简单，开箱即用，并支持自动备份、多用户、OAuth 认证和 API 访问。

zh.hot: 凭借轻量级、简单易用和丰富的功能（如 Docker 统计、告警、多用户）在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 282 颗星，总星数达 24,566，位列 Go 语言周榜第 9 名。

使用 Docker 运行多个容器的用户，希望跟踪每个容器的资源使用历史

en.tag: Lightweight server monitoring with Docker stats, history, and alerts
en.what: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform that includes Docker statistics, historical data, and alert functions. It has a friendly web interface, simple configuration, and is ready to use out of the box. It supports automatic backup, multi-user, OAuth authentication, and API access.

Users running multiple Docker containers who want to track resource usage history per container

zh.tag: 跨平台开源多轨音频编辑器与录音软件

en.what: Audacity is an easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder for Windows, macOS, GNU/Linux and other operating systems. It provides recording, editing, mixing, and effects processing, suitable for podcasting, music production, and audio restoration.

Music enthusiasts: perform simple recording, editing, and mixing, or restore old recordings.

zh.tag: 高性能内存数据存储，兼容 Redis 与 Memcached

对内存数据库内部实现感兴趣的 C++ 开发者，可阅读源码学习。

C++ developers interested in the internals of in-memory databases for learning.
